name: Celestial Strikes
summary: Your connection to good arms all your attacks against forces of evil.

name: Fiendish Strikes
summary: Your festering connection to the forces of evil infuses your weapons with debilitating malevolence, tearing down creatures of good with every attack.

name: Eye for Treasure
summary: You know good artisanship when you see it and can wax poetic about crafting techniques and forms.

name: Sheltering Slab
summary: The stone around you is your ally, and you have learned to use it to shore up your weaknesses.

name: Returning Throw
summary: You have mastered the technique of arcing a projectile so that it returns to your hand after being thrown, though this requires a moment to precisely calculate the trajectory and possible ricochets.

name: Ancestral Linguistics
summary: Over your extensive lifespan, you've studied many languages.

name: Elven Aloofness
summary: As much as you might care for them, you've come to terms with the ephemeral nature of non-elves, and it makes their threats feel less troublesome.

name: Know Your Own
summary: You've spent countless hours studying the history of elves on your world and beyond and are a studied expert in your people's ways.

name: Empathetic Plea
summary: The way you cringe or use those puppydog eyes you've been practicing elicits an empathetic response in the attacker.

name: Extra Squishy
summary: Your rubbery physique makes it easier for you to wedge yourself into tight spaces and more difficult for your enemies to dislodge you.

name: Twitchy
summary: You are naturally suspicious and wary of danger, especially when you suspect someone might be leading you into an ambush.

name: Pinch Time
summary: One of your parents has a human life span and another an elven life span, with your own somewhere between.

name: Wortwitch
summary: You have a particular affinity for leafy plants.

name: Improved Familiar (Witch)
summary: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side.

name: Familiar's Eyes
summary: You use your familiar's senses as easily as your own.

name: Demolition Charge
summary: You can rig your bombs to inanimate objects in order to cause destruction to the surrounding area.

name: Perpetual Breadth
summary: You have expanded your supply of near-infinite items.

name: Determined Dash
summary: Nothing can keep you from your enemy.

name: Conceited Mindset
summary: Because you know your mind is superior, you scoff at anyone who would alter your mental state—but this hubris gets the better of you when you're wrong.

name: Accelerating Touch
summary: Your healing energies are infused with bounding energy.

name: Corrupted Shield
summary: Your shield ally is more than just a spirit of protection— it's a conduit for deadly divine magic.

name: Invigorating Mercy
summary: Your divine touch rejuvenates the weak and tired.

name: Sacrifice Armor
summary: With divine awareness, you twist your body to lessen the impact of an attack.

name: Elucidating Mercy
summary: Your mercy grants clarity to those around you just when they need it most.

name: Litany of Self-Interest
summary: You compel a creature to act toward its own ends rather than consider others.

name: Resilient Touch
summary: Your healing energies create an aura of protection that defends your allies against more than just blades and arrows.

name: Amplifying Touch
summary: Your healing energies empower attacks.

name: Aura of Preservation
summary: Your aura protects against the twisting powers of aberrations.

name: Greater Interpose
summary: Your divine grace empowers you to avoid hits when you otherwise could not.

name: Litany of Depravity
summary: You undercut your enemy's vain moralism, opening their heart to evil.

name: Fiendish Mount
summary: Your steed ally manifests a suite of powerful and sinister gifts granted to it by your deity.

name: Through Spell
summary: Spells you cast can transform briefly into vital essence, traveling harmlessly through living and undead creatures between you and your target, blocked only by solid objects.

name: Dragging Strike
summary: You aim your weapon to snag a foe's armor, clothing, or flesh to pull them closer.

name: Gorilla Stance
summary: You lower yourself to the ground and take an imposing, knuckle-walking stance.

name: Peafowl Stance
summary: You enter a tall and proud stance while remaining mobile, with all the grace and composure of a peafowl.

name: Gorilla Pound
summary: You pound your chest before slamming into your foes.

name: Peafowl Strut
summary: You slowly move across the battlefield with dangerous grace.

name: Flinging Blow
summary: You take a moment to center yourself, then unleash a powerful blow that sends your target tumbling away.

name: Ki Form
summary: You have mastered a potent technique for using your ki to reinforce your physical form and propel yourself through the air.

name: Deadly Strikes
summary: You have honed your body to attack with lethal focus.

name: Snare Hopping
summary: You can magically move your snares around.

name: Accurate Flurry
summary: You refine the precision of your unbelievable storm of blows.

name: Impossible Snares
summary: You can create endless shorter-lived snares, protecting your lair or using them against foes.

name: Loaner Spell
prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
summary: During your daily preparations, you can gain the assistance of an allied prepared spellcaster to prepare one spell for the day.

name: Eldritch Debilitations
summary: You know how to apply debilitations that are particularly troublesome for spellcasters.

name: Steal Spell
summary: When you use Legendary Thief to steal the impossible, you can steal a prepared spell or spontaneous spell from a foe.

name: Ancestral Blood Magic
summary: The magic of your bloodline mixes with that of your ancestry.

name: Entreat with Forebears
prerequisite: a bloodline that corresponds with a creature trait
summary: Something about your presence causes creatures of your bloodline to, consciously or not, recognize you as one of their own, and you become inured to their tricks.

name: Elaborate Flourish
summary: You embellish your spellcasting with entrancing flourishes and grand pronouncements, making it harder to identify or counter.

name: Energetic Resonance
summary: Your blood resonates with magical energy, mitigating the effects of harmful spells.

name: Ancestral Mage
summary: The magic of your ancestry and bloodline are one and the same.

name: Blood Component Substitution
summary: You can bypass the need for incantations and gestures by drawing energy directly from your blood, causing you to visibly glow the color of your blood and crackle with magical energy.

name: Terraforming Spell
summary: You capture transformative fragments of magic and slam them into the ground, creating a shock wave that alters your surroundings.

name: Advanced Bow Training
summary: Through constant practice and the crucible of experience, you increase your skill with advanced bows.

name: Heal Animal
summary: You can heal your animal companion's wounds.

name: Dragon Disciple Dedication
summary: You choose to study or worship one type of dragon, and your focus grants you a measure of its power.

name: Claws of the Dragon
summary: Your fingernails grow into razor-sharp claws, and scales speckle your fingers, hands, and wrists.

name: Draconic Scent
summary: Your sense of smell is uncanny, much like a dragon's.

name: Dragon Arcana
prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots; Dragon Disciple Dedication
summary: You've discovered how to add the magic of dragons to your tradition.

name: Scales of the Dragon
summary: Scales grow across your body, protecting you against physical and magical threats.

name: Breath of the Dragon
summary: You can use a powerful breath weapon, much like the dragon you emulate.

name: Wings of the Dragon
summary: You can manifest draconic wings to soar through the air at great speed.

name: Shape of the Dragon
summary: You've discovered how to transform yourself into a dragon.

name: Disciple's Breath
prerequisite: Dragon Disciple Dedication; _dragon breath_ sorcerer bloodline spell
summary: You unleash your breath weapon without spending focus.

name: Mighty Dragon Shape
summary: You've practiced and increased your draconic might, allowing you to take your draconic form more often.

name: Horizon Walker Dedication
summary: You've mastered travel within a specific type of terrain.

name: Acclimatization
summary: Your time spent in the hostile parts of the world has inured you to extreme climates.

name: Sure Foot
prerequisite: Horizon Walker Dedication; Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Athletics
summary: You know the secrets of moving in your favored terrain.

name: Perpetual Scout
summary: You spot anything out of place in the areas you know best.

name: Magical Adaptation
summary: When an obstacle bars your path, you pull a trick from your sleeve to overcome it.

name: Wild Strider
summary: Natural obstacles pose no obstacle to you.

name: Loremaster Dedication
prerequisite: trained in at least one skill to Decipher Writing
summary: You've compiled a vast repository of information that touches on nearly every subject.

name: Magical Edification
summary: You've learned those tidbits of magic that are most conducive to furthering your acquisition and transmission of knowledge.

name: Orthographic Mastery
summary: You understand the principles that underlie all written words, allowing you to read nearly any text.

name: Quick Study
summary: During your daily preparations, you can study a particular subject to gain the trained proficiency rank in one Lore skill of your choice.

name: Greater Magical Edification
summary: You've continued to expand your compendium of tools to compile knowledge.

name: Shadowdancer Dedication
prerequisite: Master in Stealth; Expert in Performance
summary: You dedicate yourself to the shadows.

name: Shadow Sneak Attack
summary: You gain the sneak attack class feature, except you deal 1d6 precision damage regardless of your level.

name: Shadow Magic
summary: You gain the ability to fuse and play with shadows by using focus spells specific to shadowdancers.

name: Additional Shadow Magic
summary: Choose an additional shadowdancer focus spell you haven't already selected from Shadow Magic.

name: Shadow Illusion
summary: With an artful eye, you shape shadows into illusory forms.

name: Shadow Power
summary: You can focus the shadows into a powerful blast.

name: Shadow Master
summary: The shadows protect you better than any armor can, and they give you power to plunge others into darkness.

name: Hireling Manager
summary: Hirelings gain +2 to skill checks.

name: Skitter
summary: Crawl up to half your Speed.

name: Artokus's Fire
summary: Artokus developed a mixture of volatile materials that burns hotter and longer than typical alchemist's fire.

name: Wish Alchemy
summary: You have learned Artokus Kirran's most hidden secrets, granting you the ability to create alchemy infused with the power of wishes.

name: Azaersi's Roads
summary: Azaersi has granted you limited access to the Stone Roads, attuning you to the tiniest sliver of the _Onyx Key_.

name: Flamboyant Cruelty
summary: You love to kick your enemies when they're down, and you look fabulous when you do.

name: Janatimo's Lessons
summary: Thanks to Janatimo's secret techniques, you can weave your knowledge and words into powerful tools to assist your allies in life-threatening situations.

name: Rescuer's Press
summary: Any shield you wield gains the shove trait.

name: Shall Not Falter, Shall Not Rout
summary: You gain the _shall not falter, shall not rout_ focus spell.

name: Vigil's Walls Rise Anew!
summary: You can train your allies to Raise a Shield on your order

name: Medical Researcher
summary: Kassi has taught you not only how to apply medicines with your medical skills but how to craft them as well.

name: Paragon Battle Medicine
summary: Kassi Aziril taught you her techniques that originated the modern use of Battle Medicine.

name: Bright Lion Dedication
prerequisite: member of the Bright Lions; not a worshipper of Walkena; Trained in Stealth
summary: You are one of the Bright Lions, part revolutionary warrior, part undercover spy.
source: Pathfinder #172: Secrets of the Temple City pg. 79, Legends pg. 101

name: Warding Light
summary: You gain a tattoo that serves as a special ward to defend you against Walkena's forces.

name: Sun's Fury
summary: The Old Sun Gods have granted you a gift in your fight against Walkena.

name: Elude the Divine
summary: You are able to escape inquisitions involving divine magic, allowing you to blend in well in Mzali but also to avoid unwanted attention in other oppressive theocracies.

name: Oozemorph Dedication
summary: You are plagued by sporadic anatomical rearrangements, which grant you insights into other creatures with unusual anatomies.

name: Disturbing Defense
summary: Your internal organs and blood vessels have shifted and changed, and even you don't know precisely where in your body they are.

name: Hideous Ululation
summary: Your throat has multiple separate chambers that can give your voice an eerie echo.

name: Vacate Vision
summary: You cause your eyes to liquefy and run out of your eye sockets, leaving them empty.

name: Ooze Empathy
prerequisite: Oozemorph Dedication; at least two other class feats from the oozemorph archetype
summary: You can connect with oozes (and other amorphous aberrations, at the GM's discretion) on a rudimentary level.

name: Rubbery Skin
summary: Your skin develops a malleable, rubbery quality.

name: Uncanny Suction
summary: Your limbs produce strange, sucker-like growths that allow you to adhere to walls, objects, and most other surfaces.

name: Peculiar Anatomy
summary: Your circulatory system contains viscous protoplasmic fluid instead of ordinary blood.

name: Edgewatch Detective Dedication
summary: You're a specially trained detective for the Edgewatch guard precinct in Absalom.
source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace pg. 79

name: Sense Alignment
summary: You read the body language of an intelligent creature within 30 feet and pick up on subtle cues to detect its general propensity for good or evil and law or chaos.
source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace pg. 79

name: Arcane Sensitivity
summary: You can sense the presence of the supernatural, even if you don't have any magical ability yourself.
source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace pg. 79

name: Bolera's Interrogation
summary: You can force a creature to tell the truth
source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace pg. 79

name: Jalmeri Heavenseeker Dedication
prerequisite: Student of Perfection Dedication, or you've trained with a champion of the Challenge of Sky and Heaven
summary: Your skill and dedication have set you on a path to master the techniques of Jalmeray's greatest martial artists.
source: Impossible Lands pg. 224, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under pg. 78

name: Heaven's Thunder
summary: With a loud shout, you unleash your ki in a crackling shroud of thunder and lightning that engulfs your body.
source: Impossible Lands pg. 224, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under pg. 78

name: Sky and Heaven Stance
summary: You enter a stance allowing you to make jagged strikes like flashes of lightning through the sky.
source: Impossible Lands pg. 224, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under pg. 78

name: Skyseeker
summary: You Leap toward an opponent.
source: Impossible Lands pg. 225, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under pg. 79

name: Steal the Sky
summary: You can take away the air that keeps a flying foe aloft.
source: Impossible Lands pg. 225, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under pg. 79

name: Speaking Sky
summary: You can hear air movement like soft whispers.
source: Impossible Lands pg. 225, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under pg. 79

name: Cross the Final Horizon
summary: You Stride up to your Speed and your ki enshrouds your limbs in a terrifying stormy energy.
source: Impossible Lands pg. 225, Pathfinder #158: Sixty Feet Under pg. 79

name: Slice and Swipe
summary: Steal from your target when you successfully strike them.

name: Ambushing Knockdown
summary: You emerge from hiding and deliver a blow that can knock an enemy sprawling to the ground.

name: Subtle Shank
summary: You draw a concealed weapon, attack with it, and then hide it away again in one smooth motion.

name: Deny Support
summary: Keep opponents from flanking when you Feint them.

name: Coordinated Distraction
summary: You distract an opponent from the fact that one of your allies is about to attack them.

name: Provocator Dedication
summary: For you, fighting is as much about style as skill.

name: Flourishing Finish
summary: Your martial prowess demoralizes all who can see you.

name: Cartwheel Dodge
summary: You can dodge away from damaging effects.

name: Murderer's Circle
summary: Circle your foe while you beat on them.

name: Pin to the Spot
summary: Strike a foe and restrain them.

name: Performance Weapon Expert
prerequisite: Provocator Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack
summary: Your experience has made you better with a wide variety of weapons.

name: Dead Reckoning
prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; Trained in Survival
summary: You've trained yourself to maintain a strong sense of direction at all times, even when you can't use a compass or see the sky above.

name: Environmental Explorer
summary: You've traversed enough untamed wilderness to gain an intuitive understanding of the dangers that exist in such places.

name: Observant Explorer
summary: You've gained an intuitive sense about creatures.

name: Remember Your Training
summary: You were schooled on a wide variety of creatures you might encounter.

name: Spiritual Explorer
summary: You're familiar with the danger that lingering spirits can pose to an unwary adventurer.

name: Watch and Learn
summary: Pathfinder agents serve as members of diverse teams with complementary skill sets.

name: Archaeologist's Warning
summary: You visually or audibly warn your companions of danger, granting them a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.

name: Craft Facsimile
prerequisite: Expert in Crafting; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
summary: You're renowned for your ability to recover important items and sometimes that requires creating a stand-in.

name: Diverse Recognition
prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; master in a skill used to Recall Knowledge
summary: Your Pathfinder training allows you to quickly size up numerous threats.

name: Snap Out of It! (Pathfinder Agent)
prerequisite: Master in Medicine; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
summary: Pathfinders are trained to help each other be safe and successful, and you know how to jolt your allies back to their senses.

name: Wayfinder Resonance Infiltrator
prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer
summary: You are adept at using the unusual resonance of your _wayfinder_ to aid in any deceptions you might employ.

name: Eidetic Memorization
summary: Pathfinders are often asked to study the intricacies of ancient history under less than ideal conditions, and you've trained your brain to make the most of your limited time.

name: Swap Investment
summary: Your time as a Pathfinder has taught you how to improvise, and you've learned to make use of the resources you find in the field.

name: Foolproof Instructions
summary: You feel confident that you can explain your scrolls so well that even your allies can use them.

name: Innate Magic Intuition
summary: You've spent countless hours learning to recognize and predict a creature's innate magical abilities.

name: Magic Finder
summary: You've learned a few tricks to ensure you find every last magic item and interesting magical effect during your missions.

name: Transcribe Moment
summary: You gain the _transcribe moment_ focus spell.

name: Bestiary Scholar
prerequisite: Master in Arcana, Master in Crafting, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion; Scrollmaster Dedication
summary: You learn how to apply your extensive knowledge of certain creatures using the lore you know.

name: Cautious Delver
summary: You've studied the many ways that ancient architects and spellcasters protected their possessions, such as by implementing deadly traps and curses, and learned some magic to counteract them.

name: Masterful Obfuscation
prerequisite: master in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action; Scrollmaster Dedication
summary: You've mastered the art of deceiving others about your area of study.

name: Determined Lore Seeker
summary: You've mastered useful spells that let you find hidden truths others might miss.

name: Ward Mind
summary: To protect the knowledge within your mind from intrusion or erasure, you ward yourself against a mental attack.

name: Familiar Form
summary: You can use your magic to transform into a small creature of a type that commonly serves as a spellcaster's familiar, potentially allowing you to safely scout for your party while retaining a degree of spellcasting ability.

name: Glyph Expert
summary: You've learned to recognize the telltale writings and other signs that indicate the presence of magical traps.

name: Recover Spell
summary: You recover the energy of a recently disrupted spell, allowing you to cast it again as long as you do so immediately before the energy dissipates.

name: Spellmaster's Ward
summary: You can create a number of powerful shielding runes that bolster your defenses against damaging spells by absorbing the worst of the energy to keep you safe.

name: Communal Sustain
summary: Choose one spell with a sustained duration that one of your allies has in effect.

name: Spellmaster's Tenacity
summary: You call upon the power of your spells to protect you from the worst of the magic headed your way.

name: Master's Counterspell
prerequisite: Spellmaster Dedication; master in spell attack rolls and spell DCs
summary: When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your magic to disrupt it.

name: Mobile Magical Combat
summary: You dart around the battlefield, casting spells while you carefully make melee attacks with your weapon.

name: Retain Absorbed Spell
summary: When you absorb a spell using the Absorb Spell reaction, you utilize secret, techniques that allow you to retain the power and knowledge necessary to cast the spell repeatedly—potentially for a greater period of time.

name: Improvised Crafting
summary: You've learned to repair your equipment even in challenging circumstances, making use of what you have available.

name: Physical Training
prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Athletics
summary: You spend a lot of time focusing on your physical fitness.

name: Protect Ally
summary: You place your body between your friends and your enemies, protecting your allies against oncoming attacks.

name: Quick Stow (Swordmaster)
summary: You know that situations can change rapidly and might leave you needing to change equipment in the middle of combat.

name: Reflexive Grip
summary: You keep hold of your weapons even when knocked out.

name: Armored Rest
prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; trained in light, medium, or heavy armor
summary: You've slept many nights in your armor and gotten used to it.

name: Martial Exercise
summary: You've become comfortable in using weapons that you might not have picked up before training with the Swords.

name: Practiced Defender
summary: After extensive practice with the Swords, you're comfortable enough with your shield to move at a normal pace with it raised.

name: Emergency Medical Assistance
summary: You've learned a variety of methods for helping allies who are bleeding, burning, or otherwise suffering persistent damage, from brushing off acid to patting down fires.

name: Recollect Studies
prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; expert in a skill used to Recall Knowledge
summary: You paid attention during your studies and remember the right way to attack various creatures.

name: Rugged Survivalist
summary: You've studied survival skills with the School of Swords experts and are comfortable spending long periods of time in the wilderness.

name: Tense Negotiator
summary: You often find that the best way to win a conflict means avoiding a fight in the first place.

name: Armored Exercise
prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; trained in light, medium, or heavy armor
summary: You've spent time training in your armor alongside other agents from the Swords.

name: Forceful Shot
summary: Your ranged attacks push your foes away from your allies.

name: Focus Ally
summary: You're so focused on your allies that you can help them to recenter when something would take them out of the fight.

name: Stave Off Catastrophe
summary: You fully protect your allies from the worst blows.

name: Fane's Fourberie
summary: Stella Fane has perfected a technique for using playing cards as weapons that's one part sleight of hand and one part magic.

name: Fane's Escape
summary: A good getaway requires a good distraction.

name: Stella's Stab and Snag
summary: You dart towards your opponent, seeking to stab them and slice their purse-strings with a single movement.

name: Rain of Embers Stance
summary: You enter the stance of an enraged phoenix, holding your fingers as rigid as deadly talons while moving with quick, flickering gestures that dance with biting flames.
source: PFS Guide pg. 118, PFS Quest #2: Unforgiving Fire pg. 20

name: Blazing Talon Surge
summary: You rush forward and latch onto your enemy with talons of hungering fire.

name: Explosive Death Drop
summary: You lift your enemy into the air before bringing them crashing down with a fiery detonation.

name: Kreighton's Cognitive Crossover
summary: Kreighton teaches his students that an agile mind can glean clues leading to the truth, even from the most unlikely of sources.

name: Westyr's Wayfinder Repository
prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer
summary: You can use your _wayfinder_ to store a little extra magic for when you need it most.

name: Discerning Strike
summary: Identifying a creature is the first step in finding its weaknesses.

name: Farabellus Flip
prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics; trained in medium armor
summary: Surprisingly agile even in a breastplate and carrying a full rucksack, Marcos Farabellus developed this evasive maneuver during one of his many adventures.

name: Ghost Hunter Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion
summary: You have focused your training on hunting and defeating ghosts, spirits, and all manner of haunts.

name: Grave's Voice
summary: You can influence spirits and haunts

name: Investigate Haunting
summary: You are skilled at noticing the telltale signs of ghosts and hauntings.

name: Spirit Spells
summary: Your ability to confront incorporeal menaces develops into full-fledged spellcasting.

name: Ghost Strike
summary: You can infuse a weapon you are carrying with magical energies that allow it to strike true against incorporeal undead.

name: Peer Beyond
summary: You have uncanny insight into the way ghosts and haunts manifest, manipulate the mind, and rejuvenate.

name: Emberkin
summary: A peri's roaring spirit burns in your soul.

name: Idyllkin
summary: Your wild, unique features betray your agathion birthright.

name: Plumekith
summary: Your blood soars with the power of the magnificent garuda, proud and stoic avian warriors.

name: Garuda's Squall
summary: Garudas' marksmanship and magic are second nature to you.

name: Healer's Halo
summary: Your halo can enhance positive energy.

name: Tranquil Sanctuary
summary: Whenever possible, you follow the serene path and encourage others to do the same.

name: Agathion Magic
summary: The harmonious magic of Nirvana flows through you.

name: Call of Elysium
summary: The wild wonder of Elysium harmonizes within you, and in dire straits, you can share its benefits with your allies.

name: Garuda Magic
summary: You are descended from the wondrous garudas, and their keen senses manifest in your magical prowess.

name: Peri Magic
summary: The shimmering embers of the righteous peris crackle at your fingertips.

name: Enforced Order
summary: You never fail to strike down the ever-expanding reaches of chaos.

name: Flame Jump
trait: Aasimar, Concentrate, Divine, Exploration, Fire, Manipulate, Teleportation
summary: Your peri lineage has opened your mind to fire's raw, purging essence.

name: Purge Sins
summary: You call on your celestial forebears to rid your body of all toxins and impurities.

name: Truespeech
summary: It is paramount that you are understood and you understand others; language need not impede your message.

name: Radiate Glory
summary: Your inherent glory radiates into the world with all the divine power of the celestial planes for 1 minute.

name: Ancestral Insight
summary: You have extensive knowledge of your ancestors' ancient origins.

name: Hydraulic Deflection
summary: Drawing moisture from the atmosphere, you create a disc of hovering water that deflects attacks.

name: Pelagic Aptitude
summary: You've learned special tricks to survive underwater.

name: Striking Retribution
summary: You have an appropriately intense hatred for alghollthus.

name: Aquatic Conversationalist
summary: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals with the amphibious or aquatic traits.

name: Marine Ally
summary: You've befriended a sea creature, which becomes magically bonded to you.

name: Water Conjuration
summary: You carry the ocean with you wherever you go.

name: Azarketi Purification
summary: You can cast _purify food and drink_ as a primal innate spell, but only on liquids.

name: Water Dancer
summary: You glide through the water with graceful ease.

name: Water Strider
summary: Water cradles your every step, allowing you to walk on its surface.

name: Aquatic Adaptation
summary: If you and up to four other creatures are in contact with a body of water deep enough for you to fully submerge, you can spend 10 minutes adapting the creatures to that specific body of water.

name: Aquatic Camouflage
summary: You blend into the waves.

name: Hydraulic Maneuvers
trait: Azarketi, Concentrate, Manipulate, Primal, Transmutation, Water
summary: You batter your foes with a torrent of water siphoned from your surroundings.

name: Mist Strider
summary: You condense the moisture in the air, solidifying it so it can hold your weight.

name: Rehydration
summary: You surround your body with a thin layer of water drawn from the moisture in the air.

name: Underwater Volcano
summary: You can cast _volcanic eruption_ as a 7th-level primal innate spell once per day.

name: Winter Cat Senses
summary: Your eyes are keen and accustomed to winter conditions.

name: Focused Cat Nap
summary: When you Cat Nap, you can also Refocus as you dream of a relevant activity.

name: No Evidence
summary: You leave little sign when attempting to remain unseen.

name: Sense for Trouble
summary: You can tell when something's off.

name: Inspirit Hazard
summary: You awaken a spirit of creation within the hazard.

name: Maiden's Mending
summary: You can tap into some of the magic that flows through your blood to give you new life.

name: Moon May
summary: Your mother was a moon hag, a handmaiden of Groetus, and you have a single scarlet eye and a sliver of her supernal foresight.

name: Snow May
summary: You're the child of a winter hag, with one blue-white eye and an affinity for rime and snow.

name: Veil May
summary: Born of a blood hag, a fiery blood drinker hidden behind a false skin, you have one blood-red eye and the ability to slough off your appearance in an instant.

name: Virga May
summary: Born of a storm hag, you have one crystal-blue or rain-gray eye.

name: Cunning Hair
summary: Your hair moves under your control.

name: Favorable Winds
summary: You wrap a shell of favorable wind around a weapon you wield.

name: Invoke the Elements
prerequisite: Brine May, Snow May, Veil May, or Virga May
summary: You summon an aura of shimmering heat, flurrying snow, crashing waves, or swirling wind and lightning.

name: Mother's Mindfulness
summary: You have the protective instinct your own mother lacks and will gladly suffer in another's place.

name: Spiteful Rake
summary: Your instincts sing of spite and malice, and you've learned a devastating trick: go for the eyes.

name: Crone's Cruelty
summary: Filled with rancor and hate, you rend the minds of those who displease you.

name: Stormy Heart
summary: The elemental power in your blood is a raging storm.

name: Adhyabhau
summary: You descend from the rare psychic vampires known as vetalaranas.

name: Cel Rau
summary: You are a cel rau, child of a strigoi, one of the first vampires to walk Golarion.

name: Nocturnal Charm
summary: The supernatural charm of your vampiric progenitor hangs about you, and you've learned to use it on mortals.

name: Old Soul
summary: Your immortal lineage has granted you a lifespan much longer than most mortals, and you've learned a lot along the way.

name: Ru-Shi
summary: You were born to a jiang-shi, one of the so-called hopping vampires found most often in Tian-Xia.

name: Feed on Pain
summary: The psychic feedback of another creature's pain fills you with false life.

name: Hopping Stride
summary: You've internalized the hopping gait of your vampiric forebear.

name: Taste Blood
prerequisite: Cel Rau, Straveika, Svetocher, or another lineage from a vampire with the Drink Blood ability
summary: You retain not only your vampiric parent's taste for blood but their ability to gain vitality from it.

name: Undead Companion
prerequisite: an animal companion or a familiar
summary: Your companion is also touched by undeath, a mix of a traditional companion and a skeleton, zombie, or stranger form of unlife.

name: Slip into Shadow
prerequisite: ability to cast at least one spell with the darkness trait
summary: Your shadow magic bleeds into the space around you.

name: Daywalker
summary: Whether through painstaking exposure, devoted prayer, or simple luck, you've found a greater affinity for life through the sun's light.

name: Twist Healing
summary: Your connection to both life and undeath lets you twist the healing power of magic items to suit your own needs and aims.

name: Nosoi's Mask
summary: Many psychopomps wear masks when dealing with the living, and many cultures believe that seeing an unmasked psychopomp's face invites death.

name: Willing Death
summary: Once, you died because you valued someone else's life above your own; just as then, you protect an ally by suffering in their stead.

name: Shoki's Argument
summary: You feel a connection to shokis, the rambling collectors of wayward souls, and might have found old texts written by one.

name: Catrina's Presence
summary: You've adopted the calming presence of catrinas, the festive dead..

name: Morrigna's Spider Affinity
summary: Much like morrignas, you feel an affinity for spiders.

name: Calaca's Showstopper
summary: You've spent many an evening learning songs and tales featuring calacas, death's wandering minstrels.

name: Olethros's Decree
summary: You have a connection to olethroses, the enigmatic psychopomps who successfully swayed the yamaraj to permit the creation of the first duskwalkers.

name: Yamaraj's Grandeur
summary: You have been granted a sliver of the power of the yamaraj, the magistrates of the dead who agreed to allow duskwalkers to exist at all.

name: We March On
summary: You make sure that your allies push themselves while traveling.

name: Slither
summary: You are an expert at moving through extremely tight spaces.

name: Snare Commando
prerequisite: Snare Crafting; Expert in Deception or Expert in Intimidation
summary: Your snares are so befuddling that your victims rarely notice you slipping out of sight.

name: Ageless Spirit
summary: You remember more about your previous incarnations than most leshys.

name: Spore Cloud
summary: You unleash a cloud of pollen or similar spores.

name: Consult the Stars
summary: You find wisdom in the movements of the heavens.

name: Lightning Tongue
summary: Your tongue darts out faster than the eye can see to retrieve loose objects.

name: Reptile Rider
summary: To you, crocodilians, giant lizards, and dinosaurs are loyal steeds, not monsters.

name: Guided by the Stars
summary: The stars grant you insights that guide your actions.

name: Iruxi Glide
summary: You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air.

name: Tongue Disarm
summary: You lash out with your tongue to disarm your foe.

name: Bone Caller
summary: Using a mixture of dinosaur bones and the bones of your ancestors to focus your magic, you animate lizards and dinosaurs to carry messages or serve as mounts.

name: Read the Stars
prerequisite: Trained in Astrology Lore or Trained in Occultism
summary: You're incredibly skilled in iruxi astrology, and you can gain useful (if cryptic) hints from the stars' alignment.

name: Orc Warmask
summary: You paint your face to create a _warmask_.

name: Mask of Power
summary: Your _warmask_ sharpens your connection to the source of your mask's power.

name: Mask of Rejection
summary: Your _warmask_ projects a white-hot fury that attempts to vaporize the offending magic.

name: Dragon Grip
summary: Your hold has a unique draconic connection.

name: Mask of Pain
summary: Your mask has grown into a manifestation of your pain, which you can release.

name: Lifeblood's Call
summary: The impulse to survive and continue fighting resonates deep within you.

name: Mask of Fear
summary: Your _warmask_ burns off of your face, releasing your apprehension.

name: Skull Creeper
summary: You wear skulls to demoralize foes.

name: Warren Friend
summary: You're adept at making contact with other ysoki.

name: Gnaw
summary: With enough time and determination, you can chew through nearly anything.

name: Plague Sniffer
summary: You can sniff out the pungent tang of disease.

name: Waxed Feathers
summary: Your feathers are coated in a waxy substance that repels water.

name: Dogfang Bite
summary: You can swing your beak to slash your foes when piercing attacks won't do.

name: Eclectic Sword Mastery
summary: You instinctively learn how to use a sword with just a few practice swings.

name: Favor of Heaven
summary: You're one of Hei Feng's chosen people and have the authority of the Celestial Court on your side.

name: Hurricane Swing
summary: Choose either _lightning bolt_ or _gust of wind_.

name: Beastbrood
summary: One of your ancestors was a rakshasa, the corrupt and aristocratic reincarnated souls that call Golarion home.

name: Riftmarked
summary: Long ago, qlippoth marked someone in your lineage, most likely through their ancient runestones that dot Golarion's surface.

name: Shackleborn
summary: Your lineage shows the signs of velstrac tampering, including some curious quirk bequeathed by those shadowy surgeons of flesh and souls.

name: Devil in Plain Sight
summary: You've learned to draw your fiendish nature into a small ball of corruption and hide it in your soul.

name: Devilish Wiles
summary: Traditionally, fiends are exceptionally good at persuading people to do things, even when their targets know it's a bad idea.

name: Qlippoth Magic
summary: You've deeply studied the secrets of your blood and can force reality to act against its own wishes.

name: Rakshasa Magic
summary: You remember the secrets of your rakshasa forebears and know how to apply those memories to get results.

name: Velstrac Magic
summary: You know there's so much more to sensation than whips and chains—but whips and chains also have their place.

name: Finest Trick
summary: Many fiends—rakshasa rajas and demonic succubi most famously—can take on the forms of others.

name: Final Form
trait: Concentrate, Divine, Evocation, Morph, Tiefling, Transmutation
summary: You embrace your monstrous blood and make it your own, screaming out to the heavens and hells alike in rage, pain, and defiance.

name: Android Lore
summary: You have a keen interest in the origins of your people.

name: Cleansing Subroutine
summary: Your nanites help purge your body of harmful chemicals and toxins.

name: Emotionless
summary: Your malfunctioning emotional processors make it difficult for you to feel strong emotions.

name: Internal Compartment
summary: You can hide a small object of up to light Bulk inside a hollow cavity on one of your forearms.

name: Nanite Surge
summary: You stimulate your nanites, forcing your body to temporarily increase its efficiency.

name: Nightvision Adaptation
summary: The nanites in your ocular processors have adapted to darkness, enhancing your ability to see in the dark.

name: Proximity Alert
summary: You're unnaturally in tune with your surroundings and react instinctively to danger.

name: Radiant Circuitry
summary: Your biological circuitry emits light like a torch, casting bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

name: Advanced Targeting System
summary: Your ocular processors are augmented with advanced targeting systems, which allow you to more easily pinpoint your enemy and read their movements.

name: Inoculation Subroutine
summary: Your nanites reject diseases with ease.

name: Nanite Shroud
summary: Your nanites fly out of your body, swarming around you in a cloud.

name: Protective Subroutine
summary: Your nanites can augment your defenses.

name: Internal Respirator
summary: Your body can internally synthesize oxygen for limited periods of time.

name: Offensive Subroutine
summary: Nanites augment your attacks.

name: Repair Module
summary: You trigger your body's repair programming, causing your body's nanites to heal your wounds.

name: Consistent Surge
summary: Your nanites are incredibly effective, capable of improving your body's efficiency regularly.

name: Revivification Protocol
summary: Your nanites are programmed to automatically revive you.

name: Axiomatic Lore
summary: You possess a strong understanding of process among mortals and lawful outsiders alike.

name: Offensive Analysis
summary: You can enhance your senses and mental state to consider every aspect of an attack.

name: Analyze Information
summary: You can stoke your mind into a burst of analytical prowess.

name: Ancillary Motes
summary: You can use Crystalline Dust one more time per day.

name: Preemptive Reconfiguration
summary: Your body anticipates the blow.

name: Animal Senses
summary: You gain one of the following senses available to your inherent animal: darkvision, low-light vision, or scent (imprecise) 30 feet.

name: Critter Shape
summary: Once per hour, you can use Change Shape to enter a critter shape.

name: Quick Shape
summary: Your instincts kick in and you take on an aggressive stance.

name: Animalistic Resistance
summary: Your animalistic connections help you resist natural afflictions.

name: Greater Animal Senses
summary: Your senses advance to match those of your animal aspect.

name: Animal Magic
summary: Your shapeshifting grants you a magical connection to the animal world.

name: Pack Tactics
summary: You have mastered how to hunt with your pack.

name: Dire Form
summary: Your hybrid shape is a hulking beast.

name: Gift of the Moon
summary: You can share your power with others, but they can't escape the werecreature's curse as easily as you can.

name: Animal Shape
summary: You have full control over your shape and can transform into your inherent animal.

name: Animal Swiftness
summary: You move like an animal.

name: Fetchling Lore
summary: You've learned obscure lessons about your fellow fetchlings.

name: Hard to Fool
summary: You're accustomed to seeing through shifting darkness and bewildering magic.

name: Shadow Blending
summary: You draw shadows close to create a shroud.

name: Shrouded Magic
summary: Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list.

name: Shrouded Mien
summary: You're used to dealing with dangerous situations and sinister creatures.

name: Slink
summary: You can move through gloom with the speed of darkness.

name: Clever Shadow
summary: You can perform simple Interact actions with your shadow, such as opening an unlocked door.

name: Extinguish Light
summary: You wrap shadow around a single unattended light source within 120 feet that's no larger than a torch.

name: Lightless Litheness
summary: Your body is almost as flexible as your shadow.

name: Shadowy Disguise
summary: You wrap yourself in shadow to change your appearance.

name: Hefting Shadow
summary: Your shadow can contain objects.

name: Sculpt Shadows
summary: You coax nearby shadows into the shape of a simple weapon or a simple tool or item, using a tiny piece of your shadow to make it solid; in doing so, you lose 1 Hit Point.

name: Shadow Sight
summary: You draw on your connection with the Shadow Plane to see through all but the deepest darkness.

name: Shadow's Assault
summary: Your shadow assaults your foes.

name: Skirt the Light
summary: You can travel the border between the Material and Shadow Planes and even bring others along.

name: Pierce the Light
summary: You tear the veil between the Material Plane and its shadow.

name: Aberration Kinship
summary: Your mind resonates with the inscrutable thought processes that inhuman aberrations use to communicate.

name: Deepvision
summary: Your vision is suited for night or the underground.

name: Living Weapon
summary: You've learned to use part of your form as a weapon.

name: Startling Appearance (Fleshwarp)
summary: Your appearance is enough to frighten without words.

name: Finned Ridges
summary: The ridges and flaps of your skin steer you through the water.

name: Gaping Flesh
summary: Your wound yawns open, appalling your attacker.

name: Mutate Weapon
summary: deal more damage with your Living Weapon.

name: Powerful Guts
summary: Your stomach is particularly durable.

name: Uncanny Awareness
summary: You have a keen sense of movement around you.

name: Captivating Curiosity
summary: You can snare the attentions of onlookers with your unique appearance.

name: Coating of Slime
summary: An acidic ooze coats your limbs.

name: Eerie Compression
summary: Your limbs and even your torso can collapse in on themselves, allowing you to fit through tight spaces as though you were a Small creature.

name: Gripping Limbs
summary: Nodules, hooks, or claws on your limbs allow you to cling to surfaces with ease.

name: Slip the Grasp
summary: You have some feature that allows you to quickly evade effects that restrain you.

name: Augment Senses
summary: You open vestigial eyes, unfurl tympanic flaps of skin, or otherwise enhance your senses.

name: Spew Tentacles
summary: You can open your mouth to an immense size and spew forth an impossibly large field of tentacles.

name: Smashing Tail
summary: You have a tail that serves as a potent weapon.

name: Vestigial Wings
summary: You possess small, weak wings that aid in balance.

name: Mischievous Tail
summary: Your tail can bedevil your foes.

name: Elemental Eyes
trait: Ardande, Ifrit, Oread, Suli, Sylph, Talos, Undine
summary: You can see in the darkness as easily as an elemental.

name: Elemental Lore
trait: Ardande, Ifrit, Oread, Suli, Sylph, Talos, Undine
summary: You've devoted yourself to researching the secrets of the Inner Sphere.

name: Genie Weapon Familiarity
trait: Ardande, Ifrit, Oread, Suli, Sylph, Talos, Undine
summary: You've trained with weapons used by your genie ancestors.

name: Genie Weapon Flourish
trait: Ardande, Ifrit, Oread, Suli, Sylph, Talos, Undine
summary: Whenever you critically hit using a falchion, ranseur, scimitar, trident, or a geniekin weapon, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.

name: Genie Weapon Expertise
trait: Ardande, Ifrit, Oread, Suli, Sylph, Talos, Undine
summary: Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency in falchions, ranseurs, scimitars, tridents, and all geniekin weapons in which you are trained.

name: Brightsoul
summary: The fire inside you asserts itself as beaming, radiant light.

name: Cindersoul
summary: The fire of your elemental ancestor manifests like dying embers of a blaze, and your inner charcoal helps staunch bleeding, purify simple poisons, and absorb acid.

name: Ember's Eyes
summary: Your eyes blaze with inner flame.

name: Inner Fire
summary: You can call the fire inside you into the palm of your hand.

name: Lavasoul
summary: Your elemental lineage manifests as magma and molten rock, and you can focus the magma into your hand to attack your foes.

name: Sinister Appearance
summary: You possess horns, a tail, or red eyes, or could otherwise be mistaken for a tiefling.

name: Firesight
summary: You can see through the haze of flame.

name: Heatwave
summary: You harness the oncoming flames and twist them into a screen of heat and smoke, granting you concealment until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Charred Remains
summary: Your next fire spell leaves embers in its wake.

name: Efreeti Magic
summary: The magic of your efreeti ancestors flows through you.

name: Scorching Disarm
summary: You make a weapon unbearable to hold.

name: Radiant Burst
summary: Your skin glows with intensity.

name: Summon Fire Elemental
summary: You can summon an elemental ally.

name: Blazing Aura
summary: You explode in flame.

name: Dustsoul
summary: Your earth elemental ancestor's influence manifests in you as dust and dirt, like the soil of a field or the hot desert sands.

name: Elemental Trade
summary: You have a strong connection with stone and metal.

name: Gemsoul
summary: The earth inside you asserts itself as crystallized gemstones or metals, like a cluster of quartz or veins of iron and gold.

name: Miresoul
summary: You have a connection to the muddier denizens of the Plane of Earth from its border with the Plane of Water, and your elemental lineage manifests as clay or mud, reflecting that bond.

name: Steady on Stone
summary: Your connection to the earth makes natural uneven surfaces less of a hindrance for you.

name: Fortify Shield
summary: You reinforce your shield with a rocky outgrowth of metal and stone.

name: Treacherous Earth
summary: You have the power to shatter the earth into a shape of your devising.

name: Earthsense
summary: Your connection to earth and stone allows you to feel the slightest displacement that disturbs them, down to the shift of a pebble.

name: Shaitan Magic
summary: The magic of shaitans runs through your blood.

name: Metal-Veined Strikes
summary: Metallic veins grow throughout your body, giving your unarmed attacks a metallic sheen.

name: One with Earth
summary: You've learned to harness your connection to the earth to travel through it.

name: Shaitan Skin
summary: When in danger, you can harden the stone in your skin into armor, much like a shaitan.

name: Summon Earth Elemental
summary: You have a connection to the Inner Sphere, allowing you to summon an elemental ally.

name: Stone Form
summary: You can transform your body into a pure primal manifestation of earth, an elemental.

name: Dualborn
summary: Your suli heritage can be traced back to two geniekin ancestors of opposing elements, or to an elemental ancestor that embodied two combined elements.

name: Elemental Assault
summary: You shroud your arms and held weapons in elemental magic.

name: Elemental Embellish
summary: You can summon a harmless but impressive elemental display.

name: Scholar's Inheritance
summary: Your parents devoted themselves to alchemical experiments involving elemental energy.

name: Suli-Jann
summary: Your elemental ancestor was a janni, genies that walk the mortal world and embody all four elements together.

name: Elemental Bulwark
summary: You call upon the corresponding elements of your suli heritage to resist the effect.

name: Janni Hospitality
summary: You can use magic to show others desert hospitality.

name: Janni Magic
summary: The magic of jann runs through your blood.

name: Tetraelemental Assault
summary: Your Elemental Assault cycles through all four elements.

name: Continuous Assault
summary: You can use Elemental Assault once per hour instead of once per day.

name: Improved Elemental Bulwark
summary: You gain resistance 10 from Elemental Bulwark instead of 5.

name: Suli Amir
summary: You have power connected to the powerful jann amirs.

name: Fumesoul
summary: The air inside you asserts itself as a toxic miasma, inuring you to most poisons.

name: Smokesoul
summary: You have a connection to smoke and haze.

name: Stormsoul
summary: Your elemental ancestor's influence manifests in you as tumultuous, thundering storms, with dark clouds and bolts of lightning.

name: Swift
summary: You move with the wind always at your back.

name: Wind Tempered
summary: You are at home in tempestuous weather and accustomed to even the harshest winds.

name: Cloud Gazer
summary: Your connection to air allows you to see through obscuring mists.

name: Slip with the Breeze
summary: You create gusts of wind when you jump, allowing you to carry yourself across greater distances.

name: Djinni Magic
summary: The magic of djinn runs through your blood.

name: Inner Breath
summary: Your body is capable of recycling its own air.

name: Wings of Air
summary: You can strain to call forth feathered or cloudy wings from your back.

name: Airy Step
summary: You create a blanket of fog in a 5–foot burst centered on one corner of your space.

name: Summon Air Elemental
summary: You have a connection to the Inner Spheres, allowing you to summon an elemental ally.

name: Eternal Wings (Sylph)
summary: Your wings are now a permanent part of your body.

name: Storm Form
summary: You can transform into an elemental.

name: Aquatic Eyes
summary: As your connection to water grows, you can see more easily in places with less light, such as the depths of the ocean.

name: Brinesoul
summary: Your elemental ancestor's legacy asserts itself as brackish water, like the seawater of the ocean.

name: Mistsoul
summary: You have a connection to vaporous forms of water, such as fog and mist.

name: Rimesoul
summary: The water inside you is cold and frozen, like sheets of ice and frigid glaciers.

name: Tide-Hardened
summary: You're at home in the unpredictable tides.

name: Fluid Contortionist
summary: You can ignore difficult terrain caused by moving through tight spaces that aren't tight enough to force you to Squeeze.

name: Steam Spell
summary: You transform your fire spells into steam, making them more effective underwater.

name: Marid Magic
summary: You channel the magic of marids.

name: Strong Swimmer
summary: Your swim Speed increases to match your land Speed.

name: Summon Water Elemental
summary: You can summon an elemental ally.

name: Translucent Skin
summary: Your body is translucent while underwater.

name: Tidal Shield
summary: You conjure the force of the tides to gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC until the end of your next turn.

name: Foxfire
summary: A crack of your tail sparks wisps of blue energy.

name: Kitsune Lore
summary: You excel at navigating social situations and keeping secrets.

name: Kitsune Spell Familiarity
summary: You've picked up a few magical tricks.

name: Retractable Claws
summary: You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage.

name: Shapechanger's Intuition
summary: A lifetime of experience helps you see through disguises.

name: Star Orb
summary: Your magic has crystallized into a spherical stone.

name: Hybrid Form
summary: When you Change Shape, you retain elements of your kitsune form, allowing you to speak in a fox form, use kitsune unarmed attacks in a tailless form, or gain a tail in your tailless form to use abilities that require one.

name: Kitsune Spell Mysteries
prerequisite: at least one innate spell from a kitsune heritage or ancestry feat
summary: You know more kitsune magic.

name: Myriad Forms
summary: With a bit of self-discovery, you find a new form.

name: Shifting Faces
summary: You wear many faces, even those that don't belong to you.

name: Fox Trick
summary: You always have time for a joke or prank.

name: Killing Stone
summary: Your star orb hides a deadly miasma.

name: Kitsune Spell Expertise
summary: Your tails show your magical mastery.

name: Rampaging Form
prerequisite: Change Shape with a fox alternate form
summary: Once per day, when you Change Shape into a fox, you can instead gain the effects of both the canine form of 5th-level _animal form_ and 7th-level _fiery body_ for 1 minute or until you shift back, whichever comes first.

name: Corgi Mount
summary: The smallest of fey have ridden corgis as mounts since time immemorial, leading to a pattern on corgis' backs called a “faerie saddle.

name: Evanescent Wings
summary: You've manifested wings that can flutter for brief spurts.

name: Fey Cantrips
summary: You've learned the cantrips sprites have used since time immemorial.

name: Speak with Bats
summary: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with bats.

name: Sprite's Spark
summary: You can fling a portion of your magic at foes.

name: Animal Speaker
prerequisite: ability to communicate with some type of animals (such as bats or arthropods)
summary: You can speak to all animals, not just a particular subset.

name: Catchy Tune
summary: You create a tune so catchy, your foes can't help but dance along.

name: Fey Disguise
summary: You can disguise yourself with magical illusions.

name: Energize Wings
summary: You stoke your magic to energize your wings, temporarily transforming them into glowing, majestic forms.

name: Fey Magic
summary: You can use faerie magic to hide yourself and expose hidden foes.

name: Fey Skin
summary: While you are more susceptible to cold iron than most of the Wingless, you also have an incredible resilience and a deeper connection to the healing energies of the First World.

name: Invisible Trickster
summary: You have learned how to become invisible and remain so.

name: Hero's Wings
summary: You have begun the final steps to reaching your full potential.

name: Story Crooner
summary: You're a talented story weaver and use your voice effectively.

name: Strix Defender
summary: Your ancestral feud with humans gives you experience dealing with vicious foes, and your vengeance knows no bounds.

name: Strix Lore
summary: You're well connected to your tribe and perhaps even strix communities beyond your own, where you've learned about the land and techniques of graceful movement.

name: Feathered Cloak
summary: To blend in with the grounded and wingless, you fold your wings just so on your back, creating the illusion of a feathered cloak.

name: Fledgling Flight
summary: You can fly through the air in short bursts at half your land Speed.

name: Strix Vengeance
summary: You dedicate yourself to destroying those who harm your kin.

name: Thrown Voice
summary: You've learned how to throw your voice through the winds, tricking others as to your location.

name: Ferocious Gust
summary: With heavy wing beats, you whip up a furious gust and direct it at your opponents.

name: Juvenile Flight
summary: You unfold your wings for travel and can keep them unfolded for 10 minutes.

name: Rokoan Arts
summary: Ancestral spirits have begun to bond themselves to you, granting you powers characteristic of a rokoa.

name: Wing Step
summary: With a sharp flap of your wings, you stay light on your feet as you move.

name: Ancestor's Transformation
summary: You can commune with ancestor spirits to assume the form of an enormous primeval strix.

name: Fully Flighted
summary: You gain the effects of Juvenile Flight at all times, rather than just once per day for 10 minutes.

name: Eldritch Researcher Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Arcana; Trained in Occultism
summary: An eager student of occult lore, you enjoy reading rare or forgotten tomes with ancient rituals and hidden secrets.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Seeker of Truths
summary: Your devotion to discovering and hoarding abstruse truths borders on the fanatical, and you can bring this devotion to bear.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Strange Script
summary: You have such familiarity with obscure texts that you can compel them to reveal their secrets.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Scholarly Defense
summary: Your knowledge of strange creatures and their bizarre anatomy allows you to anticipate their physical attacks and reduce the damage you take from them.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Able Ritualist
summary: Your readings on rituals make you a skilled participant.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Lorefinder
summary: You know that fate sometimes conspires to keep dangerous knowledge or items from the eyes of those most able to understand them.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Know it All
summary: Your knowledge of abstruse topics is unparalleled.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Advanced Seeker of Truths
prerequisite: Eldritch Researcher Dedication; Seeker of Truths
summary: You have unlocked deeper secrets to uncovering and hoarding lore.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Words of Unraveling
summary: You have unlocked abstruse methods to tangle with reality itself, altering the fate of a single individual.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Entities from Afar
summary: You can call in aberrations to fight for you or to answer questions.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Incredible Recollection
summary: You can sift through knowledge locked within your mind at an incredible pace.
source: Pathfinder #164: Hands of the Devil pg. 76

name: Alghollthu Bound
summary: Although you may not even be aware, the alghollthus your ancestors once served maintain a stranglehold on the deepest, tethered parts of your mind.
source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens pg. 394, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement pg. 4

name: Azarketi Lore
summary: You have learned the history and origins of your people and how to connect to both your land and sea heritage.
source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens pg. 394, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement pg. 4

name: Azarketi Weapon Familiarity
summary: You are familiar with weapons that excel underwater.
source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens pg. 394, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement pg. 4

source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens pg. 394, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement pg. 4

source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens pg. 395, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement pg. 5

source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens pg. 395, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement pg. 5

source: Pathfinder #168: King of the Mountain pg. 77

name: Ceremony of Growth

name: Ceremony of Sun's Gift
summary: Your connection to the sun has become an unbreakable bond.

name: Catch the Details
summary: You are quick at recognizing broad details about people and things around you.

summary: You lived an insulated life focused on avoiding danger.

name: Pierce the Darkness
summary: Your eyes have adapted to see in all circumstances, even without the assistance of light.

summary: Ignoring your pain, you sear your attacker with a wave of flame.

name: Harden Flesh
summary: You fortify your skin with minerals drawn from earth and stone.

name: Purifying Spell
summary: You purify the water within a creature's body to cleanse them of illness.

name: Stoked Flame Stance
summary: You enter a stance of fast, fiery movements.

name: Inner Fire (SoM)
summary: While you're in Stoked Flame Stance, you have cold and fire resistance, and any creature touches you takes fire damage.

name: Blazing Streak
summary: Stride twice, making Strikes against up to four different creatures within reach at any point during your movement.

name: Flexible Spellcaster Dedication
summary: You now have four cantrips per day instead of three.

name: Geomancer Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Nature; ability to cast spells from spell slots; at least one spell with the air, cold, earth, fire, plant, or water trait
summary: You feel a deep connection to the world no matter where you are, a phenomenon known as “terrain attunement.” When you expend a spell slot to cast a spell with a trait that corresponds to the type of terrain you are currently in (as listed below), you gain the terrain attunement effect for that type of terrain.

name: Attunement Shift
summary: The magic of your spell floods into you, overriding your connection to the land around you.

name: Shared Attunement
summary: When you would gain a benefit from your terrain attunement, you can grant it to one ally within 30 feet instead of yourself.

name: Rough Terrain Stance
summary: You enter a stance that makes it difficult to move around you.

name: Attuned Stride
summary: You can move freely through terrain you're attuned to.

name: Draw from the Land
summary: You pull strength from the surrounding terrain.

name: Read the Land
summary: You've learned how to commune with the land to learn information.

name: Terrain Shield
summary: You're so attuned to the land that it rises up to protect you from a potentially fatal blow in a seeming coincidence.

name: Shifting Terrain
prerequisite: Rough Terrain Stance; Master in Nature
summary: You slam your fist into the ground or twirl your arms about to cause the terrain around you to shift and ripple, potentially throwing others off balance.

name: Quickened Attunement
summary: If your next action is to cast a spell that would grant your terrain attunement bonus, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (to a minimum of 1 action).

name: Cantrip Casting
summary: You increase your ability to cast simple spells.

name: Basic Spellcasting
summary: You increase your ability to cast spells.

name: Expert Spellcasting
summary: You gain the expert spellcasting archetype benefits.

name: Master Spellcasting
summary: You gain the master spellcasting archetype benefits.

name: Shadowcaster Dedication
summary: You've sacrificed a piece of your spirit, allowing the powers of shadow into your being and changing the nature of your magic.

name: Shadow Spells
summary: Hidden darkness whispers to you, teaching you secrets of shadow beyond other spellcasters of your tradition.

name: Disciple of Shade
summary: You've delved deeper into the mysteries of shadow and become blessed with magical power that increases your skills in the arts of deception and persuasion.

name: Shadow Spell
summary: You attach a piece of your shadow to a spell to cloud the senses and cause mischief.

name: Shadow Reservoir
prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots; Shadowcaster Dedication
summary: Your own shadow speaks to you, providing knowledge of spells and a reservoir of magical power.

name: Secrets of Shadow
summary: Your shadow's voice grows ever clearer; it whispers secrets of true power to you and shields your flesh from harm.

name: Unending Emptiness
summary: You pool the power of shadow within your eyes, gaining the ability to gather darkness into a turbulent orb of crushing emptiness within your line of sight.

name: Soulforger Dedication
prerequisite: Wisdom 14 or ability to cast divine spells
summary: You can manifest the power of your spirit in combat to realize your motivations.

name: Soul Flare
summary: You strive to change the outcome with sheer zeal.

name: Rapid Manifestation
summary: Your unwavering soul brings up your defenses as soon as you're in danger.

name: Soul Arsenal
summary: Choose an additional soulforged armament of a different type than the type you already chose, and choose one essence power for it.

name: Polearm Tricks
summary: Your connection to rune magic has revealed tricks to make polearms deadlier in your hands.

name: Fused Polearm
summary: During your daily preparations, you can magically fuse your arcane bonded weapon and a magical staff together into one item, with the staff making up the haft of the weapon.

name: School Counterspell
summary: Your intricate knowledge of your school lets you easily negate spells from that school.

name: School Spell Redirection
summary: When you Counterspell a spell with a school matching your specialization, if you critically succeed at your counteract check, or if you succeed while using a spell of a higher level than the spell you countered, you can redirect the spell you countered.

name: Reveal True Name
trait: Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, General, Mental, Rare, Skill, True Name
prerequisite: trained in Intimidation and at least one of Arcana, Nature, Occult, and Religion
summary: You attempt to get a creature to do as you wish by threatening them with your knowledge of their true name.

name: Wellspring Mage Dedication
summary: There's no longer a limit on how many temporary spell slots you can gain per day from wellspring magic.

name: Wellspring Control
summary: When you generate a wellspring surge, roll twice on the Wellspring Surges Table and take the result of your choice.

name: Urgent Upwelling
summary: Defeat lets you to tap into your wellspring.

name: Interfering Surge
summary: You overcharge the triggering spell with magic.

name: Arcane Fists
summary: Your physical training encompasses unarmed combat forms.

name: Folklorist Dedication
summary: You are a master archivist and entertainer, capable of pulling wisdom from the tales you tell and weaving your allies and enemies into a powerful narrative.
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 78

name: Folktales Lore
summary: You can pull bits of wisdom from any tale.
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 78

name: Narrative Conduit
summary: You act as a conduit for your companions just as your stories are a conduit between teller and listener.
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 78

name: Rule of Three
summary: Heroes learn from their previous failures, often succeeding on the third attempt.
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 78

name: Communal Tale
summary: Stories are an experience meant to be shared as a group.
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 78

name: Nantambu Chime-Ringer Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Performance; Trained in Society
summary: You've studied the basics of harmony and resonance in magic, exemplified by the ringing of chimes.
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 79

name: Fleet Tempo
summary: To rush after a criminal or reach someone in need, you ring a sprightly tone.
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 79

name: Deny the Songs of War
summary: To keep the peace, you disrupt those who seek to break it.
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 79

name: Sing to the Steel
summary: You strike magical tones that can turn the tide of combat.
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 79

name: Song of Grace and Speed
summary: You instill great swiftness into your allies.
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind pg. 79

name: Built-In Tools
summary: You've built tools into your innovation so you can access and use them easily.

name: Explosive Leap
summary: You aim an explosion from your innovation downward to launch yourself into the air.

name: Haphazard Repair
summary: You quickly fix your innovation, at the cost of its stability.

name: No! No! I Created You!
summary: You appeal to your construct companion's bond with its creator to have it break free of a controlling effect.

name: Prototype Companion
summary: You have created a construct companion, and while it might not be an innovation, it serves as a trustworthy minion.

name: Tamper
summary: You tamper with a foe's weapon or armor, using a free hand.

name: Variable Core
summary: You adjust your innovation's core, changing the way it explodes.

name: Collapse Armor
summary: You've modified your armor innovation to collapse into a more compact form so you can don or remove it in an instant.

name: Collapse Construct
summary: You've modified your construct companion and built it out of light materials, enabling you to collapse it into a carrying case or other compact and innocuous form.

name: Reverse Engineer
summary: You are incredibly skilled at reverse engineering items to learn their formulas, or disassembling them just to disable them.

name: Searing Restoration
summary: They told you there was no way that explosions could heal people, but they were fools… Fools who didn't understand your brilliance! You create a minor explosion from your innovation, altering the combustion to cauterize wounds using vaporized medicinal herbs.

name: Advanced Construct Companion
summary: You've upgraded your construct companion's power and decision-making ability.

name: Diving Armor
summary: You've modified your armor with fins, rotors, and other devices to make it easy for you to move through the water, plus mechanical gills that can help you extract breathable air from water.

name: Dual-Form Weapon
summary: You've built your innovation with replaceable interlocking pieces that you can use to transform it into another type of weapon entirely.

name: Gadget Specialist
summary: Rather than just using your gadgets for various boosts and tweaks, you also craft a few specific temporary consumable gadgets each day.

name: Megaton Strike
summary: You activate gears, explosives, and other hidden mechanisms in your innovation to make a powerful attack.

name: Clockwork Celerity
summary: You can use unstable clockwork devices in your innovation to push your invention to act more quickly.

name: Construct Shell
summary: You've adjusted your construct innovation so that when you ride it, special plates, hollows, or similar form partial barriers around you to add additional protection.

name: Megavolt
summary: You bleed off some electric power from your innovation in the shape of a damaging bolt.

name: Visual Fidelity
summary: You've found a way to use a hodgepodge combination of devices to enhance your visual abilities in every situation.

name: Gigaton Strike
summary: When you use a full-power Megaton Strike, you can knock your foe back.

name: Incredible Construct Companion
summary: Thanks to your continual tinkering, your construct companion has advanced to an astounding new stage of engineering, enhancing all its attributes.

name: Manifold Modifications
summary: You've modified your innovation using clever workarounds, so you can include another initial modification without compromising its structure.

name: Overdrive Ally
summary: You quickly fling some of your powered-up mechanisms to an ally, sharing your benefits with them briefly.

name: Ubiquitous Gadgets
summary: They thought you had used up all your devices, but they thought wrong! You have a few more gadgets up your sleeve than others expect.

name: Distracting Explosion
summary: Your enemies think they can concentrate on something else while you're nearby? Oh, you'll give them a distraction, all right!

name: Electrify Armor
summary: You electrify your armor to punish foes who dare to attack you.

name: Helpful Tinkering
summary: You don't just tinker with your own innovation, you fiddle with your allies' weapons as well (for their benefit, of course).

name: Lock On
summary: Aha! You lock on to your enemy's weak point to assist your construct companion in destroying it.

name: Boost Modulation
summary: You aren't satisfied with keeping to just one kind of boost from your constant tinkering, so you've learned to modulate between several possibilities at once.

name: Contingency Gadgets
summary: You are too brilliant to be caught off guard, and you always have just the right gadget for the situation.

name: Deep Freeze
summary: You vent a jet of supercooled fluid from your innovation, damaging a foe and slowing it down.

name: Gigavolt
summary: When you unleash electricity from your innovation, you can bounce it off obstacles, creating a field of electric death.

name: Shared Overdrive
summary: You've experimented enough on your teammates to transfer a substantial number of powered-up gizmos to them, enabling one of your allies to benefit from the full effects and duration of your Overdrive.

name: Explosive Maneuver
summary: Thanks to a hidden experimental feature you built into your weapon, your weapon explosively deploys levers, tangling hooks, or similar mechanisms to provide significant assistance when you perform a combat maneuver.

name: Paragon Companion
summary: Your construct companion has reached the pinnacle of form and function.

name: Soaring Armor
summary: You've managed to free your innovation from the bonds of gravity!

name: Unstable Redundancies
summary: You've built triple redundancies into your innovation and added all sorts of buffers to protect it from the harm of your unstable experiments.

name: Just the Thing!
summary: Need to balance on a razor's edge, force open an iron door, or persuade a dragon to negotiate? Never fear! No matter the situation, you always have just the thing.

name: Persistent Boost
summary: Your innovation sets foes on fire, covers them in acid, leaves barbed thorns behind, or otherwise deals persistent damage to your foes that sticks around long after you deliver your boosted attack.

name: You Failed to Account for… This!
summary: When your foes try to attack you, you always seem to have some outlandish invention you can pull out at the last second to protect you from whatever attack they throw at you.

name: Devastating Weaponry
summary: You release a volley of projectiles from your weapon, or power it to fly in every direction across the battlefield and Strike multiple creatures.

name: Engine of Destruction
summary: Your construct unleashes a broad swath of devastation by separating its limbs, deploying hidden armaments, or using a similar technique to wreak havoc.

name: Negate Damage
summary: Your armor innovation activates various devices you prepared ahead of time, and you use one of them to reduce the damage you would take by 15.

name: Full Automation
summary: You become so entwined with your innovations that you can use them without a second thought.

name: Ubiquitous Overdrive
summary: You prepare a variety of incredible gizmos on each of your allies, linking them together through careful modification to enable you to power them up all at once.

name: Automaton Armament
summary: You've been provided a body part designed for combat.

name: Arcane Communication
summary: You can deliver silent messages.

name: Arcane Eye
summary: Your eye has been magically enhanced to pierce darkness.

name: Automaton Lore
summary: You have come to better understand the process that made your body and the magic that powers it.

name: Energy Beam
summary: You can channel your core's power through the magical gem that serves as your eye.

name: Reinforced Chassis
summary: Your body is designed to be particularly resilient.

name: Arcane Safeguards
summary: The magic powering you makes it difficult for outside magic to affect you.

name: Integrated Armament
summary: Your mechanical body houses a weapon or shield that you can quickly draw and stow, leaving you prepared for combat at all times.

name: Magical Resistance
summary: Your animating magic provides some defense.

name: Arcane Camouflage
summary: You have developed magical techniques to aid you with stalking your prey.

name: Arcane Propulsion
