summary: You redirect energy from your core to ports on your back or feet, allowing you to fly for a short time.

name: Arcane Slam
summary: You channel magical power from your core into your arm, empowering your attack as you attempt to slam your foe into the ground.

name: Core Attunement
summary: Your core allows you to draw more power from it.

name: Lesser Augmentation
summary: You've focused on enhancing yourself and have received an improvement to one of your existing abilities.

name: Rain of Bolts
summary: Throughout the day, your body produces powerful projectiles within your chassis.

name: Arcane Locomotion
summary: You've modified your body to allow you to augment your movement.

name: Astral Blink
summary: You've attuned your core to allow you to phase in and out of the Astral Plane, allowing you to teleport periodically.

name: Core Rejuvenation
summary: Your soul taps into your core's power to push against the grasp of death and allow you to recover consciousness.

name: Enlarged Chassis
summary: You've empowered your core to support a larger body, granting you size and additional reach.

name: Axial Recall
summary: You have reconfigured the magical resonance of your core to attune to the planar energies of Axis.

name: Core Cannon
summary: Your body transforms into a powerful magical cannon.

name: Greater Augmentation
summary: You've greatly improved your abilities and your core can support further augmentations.

name: Inventor Dedication
summary: You become trained in Crafting and inventor class DC.

name: Basic Breakthrough
summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level inventor feat of your choice.

name: Brilliant Crafter
summary: Your skill at crafting is unparalleled.

name: Advanced Breakthrough
summary: You gain one inventor feat.

name: Explosion
summary: Your innovation can explode on command.

name: Basic Modification
summary: You've learned to modify your innovation in order to enhance its capabilities beyond what an ordinary piece of equipment can accomplish.

name: Overwatch Dedication
summary: You have an innate knack for tactical observation, and you've innovated to apply that knack in a variety of ways that allow you to assist your allies.

name: Spyglass Modification
summary: Your enhanced visual gear includes a regulating scope and reflectors, combined in an ingenuous setup that allows you to see around corners within the area of your overwatch field.

name: Swift Intervention
summary: You're burdened with noticing potential threats at all times.

name: Topple Giants
summary: When you observe an ally try and fail to execute a strategic maneuver against your enemies, you coordinate with your other allies to finish the job.

name: Wide Overwatch
summary: Through a variety of perceptive techniques, careful routines, and upgrades to your enhanced visual gear, you have become able to observe and maintain your overwatch at a much greater distance.

name: Forewarn
summary: Your foresight and planning are more valuable than armor as you direct your ally away from danger, but there's a limit to how often you can guide your allies away from a foe's relentless assaults.

name: Master Spotter
summary: Your incredible perception and trusty enhanced visual gear allow you to see things others miss.

name: Control Tower
summary: Your keen senses and ability to process battlefield information have dramatically improved, allowing you to drastically reduce the advantage of unseen foes.

name: Converge
summary: Informing your ally of an opening created by your shot, you coordinate to set them up to hit the target at the same time.

name: Sterling Dynamo Dedication
summary: You obtain a sterling dynamo prosthetic, which allows you to replace or augment a limb, or even add a simple new non-prehensile limb, such as a tail.

name: Modular Dynamo
summary: Your dynamo has modular configurations, allowing you to swap between various different possibilities with ease in order to adapt to various situations in combat.

name: Piston Punch
summary: You lash out with a powerful punch, extending your dynamo to a greater length in order to attack two creatures in a row.

name: Stasian Smash
summary: You've modified your dynamo with Stasian coils, allowing you to make a powerful attack that crackles with electricity.

name: Beast Dynamo Howl
summary: You've incorporated beast tech from Arcadia into your dynamo, adding in components from various terrifying creatures to enhance your prosthesis's capabilities.

name: Golem Dynamo
summary: You've learned the secrets of Jistkan golem prostheses, allowing you to incorporate golem components into your dynamo and gain a portion of their magic.

name: Soaring Dynamo
summary: You've built clockwork wings or jets into your dynamo, allowing you to use your prosthesis to fly.

name: Trapsmith Dedication
summary: You use glimmering gears and gnashing mechanisms to manufacture snares using specialized parts.

name: Gear Gnash
summary: Snares you create have complicated inner workings that are quite difficult to disable.

name: Propeller Attachment
summary: You've mastered attaching clockwork propellers to your daily quick-deploy snares that use gears.

name: Recycled Cogwheel
summary: You're able to scavenge the cogwheels from your daily quick-deploy snares that use gears.

name: Repurposed Parts
summary: You are familiar with the fittings and cogwheels of your snares and can repurpose parts from prepared quick-deploy snares to assemble a new creation on the fly.

name: Finessed Features
summary: You've learned how to build snares that trigger based on visual stimuli.

name: Trick Driver Dedication
summary: You are equally at home piloting any vehicle, adapting yourself instantly to varied controls, movements, and handling.

name: Express Driver
summary: You can optimize your vehicle's performance, coaxing extra speed and choosing paths to avoid slowdowns.

name: Take the Wheel
prerequisite: Trick Driver Dedication; Expert in Driving Lore
summary: Diving into a moving vehicle and seizing the controls is nothing new for you.

name: Power Slide
summary: You throw the vehicle into a barely controlled skid, turning sharply to evade pursuit or bring your weapons to bear.

name: Push it
prerequisite: Trick Driver Dedication; Master in Driving Lore
summary: You can push your vehicle's performance beyond the limits envisioned by its makers.

name: Roadkill
summary: In your hands, any vehicle is a weapon.

name: Drive-By Attack
summary: You can smoothly line up an attack without disrupting your control.

name: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication
summary: You are adept at designing and maintaining mechanical vehicles, and you lavish your attention and ingenuity on one vehicle in particular.

name: Engine Bay
prerequisite: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication; Expert in Crafting
summary: You are practiced at working in vast garages of vehicles and can work on many machines at a time.

name: Patch Job
summary: You can patch up damage to an object with a quick fix.

name: Superior Propulsion
summary: By experimenting with the effects of momentum gained from your signature vehicle's movement, you have learned to get more from propulsion than just speed when the pilot pushes the vehicle to its limit.

name: Efficient Controls
prerequisite: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication; Master in Crafting
summary: By reducing redundant systems and streamlining essential functions, you have made it easier for the vehicle to operate with fewer crew.

name: Impervious Vehicle
summary: From armor plating and flexible components, to reinforced materials and backup redundant functionality, you have built safeguards to protect your vehicle from the rigors of combat.

name: Miraculous Flight
summary: With superior engineering and magical application, you have freed your signature vehicle from the bonds of gravity, allowing it to soar through the sky like a dragon.

name: Blast Lock
summary: Sometimes taking the shortest distance between two points involves removing an obstacle or two.

name: Cover Fire
summary: You lay down suppressive fire to protect allies by forcing foes to take cover from your wild attacks.

name: Crossbow Crack Shot
summary: You have a deep understanding of the crossbow.

name: Hit the Dirt!
summary: You fling yourself out of harm's way.

name: Munitions Crafter
summary: Bullets and bombs can be scarce in some parts, so you've learned to make your own.

name: Sword and Pistol
summary: You're comfortable wielding a firearm or crossbow in one hand and a melee weapon in the other, combining melee attacks with shots from the firearm.

name: Defensive Armaments
summary: You use bulky firearms or crossbows to shield your body from your foes' attacks.

name: Fake Out
summary: With a skilled flourish of your weapon, you force an enemy to acknowledge you as a threat.

name: Pistol Twirl
summary: Your quick gestures and flair for performance distract your opponent, leaving it vulnerable to your follow-up attacks.

name: Risky Reload
summary: You've practiced a technique for rapidly reloading your firearm, but attempting to use this technique is a dangerous gamble with your firearm's functionality.

name: Warning Shot
summary: Who needs words when the roar of a gun is so much more succinct?

name: Alchemical Shot
summary: You've practiced a technique for mixing alchemical bombs with your loaded shot.

name: Black Powder Boost
summary: You fire your weapon as you jump, using the kickback to go farther.

name: Instant Backup
summary: Even as your firearm misfires, you quickly draw a backup weapon.

name: Paired Shots
summary: Your shots hit simultaneously.

name: Advanced Shooter
summary: You've dedicated your training to the most complex and weird weapons of your favorite group.

name: Cauterize
summary: You use the smoking barrel of your firearm to sear shut a bleeding wound.

name: Drifter's Juke
summary: You move in and out of range to complement your attacks.

name: Munitions Machinist
summary: You're particularly adept at crafting ammunition and bombs.

name: Phalanx Breaker
summary: You know that to take out an enemy formation, you must punch a hole through its center.

name: Pistolero's Challenge
summary: With a stern call, carefully chosen barb, or some other challenging declaration, you demand your foe's attention in a duel.

name: Scatter Blast
summary: You pack your weapon with additional shot and powder, creating a risky but devastating wave of destruction.

name: Sniper's Aim
summary: You take an extra moment to carefully sync your aim and breathing, then fire a shot with great accuracy.

name: Bullet Split
summary: You carefully align your weapon with the edge of your blade, splitting the projectile in two as you fire to attack two different targets.

name: Grit and Tenacity
summary: You call upon deep reserves of toughness and mental fortitude to power through an otherwise debilitating effect.

name: Leap and Fire
summary: You're quick enough to line up a shot even while diving to the ground.

name: Smoke Curtain
summary: You load an extra dose of powder into your shot, causing it to belch a cloud of smoke.

name: Stab and Blast
summary: You slice or smash your opponent with the melee portion of your weapon before pulling the trigger at point-blank range.

name: Called Shot
summary: You target a specific area of your foe's anatomy to debilitating effect.

name: Deflecting Shot
summary: You're always ready to take a quick shot to deflect a weapon or distract a foe enough to render them off target.

name: Penetrating Fire
summary: You blast a bullet through one foe and into another.

name: Precious Munitions
summary: You mix flecks of precious materials you've gathered on your journeys into your custom bullets to bring out those properties in your temporary ammunition.

name: Rebounding Assault
summary: You hurl your melee weapon at an opponent, then fire a bullet into the weapon's hilt, making it deal additional damage and bounce back to your grasp.

name: Redirecting Shot
summary: Seeing your ally's attack about to go astray, you fire your weapon to right its course.

name: Trick Shot
summary: You shoot not at your foe but at an object nearby.

name: Twin Shot Knockdown
summary: You fire at an enemy while targeting a part of its anatomy that will disrupt its balance.

name: Blood in the Air
summary: Once you've locked on to a target, little can obscure your aim.

name: Deadeye
summary: You relax your eyes, taking in the presence of hidden things, granting you the ability to locate invisible creatures.

name: Flesh Wound
summary: You fire to ensure that even if your shot doesn't land cleanly, it still lands close enough to deal some damage.

name: Ricochet Shot
summary: You bounce your shot off a nearby surface to strike your opponent from an unexpected angle.

name: Shattering Shot
summary: You fling a bomb into the air and then shoot it with your gun before it falls, raining destruction down over a wide area.

name: Shooter's Camouflage
summary: You specialize in blending into a particular type of environment, able to disappear after taking your shot.

name: Unshakable Grit
summary: You've become hardened by conflict after everything you've faced, and you possess a certain intractable stubbornness.

name: Blast Tackle
summary: You throw yourself at an enemy, bracing your weapon against it and pulling it close before releasing a destructive shot.

name: Come at Me!
summary: You're a legendary duelist, welcoming all challengers, enabling you to challenge many foes even while other challenges are active.

name: Dance of Thunder
summary: Your steps echo with the thunderous retort of exploding black powder as you dance a dance of death.

name: Disruptive Blur
summary: You use cacophonous blasts from your gun or distracting shots from your crossbow to cause momentary diversions, letting you move about the battlefield with impunity.

name: Headshot
summary: You attempt to finish your target with a final, well-placed shot.

name: Showstopper
summary: Your twirling weapons create a grand distraction that's difficult to look away from.

name: Two-Weapon Fusillade
summary: You attack with both your weapons in a furious barrage.

name: Fatal Bullet
summary: You're especially talented at striking your enemies in their most vulnerable areas.

name: Hair Trigger
prerequisite: initial deed that allows you to Interact to draw a weapon
summary: No one can react faster than you can pull your trigger.

name: Instant Return
summary: With a single fluid gesture, you catch a projectile out of the air, load it in your weapon, and shoot it back at the attacker.

name: Ricochet Master
summary: You have an eye for angles and can find shots that others believe are impossible.

name: Final Shot
summary: You jam a triple charge of black powder into your weapon to unleash a devastating but risky and inaccurate attack.

name: Piercing Critical
summary: Your attacks with your preferred weapons deal especially devastating wounds.

name: Unerring Shot
summary: Your senses are finely tuned to the slightest variations in the air, so much that you can place your shot exactly where you intend to aim it from any range possible with your weapon.

name: Reach for the Stars
summary: The sky's the limit, as long as you've got enough black powder.

name: Perfect Readiness
summary: You prepare to fire with an instinctive speed and muscle memory that go beyond your conscious thoughts.

name: Ricochet Legend
summary: The more obstacles between you and your target, the deadlier your shots become, as you ricochet off multiple surfaces to hit them.

name: Slinger's Reflexes
summary: Your ability to react to unexpected circumstances is preternaturally sharp.

name: Gunslinger Dedication
summary: You become trained in simple and martial crossbows and simple and martial firearms.

name: Basic Shooting
summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level gunslinger feat of your choice.

name: Advanced Shooting
summary: You gain one gunslinger feat.

name: Slinger's Readiness
summary: You've learned a gunslinger's tricks for staking out your territory in a fight.

name: Practiced Reloads
summary: You've mastered the reloading techniques and methods usually practiced by only the most dedicated firearm professionals.

name: Eagle Eye
summary: Your practice with crossbows and firearms has sharpened your attention to detail.

name: Advanced Firearm Familiarity
prerequisite: Gunslinger Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack
summary: You have familiarity with advanced firearms, treating them as martial weapons for the purposes of proficiency.

name: Artillerist Dedication
summary: Artillery is a team sport, where every member of the crew has to rely on the other members.

name: Named Artillery
summary: It is a tradition among artillerists to name the siege weapon most important to them and closest to their heart—much as a sailor on a ship, the weapon is their livelihood.

name: Shorthanded
summary: You can operate a siege weapon with fewer than the minimum number of crew, at an increasing penalty.

name: Cannon Corner Shot
summary: By loading special ammunition in a particular way, you can make your siege weapons do all manner of tricks that other siege engineers can barely even imagine.

name: Field Artillery
summary: While castles are generally obliging enough to stay in one place, out in the field positioning is of paramount importance—a gun in the wrong place is worse than useless.

name: Live Ammunition
summary: There are generally few things as ill-advised as being shot out of a cannon or launched by a trebuchet, but people use the tactic every so often in a desperate situation.

name: Master Siege Engineer
summary: What you don't know about artillery isn't worth knowing and your mastery allows you to perform an impossible number of actions as part of a siege weapon's crew.

name: Beast Gunner Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Arcana; Trained in Crafting; expert with at least one type of firearm, you own a beast gun and have slain the type of creature associated with your beast gun in a fair hunt (see above)
summary: You've bonded to your beast gun and unlocked the first hints of its hidden potential.

name: Basic Beast Gunner Spellcasting
summary: You've unlocked the first secrets of beast guns, granting you the power of their synergistic magic.

name: Drain Vitality
summary: You draw out the bestial magic energy within your bonded beast gun to fortify yourself, purge ongoing harm, and bolster your life force with a sheath of swirling life essence.

name: Expert Beast Gunner Spellcasting
prerequisite: Basic Beast Gunner Spellcasting or Basic Wizard Spellcasting
summary: You've learned the deeper secrets of beast guns, making you an expert in the magic they grant you.

name: Controlled Bullet
summary: You create a direct magical connection with your beast gun, allowing you to guide the beast gun's next shot by taking control of the projectile directly.

name: Master Beast Gunner Spellcasting
prerequisite: Expert Beast Gunner Spellcasting or Expert Wizard Spellcasting
summary: You've learned the final truth of beast guns, making you a master in the magic they grant you.

name: Bullet Dancer Dedication
prerequisite: expert in unarmored defense and trained in unarmed attack
summary: You've learned how to synchronize traditional martial arts and guns.

name: Bullet Dancer Burn
summary: The fiery blaze of your weapons combined with your unorthodox technique leaves your opponents with little opportunity to capitalize on any gaps in your defenses, or properly defend themselves against your onslaught.

name: Black Powder Blaze
summary: You learn to take advantage of every shot, flying across the battlefield with the help of your weapon's recoil.

name: Bullet Dancer Reload
summary: You've learned to reload your simple firearms with uncanny grace, the ammunition simply falling into place as though part of a well-practiced kata.

name: Ranged Disarm
summary: When using a simple firearm, you can shoot objects right out of your enemy's hands.

name: Demolitionist Dedication
summary: You know how to set explosives to cause the maximum possible damage to buildings and other structures.

name: Safety Measures
summary: You're often careful to be sure you're not hoisted on your own petard, or anyone else's, for that matter.

name: Explosive Entry
prerequisite: Demolitionist Dedication; Master in Engineering Lore
summary: You know exactly how to make a memorable entrance.

name: Controlled Blast
summary: You maximize the effectiveness of your explosives by controlling every possible parameter of the blast meticulously.

name: Collapse Wall
summary: You detonate the required bombs in order to bring a wall down on a creature.

name: Pistol Phenom Dedication
prerequisite: trained in at least one type of one-handed firearm; Trained in Deception; Trained in Performance
summary: You catch an opponent off-guard by spinning your weapon.

name: Gunpowder Gauntlet
summary: Your flair keeps foes' attention, as your motions with your gun draw your foes into a deadly game.

name: Dazzling Bullet
summary: Your tricks discombobulate your opponent, leaving spots in their vision from the bright flash of your gunshot reflected straight into their eyes.

name: Hot Foot
summary: Using a carefully aimed shot, you make a creature “dance.”

name: Phenom's Verve
summary: You're possessed with an incredibly vivacious spark that separates you not only from ordinary gun users and gunslingers, but even from other phenoms.

name: Reach for the Sky
summary: You command the room, firing a gun into the air and ordering everyone to surrender and put their hands in the air.

name: Whirling Knockdown
summary: You fire your gun while throwing off a target's balance with your melee weapon.

name: Sniping Duo Dedication
prerequisite: trained in at least one type of weapon in the crossbow or firearm groups; Trained in Stealth
summary: You can choose one willing, non-minion ally to act as your spotter.

name: Triangulate
summary: Your spotter's quick signals help you make even difficult shots seem simple.

name: Exploit Opening
summary: You take advantage of your spotter’s devastating attack to unleash your own follow-up attack.

name: Targeted Redirection
summary: You aim a shot at your spotter, intending for your spotter to redirect that shot off their own weapon or shield to hit your foe from a better angle, and avoid your foe's cover.

name: Duo's Aim
summary: With assistance from your spotter, you aim for an especially accurate attack.

name: Vantage Shot
summary: You and your spotter take advantage of each other's attacks to momentarily hide and throw your foes off-balance against your follow-up attack.

name: Tag Team
summary: Your skilled teamwork with your spotter enables you both to assist one another when you falter, using either other's failures as opportunities to strike.

name: Eagle Eyes
summary: You and your spotter are adept at watching out for one another.

name: Concentrated Assault
summary: You and your spotter combine your efforts to bring down your target.

name: Spellshot Dedication
summary: You've steeped yourself in magic and gunplay to the extent that you can conjure bullets from thin air.

name: Fulminating Shot
summary: You channel potent magic into your next shot, empowering it with a blast of crackling energy.

name: Call Gun
summary: You build a powerful magical connection with a chosen gun or crossbow, gaining the ability to conjure it directly to your hand from any distant location.

name: Phase Bullet
summary: You can aim your bullets not just in three normal dimensions, but in additional dimensions as well, removing all obstacles between you and your target.

name: Black Powder Embodiment
summary: You merge your body with your ammunition, enabling you to travel the same path as your bolt or bullet.

name: Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication
summary: Who needs skill when you've got dumb luck?

name: Lucky Escape
summary: Force your foe to reroll the triggering attack

name: No Hard Feelings
summary: Despite the devastation your weapons tend to inflict upon their targets or the destruction you might unleash upon an area, your foes still manage to walk away at the end of a fight—at least sometimes.

name: That was a Close One, Huh?
prerequisite: Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication; Master in Deception
summary: You laugh innocently about the inexplicable luck of your last shot hitting its mark or how close the attack that just missed you came to taking your head off, causing your foes to second guess whether it's a good idea to oppose you in battle.

name: Unbelievable Luck
summary: While no one, not even you, might appear to understand why, you demonstrate a greater ability to hit your targets regardless of the obstacles in your way.

name: Unbelievable Escape
summary: Your ability to narrowly evade danger defies all logic.

name: I Meant to Do That
prerequisite: Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication; Trained in Deception
summary: Somehow your stray bullet causes an unintended reaction that creates a problem for your enemy: perhaps a ricochet knocks your foe's weapon away or they stumble over stray debris in an attempt to dodge your bullets.

name: Chain Reaction
summary: You fire your gun once, creating a devastating and unpredictable chain of events; perhaps your bullet strikes exactly the right spot on a water tower, causing it to flood and incite a stampede of horses which knock over a lantern that sets a city on fire.

name: Adaptive Vision
summary: After years of using black powder weaponry in dimly lit spaces, you've become accustomed to dazzling flashes of light and sudden shifts in illumination.

name: Clan Pistol
summary: Raised in the ancient halls of Dongun Hold or the surrounding region, you display your lineage with a clan pistol, rather than a clan dagger.

name: Dongun Education
summary: You're knowledgeable in trades that are important to your people's survival and commercial interests.

name: Explosive Savant
summary: A lifetime wielding firearms and explosive ordinance amid the chaos of battle has granted you great skill with volatile weapons.

name: Fire Savvy
summary: You've grown up around a forge and are well-suited to dealing with smoke and flame.

name: Blast Resistance
summary: You're used to the clamor of steel, the crack of a firearm, and the thunderous blast of explosions.

name: Spark Fist
summary: You dust explosive black powder on your fist or glove before attacking, which combusts as you hit an opponent.

name: Demolitionist
summary: You know how to destroy objects with a well-placed explosion.

name: Smoke Sight
summary: You're used to fighting and hiding in a haze of smoke and flame.

name: Crafter's Instinct
summary: You sense a minor flaw in the weapon as you fire it, and quickly adjust your aim on the fly to avoid the flaw.

name: Explosive Expert
summary: You have continued training in volatile weapons and gained a deeper understanding.

name: Scrutinizing Gaze
summary: Your family's traditions of defending against Geb's undead have granted you a sixth sense for detecting spirits, haunts, and other restless dead, no matter their form or the strength of their presence.

name: Forge-Blessed Shot
summary: You intone a prayer to the dwarven deities Torag or Angradd, willing a higher power to guide your aim in the heat of battle.

name: Dual-Weapon Reload (Gunslinger)
summary: You carry your ammunition in a way that allows you to reload while holding two weapons.

name: Executioner Weapon Training
prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: Your Gray Gardener training has made you deeply skilled with the weapons that execute with a swift chop to the neck.
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 64

name: Harsh Judgment
prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: You loudly declare the creature's life forfeit by your judgment
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 64

name: Voice of Authority
prerequisite: Expert in Intimidation; Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: You easily command the attention of others, and when the time comes to turn threats into action, your authoritative voice causes foes to falter.
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 64

name: Discerning Gaze
prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: You have a sense for when people are lying.
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65

name: Frightful Condemnation
prerequisite: Harsh Judgment; Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: Your willingness to follow through on your pitiless judgment is frightful to the person you have condemned.
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65

name: Accurate Swing
prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Harsh Judgment; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: You strike cleanly with wide, sweeping attacks to inflict maximum damage
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65

name: Gardener's Resolve
prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: The Gray Gardeners are known for having nerves of steel and an unbreakable resolve.
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65

name: Reminder of the Greater Fear
summary: You give a target a stern glower to remind them that it is you, and no one else, they should truly fear.
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65

name: Strident Command
prerequisite: Master in Intimidation; Vigilante Dedication; Voice of Authority; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: The common folk heed your demands, and though your true foes rarely bend to your commands, when they do the hesitation can cost them the battle.
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65

name: Execution
prerequisite: Harsh Judgment; Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: You swing wide, attempting to behead your condemned foe.
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65

name: Terrifying Countenance
prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
summary: You can erect a magical cowl that terrorizes your enemies.
source: Night of the Gray Death pg. 65

name: Harmless Doll
summary: You look like nothing more than an ordinary toy, doll, or statuette, and you can fool others with your innocuous appearance.

name: Helpful Poppet
summary: You're particularly skilled at helping others with a task.

name: Quadruped
summary: You were crafted in a form with four legs rather than two.

name: Shiny Button Eyes
summary: You've polished your eyes to reflect the smallest details in dimmest light.

name: Wash Out
summary: Toxins seep out of your artificial body quickly.

name: Cunning Tinker
summary: Time spent tending to your own form has unlocked your ability to fix other things.

name: Histrionic Injury
summary: You respond with a startled look, dramatic pratfall, or theatrical arm-flailing that stymies your attacker.

name: Nothing but Fluff
summary: Your fluffy interior lacks specific organs and struts, with few weak spots to injure.

name: Sealed Poppet
summary: You've reinforced your interior parts with sealant or other flame-retardant materials, protecting you from fire.

name: Spark of Independence
summary: You touch a creature with the minion trait and share the heightened sense of autonomy you've discovered.

name: Swimming Poppet
summary: Your fins, flippers, or other accessories assist with steering you through water.

name: Scaling Poppet
summary: Your construction integrates ropes, hooks, or other tools to help you move across steep surfaces.

name: Wheedle and Jig
summary: You make capering motions and silly sounds to captivate onlookers.

name: Impossible Gossip
summary: You can speak to inanimate objects, finding a magical spark within them similar to the one that animated you.

name: Reanimating Spark
summary: The magic that animates you strains to keep you alive.

name: Squirm Free
summary: You're used to slipping out of a bigger creature's grasp or escaping a child's overly enthusiastic hug.

name: Restitch
summary: You've learned how to sew even the most terrible tears and wounds together.

name: Soaring Poppet
summary: Your construction has flaps of cloth or wicker that can keep you aloft.

name: Captivator Dedication
prerequisite: Charisma 14; Trained in Deception or Trained in Diplomacy
summary: Your ability to captivate others borders on the preternatural.

name: Basic Captivator Spellcasting
summary: Your innate ability to fascinate others develops into full-fledged spellcasting.

name: Captivating Intensity
summary: Your ability to captivate others has grown, and you can use your captivator abilities more often.

name: Countercharm
summary: Your enchantments and illusions are so dominant that you can use them to counteract similar magic cast by others.

name: Heightened Captivation
summary: You can infuse your enchantments and illusions with more power.

name: Expert Captivator Spellcasting
summary: You learn more powerful spells to enchant and deceive.

name: Reactive Charm
summary: You're so charming and distracting that when pressed, you can cast a simple enchantment in time to foil an attacker.

name: Effortless Captivation
summary: You maintain your innate enchantments and illusions with hardly a thought.

name: Master Captivator Spellcasting
summary: You master the most powerful spells that enchant and deceive.

name: Look Again
summary: If your illusions or enchantments fail to ensnare the minds of others, you can cast them again.

name: Spell Trickster Dedication
prerequisite: Able to cast spells; Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
summary: Your experience with magic and its traditions lets you specialize in the casting of certain spells, customizing familiar spells to create novel effects.

name: Agile Hand
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _mage hand_
summary: When you cast _mage hand_, you can modify it to control a set of thieves' tools.

name: Barrier Shield
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _shield_
summary: When you cast _shield_, you can modify the spell to create a solid barrier you can use for cover, but not for blocking.

name: Forceful Push
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _mage hand_
summary: When you cast _mage hand_, you can modify it to shove a creature.

name: Shining Arms
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _light_
summary: When you cast _light_, you can modify its target to be 1 melee weapon.

name: Summon Ensemble
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _summon instrument_
summary: When you cast _summon instrument_, you can modify it to summon multiple instruments.

name: Tracing Sigil
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _sigil_
summary: When you cast _sigil_, you can modify the spell to allow you to track the target.

name: Wild Lights
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _dancing lights_
summary: When you cast _dancing lights_, you can modify it to create a single floating light in the shape of a Tiny creature.

name: Animate Net
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _animate rope_
summary: When you cast _animate rope_, you can modify it to animate a net.

name: Confounding Image
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _mirror image_
summary: When you cast _mirror image_, you can modify it to create a duplicate of yourself.

name: Disk Rider
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _floating disk_
summary: When you cast _floating disk_, you can modify it to ride atop.

name: Drenching Mist
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _obscuring mist_
summary: When you cast _obscuring mist_, you can modify it to extinguish flames.

name: Obscured Terrain
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _obscuring mist_
summary: When you cast _obscuring mist_, you can modify the spell to blanket the area, making it difficult to see the ground.

name: Uneasy Rest
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _sleep_
summary: When you cast _sleep_, you can modify the spell to make subjects of your spell experience troubled dreams.

name: Volatile Grease
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _grease_
summary: When you cast _grease_, you can modify it to cover a creature in flammable grease.

name: Beacon Mark
summary: When you cast _sigil_, you can modify the spell to allow you to determine the target's location.

name: Larcenous Hand
summary: When you cast _mage hand_, you can modify it to steal an object from the target.

name: Lingering Flames
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _fireball_
summary: When you cast _fireball_, you can modify its effects to set creatures in its area aflame.

name: Scattered Fire
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _fireball_
summary: When you cast _fireball_, you can modify its area to be two non-overlapping 10-foot bursts.

name: Siphoning Touch
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _vampiric touch_
summary: When you cast _vampiric touch_, you can modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of gaining the temporary Hit Points yourself, you can grant the temporary Hit Points to an ally within 30 feet.

name: Smoldering Explosion
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _fireball_
summary: When you cast _fireball_, you can modify the spell to leave behind a brief cloud of smoke in its area.

name: Steal Vitality
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _vampiric touch_
summary: When you cast _vampiric touch_, you can modify it to remove your enfeebled or clumsy condition.

name: Surrounding Flames
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _wall of fire_
summary: When you cast _wall of fire_, you can modify it to create a 10-foot-radius hemisphere of fire.

name: Toppling Tentacles
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _black tentacles_
summary: When you cast _black tentacles_, you can modify it to trip the targets.

name: Choking Smoke
summary: When you cast _fireball_, you can modify it to create a cloud of smoking smoke.

name: Directed Poison
prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _cloudkill_
summary: When you cast _cloudkill_, you can modify it to be under your control.

name: Cloud Walk
summary: Your growing link to cloud dragons has granted you the ability to walk on clouds.

name: Shape of the Cloud Dragon
summary: You've discovered how to transform yourself into a cloud dragon.

name: Deflecting Cloud
prerequisite: Dragon Disciple Dedication; _dragon wings_ sorcerer bloodline spell
summary: You've mastered a defensive technique unique to the ancient dragons of Bloodsalt: beating your wings to create a billowing cloud of mist.

name: Mighty Wings
prerequisite: Dragon Disciple Dedication; _dragon wings_ sorcerer bloodline spell
summary: Your dragon wings are now a permanent part of your body, giving you a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Blessing of the Sun Gods
summary: The Old Sun Gods share their power with you.
source: Pathfinder #172: Secrets of the Temple City pg. 79

name: Lion's Might
summary: You've trained with the weapons of the Bright Lions.
source: Pathfinder #172: Secrets of the Temple City pg. 79

name: Lion's Fury
summary: You gain access to the lion scythe's and sun sling's critical specialization effects.
source: Pathfinder #172: Secrets of the Temple City pg. 79

name: Greater Sun Blessing
summary: Your connection to the Old Sun Gods grows stronger.
source: Pathfinder #172: Secrets of the Temple City pg. 79

name: Pactbound Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Nature; Erutaki or Giant language, must have earned the trust of a saumen kar who initiates you into the archetype
summary: You befriended one of the last saumen kar and were infused with a fraction of their power, granting you the potential to become a guardian of their ancient pact.

name: Ice Crafter
summary: The ancient ice-crafting techniques of the saumen kar awaken within you.

name: Crown of the Saumen Kar
summary: Your body begins to evolve and adapt, taking the first steps towards blending your very self with the ancient curse of the saumen kar.

name: Frostbite Runes
summary: Thick tattoos, each one a rune fragment from the saumen kar's long-lost language spelling out their pact with their equally lost deity, cover your body and stretch across your limbs, torso, and face.

name: Curse of the Saumen Kar
summary: You activate the runes on your body to create an icy prison around a Huge or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet.

name: Bound in Ice
summary: You become a hybrid of your ancestry and a saumen kar.

name: Irezoko Tattoo
trait: Bard, Champion, Cleric, Druid, Magus, Monk, Oracle, Psychic, Ranger, Sorcerer, Summoner, Uncommon, Witch, Wizard
prerequisite: Expert in Arcana or Expert in Occultism
summary: Your face bears an intricate magical tattoo known as the _irezoko_, a badge of your understanding of your chosen field of magic and a recognition of your advancement within Absalom's College of Mysteries.
source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens pg. 185

name: All of the Animal
summary: You know how to make the best and most efficient use of a hunted animal's carcass.

name: Spirit Speaker
summary: You know that when an animal dies, its spirit lingers briefly before moving on.

name: Tame Animal
summary: Animals born and raised far from humanoid settlements rarely get along with two-legged beings, whom they assume to be dangerous predators.

name: Game Hunter Dedication
summary: You are skilled at tracking big game animals and similar creatures.

name: Big Game Trapper
summary: You can set snares specifically for big prey, leaving smaller creatures unscathed.

name: Keep Pace
summary: When your hunted prey tries to bolt, you follow.

name: Quick Positioning
summary: You're always ready to get the jump on your target.

name: Pyrophilic Recovery
summary: You rely on fire and extreme heat to sprout and regrow.

name: Climate Adaptation
summary: Like evergreen trees, which stay healthy and vibrant from winter through summer, you too can adapt to a variety of extreme climates.

name: Defensive Needles
prerequisite: Cactus Leshy heritage or Pine Leshy heritage
summary: Your body is covered in sharp needles or spines which you can use to defend yourself.

name: Towering Growth
summary: You're capable of growing as tall as a pine tree for a short time.

name: Cunning Trickster Mask
summary: Your mask carries the legacy of Verdant Spider, the Speaker of Needs, allowing you to deceive and outwit your foes.
source: Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients pg. 78

name: Emancipator's Mask
summary: Your mask grants you the abilities of Whistling Kite, the Vigilant Seer, who emancipated thousands.
source: Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients pg. 78

name: Grand Medic's Mask
summary: Your mask is infused with restorative magic associated with Ibex, the Flourishing Field, so it constantly repairs itself.
source: Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients pg. 78

name: Protective Spirit Mask
summary: Your mask carries the protective instincts of White Bull, the Horn Forger, and no one will hurt your allies while you have anything to say about it.
source: Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients pg. 78

name: Sky Master Mask
summary: Your mask holds the legacy of Black Heron, the Wings of Knowledge, who united the aeromancers of the Shory Empire.
source: Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients pg. 78

name: Stalking Feline Mask
summary: Like Azure Leopard, the Patient Warden, your mask makes you most at home in the night and teaches you how to use the darkness to hunt.
source: Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients pg. 78

name: Storyteller's Mask
summary: Your mask remembers the stories of Shifting Frog, Storyteller of the Past and Future.
source: Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients pg. 79

name: Thick Hide Mask
summary: Your mask grants you the toughness of Elephant, the Conjured Chronicle.
source: Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients pg. 79

name: Tireless Guide's Mask
summary: Your mask hosts the legacy of Golden Snake, the Tireless Guide, allowing you to guide others with ease.
source: Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients pg. 79

name: Vigilant Mask
summary: Your mask grants the extraordinary magical senses of Carmine Jaws, the Hyena who Looks Between.
source: Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients pg. 79

name: Mammoth Lord Dedication
summary: You've undertaken the ultimate challenge of the Mammoth Lords and tamed a megafauna.

name: Mammoth Charge
summary: You Command an Animal to order your megafauna companion to Stride twice.

name: Mature Megafauna Companion
summary: You've raised your megafauna companion to be a more powerful force on the battlefield than most of its kind.

name: Megafauna Veterinarian
prerequisite: Mammoth Lord Dedication; Expert in Nature
summary: By heeding the wise advice of elders in your following— and aided by your own experience—you've learned how to provide medical care to the megafauna of the Mammoth Lord followings.

name: Speech of the Mammoth Lords
prerequisite: Mammoth Lord Dedication; Master in Diplomacy or Master in Intimidation
summary: You've learned the ancient tongue spoken by the creatures of the far north.

name: Incredible Megafauna Companion
summary: Under your care and training, your megafauna companion has realized its innate potential.

name: Stalwart Mind
summary: When necessary to avoid a magical compulsion or curse, you can be as stubborn as your megafauna companion.

name: Staggering Blow
summary: You've trained your megafauna companion to stagger its enemies, impeding their ability to fight back.

name: Unbreakable Bond
summary: You and your megafauna companion are bound together; as long as you live, it's much harder for your companion to die.

name: Gigantic Megafauna Companion
summary: The mammoths and other megafauna ridden by your people are larger than any ordinary beast.

name: Specialized Megafauna Companion
summary: You've trained your mammoth or other megafauna companion to perform in unusual or extreme situations, granting it abilities far beyond others of its kind.

name: Exorcist Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion
summary: You've learned to attract, quell, and purify spirits, housing them in a special receptacle called a _spirit dwelling_ until they're ready to move on.

name: Cast Out
summary: You attempt to cast a malevolent entity out of the creature or object it's possessing.

name: Spirit's Absolution
summary: You purify a spirit by absolving it of its sins and regrets.

name: Spirit's Anguish
summary: You purify a spirit by coaxing it to release its anguish in a final cathartic howl.

name: Enticing Dwelling
summary: Your _spirit dwelling_ is particularly inviting to spirit wisps.

name: Hallowed Necromancer Dedication
prerequisite: Expert in Religion; good alignment, able to cast spells using spell slots, able to cast at least one necromancy spell
summary: You've studied techniques allowing you to blend so-called hallowed necromancy into your own spellcasting to bolster the living and destroy the undead.

name: Hallowed Initiate
summary: You've expanded your focus spellcasting to techniques used by clerics and wizards.

name: Sacred Spells
summary: Add _chill touch_, _death ward_, _disrupt undead_, _disrupting weapons_, _holy cascade_, _magic stone_, and _sunburst_ to your spell list.

name: Death Warden
summary: With your intimate familiarity with the duality of positive and negative energy, you're able to stand as a bulwark against death and undeath alike.

name: Advanced Hallowed Spell
prerequisite: Hallowed Necromancer Dedication; necromancer initial school spell or death initial domain spell
summary: You dig deeper into the magical tools found in wizard schools and divine domains.

name: Positive Luminance
summary: You learn how to create a luminous reservoir of positive energy that you can use to punish undead who dare attack you.

name: Consecrated Aura
summary: Your body radiates positive energy, making your very presence disorienting to undead and encouraging them to move away from you.

name: Soul Warden Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion; worships Pharasma or a psychopomp usher
summary: You can take 10 minutes to emblazon Pharasma's holy sigil—a spiraling comet that represents the winding path a soul takes through its existence—upon a shield, tabard, banner, or other prominent object that your wear or wield.

name: Cycle Spell
summary: Your devotion to the cycle of souls grants you an additional divine spell.

name: Psychopomp Familiar
summary: Your familiar becomes a masked psychopomp—an extraplanar guardian of the cycle of souls.

name: Liberate Soul
summary: The light flows from your sigil of Pharasma to shatter the bonds imprisoning a soul.

name: Spiral Sworn
summary: You trace a spiral in the air while intoning prayers to Pharasma, gaining her blessing for a time.

name: Enhanced Psychopomp Familiar
summary: Your psychopomp's continued service in Pharasma's name brings it favor from the goddess.

name: Safeguard Soul
summary: You've girded your soul against outside interference.

name: Expand Spiral
summary: Your prayers encompass your companions, granting you the ability to share Pharasma's blessings.

name: Undead Slayer Dedication
summary: Your training has prepared you to recognize most undead on sight.

name: Blessed Medicine
summary: Your experience battling undead has uniquely prepared you to fight the diseases they inflict on the survivors, and you know that leaving these maladies untreated for long will eventually lead to more undead.

name: Hunter's Sanctum
summary: You establish a safe house where you can prepare for your hunt.

name: Necromantic Resistance
summary: As part of your training, you've inured yourself against necromancy through grueling, repeated exposure.

name: Slayer's Strike
summary: You've dedicated yourself to studying ancient techniques and memorized minor prayers against undead to swiftly dispatch them.

name: Frighten Undead
prerequisite: Undead Slayer Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
summary: Your very presence chills creatures of the night down to their core and you can use the spiritual power and faithful life force of religious verses to frighten even mindless undead.

name: Gear Up
summary: Whether it's wooden stakes, holy water, or more unusual tools, you always have just the right thing to handle an undead's unusual weaknesses and vulnerabilities.

name: Slayer's Blessing
summary: You carry scraps of materials dangerous to undead and can apply them to your weapon.

name: Slayer's Presence
summary: Your very presence strikes fear into the undead.

name: Undying Conviction
trait: Aura, Cleric, Necromancy, Oracle, Uncommon, Wizard
prerequisite: able to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
summary: Your presence has a bolstering effect on your undead minions.

name: Necromancer's Visage
prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
summary: Necromantic energy demonstrates your power over undead, creating a demeanor that commands their fear and respect.

name: Sepulchral Sublimation
trait: Cleric, Concentrate, Metamagic, Necromancy, Oracle, Uncommon, Wizard
prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard
summary: You repurpose the negative energy that flows through your minions at a moment's notice.

name: Reanimator Dedication
prerequisite: able to cast _animate dead_ with a spell slot
summary: You have dedicated your studies to the art of raising and commanding undead.

name: Deathly Secrets
summary: No means of creating or ruling the undead is beyond your grasp, even those of magical traditions not your own.

name: Macabre Virtuoso
prerequisite: Reanimator Dedication; Expert in Arcana, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
summary: Any necromancer can create zombie and skeleton, but you know the secrets behind the creation of far more advanced undead monstrosities.

name: Bonds of Death
summary: You sway with the motions of your spells that animate the dead, channeling your power to sustain two at the same time.

name: Greater Deathly Secrets
summary: Your undead secrets grow stronger still.

name: Master of the Dead
summary: You have reached the pinnacle of the reanimator's craft: the ability to raise nearly any corpse or skeleton as a gruesome mockery of the creature it once was.

name: Undead Master Dedication
summary: You gain the services of an undead companion that travels with you and obeys your commands.

name: Guardian Ghosts
summary: You magically divert some of the harm from an incoming attack away from yourself, forcing your undead companion to take it in your stead.

name: Their Master's Call
prerequisite: Undead Master Dedication; Call Companion, at least one inactive undead companion whose remains or anchor are currently in your possession.
summary: In a pinch, you pull one of your inactive companions from their rest to provide a companion's support benefit.

name: Stitch Flesh
summary: You can use Treat Wounds to restore Hit Points to undead creatures, not just living ones.

name: Ghost Dedication
prerequisite: You died and returned as a ghost.
summary: You have risen as a shell of your former self, a spirit of mist and anguish.

name: Frightful Moan
trait: Archetype, Auditory, Divine, Emotion, Enchantment, Fear, Mental
summary: You lament your fate, realeasing a ghastly moan that frightens the living.

name: Ghostly Resistance
summary: Your ghostly form becomes innately weaker but also gains resistance to many forms of damage.

name: Ghostly Grasp (Ghost)
summary: Your control over your ghostly form grows.

name: Ghost Flight
summary: You can suppress your tether to the ground, overcoming your resistance to fly free.

name: Pass Through
summary: Filtering your form through the substance of an object, you can pass through walls, doors, and more.

name: Rejuvenation
summary: The call of your unfinished business recreates you after destruction.

name: Unlimited Ghost Flight
summary: You put your connection to the material world farther behind you.

name: Ghoul Dedication
prerequisite: You were killed by ghoul fever.
summary: You have succumbed to ghoul fever, dying and returning as a ghoul, an undead cursed with a never-ending hunger for dead flesh that slowly overrides your reason and willpower until you would do anything for the meal you crave.

name: Replenishing Consumption
summary: When you devour corpses and satiate your hunger, you also recover from some of your wounds, your necrotized blue flesh knitting back together almost immediately as soon as you begin shoveling the chunks of dead flesh down your throat.

name: Swift Leap
summary: Your undead physiology allows you to leap quickly toward or away from your opponent.

name: Feverish Enzymes
summary: Your claws and fangs exude an infectious enzyme, related to the necrotic effects of ghoul fever, that causes a creature's wounds to heal slowly.

name: Grave Strength
summary: The flesh you've consumed over the course of your existence as a ghoul has made you stronger, gifting you with strange insights from the minds of the sapient creatures you've devoured and bringing you closer to a state of undead perfection.

name: Paralyzing Slash
summary: Your enzymes can paralyze your foes rather than merely making it harder for them to heal their wounds.

name: Sickening Bite
summary: Your saliva causes severe nausea and mild fever in the living, weakening them so that you can more easily finish them off.

name: Glutton for Flesh
summary: You have developed a capacity to store more flesh within your gaunt body to leave yourself satiated longer.

name: Corpse Stench
summary: Your body exudes an overwhelming scent of decay in a 10-foot emanation, so putrid that it nauseates creates within that range.

name: Lich Dedication
prerequisite: Expert in Crafting; living creature, ability to cast 6th-level or higher spells from spell slots, completed ritual to become a lich and crafted a _soul cage_
summary: After years of study and careful planning, you finally completed a _soul cage_ to house your soul and successfully performed a ritual to transform yourself into a lich.

name: Drain Soul Cage
prerequisite: Lich Dedication; Drain Bonded Item, spellbook
summary: You make your _soul cage_ into your bonded item, allowing you to harness its abundant magical energy.

name: Enshroud Soul Cage
summary: You wreathe your _soul cage_ in an ever-growing collection of obfuscating illusions and protective abjurations to hide it from your enemies.

name: Hand of the Lich
summary: Negative energy intensifies your undead form and makes your very touch the antithesis of life.

name: Bolster Soul Cage
summary: Your constant efforts to augment and perfect your _soul cage_ have bolstered its efficiency.

name: Spell Gem
summary: Inspired by the degenerate demiliches your kind sometimes devolves into, you've embedded a gem into your brow, fusing it to your necrotic flesh.

name: Frightful Aura
summary: You're surrounded by a palpable sense of menace and power that's terrifying to behold.

name: Mummy Dedication
prerequisite: you are dead and were mummified (by natural or ritualistic means)
summary: Whether through natural processes or foul rituals, your body was mummified, and you've risen as an undead mummy.

name: One with the Land
summary: Your connection to your bound terrain strengthens, making you unhindered by local weather.

name: Semblance of Life
summary: You draw the moisture you've drained from others into your own flesh, temporarily taking on the appearance of life.

name: Grave Mummification
summary: Exposure to the elements, magic, alchemy, and other phenomena intensified the changes from your mummification.

name: Mummy's Despair
trait: Archetype, Aura, Divine, Emotion, Enchantment, Fear, Mental
summary: You force your mental anguish outward, projecting it upon those around you.

name: Accursed Touch
summary: You've learned to harness the supernatural curse that animates you, imbuing your most powerful attacks with a terrible curse.

name: Storm Shroud
summary: You become surrounded by a swirling storm of rain, sand, snow, or clouds, whichever of those suits your bound terrain.

name: Channel Rot
summary: You've learned to channel your curse through weapons you wield instead of solely through your flesh.

name: Ensnaring Wrappings
summary: Some of your wrappings come loose to ensnare a creature you recently damaged.

name: Terrain Form
summary: You crumble to pieces, becoming composed of the very terrain to which you're bound, with the effects of the _gaseous form_ spell, or you reconstitute into your normal form.

name: Desiccating Inhalation
summary: You draw in the moisture from nearby creatures, draining them dry to heal your wounds.

name: Greater Despair
summary: You increase the frequency of Mummy's Despair to once per 10 minutes instead of once per hour.

name: As in Life, So in Death
summary: Specific memories of your old life are hard to hold onto, but you know things without remembering why.

name: Collapse
summary: You collapse into a pile of bones, mitigating the worst of the damage you would have taken, and the triggering attack deals only the amount it would deal on a hit (typically full damage instead of double damage).

name: Play Dead
summary: You lie prone and pretend to be an ordinary skeleton.

name: Undead Empathy
summary: Your relationship with undeath gives you a stronger bond with other undead.

name: Past Life
summary: Flashes of your life become clearer and more frequent, allowing you to apply skills you developed while alive.

name: Well-armed
summary: Your detachable limbs offer flexibility.

name: Bone Missile
summary: You can remove your ribs to use them as arrows or bolts.

name: Rejuvenation Token
summary: You tie yourself to the Material Plane by implanting a piece of your consciousness into a weapon, piece of armor, or other item that's precious to you.

name: Skeletal Resistance
summary: Your body becomes resistant, your hardened bones deflecting weapons and other forms of damage.

name: Skeletal Transformation
summary: You rearrange your bones into a bestial shape.

name: Skeleton Commander
summary: You gain the ability to summon your own skeletal minions.

name: Bone Swarm
summary: You scatter your body and transform into a whirling storm of bones for up to 1 minute or until you spend a single action to return to your normal shape.

name: Necromantic Heir
summary: Your affinity for negative energy spills outward and grants you a refilling well of necromantic essence.

name: Vampire Dedication
prerequisite: You were a killed by a vampire drinking your blood.
summary: You're a newly risen vampire.

name: Clinging Climber
summary: You climb like a spider.

name: Manipulative Charm
prerequisite: Vampire Dedication; Trained in Deception or Trained in Diplomacy
summary:
Against humanoids, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie, and to Diplomacy checks to Gather Information and Make an Impression.

 Once per day, you can cast _charm_ as a divine innate spell using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

name: Nocturnal Kindred
summary: You have an innate connection with other creatures of the night and understand some of them.

name: Daywalker
summary: Through a profane pledge or a bloodline quirk, you can tolerate the sun's light.

name: Predatory Claws
summary: Your nails grow into sharp claws, perfect for seizing and tearing your prey.

name: Vicious Fangs
summary: You aim for your victim's prominent arteries.

name: Bat Form
summary: You can transform into a bat.

name: Turn to Mist
summary: You turn into vapor, gaining the effects of _gaseous form_.

name: Coffin Bound
summary: You bind your spirit to a coffin filled with soil of your homeland, making it a place of recovery.

name: Mist Escape
summary: As you fall, your body reacts to defend itself.

name: Dominating Gaze
summary: You stare into your target's eyes and enthrall them, shattering their free will.

name: Zombie Dedication
prerequisite: You died and were animated as a husk zombie.
summary: Despite your death and subsequent reanimation as a rotting corpse, you retain most of your mind and identity.

name: Ankle Biter
summary: You fight just as well on the ground as you do standing up.

name: Feast
summary: You feast upon an adjacent restrained or unconscious creature, or a deceased creature that died in the past hour.

name: Ravenous Charge
summary: Hungry for the flesh of the living, you hurl yourself into the fray, teeth gnashing.

name: Brains!
summary: You consume the brains of your foe, causing synapses long rotten to fire and enabling you to shake off your mental torpor.

name: Numb
summary: As your body continues to rot and putrefy, your senses deaden and your undead powers grow.

name: Out of Hand
summary: Even when your limbs are severed, they remain a part of you.

name: Shamble
summary: You may be slower than you were in life, but your pace is unfaltering.

name: Unkillable
summary: You're relentless and nigh unkillable, shrugging off blows that should destroy you, though they might make your body start to fall apart.

name: Festering Wound
summary: Wounds you inflict with your unarmed attacks fester and rot, becoming infected and difficult to heal.

name: Seize
summary: You seize your foe and pull it close.

name: Alkenstar Agent Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Deception; trained at least one firearm
summary: You put on the persona of a rough and tumble outlaw, but your real goals are to report threats to Alkenstar back to the grand duchess.
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 78

name: Loose Cannon
summary: Your unpredictable gunfire often catches enemies off guard or hits unprotected areas.
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 78

name: Prepare Papers
prerequisite: Alkenstar Agent Dedication; Master in Society
summary: You're practiced at creating forgeries that establish your outlaw credentials or augment your legal authority.
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 78

name: Flash your Badge
prerequisite: Alkenstar Agent Dedication; Master in Intimidation
summary: You make a fearsome show of your authority.
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 78

name: Black Powder Flash
summary: You ignite a pinch of black powder in a foe's face.
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 79

name: Inured to Alchemy
summary: You've developed control over how your body processes alchemical poisons and drugs.
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 79

name: Pain Tolerance
summary: You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you clumsy, drained, or enfeebled.
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 79

name: Powder Punch Stance
summary: You infuse your handwraps with black powder.
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 79

name: Thunder Clap
summary: You slam your hands together to unleash a deafening blast.
source: Pathfinder #178: Punks in a Powderkeg pg. 79

name: Divine Healing
prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; Expert in Religion; worship a deity with a divine font that grants _heal_
summary: Although you aren't a proper champion of your faith, your deity still recognizes your efforts and provides you with a small divine ability to help others.

name: Interrupt Charge
summary: You attempt to snag the foe before they run away.

name: Phalanx Formation (Knight Vigilant)
summary: You know how to clear a line of fire for your allies.

name: Emissary of Peace
summary: Even when bloodshed is inevitable, you would rather see your foes surrender.

name: Instant Armor
summary: A knight is nothing without their armor, and you know how to keep yours ready.

name: Lead the Way
summary: You move forward, creating an opening for others to follow.

name: Guarded Advance (Knight Vigilant)
summary: You slowly advance on the battlefield, taking utmost caution.

name: Vigilant Benediction
prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; alignment permitted by the chosen deity
summary: Unwilling to be outdone by the Crimson Reclaimers and their oath, you've petitioned the gods of good for a sliver of divine magic.

name: Instinctual Interception
summary: You react to movement with hardly a thought, seeming constantly poised to spring.

name: Empyreal Aura
summary: As an ultimate foe of evil and protector of the innocent, your very presence is a ward against evil.

name: Tower Shield Mastery
summary: You've learned how to maximize the defensive abilities of your tower shield.

name: Ashen Veil
prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Expert in Religion; Master in Stealth
summary: By smearing ash or tainted earth over your skin and armor, you shroud yourself from the dead.

name: Voice Cold as Death
trait: Archetype, Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, Fear, Mental, Skill
prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Master in Intimidation
summary: Channeling the energy of the Crimson Oath into your voice, you pronounce a threat in a tone so icy it freezes the blood.

name: Hilt Hammer
summary: You know how to turn any weapon into a bone-crushing implement of skeletal destruction.

name: For Love, For Lightning
summary: Rumors suggest this technique was pioneered by knights who undertook missions for Clarethe Iomedar at the half-moon, but many Crimson Reclaimers have since mastered it.

name: Reclaimant Plea
prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; ability to cast divine spells
summary: You call on the power of the Crimson Oath to gain magical aid.

name: Shepherd of Desolation
prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Survivor of Desolation
summary: You know how to keep others alive in the Gravelands' murkiest shadows.

name: Crimson Oath Devotion
prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; ability to cast focus spells
summary: You've made the Crimson Oath a part of yourself; you mumble it in your sleep and recite it under your breath as you march.

name: The Tyrant Falls!
prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Invoke the Crimson Oath
summary: You've reached the apex of the Crimson Oath's power.

name: Always Ready
summary: Extensive training against undead has taught you to cover your weak points, even when you think that you're alone.

name: Bless Shield
prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; you worship a good-aligned deity
summary: Your uttered prayers become an aegis, drawing the blessing of your deity across the surface of your shield.

name: Familiar Foe
prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; Expert in Religion or Expert in Undead Lore
summary: You regularly face off against undead and can identify many with a glance.

name: Final Rest
summary: As stubborn in death as you are in life, you vow you'll never aid your hated enemies.

name: Nonlethal Takedown
summary: You prefer to use nonlethal means against living opponents, but the weapons you carry are lethal enough to destroy undead.

name: Practiced Opposition
summary: You've battled more undead than you care to remember, often with little time to prepare between foes, forcing you to rely on experience and muscle memory to guide your blade.

name: Repulse the Wicken
summary: You use your foe's failure as an opening to push them away.

name: Sacred Armaments
summary: Through the power of your faith or the blessing of a priest, your weapons are fully effective against incorporeal creatures.

name: Flashing Shield
prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; you worship a good-aligned deity
summary: Your shield flares with holy light as you block the attack, searing the undead with the power of your faith.

name: Necromantic Bulwark
summary: Regular exposure to necromantic effects left you better able to defend against them.

name: Grave Sight
summary: Your ability to sense undead has improved.

name: No Stranger to Death
summary: Your regular exposure to the insidious putrescence of undeath inured you to its effects.

name: Resolute Defender
summary: You hold your shield together with the power of your faith and conviction, refusing to let wood splinter and steel shatter until the day's battles are won.

name: Thwart Evil
prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; Expert in Religion
summary: You react instinctively when you sense evil forming, thrusting your spiritual energy toward the source to snuff out evil before it fully manifests.

name: Withstand Death
summary: Through repeated exposure, you've trained to resist the damage wrought by undead.

name: Angel of Vindication
summary: To aid with your mission of destroying undead, you've specialized in techniques to destroy them, much as other assassins learn to kill the living.

name: Eclipsed Vitality
prerequisite: Assassin Dedication or Scout Dedication; Master in Stealth
summary: You shroud yourself in ashes that hide the vital essence sought by life-sensing undead.

name: Gravelands Herbalist
summary: Your time with the Knights of Lastwall has taught you the secrets of creating and improving upon Lastwall soup.

name: Push Back the Dead!
summary: You call to your ally and strengthen their resolve and abilities to defend against the horrific tricks undead bring to bear.

name: Staggering Fire
summary: You've learned how to fire at enemies to slow them down, allowing innocents and fellow knights alike time to escape.

name: Drive Back
summary: You push the enemy back and attempt to intercede between the foe and your ally.

name: Preventative Treatment
summary: You provide preventative remedies and care to help your patient fight off future maladies.

name: Viking Vindicator
summary: You are one of the raiders eagerly planning to launch an assault by sea on the Whispering Tyrant's Isle of Terror.

name: Stalwart Standard
summary: Your banner makes it harder for your foes to push your allies around and encourages your allies to protect the innocent.

name: Wave the Flag
trait: Archetype, Emotion, Flourish, Mental, Uncommon, Visual
summary: You wave your banner, inspiring allies to throw off the shackles of fear.

name: Agile Shield Grip
summary: You change your grip on the shield, allowing you to combine rapid attacks with your shield boss or shield spikes and your main weapon's Strikes in a series of swift motions.

name: Devoted Guardian
summary: You adopt a wide stance, ready to defend both yourself and your chosen ward.

name: Reliable Squire
summary: You know the path to victory isn't traveled alone, and you lend aid to your companions whenever you can.

name: Resilient Mind
summary: You're firm in your convictions and have girded your mind against outside influence.

name: United Assault
summary: Through countless battles, you've learned you're stronger when working alongside your allies.

name: Chemical Purification
summary: You developed a method to chemically purify and consecrate your bombs on the fly.

name: Ghost Wrangler
summary: Spirits around you coalesce upon your fists, enabling you to seize and harm other ghosts and spirits.

name: Inspiring Resilience
summary: You show defiance in times of hardship and inspire your companions to persevere.

name: Knock Sense
summary: You attack carefully to knock some sense into a creature whose actions aren't their own.

name: Prayer-Touched Weapon
prerequisite: divine spells, you follow a good-aligned deity
summary: You coat a weapon you're wielding in prayers and the divine power given to you by your deity.

name: Detonating Spell
trait: Cleric, Concentrate, Metamagic, Oracle, Sorcerer, Uncommon, Witch, Wizard
summary: Your spell becomes volatile and explosive.

name: Divine Emissary
prerequisite: a familiar, you follow a good-aligned deity or patron
summary: Your familiar is a divine emissary, sent to you by your deity or patron and infused with celestial powers.

name: Shield Wall
summary: You use your shield in tandem with an ally's, forming a barricade.

name: Knight's Retaliation
summary: You knock the enemy's blow aside and twist, unbalancing your foe.

name: Retaliatory Cleansing
summary: You twist your hand in front of the blow, ensuring the enemy's attack shatters the required _holy water_ or bomb.

name: Consecrate Spell
trait: Cleric, Concentrate, Metamagic, Oracle, Sorcerer, Uncommon
prerequisite: ability to cast focus spells, divine spells
summary: You infuse a spell with the power of your faith, consecrating it.

name: Corpse-Killer's Defiance
summary: You defy Tar-Baphon with every undead you destroy, using your victory to rally your allies.

name: Holy Light
trait: Champion, Cleric, Concentrate, Divine, Evocation, Light, Uncommon
summary: You raise your arms to the sky and pray fervently, surrounding yourself in a beacon of holy light.

name: Miraculous Intervention
summary: Through divine intervention or whispered prayers, you foil an enemy's response.

name: Necromantic Deflection
summary: You imbue your shield with life-giving energy to deflect harmful necromantic magic.

name: Shared Sight
summary: You bestow the mystical vision granted to you by your muse upon your allies.

name: Purifying Breeze
summary: You transfer the divine essence of your magic to the air around you, cleansing it of toxins.

name: Glass Skin
prerequisite: You were present at the death of the medusa Alethsia, whose vitrumantic powers were passed on to you in the wake of her destruction.
summary: Even if vitrumancy is a mystery to you, your blood and flesh know the secrets of the art of arcane glass.

name: Clockwork Reanimator Dedication
summary: You can animate corpses through cunning engineering.

name: Advanced Reanimated Companion
summary: Your corpselike construct companion becomes much more powerful and can act with limited autonomy to follow your greater directives.

name: Hijack Undead
summary: Your clockwork devices can commandeer the bodies of undead, bending them to your will.

name: It's Alive!
summary: You've mastered the use of electrical energy to power your clockwork creations.

name: Incredible Reanimated Companion
summary: You imbue the necrotized flesh of your reanimated construct companion with strange chemicals and fine-tune the clockwork within, enhancing all its capabilities.

name: Self-Destruct
summary: You've installed a self-destruct device within your construct companion, which you can trigger with a special device from up to 60 feet away.

name: Improved Hijack Undead
summary: Undead creatures find it all but impossible to resist your commands.

name: Paragon Reanimated Companion
summary: You have reached the pinnacle of necromantic science, creating a mechanical zombie unlike any the world has seen before.

name: Unwind Death
summary: Combining necromancy with the mysterious temporal powers of clockwork, you wind a creature backward from the moment of its death.

name: Zombie Horde
summary: You built your reanimated construct companion of modular components from various corpses.

name: Corpse Tender Dedication
summary: You have a connection to mindless undead that allows you to communicate your intentions to them on a rudimentary level.

name: Command Corpse
prerequisite: Corpse Tender Dedication; ability to cast _harm_
summary: You gain the Command Undead feat, but you can use it only to transform the effects of _harm_ spells you cast on mindless undead.

name: Corpse Tender's Font
summary: You easily tend to the wounds of the dead.

name: Improved Command Corpse
summary: When you use Command Undead on a mindless undead, if the undead succeeds at its save but doesn't critically succeed, it becomes your minion for 1 round.

name: Imbue Mindlessness
summary: You grasp the mind of an undead creature and temporarily wipe it as empty as a zombie's brain.

name: Flailtongue
summary: Your tongue has mutated into a lashing weapon reminiscent of Kabriri's bone-laden flail.

name: Competitive Eater
summary: Gorging on flesh after your stomach is full fortifies you, making you hardy enough to withstand more punishment.

name: Secret Eater
summary: You have discovered and found favor with the cult within the church of Kabriri known as the Secret Eaters.

name: Tunneling Claws
summary: You have elongated claws and enhanced senses, making you uncanny at digging the underground passageways needed to construct ghoul warrens and rob graves without arousing suspicion.

name: Bodysnatcher
summary: Your secret-stealing maggots reveal how to devour more than just the flesh and secrets of a victim; you can ingest and assume their whole physical appearance.

name: Graveshift
summary: The maggots inhabiting your body impart you with the knowledge to travel from grave to grave, drawing upon the mystical power of the labyrinthine network of magical warrens and tunnels that connect Everglut to the Material Plane.

name: Breath of Hungry Death
trait: Acid, Archetype, Divine, Incapacitation, Necromancy, Occult, Rare
summary: You have uncovered occult mysteries that allow you to unleash the devastating hunger of Kabriri upon your foes with a single exhalation, releasing a massive cloud of flesh-eating gas that glows with a sickly green light.

name: Wrath of the First Ghoul
trait: Archetype, Death, Divine, Enchantment, Flourish, Mental, Occult, Rare
