summary: The ravenous maggots inside you become capable of exploding forth from your attacks into the wounds of an opponent, whispering telepathic words of destruction that invoke horrific flashbacks of Kabriri's transformation from elf to ghoul or psychic images of hundreds of maggots bursting from the victim's flesh all at once.

name: Triumphant Boast
summary: You relate a loud and impressive tale of your triumph over a formidable foe.

name: That's Not Natural!
summary: Your mastery at surviving in the wild has given you a sort of sixth-sense when it comes to noticing creatures that aren't part of the natural order.

name: Say that Again!
summary: The world is full of obnoxious weasels who think they can pull one over on you—put them in their place! When an adjacent creature attempts to Lie to you or to Demoralize you and gets a critical failure on the roll, you can use your reaction to make a Shove attempt against that opponent.

name: Too Angry to Die
summary: You refuse to yield the battle, even after you've been knocked off your feet and nearly killed.

name: Giant Hunter
summary: You have studied giants and hunt them with efficiency.

name: The Harder They Fall (Ranger)
summary: You know how to make a larger creature hurt when it falls to the ground.

name: Hamstringing Strike
summary: You slow your foes with a well-aimed attack.

name: Roll with It (Ranger)
summary: You can dodge attacks from giants.

name: Giant Slayer
summary: Your well-placed blows can fell mighty giants.

name: Ambush Tactics
prerequisite: trained in Lore about a specific terrain
summary: You've made a study of the best practices for laying ambushes in terrains you've spent time learning about, be it the best way to ambush foes or the best methods of reacting to surprise attacks in those terrains.

name: Efficient Explorer
prerequisite: trained in Lore about a specific terrain
summary: You are more efficient at exploring uncharted territories.

name: Predict Weather
summary: By observing often subtle indicators in the environment, you may try to predict the day's weather.

name: Civil Service
summary: Citizens bolster vacant leadership roles

name: Cooperative Leadership
summary: Leaders gain increased bonuses to aid each other

name: Crush Dissent
summary: Quell Dissent more efficiently

name: Endure Anarchy
summary: Recover from Unrest more quickly and lessen its effects

name: Fame and Fortune
summary: Gain RP when you critically succeed at Kingdom skills

name: Fortified Fiefs
summary: Gain bonuses to Fortify, and Construct or Rebuild certain buildings easier

name: Free and Fair
summary: Use New Leadership and other activities more efficiently

name: Insider Trading
summary: +1 to Work Camp, Establish Trade Agreement, and Trade Commodities activities

name: Inspiring Entertainment
summary: Use Culture on checks to determine Unrest

name: Kingdom Assurance
prerequisite: Trained in at least three skills
summary: Receive a fixed result on a skill check

name: Liquidate Resources
summary: Draw upon reserve funds to avoid Ruin

name: Muddle Through
summary: Ruin accumulates more slowly

name: Practical Magic
summary: +1 to Magic checks, use Magic instead of Engineering

name: Pull Together
summary: Your citizens help mitigate failures

name: Quality of Life
summary: Cost of living expenses are reduced

name: Quick Recovery (Kingdom)
summary: +4 to checks to end ongoing harmful events

name: Skill Training (Kingdom)
summary: Become trained in a Kingdom skill

name: Embodied Legionary Subjectivity
summary: Nex's Fleshforges shaped you not to achieve individual greatness at arms, but rather to become a part of a legion, a modular piece integral to the combined arms stratagems of Nexian battlemages.

name: Embodied Dreadnought Subjectivity
summary: Your colossal might marks you as a behemoth, the pride of Nex's Fleshforges, and the heaviest ordnance is a child's toy in your monumental grasp.

name: Transposable Compliance
summary: Your protean vitality is fecund and many-succoring: your veins run with life-giving ichor that adapts to the blood and physiology of any body, and your skin molts on command, creating wound-stanching sheaths of tissue for yourself and others.

name: Embodied Dragoon Subjectivity
summary: When your allies call for swift reinforcements or lightning raids, you're ready to answer.

name: Molten Wit
summary: Your elemental soul has sparked not just your body but also your mind.

name: Native Waters
summary: You were born with or obtained a special connection to either fresh water or salt water.

name: Silent Stone
summary: You've lived in the shadow of the Shattered Range, and the patience of those ancient mountains expresses itself in your stillness.

name: Wind Pillow
summary: The winds have whispered to you all your life, and the essence of air itself helps you at times, making you somewhat buoyant when you're suspended in space.

name: Noble Resolve
trait: Ardande, Ifrit, Oread, Suli, Sylph, Talos, Undine
summary: Once, genies ruled vast kingdoms, and a remnant of that confidence and power is reflected in your strong will.

name: Miraculous Repair
trait: Arcane, Ardande, Concentrate, Ifrit, Oread, Suli, Sylph, Talos, Transmutation, Undine
summary: Geniekin can't grant magical wishes, but some echo of power lingers within you.

name: Planar Sidestep
trait: Arcane, Ardande, Concentrate, Conjuration, Ifrit, Oread, Suli, Sylph, Talos, Undine
summary: You shift your body briefly between planes, reducing the damage from your foe's attack.

name: Reveal Hidden Self
summary: While hidden, you manifest a version of your animalistic nature.

name: Asura Magic
summary: You can cast _blood vendetta_ and _death knell_ once per day each as 2nd-level divine innate spells.

name: Jalmeri Rakshasa Magic
summary: You can cast _dispel magic_ and _reaper's lantern_ once per day each as 2nd-level divine innate spells.

name: Idol Threat
summary: You brandish the precious object you're holding menacingly, at once mocking it and threatening its safety.

name: Dominion Aura
summary: For a short time, you fully manifest the expectations of the god destroyer within you.

name: Ancient Memories
summary: In the long years since Ghorus's day, you've done pretty much everything at one time or another.

name: Flexible Form
summary: Your body is as supple as a sapling, capable of bending without breaking.

name: Ghoran Lore
summary: The very first memories ghorans have are those of their creation, and even after thousands of years, those memories have never faded for you.

name: Ghoran Weapon Familiarity
summary: Over the course of your long, long existence, you've had a chance to practice with traditional ghoran weapons.

name: Hidden Thorn
summary: Some flowers can hide their thorns, and yours happen to be hidden along your arms.

name: Ghoran Weapon Practice
summary: With plenty of practice, the memories of previous fights from previous lives come flooding back.

name: Murderous Thorns
prerequisite: Hidden Thorn or Thorned Rose heritage
summary: Your thorns are many, vicious, and sharp.

name: Speak with Flowers
summary: At your very heartwood, you're a flower animated by elder magic, and with a little effort, you can speak to your kindred.

name: Tree's Ward
summary: You've lived among trees for so long they recognize your presence and seek to protect you from harm.

name: Endless Memories
summary: You've lived a thousand lives and done a hundred-thousand things.

name: Flower Magic
summary: Certain magics in the world flow easily through your sap.

name: Perfume Cloud
summary: You issue a cloud of your fragrance like a full-body sneeze—but one that might save your life as the powerful perfume makes your attackers' eyes sting and water.

name: Solar Rejuvenation (Ghoran)
summary: The warmth and light of the sun gives you life.

name: Eternal Memories
summary: You have lived longer than most realize, and due to your many lifetimes of practice you remember almost everything from your previous incarnations now.

name: Ghoran Weapon Expertise
summary: It's as if you've been training for a thousand years.

name: Look but Don't Touch
summary: Many flowers are beautiful to look upon but deadly to touch—and you're one of them.

name: Violent Vines
summary: When angered, you can imbue nearby vines with your wrath, provoking them into a murderous rampage.

name: Ghoran's Wrath
summary: You have such a strong connection to the natural world that you can inspire it to attack at those who threaten you.

name: Community Knowledge
summary: You commune with the psychic echoes of your ancestors and community, channeling their experiences into yourself.

name: Crystal Luminescence
summary: Your horn glows with bioluminescent color, casting bright light in a 20-foot emanation (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

name: Emotional Partitions
summary: You have created strong mental partitions in your mind to filter out negative emotional influences.

name: Mental Sustenance
summary: You can sustain yourself with the power of your mind.

name: Open Mind
summary: You have inherent psychic abilities that allow you to tap into the power of your mind.

name: Puncturing Horn
summary: While many kashrishi never use their horns for more than cracking open hard-shelled fruits or amplifying their psychic powers, you've practiced using yours offensively.

name: Scuttle Up
summary: Your environment requires you to climb cave walls or tree trunks with great regularity.

name: Tough Skin
summary: Your skin is medium armor in the plate armor group that grants a +4 item bonus to AC, and has a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of 16, and the comfort trait.

name: Empathic Calm
summary: Once per day, you can cast either _calm emotions_ or _sanctuary_ as an innate occult spell, heightened to half your level rounded up.

name: Fighting Horn
summary: You can modify the size and shape of your horn over time using your mental powers.

name: Skilled Climber
summary: You can navigate vertical surfaces with ease.

name: Unlock Secret
summary: You delve deeper into your psychic potential.

name: Well of Potential
prerequisite:
focus pool, at least one innate spell from a
kashrishi heritage or ancestry feat that shares a tradition with at
least one of your focus spells
summary: Your mind is a deep well of psychic potential.

name: Fortified Mind
summary: Your mind is unusually resilient and resistant to influence.

name: Telekinetic Slip
summary: A thin shell of telekinetic energy pushes from your skin, widening your enemy's grasp enough for you to slip free.

name: Transcendent Realization
summary: You've unleashed even more of your mind's limitless potential.

name: Kashrishi Revivification
summary: The well of psychic energy held within your mind can exceed the limitations of your physical body.

name: Reimagine
summary: You can cast _dreaming potential_ as an innate occult spell.

name: Bend Space
summary: Not even space itself is a match for the unleashed power of your mind.

name: Cleansing Light
summary: A burst of light from your horn cleanses your allies of ailments and sends your foes reeling.

name: Cold Minded
summary: The subtle strands of beguiling magic leave little impression on your mind.

name: Nagaji Lore
summary: You're the vassal or apprentice of a learned naga, and you've studied the secrets of naga magic and concocting intricate poisons.

name: Nagaji Spell Familiarity
summary: Either through study, exposure, or familial devotion, you have the magic of nagas bubbling in your blood.

name: Serpent's Tongue
summary: You subconsciously flick your tongue through the air to taste the world around you.

name: Water Nagaji
summary: Much like a water naga, you've formed a connection to a sacred or pristine body of water, either as a home or a place to protect.

name: Hypnotic Lure
trait: Concentrate, Enchantment, Mental, Nagaji, Occult, Visual
summary: Your unblinking gaze is so intense it can befuddle the mind of others, drawing your victims toward you even against their better judgment.

name: Nagaji Spell Mysteries
prerequisite: at least one innate spell from a nagaji heritage or ancestry feat
summary: You've learned more naga magic.

name: Skin Split
summary: You claw open the top layer of your scales and peel off the premature shed in order to remove harmful substances from your skin.

name: Venom Spit
summary: You've learned the art of lobbing toxic spittle at vulnerable spots on your foes, especially the eyes.

name: Envenom Strike
prerequisite: you possess a Strike from a nagaji heritage or ancestry feat that deals poison damage
summary: You spit venom onto a weapon you're holding or a weapon held by a willing creature within 30 feet; you can also use this ability to envenom your nagaji fangs unarmed attack.

name: Guarded Thoughts
summary: Your mind, like a dark naga's, foils attempts to read your thoughts.

name: Serpentcoil Slam
summary: Your people's ancient and storied rivalry with garudas led you to develop special techniques against flying foes.

name: Serpentine Swimmer
summary: You undulate your body in a series of sinuous serpentine motions as you swim, drastically improving the speed at which you move through the water.

name: Disruptive Stare
summary: Your frigid gaze can turn a foe's blood to ice.

name: Nagaji Spell Expertise
summary: Your magical skill rivals that of accomplished naga spellcasters.

name: Pit of Snakes
summary: Mundane serpents obey your summons.

name: Breath of Calamity
summary: Your roar shakes the earth and splits the heavens.

name: Prismatic Scales
summary: You can cause your scales to glow with scintillating, many-hued colors, protecting you from energy while dazzling foes.

name: Canopy Sight
summary: You can see equally well even in dense jungles where only a small amount of light shines through.

name: Climbing Tail
summary: Your tail makes it much easier for you to climb.

name: Sudden Mindfulness
summary: Your mind retains full awareness despite the best attempts of others, and your focus throws others off-balance.

name: Vanara Lore
summary: You attained the cultural training of a ba-sadhak, a seeker of treasures and rare delights.

name: Vanara Weapon Familiarity
summary: You favor weapons steeped in vanaran tradition.

name: Whitecape
summary: You're shorter and wider than many vanaras of your heritage, and the hair on your shoulders and your head is particularly thick and luxurious, like a majestic cape.

name: Darting Monkey
summary: You have a heightened awareness in combat, and your darting strikes prevent your foes from distracting you or breaking your focus.

name: Jungle Runner
summary: You run through the jungle as easily as you would through an open field.

name: Ragdya's Revelry
summary: You dart away from your foe's attack with a casual laugh, using the opening to cause mischief.

name: Skillful Climber
summary: You can scamper up or down surfaces as nimbly as a monkey.

name: Tail Snatch
summary: You can whip your tail around to lash items from the unwary's grip.

name: Vanara Weapon Trickery
summary: You've learned how to trick your foes using vanara weapons.

name: Dangle (Vanara)
summary: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing.

name: Legendary Size
summary: The vanaras of old were tricksters able to step across wide rivers or slip into impossibly small spaces.

name: Ragdya's Dance
summary: Even when faced with deadly danger, you fight with the rapturous laughter of Ragdya in your heart and can play impossible tricks.

name: Rakshasa Ravaged
summary: You and your family know well the ravages of rakshasa predations, and you know how to best defend yourself against their growing corruption in the world.

name: Monkey Spirits
summary: Vanaras generally consider the spirits of departed monkeys to be less informative or interesting than their own ancestors traveling the cycles of existence, yet these monkey spirits can prove useful when the situation is dire.

name: Unbound Freedom
summary: Your future is no other person's to control, and the cycles of your fate sometimes step in to protect you when that control would be taken from you.

name: Vanara Battle Clarity
summary: Your focus in combat is practically unshakable.

name: Vanara Weapon Expertise
summary: Thanks to numerous joyous practice exercises, you've become an expert in vanara weapons.

name: Unfettering Prankster
summary: You can uplift all around you with your pranks, causing you and your allies to receive divine guidance in all your movements to effortlessly avoid environmental hindrances.

name: Alabaster Eyes
summary: In place of the normal vishkanyan golden eyes, you were born with especially perceptive snow-white eyes.

name: Lesser Enhance Venom
summary: Your venom grows deadlier and more plentiful.

name: Social Camouflage
summary: You have the uncanny ability to quickly blend into the lifestyle of whatever settlement in which you find yourself.

name: Vishkanya Lore
summary: You deeply understand vishkanyan strengths and cultural traditions.

name: Vishkanya Weapon Familiarity
summary: You favor weapons historically used in subtle work and in ceremony.

name: Debilitating Venom
summary: Your venom is particularly potent, affecting targets in different ways.

name: Restoring Blood
summary: Your body can process an alternative to your venom that heals wounds.

name: Vishkanya Weapon Arts
summary: You are graceful and efficient in the use of vishkanyan weapons.

name: Alluring Performance
summary: You command the attention of those around you with an elegant display.

name: Moderate Enhance Venom
summary: You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with Envenom to moderate vishkanyan venom.

name: Swift Application
summary: You expertly combine the motions of attacking and coating your weapon with venom.

name: Viper Strike
summary: You move and attack with a swiftness that most can't follow.

name: Stronger Debilitating Venom
summary: Add one of the following to the debilitations from which you can choose when you Envenom.

name: Venom Purge
summary: You produce a specialized venom that burns out other toxins and impurities in your body.

name: Vishkanya Weapon Expertise
summary: Extensive training has granted you an elegant control in the use of vishkanyan weapons.

name: Greater Enhance Venom
summary: You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with Envenom to greater vishkanyan venom.

name: Vicious Venom
summary: The venom you produce is exceptionally potent and difficult to overcome.

name: Triggerbrand Salvo
summary: You slice, stab, or batter your opponent with the melee portion of your combination weapon before pulling the trigger at point-blank range.

name: Triggerbrand Blitz
summary: You dance through your foes, stabbing and shooting.

name: Shieldmarshal Dedication
summary: Your elite shieldmarshal training makes you equally at home in the squalor of Smokeside and the splendor of Skyside.

name: Consolidated Overlay Panopticon
summary: You volunteered for a controversial experimental procedure to install clockwork prosthetic eyes.

name: Equitable Defense
summary: Gritting your teeth through the pain, you position yourself to counterattack.

name: Counterclockwork Focus
summary: You understand the need for law enforcement doctrine to adapt to the ever-changing innovations in technology and arcana.

name: Masquerade of Seasons Stance
summary: You have mastered the opening steps to the Masquerade of Seasons, a dance that channels the power of spring, summer, winter, and autumn.

name: Pirouette
summary: You twirl gracefully, spinning on one foot to evade your opponent's attack.

name: Grand Dance
summary: You can summon the full magic of Bhopan's grand dance.

name: Drain Emotion
summary: You touch an adjacent creature and attempt to draw out its excess emotion.

name: Fey Ascension
summary: The fey influence on your form and features grows even more powerful and notable.

name: Cannibalize Magic
summary: The fey magic inside of you is a vital part of your body, and you can steal other sources of magic to replenish yours.

name: Glamour
summary: You unlock a new level of fey power and can manipulate the perceptions of others using a font of First World magic.

name: Eldritch Calm
summary: Your fey heritage has altered your mindset to more resemble the uncanny perspective of the fey.

name: Fey Transcendence
summary: You become a powerful fey creature, gaining strengths tied to the First World but also some of the weakness against which all fey must contend.

name: Greenwatch Initiate
summary: You've received the basic training developed for all Greenwatch recruits.

name: Defy Fey
summary: You are keen to the wiles of the fey and can usually shake off their magic.

name: Fey Tracker
summary: You are exceptionally skilled at noticing the subtle techniques fey use to avoid notice.

name: Greenwatch Veteran
summary: Your time spent tracking your target allows you to quickly identify its weaknesses and relay them to your allies.

name: Unseen Passage
summary: You have mastered a magical technique for moving through dangerous woodlands unseen.

name: Greenwatcher
summary: Your experience fighting against and alongside fey creatures is nearly unrivaled.

name: Perfect Weaponry
summary: You gain the Monastic Weaponry monk class feat.

name: Perfect Resistance
summary: You gain resistance equal to half your level to all damage from effects with the appropriate trait for your School of Perfection: fire for Unblinking Flame, water for Unbreaking Waves, air for Unfolding Wind, and earth for Untwisting Iron.

name: Perfect Ki Expert
summary: You gain an appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection: _unblinking flame aura_ for Unblinking Flame, _unbreaking wave vapor_ for Unbreaking Waves, _unfolding wind buffet_ for Unfolding Wind, or _untwisting iron roots_ for Untwisting Iron.

name: Perfect Ki Exemplar
summary: You gain an appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection: _unblinking flame emblem_ for Unblinking Flame, _unbreaking wave barrier_ for Unbreaking Waves, _unfolding wind blitz_ for Unfolding Wind, or _untwisting iron augmentation_ for Untwisting Iron.

name: Perfect Ki Grandmaster
prerequisite: Perfect Ki Expert or Perfect Ki Exemplar
summary: You gain an appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection: _unblinking flame ignition_ for Unblinking Flame, _unbreaking wave containment_ for Unbreaking Waves, _unfolding wind crash_ for Unfolding Wind, or _untwisting iron pillar_ for Untwisting Iron.

name: Jellyfish Stance
summary: You relax your posture and loosen your joints, allowing yourself to move with incredible fluidity.
source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover pg. 212, Pathfinder #167: Ready? Fight! pg. 75

name: Sixth Pillar Mastery
summary: You align your magical and physical potential.
source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover pg. 223, Pathfinder #167: Ready? Fight! pg. 77

name: Touch Focus
summary: You can redirect a spell's power through you to deliver it within striking distance.
source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover pg. 223, Pathfinder #167: Ready? Fight! pg. 77

name: Legendary Tattoo Artist
summary: Your craftsmanship at decorating flesh is unparalleled.

name: Quick Setup
summary: You have learned to setup simple crafting jobs with ease.

name: Ursine Avenger Form
summary: You draw the _Ursine Avenger Hood_ over your head and its fur over your arms, assuming an ursine form that has traits of your original form as well as that of a bear.

name: Senses of the Bear
summary: While in ursine form, you gain low-light vision and scent (imprecise) 30 feet.

name: Bear Hug
summary: You snatch at your opponent with your claws, pulling them close in a ferocious bear hug.

name: Call Ursine Ally
summary: You can cast a 3rd-rank _summon animal_ as an innate spell, but only to summon a black bear.

name: Bear Empathy
summary: You have a magical affinity for bears and can speak to them through sounds and body language.

name: Great Bear
summary: When you transform, you can take on a bear's bulk and size.

name: Terrible Transformation
summary: You let out a mighty roar as part of your transformation.

name: Fearsome Fangs
summary: Your claws and jaws are brutally powerful and efficient, even by ursine standards.

name: Mighty Bear
summary: The power of the bear within you can expand your physical presence even further.

name: Immortal Bear
summary: Your body thrums with the primal vitality of the greatest of the ursine beasts.

name: First Frost
summary: The _gelid shard_ within your heart may sap your ability to feel and experience emotion, but it also lets you create and manipulate cold.

name: Snowcaster
summary: Your magical power grows as the shard's icy influence spreads ever deeper into your being.

name: Snowstep
summary: Snow and ice are no hindrance to you.

name: Frozen Breadth
summary: Your attunement to arcane cold enhances the depths of your growing power.

name: Winter's Embrace
summary: Your eyes are accustomed to the harsh glare of the sun on snow and ice.

name: Expert Snowcasting
summary: You draw ever more magical cold into your being, learning how to manipulate it to your whims.

name: Winter's Kiss
summary: Whether in the heart of a volcanic passageway or the glacial tundras of the Crown of the World, the only temperature you ever personally experience is an oddly comfortable chill.

name: Greater Snow Step
summary: You can't be impeded by environmental effects that rely on cold or its byproducts.

name: Master Snowcasting
summary: You have unlocked the deeper magic of your _gelid shard_, gaining access to new levels of spells.

name: Icy Apotheosis
summary: You are as much a creature of cold as whatever ancestry you were born to.

name: Fleeing Diversion
summary: You are quick to capitalize on your distractions.

name: Half-Truths
prerequisite: Expert in Deception; Expert in Diplomacy
summary: You are able to weave your words in such a way that you never use actual lies, but still mislead people to certain conclusions.

name: Devrin's Dazzling Diversion
summary: Devrin Arlos has a habit of using whatever is at hand to temporarily blind others in combat.

name: Ostentatious Reload
summary: Every good Firebrand knows that style can be as important as substance—so long as you don't screw up the delivery.

name: Nightwave Springing Reload
summary: Training with the crew of the Nightwave has taught you their technique for reloading while leaping to board another ship.

name: Helt's Spelldance
summary: Ranik Helt knows a special technique to hide his spells as part of a performance, and you've learned this technique.

name: Dazzling Display
summary: You perform a bewildering show of prowess, such as by whirling and flashing a weapon, that unnerves foes.

name: We're on the List
prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication or Archaeologist Dedication; Trained in Society
summary: Emulating Shensen whenever she arrives at a show, you share your knowledge of the region and drop a few important local names to make a good impression and help your allies do the same.

name: Broadside Buckos
summary: Shimali Manux trains every Salt Breaker to fight in the cramped quarters below deck, and you've learned how to use these techniques with your crew.

name: Devrin's Cunning Stance
summary: You've learned Devrin Arlos's guileful ways, and his sly teachings help you remind your allies to keep their wits about them.

name: Rebel's Map
prerequisite: Horizon Walker Dedication or Scout Dedication
summary: Rebellions require an intricate knowledge of one's surroundings—because you might need to escape at any moment.

name: Tut-Tut
trait: Archetype, Emotion, Fear, Mental, Press, Uncommon
summary: The Sapphire Butterfly is not one for violence when simply intimidating a foe will do.

name: You're an Embarrassment!
summary: Some Firebrands can't stand it when their allies are ruining their moment, and you're no different.

name: Cutting Flattery
prerequisite: Dandy Dedication or Pirate Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
summary: Repeated entries in Firebrand bragging and flyting contests have taught you how to twist pretty words into concealed insults.

name: Feeling Your Oats
prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Dandy Dedication; Trained in Deception
summary: You are incredible, impeccable, an icon of style and grace—and everyone knows it.

name: Watch This!
summary: A common saying among Firebrands is, “There's always a fool who thinks they can do it better—and they're often right.” You verbally commit to using an action on your next turn to make a melee Strike against the same enemy your ally has missed.

name: Grudging Compliment
summary: Every Firebrand can recognize the skill of others, but you've turned it into an art you can wield in combat.

name: Living for the Applause
summary: Nothing can stop you as long as you have an audience cheering you on.

name: Public Execution
summary: Some rebel Firebrand cells make a practice of publicly declaring the main target of a given operation.

name: Show-Off
summary: As is the tradition with many Firebrands, you call your shot and look to impress with an extra bit of panache or a greater stunt.

name: Statement Strut
summary: You have an eye for fashion and know how to sell attitude and confidence with your walk.

name: Big Debut
summary: Now's your chance! You're a Firebrand, and the world must know it.

name: Hook 'Em
summary: The Salt Breakers learned to use whatever they could during the Vidric Revolution, and they quickly mastered the art of making a rope into a useful tool in combat.

name: Mockingbird's Disarm
summary: The Mockingbird is a master at running into foes and coming away with their weapons.

name: Illusory Identity
summary: There are times when skills or looks are not enough to convince someone of your identity, and you instead require adequate documentation.

name: Acknowledge Fan
trait: Archetype, Enchantment, Incapacitation, Mental, Uncommon, Visual
summary: Your reputation as a Firebrand precedes you, and you need only make a simple gesture or give a look of recognition to amaze those around you.

name: Quick Spring
summary: Ishii Bunji is a skilled tumbler, and learning his technique allows you to propel yourself across the battlefield faster than your enemies can react.

name: It Was Me All Along!
prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication or Vigilante Dedication
summary: You discard a disguise and dramatically reveal your true identity, catching your foes off guard.

name: Harrower Dedication
summary: You become trained in Occultism; if you are already trained in this skill, you become trained in a different skill of your choice instead.

name: Experienced Harrower
summary: When you perform the _harrowing_ ritual, the DC for the Primary Check is never more than the standard DC by level, and the cost for the ritual is halved.

name: Harrow Casting
summary: You draw a card from your harrow deck just before you cast a spell to infuse your magic with its destined potential.

name: Restore Omen
summary: You spend 10 minutes meditating with your harrow deck, then draw a card.

name: Benevolent Spirit Deck
summary: You manifest a ghostly deck of harrow cards that seek to protect you or an ally.

name: Harrow Ritualist
summary: You immediately learn two of the following rituals: _astral projection_, _call spirit_, _commune_, _commune with nature_, _legend lore_, or _planar binding_.

name: Vengeful Spirit Deck
summary: You manifest a ghostly deck of harrow cards.

name: Reading the Signs
summary: You have a knack for drawing the right card, be it from a harrow deck, in a game of cards, or even when drawing from a _Deck of Many Things_.

name: Axuma's Awakening
prerequisite: Exposure to the Well of Axuma
summary: Exposure of the well of Axuma has given you some arcane magic.

name: Axuma's Vigor
prerequisite: Exposure to the Well of Axuma
summary: Your vigor makes it easier for others to heal you.

name: Contract Negotiator
summary: Your experience with bargaining and deciding terms as part of Highhelm's guilds helps you make deals in other situations.

name: Vicious Critique
prerequisite: Trained in Crafting; Trained in Intimidation
summary: You have an eye for detail and a mouth for pointing out flaws, which makes it all the easier to convince the merchants and crafters of King's Heart to help you.

name: Cooperative Crafting
summary: You've learned to make the most of working with others on your crafting projects, a must when working with the various guilds of Highhelm.

name: Master of Apprentice
prerequisite: Master in Crafting, Master in Performance, or Master in a Lore skill
summary: Teaching is a difficult art form, but you've gotten a pretty good handle on it.

name: What's That up Your Sleeve?
summary: Whether as a dealer or player, you've learned to spot cheaters.

name: Clan Lore
summary: Your identity as a member of your clan is as central to your sense of self as your dwarven ancestry.

name: Rivethun Disciple
summary: By studying with the dwarven shamans of Highhelm, you have become aware of the friction between your body and spirit.

name: Rivethun Spiritual Attunement
summary: Your time spent among the Rivethun has heightened your awareness of animate spirits around you, giving you the ability to sense them briefly.

name: Stalwart Defender Dedication
summary: You have completed your initial training in the ways of a stalwart defender.

name: Mountain Skin
summary: You become trained in medium and heavy armor.

name: Tunnel Wall
summary: Using your shield, you guard against the movement of foes as surely as if you were a wall of stone.

name: Crushing Step
summary: The weight of your armored feet casts aside natural impediments.

name: Gravel Guts
summary: Stone never becomes queasy, so why should you? You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the sickened condition.

name: Upset Balance
prerequisite: Stalwart Defender Dedication; Expert in Athletics
summary: You lean into your foe's attack, using the weight of your body and armor to send them reeling.

name: Rupture Stomp
summary: Every dwarf knows that the rock they walk upon can be either a best friend or a treacherous path.

name: Unshaken in Iron
summary: You know the precise limits of your armor, and trust it to save you from harm.

name: Gathering Moss
summary: By rooting yourself in place, you are able to focus your body's natural healing to work faster.

name: Cracked Mountain
summary: You fight on, staying on your feet and lashing out at a foe.

name: Stone Body
summary: Emulating the great defenders throughout dwarven history, you close your mind to the sensation of pain, becoming as resolute as stone itself.

name: Elemental Familiar (Kineticist)
summary: A small creature made of elemental matter springs forth from your kinetic gate.

name: Extended Kinesis
summary: You've refined the control you can exert over your elements.

name: Versatile Blasts
summary: Accessing a wider realm of elemental manifestations, you can make blasts with rare forms of your elements.

name: Weapon Infusion
summary: With a signature flair, you shape blasts of elemental power into the form of a weapon, such as a sword made of whirling wind or a bow that shoots flames.

name: Kinetic Activation
summary: Rather than incantations and gestures, you can use your kinetic gate to directly unlock the potential of elementally empowered magic items.

name: Voice of the Elements
summary: You can speak with the secret tones of elements you channel, finding words in the crackle of flame, the grinding of stone.
source:
Rage of Elements pg. 21, [Draconic Codex
](/Sources.aspx?ID=277) pg. 216

name: Command Elemental
summary: You grasp the animating force within an elemental creature and bend it to your will.

name: Safe Elements
summary: Elements are wild and dangerous, but you've found ways to reduce their risk.

name: Counter Element
summary: Your absolute dedication to a single element lets you attempt to gain control over it, even when the element is in service to another entity.

name: Fearsome Familiar
summary: Your elemental familiar trades places with an elemental from its elemental plane.

name: Two-Element Infusion
summary: Slamming one element into another, you combine their strengths.

name: Elemental Overlap
summary: Though you've dedicated yourself to one element, you learn to mix that element with another.

name: Purify Element
summary: You turn an element into its purest form.

name: Aura Shaping
summary: You control the size of your kinetic aura.

name: Chain Infusion
summary: The elemental matter in your blast keeps reconstituting itself to travel onward, no matter how many bodies it collides with.

name: Elemental Transformation
summary: You open your kinetic gate, but rather than activating your kinetic aura, you instead become overwhelmed with transformative elemental energy.

name: Effortless Impulse
summary: A steady ripple from your kinetic gate maintains one of your impulses.

name: Nourishing Gate
summary: You can sustain yourself on a single drop of elemental dew or the slightest spark from the Plane of Fire.

name: Rapid Reattunement
summary: You spend 10 minutes realigning your elemental connections in an elemental trance.

name: Imperious Aura
prerequisite: one or more stance impulses that affect your kinetic aura
summary: Your glowing and majestic kinetic aura marks you as a true child of the elements.

name: Elemental Apotheosis
prerequisite: Nourishing Gate; exactly one kinetic element
summary: You take on an elemental countenance, appearing like a type of elemental of your element.

name: Kinetic Pinnacle
summary: No one can match the pace at which elements flow from you.

name: Omnikinesis
summary: You can realign your kinetic gate with a thought.

name: Aerial Boomerang
summary: A blade of shearing wind races away from you in a 60-foot line.

name: Air Cushion
summary: Air currents flow upward to slow the target's fall to 60 feet per round.

name: Four Winds
summary: Mimicking the anemoi—monarchs of the four winds—you propel four creatures.

name: Whisper on the Wind
trait: Air, Auditory, Illusion, Impulse, Kineticist, Linguistic, Primal
summary: You speak in a whisper, a soft wind carrying your words far away.

name: Air Shroud
summary: Turbulent air suffuses your kinetic aura.

name: Lightning Dash
trait: Air, Electricity, Impulse, Kineticist, Move, Overflow, Polymorph, Primal
summary: For an instant, you transform yourself into a being of pure lightning and fly forward, shocking anyone in your way.

name: Clear as Air
trait: Air, Illusion, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal
summary: Compact layers of air diffract and bend light around your body, making you appear as clear as the sky on a perfect day.

name: Flinging Updraft
summary: A speeding wind heeds your call, picking someone up and depositing them nearby.

name: Cyclonic Ascent
summary: Whorls of wind surround your lower body, forming a cyclone that lifts you into the air.

name: Storm Spiral
trait: Air, Electricity, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal, Sonic
summary: Dark thunderclouds swirl in a miniature storm, crisscrossed with lightning bolts; a tremendous thunderclap fills the air.

name: Ghosts in the Storm
trait: Air, Electricity, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal, Stance
summary: Clouds, like eager pets, are drawn to you and to those in your good graces.

name: Wiles on the Wind
trait: Air, Auditory, Illusion, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal
summary: Speaking lies, you set them loose upon a drifting wind.

name: Body of Air
trait: Air, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Polymorph, Primal
summary: Your gathered air consumes your body, leaving only a cloud of living vapor.

name: Crowned in Tempest's Fury
trait: Air, Electricity, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal, Stance
summary: You become one with a devastating thunderstorm from the Plane of Air, placing a crown of lightning upon your brow.

name: Infinite Expanse of Bluest Heaven
trait: Air, Illusion, Impulse, Kineticist, Mental, Overflow, Primal, Visual
summary: An illusion of a limitless expanse with an impossibly blue sky makes all within feel the sensation of falling...

name: Armor in Earth
summary: Stone encases you like armor.

name: Geologic Attunement
summary: You tune to the earth and stone around you, extending your senses through it in rippling waves.

name: Stepping Stones
summary: Disks of rock fly to points that you designate to make a new path.

name: Tremor
summary: You unleash a small, localized tremor in a 10-foot burst within 30 feet.

name: Calcifying Sand
trait: Earth, Impulse, Incapacitation, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal
summary: Your flesh gives way as you're struck, becoming coarse sand that can magically turn your enemy to stone.

name: Igneogenesis
summary: You can create a permanent stone object, either sculpting stone pulled directly from your kinetic gate or manipulating earth and stone around you.

name: Sand Snatcher
summary: A figure of sand with grasping arms arises in an unoccupied square within 30 feet.

name: Weight of Stone
summary: A packed cloud of thundering boulders descends from the sky, beating down everyone in its path.

name: Spike Skin
summary: You touch a willing creature, causing its skin to harden and form spiky protrusions.

name: Swim Through Earth
summary: The earth parts before you, letting you swim through it.

name: Rattle The Earth
summary: Striking the ground with the gravity of the deepest rocks, you cause an earthquake.

name: Rock Rampart
trait: Earth, Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Overflow, Primal
summary: Drawing on your connection to the Plane of Earth, you form a wall of rock and earth.

name: Assume Earth's Mantle
summary: Enormous pieces of rock cluster around your body.

name: Rebirth in Living Stone
summary: Rock overflows from within you to consume your form before cracking open to reveal your body transformed into living stone.

name: The Shattered Mountain Weeps
summary: A massive sphere of rock explodes, unleashing a cataclysm of falling debris and deadly shrapnel.

name: Burning Jet
summary: A condensed burst of flame shoots behind you, propelling you forward with its sheer force.

name: Eternal Torch
trait: Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Light, Manipulate, Primal
summary: You open a connection to your kinetic gate, large enough for a torch flame to flow.

name: Flying Flame
summary: A Tiny shape of flame appears, taking a form of your choice— such as a bird, an arrow, or a simple sphere.

name: Scorching Column
summary: With an upward gesture, you shape a vertical column of extreme heat.

name: Blazing Wave
summary: Flames flow out of you in a cascade, engulfing everyone in a 30-foot cone.

name: Thermal Nimbus
summary: You direct waves of warmth into or out of your kinetic gate to drastically shift the temperature around you.

name: Crawling Fire
summary: You mimic the motions of a beast of your devising, and it becomes real, with a flaming pelt and searing claws.

name: Volcanic Escape
summary: Lava reflexively explodes underneath you and the creature that hurt you.

name: Kindle Inner Flames
summary: As a candle can light another, you awaken the latent potential to channel fire in other creatures.

name: Solar Detonation
trait: Fire, Impulse, Incapacitation, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal, Vitality
summary: Blinding flames explode in a swirling sphere! The detonation fills a 20-foot burst within 60 feet of you.

name: Architect of Flame
trait: Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Overflow, Primal
summary: Flames rise and shape to your will, forming a wall or dome of your design.

name: Furnace Form
trait: Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Polymorph, Primal
summary: Opening your kinetic gate, you allow flames to consume your form and leave you a living flame.

name: Walk Through the Conflagration
trait: Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal, Teleportation
summary: You fall through your own kinetic gate, leaving behind an effigy of flame and reappearing majestically near another fire.

name: All Shall End in Flames
trait: Death, Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal
summary: White-hot fire consumes everything in a cataclysmic sphere of death.

name: Ignite the Sun
summary: The fires of creation become yours to control.

name: Flash Forge
summary: An artificial metal object forms in the hands of you or a willing ally within 30 feet.

name: Magnetic Pinions
trait: Attack, Impulse, Kineticist, Metal, Overflow, Primal
summary: Small pieces of metal fly from you, propelled with magnetism at great velocity.

name: Metal Carapace
summary: Sheets of bent and rusted metal cover you in an armored shell.

name: Shard Strike
summary: Jagged metal shards form in the air and lash out from you.

name: Magnetic Field
summary: A magnetic field surrounds you.

name: Plate in Treasure
summary: Precious metal flows from your fingers to plate an object.

name: Consume Power
summary: You absorb energy and hold it in your kinetic gate.

name: Scrap Barricade
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Metal, Overflow, Primal
summary: Ragged pieces of metal weld together into a ramshackle structure.

name: Conductive Sphere
trait: Electricity, Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Metal, Primal
summary: A floating metal ball forms in a space within 30 feet, flashing with electricity.

name: Retch Rust
summary: You exhale tendrils formed from flakes of rusted metal.

name: Rain of Razors
summary: Razor-sharp slivers of metal fall from the sky.

name: Shattershields
summary: Four plates of pitted metal float around you to intercept attacks.

name: Alloy Flesh and Steel
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Metal, Polymorph, Primal
summary: Elemental energy replaces every cell of your body with raw metal.

name: Beasts of Slumbering Steel
summary: You conjure metal elemental mounts made of interlocking metal pieces.

name: Hell of 1,000,000 Needles
summary: The landscape fills with monumental filaments of metal.

name: Deflecting Wave
summary: A cascade of water blunts or disperses the incoming attack.

name: Ocean's Balm
trait: Healing, Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Primal, Vitality, Water
summary: A blessing of the living sea salves wounds and douses flames.

name: Tidal Hands
summary: With an emphatic gesture, you create waves that rush out from you in the shape of your hands.

name: Winter's Clutch
summary: Gleaming flakes of chilling snow fall in a 10-foot burst within 60 feet.

name: Return to the Sea
summary: You adapt a creature to living and moving in water.

name: Winter Sleet
trait: Cold, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal, Stance, Water
summary: Bone-chilling, swirling sleet surrounds you, cruel as deepest winter.

name: Driving Rain
summary: Heavy drops of rain batter down, hitting like sling stones and impeding vision.

name: Torrent in the Blood
trait: Healing, Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Overflow, Primal, Vitality, Water
summary: A healing wave splashes across creatures in a 30-foot cone, its cleansing water driving afflictions from the body.

name: Call the Hurricane
summary: Massive waves spiral around you, with you as the eye of the hurricane.

name: Impenetrable Fog
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Overflow, Primal, Water
summary: Fog condenses in a chaotic, swirling pattern, thick enough that it seems to push back against you.

name: Glacial Prison
trait: Cold, Impulse, Incapacitation, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal, Water
summary: Intense cold swirls around your foe, covering it in frost that slows it down and turns its body to ice.

name: Sea Glass Guardians
summary: Eerily beautiful elemental water beings race around you, eager to protect and heal you and your allies.

name: Barrier of Boreal Frost
trait: Cold, Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Overflow, Primal, Water
summary: You form an intricate structure of ice, such as a wall of bricks made of packed snow or a screen of enormous icicles.

name: Ride the Tsunami
summary: Booming, crashing walls of water, enough to fill a harbor, smash out ahead of you, overwhelming all in their path.

name: Usurp the Lunar Reins
summary: The moon has always been connected to the tides, and now you can grasp that connection.

name: Fresh Produce
trait: Healing, Impulse, Kineticist, Plant, Primal, Vitality, Wood
summary: You grow a nourishing nut, vegetable, seed, or fruit.

name: Hail of Splinters
summary: A fusillade of jagged splinters flies from you.

name: Hardwood Armor
summary: Wood and bark grow over your body like armor.

name: Timber Sentinel
summary: A slim, symmetrical tree travels from the Plane of Wood.

name: Ravel of Thorns
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Plant, Primal, Stance, Wood
summary: Thorny vines grow in geometric patterns on surfaces in your kinetic aura.

name: Tumbling Lumber
summary: A slew of logs eject from the Plane of Wood and slam into your enemies.

name: Dash of Herbs
trait: Healing, Impulse, Kineticist, Plant, Primal, Vitality, Wood
summary: A small cloud of medicinal herbs heal a creature.

name: Wooden Palisade
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Overflow, Primal, Wood
summary: Planks of wood, embellished with carvings, spring forth to form a wall.

name: Drifting Pollen
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Plant, Primal, Stance, Wood
summary: A haze of pollen floats around you.

name: Sanguivolent Roots
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Plant, Primal, Wood
summary: Blood-drinking vines grow from the ground in a 15-foot burst within 120 feet.

name: Hedge Maze
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Manipulate, Overflow, Plant, Primal, Wood
summary: You sculpt a manicured maze of hedges.

name: Witchwood Seed
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Plant, Polymorph, Primal, Wood
summary: You touch a creature to implant a malignant seed in its body.

name: Orchard's Endurance
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Plant, Primal, Stance, Wood
summary: Patches of bark appear on the skin of you and your nearby allies.

name: Rouse the Forest's Fury
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Plant, Primal, Wood
summary: Terrifying trees attack your enemies.

name: Turn the Wheel of Seasons
summary: The seasons shift rapidly.

name: Ambush Bladderwort
trait: Composite, Impulse, Kineticist, Plant, Primal, Water, Wood
summary: You plant the seed of a giant bladderwort in an unoccupied square of ground or water within 30 feet.

name: Lava Leap
trait: Composite, Earth, Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal
summary: You wreath yourself in molten stone and hurtle toward your enemy.

name: Living Bonfire
trait: Composite, Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal, Wood
summary: Roots and branches of living wood writhe in elemental fire at your command, forming a bonfire fearsome enough to scare off predators in the night.

name: Rain of Rust
trait: Composite, Impulse, Kineticist, Metal, Primal, Water
summary: You conjure a red raincloud in a 10-foot burst within 60 feet, which pours rust-colored rain directly below it.

name: Whirling Grindstone
trait: Attack, Composite, Earth, Impulse, Kineticist, Metal, Primal
summary: A whirling grindstone made of flint appears in an unoccupied square within 30 feet.

name: Ash Strider
trait: Air, Composite, Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Polymorph, Primal
summary: You discorporate into a cloud of whirling ash and Stride.

name: Desert Wind
trait: Air, Composite, Earth, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal, Stance
summary: A vortex of sand and dust surrounds you.

name: Elemental Artillery
trait: Attack, Composite, Impulse, Kineticist, Metal, Primal, Wood
summary: Spinning wood and metal together, you create a rugged wooden ballista.

name: Jagged Berms
trait: Composite, Earth, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal, Wood
summary: You conjure up to six cube-shaped mounds of packed earth.

name: Lightning Rod
trait: Air, Composite, Impulse, Kineticist, Metal, Primal
summary: You smash a metal rod into your foe and call lightning to it.

name: Molten Wire
trait: Attack, Composite, Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Metal, Primal
summary: Spinning molten iron through a vortex of fire, you trap your foe in searing wires.

name: Rising Hurricane
trait: Air, Composite, Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Primal, Water
summary: A hurricane lifts your enemies into the air before bringing them crashing down in a bloody rain.

name: Roiling Mudslide
trait: Composite, Earth, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal, Water
summary: You form water and earth into a mudslide that smashes your opponents and coats them in mud.

name: Steam Knight
trait: Composite, Fire, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal, Stance, Water
summary: You shape your kinetic aura into swirling armor of steam that scalds your enemies and propels you on super-heated jet streams.

name: Tree of Duality
trait: Air, Composite, Impulse, Kineticist, Primal, Wood
summary: An ephemeral tree bursts forth, floating on air in an unoccupied square of your choice within 60 feet.

name: Ambersoul
summary: Your elemental heritage is reflected in the oils and fragrances of plants, in tree resin that fossilizes into amber, or in the gentle smell of a flower.

name: Grove-Harbored
summary: You are accustomed to exploring thick woodlands and defending yourself against the attacks of magical plants.

name: Moldersoul
summary: Your connection to elemental wood asserts itself in the form of decay, like forgotten logs left to rot and the char that remains after a forest fire, cycles of devastation clearing away what was to make room for the next generation of life.

name: Springsoul
summary: Your connection to elemental wood manifests as fresh blossoms, spring fruits, and the seeds of new life, and you harness this power to spread vitality and abundance.

name: Sunlit Vitality
summary: You gain nourishment through photosynthesis, like trees and other green plants.

name: Woodworker
summary: Denizens of the Plane of Wood take immense pride in the magnificent works of art they can craft from wood, and practicing your own woodcraft helps you feel a connection with your planar heritage.

name: Read the Roots
summary: The root systems of trees are a far-reaching network of information, and you know how to access them and extract their secrets.

name: Treespeech
summary: Your connection to elemental wood allows you to communicate with trees in the Universe in Muan, the language of wood elementals.

name: Flowering Path
summary: Vitality and elemental wood flows out from your body and into the earth, infusing it with a stream of new life.

name: Kizidhar Magic
summary: You can wield the arcane magic of a kizidhar

name: Summon Wood Elemental
summary: Your connection to the Plane of Wood allows you to summon elemental allies.

name: Wooden Mantle
summary: Your connection to the magic of the Plane of Wood allows you to call upon the power of plants and trees to protect yourself.

name: Wood Ward
summary: With a sweep of your hand, vines and roots burst from the ground along the edge of your space between you and the attacker, creating a natural lattice of wood that grants standard cover.

name: Ferrousoul
summary: The elemental metal in your soul resonates strongly with iron, bronze, and other sturdy, practical metals suitable for weaponry.

name: Gildedsoul
summary: Your elemental lineage manifests in the polished gleam of precious metals.

name: Quicksoul
summary: The elemental metal in your bloodline literally courses through your veins.

name: Reflective Defense
summary: Your body's natural luster has been polished to a gleaming shine.

name: Conductor's Redirection
summary: You conduct electrical damage through your body.

name: Precious Alloys
summary: Your unarmed attacks gain the properties of special materials.

name: Natural Magnetism
summary: Your connection with elemental iron grants you a natural field of weak magnetic attraction.

name: Summon Metal Elemental
summary: You can summon an elemental ally.

name: Metallic Skin
summary: You fortify your natural resistances with elemental metal, covering your skin with thick metal.

name: Kineticist Dedication
summary: You become trained in kineticist class DC and impulse attack rolls.

name: Base Kinesis
summary: You gain the Base Kinesis impulse.

name: Through the Gate
summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level kineticist feat of your choice.

name: Advanced Element Control
summary: You gain one kineticist feat.

name: Improved Elemental Blast
summary: The power of your elemental blast improves.

name: Add Element
summary: Choose a second kinetic element to add to the one you already have.

name: Expert Kinetic Control
summary: You become an expert in kineticist class DC and impulse attack rolls.

name: Elementalist Dedication
summary: Each day when you make your daily preparations, you can attune yourself to one element of your choice from your elemental philosophy.

name: Dousing Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; water is in your elemental philosophy
summary: You enhance your spell with elemental water, soaking the target.

name: Elemental Familiar
summary: Your familiar becomes an elemental spirit capable of taking on aspects of the elements.

name: Burning Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; fire is in your elemental philosophy
summary: You enhance your spell with elemental fire, causing it to set the target on fire.

name: Current Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; air or water is in your elemental philosophy
summary: As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you divert some of its currents to form a barrier around you.

name: Expanded Elemental Magic
summary: You reach new understandings of the elements, taking an expansive view.

name: Metabolize Element
summary: Your rapidly metabolize the elemental particles in your opponent's spell to gain a boost of energy.

name: Reverberating Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; metal is in your elemental philosophy
summary: Your spell disorients your targets with a metallic clangor.

name: Growth Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; wood is in your elemental philosophy
summary: You enhance your spell with elemental wood, causing your magic to expand and grow beyond its original limitations.

name: Rockslide Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; earth is in your elemental philosophy
summary: You enhance your spell with elemental earth, causing chunks of stone to litter the ground.

name: Redirect Elements
summary: You seize the elemental essence of an incoming spell and redirect the spell to a creature of your choice within the spell's area.

name: Wind-Tossed Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; air is in your elemental philosophy
summary: You enhance your spell with elemental air, using the wind to find your target and carry your magic around cover.

name: Elemental Evolution
summary: The elemental power within you is more mutable and versatile than most.

name: Elemental Explosion
summary: You unleash the energy roiling within you.

name: Ki Cutting Sight
summary: Everything is connnected—all is part of the whole. Find where to add your ki and you can break the whole.

name: Worm Caller Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Nature or Trained in Cave Worm Lore
summary: You pledge yourself to understanding and emulating one of the most powerful creatures of the Darklands: the mighty cave worm.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 80

name: Worm Sense
summary: You emulate the senses of the cave worm.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 80

name: Wormskin
summary: Your flesh grows thick and bloated, protecting you against harm.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 80

name: Inexorable
summary: You imbue yourself with the resilience of the cave worm.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 80

name: Worm's Feast
summary: You call forth a brood of infantile cave worms to feast on your enemy's flesh.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 80

name: Worm Empathy
summary: You can connect with cave worms (and other worm-related creatures, at the GM's discretion) on a rudimentary level.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 81

name: Azure Fins
summary: When submerged in water or another liquid, you form small fin-like arms along your body, granting you far greater maneuverability while swimming.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 81

name: Call Worm Spirit
summary: You call forth a ghostly manifestation of the worm spirit.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 81

name: Tunnel
summary: You gain a burrow speed of 10 feet.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 81

name: Crimson Breath
summary: You gain a fire breath weapon similar to that of a crimson worm.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 81

name: Venomous Touch
summary: You've learned to channel the sting of the worm.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 81

name: Worm Form
summary: You take on the form of a purple worm or transform into a humanoid-worm hybrid, retaining your own head but with a worm's body, transforming into a Huge battle form.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 81

name: Call the Worm
summary: You gain _summon animal_, heightened to 9th level, as an innate primal spell that you can cast once per day, but can only summon a purple worm.
source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm pg. 81

name: Stone Brawler Dedication
summary: You've learned to call the primal power of elemental stone to your aid.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 82

name: Stoney Skin
summary: Your skin takes on the hardness of stone.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 82

name: Stoney Deflection
summary: You gather the resiliency of stone to block attacks against you.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 82

name: Ore Fists
summary: When you enter the Stonestrike Stance, your fists appear to be covered with veins of unrefined ore.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 82

name: Stonebane
summary: Your stonestrike attacks deal 1d6 additional damage against constructs, creatures with the earth trait, and earthen objects, such as a stone door.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 82

name: Adamantine Fists
summary: You imbue your unarmed strikes with one of the strongest metals.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 82

name: Stonebound Dedication
summary: You bind yourself to the very essence of stone.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 83

name: Elemental Existence
summary: Your body becomes infused with elemental earth.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 83

name: Stone Guardian
summary: You learn to call a powerful guardian of earth and stone to your side.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 83

name: Stone Blood
summary: Your blood becomes thick and sluggish, but no less effective at oxygenating your cells.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 83

name: Stonebound Magic
summary: You've learned to manifest your connection to stone by conjuring it to your side.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 83

name: Statue
summary: Your body and equipment appear to be made of stone as you hold perfectly still.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 83

name: Rocky Flesh
summary: Your flesh takes on the hardness of stone.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 83

name: Living Stone
summary: Your body becomes living stone.
source: Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown pg. 83

name: Chaotic Spell
trait: Bard, Manipulate, Metamagic, Oracle, Sorcerer, Uncommon, Witch, Wizard
summary: Your foe can hardly predict and counter your moves if you yourself have no idea what will happen.

name: Dwarven Doughtiness
summary: You are naturally calm and collected in the face of imminent danger.

name: Dwarven Lore
summary: You eagerly absorbed the old stories and traditions of your ancestors, your gods, and your people.

name: Dwarven Weapon Familiarity
summary: Your kin have instilled in you an affinity for hard-hitting weapons, and you prefer these to more elegant arms.

name: Mountain Strategy
summary: Dwarves have a long history fighting common foes, and you've mastered the ancient tactics to better face these enemies.

name: Rock Runner
summary: Your innate connection to stone makes you adept at moving across uneven surfaces.

name: Stonemason's Eye
summary: You understand the intricacies of stonework.

name: Unburdened Iron
summary: You've learned techniques first devised by your ancestors during their ancient wars, allowing you to comfortably wear massive suits of armor.

name: Boulder Roll
summary: Your dwarven build allows you to push foes around, just like a mighty boulder tumbles through a subterranean cavern.

name: Defy the Darkness
summary: Using ancient dwarven methods developed to fight enemies wielding magical darkness, you've honed your darkvision and sworn not to use such magic yourself.

name: Dwarven Reinforcement
summary: You can use your knowledge of engineering and metalwork to temporarily strengthen thick objects and structures.

name: Echoes in Stone
summary: You pause a moment to attune your senses to the stone around you.

name: Mountain's Stoutness
summary: Your hardiness lets you withstand more punishment than most.

name: Stone Bones
summary: Your intractable nature can help you shrug off even the most grievous injuries.

name: Stonewalker
summary: You have a deep reverence for and connection to stone.

name: March the Mines
summary: You march through the earth and lead an ally along.

name: Telluric Power
summary: You channel strength from the earth beneath your feet to pummel your enemies.

name: Stonegate
summary: Earthen barriers no longer impede your progress.

name: Stonewall
summary: The strength of stone overcomes you so strongly that it replaces your stout body.

name: Ancestral Longevity
summary: You have accumulated a vast array of lived knowledge over the years.

name: Elven Lore
summary: You've studied traditional elven arts, learning about arcane magic and the world around you.

name: Elven Weapon Familiarity
summary: You favor bows and other elegant weapons.

name: Forlorn
summary: Watching your friends age and die fills you with moroseness that protects you against harmful emotions.

name: Nimble Elf
summary: Your muscles are tightly honed.

name: Otherworldly Magic
summary: Your elven magic manifests as a simple arcane spell, even if you aren't formally trained in magic.

name: Unwavering Mien
summary: Your mystic control and meditations allow you to resist external influences upon your consciousness.

name: Ageless Patience
summary: You work at a pace born from longevity that enhances your thoroughness.

name: Ancestral Suspicion
summary: Long-lived elves have seen civilizations rise and fall, often at the hands of outside forces. As a result, they have developed a wariness of others who might seek to influence or control them.

name: Martial Experience
summary: You've crossed blades with a wide variety of foes wielding a wide variety of weapons, and you've learned the basics of fighting with nearly any of them.

name: Elf Step
summary: You move in a graceful dance, and even your steps are broad.

name: Expert Longevity
summary: You've continued to refine the knowledge and skills you've gained through your life.

name: Otherworldly Acumen
prerequisite: at least one innate spell gained from an elf ancestry feat
summary: The arcane magic you possess grows in power and complexity.

name: Tree Climber
summary: You've spent much of your life among the treetops and have become an expert at quickly and safely climbing them.

name: Avenge Ally
summary: Though you know that you will eventually outlive your companions, seeing them at death's door brings clarity to your attacks.

name: Universal Longevity
summary: You’ve perfected your ability to keep up with all the skills you’ve learned over your long life, so you’re almost never truly untrained at a skill.

name: Magic Rider
summary: Your people used powerful magic to travel between distant worlds in the distant past, and the remnants of that magic make such transportation easier for you.

name: Animal Accomplice
summary: You build a rapport with an animal, which becomes magically bonded to you.

name: Animal Elocutionist
summary: You hear animal sounds as conversations instead of unintelligent noise, and you can respond in turn.

name: Fey Fellowship
summary: Your enhanced fey connection (either through your blood or via prolonged contact with their kind) affords you a warmer reception from creatures of the First World as well as tools to foil their tricks or withstand their magic.

name: First World Magic
summary: Your connection to the First World grants you a primal innate spell, much like those of the fey.

name: Gnome Obsession
summary: You might have a flighty nature, but when a topic captures your attention, you dive into it headfirst.

name: Gnome Weapon Familiarity
summary: You favor unusual weapons tied to your people, such as blades with curved and peculiar shapes.

name: Illusion Sense
summary: Your ancestors spent their days cloaked and cradled in illusions, and as a result, sensing illusion magic is second nature to you.

name: Razzle-Dazzle
summary: You've spent considerable time practicing the manipulation of light, weaponizing your blade's reflection or bolstering the luminosity of magical displays to unconventional heights.

name: Energized Font
prerequisite: focus pool, at least one innate spell from a gnome heritage or ancestry feat that shares a tradition with at least one of your focus spells
summary: You can focus your mind more quickly thanks to the magic that flows within you.

name: Project Persona
summary: Where others etch their armor to serve as a conduit for their imaginations, your vivid mind and bold personality allow you to project a more fitting persona over your lackluster armor.

name: Cautious Curiosity
prerequisite: at least one arcane or occult innate spell gained from a gnome heritage or gnome ancestry feat
summary: You've learned a few magical techniques for getting yourself both into and out of trouble unnoticed.

name: First World Adept
prerequisite: at least one primal innate spell
summary: Over time your fey magic has grown stronger.

name: Life Leap
summary: You phase through a space that a living creature occupies in a flash, spontaneously appearing on the opposite side of it in a vibrant display of colorful light.

name: Vivacious Conduit
summary: Your connection to the First World has grown, and its vital energy flows into you rapidly.

name: Instinctive Obfuscation
prerequisite: at least one arcane or occult innate spell gained from a gnome heritage or gnome ancestry feat
summary: The magic within you manifests as a natural reaction to threats.

name: Homeward Bound
summary: The connection between you and the First World resonates within your body stronger than it does for most gnomes, allowing you to cross the threshold between the Universe and the First World.

name: Burn It!
summary: Fire fascinates you.

name: City Scavenger
summary: You know that the greatest treasures often look like refuse.

name: Goblin Lore
summary: You've picked up skills and tales from your goblin community.

name: Goblin Scuttle
summary: You take advantage of your ally's movement to adjust your position.

name: Goblin Song
summary: You sing annoying goblin songs, distracting your foes with silly and repetitive lyrics.

name: Goblin Weapon Familiarity
summary: Others might look upon them with disdain, but you know that the weapons of your people are as effective as they are sharp.

name: Junk Tinker
summary: You can make useful tools out of even twisted or rusted scraps.

name: Rough Rider
summary: You are especially good at riding traditional goblin mounts.

name: Very Sneaky
summary: Taller folk rarely pay attention to the shadows at their feet, and you take full advantage of this.

name: Kneecap
summary: You deliver a punishing blow to an enemy's knee, shin, or other vulnerable anatomy within your reach.

name: Loud Singer
summary: Staying on pitch, proper breath control, and remembering the words are all less important than the real measure of a good singer: volume!

name: Vandal
summary: You have a knack for breaking and dismantling things.

name: Cave Climber
summary: After years of clambering through caverns, you can climb easily anywhere you go.

name: Cling
summary: You hang onto a foe to harry them into submission.

name: Skittering Scuttle
summary: You can scuttle farther and faster when maneuvering alongside allies.

name: Very, Very Sneaky
summary: You can move up to your Speed when you use the Sneak action, and you no longer need to have cover or greater cover or be concealed to Hide or Sneak.

name: Reckless Abandon (Goblin)
summary: Despite a lifetime filled with questionable decisions, you've managed to survive, as though you have uncanny luck that lets you avoid the consequences of your own actions.

name: Distracting Shadows
summary: You have learned to remain hidden by using larger folk as a distraction to avoid drawing attention to yourself.

name: Folksy Patter
summary: You are adept at disguising coded messages as folksy idioms.

name: Halfling Lore
summary: You've dutifully learned how to keep your balance and how to stick to the shadows where it's safe, important skills passed down through generations of halfling tradition.

name: Halfling Luck
summary: Your happy-go-lucky nature makes it seem like misfortune avoids you, and to an extent, that might even be true.

name: Halfling Weapon Familiarity
summary: You favor traditional halfling weapons, so you've learned how to use them more effectively.

name: Prairie Rider
summary: You grew up riding your clan's shaggy ponies and riding dogs.

name: Sure Feet
summary: Whether keeping your balance or climbing, your feet easily find purchase.

name: Titan Slinger
summary: You have learned how to use your sling to fell enormous creatures.

name: Unfettered Halfling
summary: You were either pressed into indentured servitude or shackled in a prison, but you've since escaped and have trained to ensure you'll never be caught again.

name: Watchful Halfling
summary: You pay close attention to the people around you, allowing you to more easily notice when they act out of character.

name: Cultural Adaptability
summary: During your adventures, you've honed your ability to adapt to the culture of the predominant ancestry around you.

name: Step Lively
summary: You are an expert at avoiding the lumbering footsteps of larger creatures.

name: Dance Underfoot
summary: You dart under the legs of your enemies in combat.

name: Guiding Luck
summary: Your luck guides you to look the right way and aim your blows unerringly.

name: Irrepressible
summary: You are easily able to ward off attempts to play on your fears and emotions.

name: Unhampered Passage
summary: You won't allow others to restrain you.

name: Ceaseless Shadows
summary: You excel at going unnoticed, especially among a crowd.

name: Toppling Dance
summary: While sharing a creature's space using Dance Underfoot, your melee weapons and unarmed attacks gain the trip trait, but only against the creature whose space you share.

name: Shadow Self
summary: You slip from your adversaries' notice and appear to be somewhere else.

name: Adapted Cantrip
summary: Through study of multiple magical traditions, you’ve altered a spell to suit your spellcasting style.

name: Cooperative Nature
summary: The short human life span lends perspective and has taught you from a young age to set aside differences and work with others to achieve greatness.

name: General Training
summary: Your adaptability manifests in your mastery of a range of useful abilities.

name: Haughty Obstinacy
summary: Your powerful ego makes it harder for others to order you around.

name: Natural Ambition
summary: You were raised to be ambitious and always reach for the stars, leading you to progress quickly in your chosen field.

name: Natural Skill
summary: Your ingenuity allows you to learn a wide variety of skills.

name: Unconventional Weaponry
summary: You’ve familiarized yourself with a particular weapon, potentially from another ancestry or culture.

name: Adaptive Adept
summary: You’ve continued adapting your magic to blend your class’s tradition with your adapted tradition.

name: Clever Improviser
summary: You’ve learned how to handle situations when you’re out of your depth.

name: Sense Allies
summary: Like many humans raised in a close-knit community, you have always been strongly attuned to the presence of others.

name: Cooperative Soul
summary: You have developed a soul-deep bond with your comrades and maintain an even greater degree of cooperation with them.

name: Group Aid
summary: Your upbringing emphasized teamwork, and helping your allies comes naturally to you.

name: Hardy Traveler
summary: There’s no journey too far or burden too heavy when you have friends at your side or hope within your heart.

name: Incredible Improvisation
summary: A stroke of brilliance gives you a major advantage with a skill despite your inexperience.

name: Multitalented
summary: You’ve learned to split your focus between multiple classes with ease.

name: Advanced General Training
summary: Over the long course of your adventuring life, your adaptability has let you pick up numerous useful abilities.

name: Bounce Back
summary: You recover from near-death experiences with astounding resilience.

name: Stubborn Persistence
summary: Humans are renowned for their ability to persist through the most grueling of trials that would leave others ready to drop.

name: Heroic Presence
summary: The blood of heroes courses through your veins, and you inspire your allies to dig deep and find a new level of resolve.

name: Grasping Reach
summary: You can extend a tangle of vines or tendrils to support your arms and extend your reach.

name: Harmlessly Cute
summary: Your size and demeanor make it easy for you to convince others that you mean no harm.

name: Leshy Lore
summary: You deeply understand your people’s cultural traditions and innate strengths.

name: Leshy Superstition
summary: You notice spirits that inhabit objects, learning which bring good fortune and which are unlucky.

name: Seedpod
summary: Your body produces a nearly endless supply of hard seedpods.

name: Shadow of the Wilds
summary: It’s difficult to notice your passage through wild areas.

name: Undaunted
summary: Your spirit has endured many challenges over its long existence.

name: Anchoring Roots
summary: Small roots sprout from your feet, steadying you as you move.

name: Leshy Glide
prerequisite: Leaf Leshy heritage or Cat Fall
summary: Using your own leaves, you can control your descent.

name: Ritual Reversion
summary: You can temporarily revert to a less conspicuous form without diminishing your senses.

name: Speak with Kindred
summary: You have a connection with creatures that share your physiology.

name: Bark and Tendril
summary: You wield primal magic.

name: Lucky Keepsake
summary: You have a keepsake that grants you luck.

name: Solar Rejuvenation
summary: If you rest outdoors for 10 minutes during the day, you regain Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier × half your level.

name: Thorned Seedpod
summary: When your seedpods strike a felling blow, they burst into viciously thorny vines.

name: Call of the Green Man
summary: You can call forth nearby nature spirits to augment your body.

name: Cloak of Poison
summary: You secrete a cloak of concentrated poison that harms any who dare attack you.

name: Flourish and Ruin
