summary: You can call upon the vital essence of your spirit to restore life to your allies and call forth vines to ensnare and bludgeon your foes.

name: Regrowth
summary: Your command over your vital essence allows you or an ally to recover from grievous wounds.

name: Beast Trainer
summary: You have an impressive innate ability to tame and command ferocious beasts.

name: Iron Fists
summary: Your fists have been forged by battle, your naturally tough skin and dense bone further hardened by conflict.

name: Orc Ferocity
summary: Fierceness in battle runs through your blood, and you refuse to fall from your injuries no matter how terrible they may be.

name: Orc Lore
summary: The hold elders taught you your people’s histories, told tales of great athletic feats, and shared with you the hardships your ancestors endured so that you can pass this wisdom down to future generations.

name: Orc Superstition
summary: You defend yourself against magic by relying on techniques derived from orc cultural superstitions.

name: Hold Mark
summary: You bear scars or tattoos enhanced by the mark of your community’s prowess.

name: Orc Weapon Familiarity
summary: In combat, you favor the brutal weapons that are traditional for your orc ancestors.

name: Tusks
summary: You have particularly long, jagged tusks perfect for tearing meat from bone.
source: Player Core pg. 72, Character Guide pg. 15

name: Athletic Might
summary: Surviving in hostile terrain has given you a great talent for mobility.

name: Bloody Blows
summary: Your lethal unarmed attacks leave bloody gouges or cause severe internal bleeding.

name: Defy Death
summary: You’re exceptionally difficult to kill.

name: Scar-Thick Skin
summary: Glorious, storied scars cover and protect much of your body, girding you in fleshly armor that resists any wound weaker than those you have already survived.

name: Pervasive Superstition
summary: You steep yourself in superstition and practice ancient orc mental exercises for shrugging off the effects of magic.

name: Undying Ferocity
summary: You resist death’s clutches with supernatural vigor, daring death to claim you while promising that any such attempt will surely fail.

name: Incredible Ferocity
summary: Given time to collect yourself after a near-death scrape, you can rebuild your ferocity and withstand additional finishing blows.

name: Ferocious Beasts
prerequisite: Bonded Animal, animal companion, or Pet; Orc Ferocity
summary: Since ancient times, the mightiest orc beast tamers would draw out the true fighting spirit of their companion beasts by feeding the creatures a draft incorporating the orc’s own blood.

name: Spell Devourer
summary: You don’t just resist magic; you devour it.

name: Rampaging Ferocity
summary: You lash out viciously even as you fend off death.

name: Brine May
summary: Your mother was a sea hag, granting you one sea-green or blue eye.

name: Callow May
summary: You are among the most common of changelings—those born to sweet hags—and a vibrant green eye signifies that parentage.

name: Dream May
summary: You are the child of a cuckoo hag, making one of your eyes violet or even black.

name: Slag May
summary: Your mother was an iron hag known for physical prowess, and you have one violet or steel-gray eye.

name: Changeling Lore
summary: All too aware of your true nature, you’ve studied hags and their powers.

name: Hag Claws
summary: When you came of age, your fingernails grew long and sharp.

name: Hag's Sight
summary: You’ve nurtured the supernatural abilities gifted by your hag mother, particularly your sight.

name: Called
summary: You’ve heard the Call, and by resisting it, you’ve developed a bulwark against effects that target your mind.

name: Mist Child
summary: You blend in with unnatural subtlety.

name: Accursed Claws
summary: Your claws carry your mother’s hag magic.

name: Occult Resistance
summary: Your study of occult practices has shown you how to best defend against them.

name: Hag Magic
summary: Through your heritage, you can replicate a hag’s magic.

name: Angelkin
summary: You descend from an angel, a winged messenger from Nirvana or one of the other celestial realms.

name: Grimspawn
summary: Your lineage traces back to a daemon, one of the manifestations of horrific forms of death that devour souls within their foul home of Abaddon.

name: Hellspawn
summary: Your lineage descends from devils, conniving schemers of Hell.

name: Lawbringer
summary: You trace your lineage to archons, guardians of the seventiered mountain of Heaven and nurturers of law and virtue within mortals.

name: Musetouched
summary: Your blood sings with the liberating power of the azatas.

name: Pitborn
summary: Your blood bears the mark of a demon.

name: Bestial Manifestation
summary: Part of your body has an animalistic influence from a planar creature.

name: Halo
summary: You have a halo of light and goodness that sheds light with the effects of a divine _light_ cantrip.

name: Nephilim Eyes
summary: Your eyes can see through darkness with visual acuity akin to that possessed by most extraplanar beings.

name: Nephilim Lore
summary: You know the secrets of the Multiverse.

name: Nimble Hooves
summary: You possess hooves, ankle wings, or some other feature that hastens your movement.

name: Blessed Blood (Nephilim)
summary: Your spilled blood is sanctified, with effects similar to those of holy water.

name: Extraplanar Supplication
summary: You call upon divine power to place a benediction upon your allies or a malediction upon your foes.

name: Nephilim Resistance
summary: You resist energy like your extraplanar predecessors.

name: Scion of Many Planes
summary: The long and complicated history of your bloodline manifests in your ability to draw power from more planar sources than most other nephilim.

name: Skillful Tail
summary: You’ve always had a tail, but with practice, you’ve learned to use it for more than signaling your mood.

name: Celestial Magic
prerequisite: Angelkin, Lawbringer, Musetouched, or another lineage feat associated with celestials
summary: You possess celestial magic.

name: Divine Countermeasures
summary: You’ve studied your extraplanar heritage with the intent of better defending yourself, whether against creatures aligned with or opposed to your extraplanar lineage, and you’ve found that your techniques are equally powerful against celestials, fiends, and other divine entities.

name: Divine Wings
summary: With effort, you can call forth magical wings from your back, similar in appearance to those of your extraplanar forebear, whether they be elegantly feathered wings or ominous bat wings.

name: Fiendish Magic
prerequisite: Grimspawn, Pitborn, or Hellspawn, or another lineage feat associated with fiends
summary: You possess fiendish magic.

name: Celestial Mercy
prerequisite: Angelkin, Lawbringer, Musetouched, or another lineage feat associated with celestials
summary: Your celestial powers allow you to remove lesser afflictions with ease.

name: Slip Sideways
prerequisite: Grimspawn, Pitborn, or Hellspawn, or another lineage feat associated with fiends or the Maelstrom
summary: Like many fiends, you have the supernatural ability to teleport yourself to safety.

name: Summon Nephilim Kin
summary: You have a connection to the Outer Planes, allowing you to summon a divine ally.

name: Divine Declaration
summary: You can call forth a holy or unholy word from the realms beyond to punish your foes.

name: Eternal Wings
summary: Your wings are now a permanent part of your body.

name: Earned Glory
summary: Elves often struggle with underestimating aiuvarins, and you are experienced at telling stories of your accomplishments to gain their respect.

name: Elf Atavism
summary: Your elven blood runs particularly strong, granting you features far more elven than those of a typical aiuvarin.

name: Inspire Imitation
summary: Your actions inspire your allies to great achievements.

name: Supernatural Charm
summary: The elven magic in your blood manifests as a force you can use to become more appealing or alluring.

name: Monstrous Peacemaker
summary: Your dual human and orc nature has given you a unique perspective, allowing you to bridge the gap between humans and the many intelligent creatures in the world that humans consider monsters.

name: Orc Sight
summary: Your orc blood grants you the keen vision of your forebears.

name: Bardic Lore
summary: Your studies make you informed on every subject.

name: Hymn of Healing
summary: You learn the hymn of healing composition spell, which imbues your music with rich melodies that help your allies recover from harm.

name: Lingering Composition
summary: By adding a flourish, you make your compositions last longer.

name: Martial Performance
summary: Your muse has taught you how to handle a wider variety of weapons than most bards, empowering you to effortlessly blend your performance into combat tools.

name: Reach Spell
trait: Bard, Cleric, Concentrate, Druid, Oracle, Sorcerer, Spellshape, Witch, Wizard
summary: You can extend your spells’ range.
source: Player Core pg. 101, Player Core 2 pg. 138

name: Versatile Performance
summary: You can rely on the grandeur of your performances rather than ordinary social skills.

name: Well-Versed
summary: You’re resilient to performative influences that aren’t your own.

name: Cantrip Expansion
trait: Bard, Cleric, Magus, Oracle, Psychic, Sorcerer, Witch, Wizard
summary: Study broadens your range of simple spells.
source: Player Core pg. 101, Player Core 2 pg. 138

name: Directed Audience
summary: You can shape the area of your composition spells.

name: Emotional Push
summary: You prepare to take advantage of your enemy’s sudden change in emotions.

name: Esoteric Polymath
summary: You keep a book of occult spells, similar to a wizard’s spellbook, and can use its spells to supplement your spell repertoire.

name: Loremaster's Etude
summary: You magically unlock memories, making them easier to recall.

name: Multifarious Muse
summary: Your muse doesn’t fall into a single label.

name: Song of Strength
summary: Your performances inspire strength in your allies to aid them at physical tasks.

name: Uplifting Overture
summary: You learn the uplifting overture composition cantrip, which aids your allies’ skills with the inspiring nature of your performance.

name: Combat Reading
summary: You use a performer’s cold reading techniques, aura reading, and other tricks to discover your foe’s strengths and weaknesses.

name: Courageous Advance
summary: With a rousing call, you exhort an ally to advance.

name: In Tune
summary: You attune your great skill in performing to another, granting them a small measure of your skill as though anyone could do it.

name: Melodious Spell
summary: You subtly weave your spellcasting into a performance.

name: Rallying Anthem
summary: You learn the rallying anthem composition cantrip, which protects you and allies.

name: Ritual Researcher
summary: Careful research into the art of rituals has made you better at performing them.

name: Triple Time
summary: You learn the triple time composition cantrip, which speeds up you and your allies for a round.

name: Versatile Signature
summary:
You’re always tweaking your
available repertoire.

name: Assured Knowledge
summary: You can procure information with confidence.

name: Defensive Coordination
summary: Like the storied heroes who persist in the face of overwhelming odds, you and your allies will hold the line.

name: Dirge of Doom
summary: You learn the dirge of doom composition cantrip (page 370), which frightens your enemies and keeps them from fully recovering from their fear.

name: Educate Allies
summary: You tweak the properties of your composition spell to convey a bit of your defensive knowledge.

name: Harmonize
summary: You can perform multiple compositions simultaneously,

name: Song of Marching
summary: You learn the song of marching composition cantrip, which enables you and your allies to cross vast distances without strain.

name: Steady Spellcasting
trait: Bard, Cleric, Druid, Oracle, Psychic, Sorcerer, Witch, Wizard
summary: You don’t lose spells easily. If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. If you succeed, your action isn’t disrupted.
source: Player Core pg. 103, Player Core 2 pg. 140

name: Accompany
summary: You use your performance to supplement an ally’s spellcasting, providing magical energy for their spell in their stead.

name: Call and Response
summary: Your composition takes the form of a call-and-response chant that lets your allies continue the effect without you.

name: Eclectic Skill
summary: Your broad experiences translate to a range of skills.

name: Fortissimo Composition
summary: Your anthems grow louder and more potent, bolstered by your muse’s power.

name: Know-It-All
summary: When you Recall Knowledge, you gain additional information or context.

name: Reflexive Courage
summary: You bellow a ferocious call to arms, inspiring yourself to lash out at a foe.

name: Soulsight
summary: Your muse has opened your senses to the world beyond.

name: Annotate Composition
summary: By putting composition to paper, you can create a source of stirring words or song that others can read and understand.

name: Courageous Assault
summary: With a mighty shout, you can stir an ally to attack.

name: House of Imaginary Walls
summary: You erect an imaginary barrier others believe to be real.

name: Ode to Ouroboros
summary: You learn the ode to ouroboros composition spell (page 371), which enables you to temporarily spare your allies from death.

name: Quickened Casting
trait: Bard, Concentrate, Oracle, Sorcerer, Spellshape, Witch, Wizard
summary: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).
source: Player Core pg. 105, Player Core 2 pg. 141

name: Symphony of the Unfettered Heart
summary: You learn the symphony of the unfettered heart composition spell (page 371), which enables you to protect an ally against incapacitating conditions.

name: Unusual Composition
summary: You can translate the emotion and power of a composition to other mediums.

name: Eclectic Polymath
summary: Your flexible mind can quickly shift from one spell to another.

name: Enigma's Knowledge
summary: Your muse whispers knowledge to you at all the right times.

name: Inspirational Focus
summary: Your connection to your muse has granted you unusual focus.

name: Reverberate
summary: You can manipulate the acoustics around you to deflect sonic damage back at its source.

name: Shared Assault
summary: In the triumph of battle, you can share the glory with another ally.

name: Allegro
summary: You can quicken your allies with a fast-paced performance.

name: Earworm
summary: By endlessly repeating a motif, you implant a memorable song that repeats over and over again in your allies’ heads, preparing them to respond to it later.

name: Soothing Ballad
summary: You soothe your allies’ wounds with the power of performance.

name: Triumphant Inspiration
summary: With a triumphant shout, you inspire your allies.

name: True Hypercognition
summary: Your mind works at an incredible pace.

name: Vigorous Anthem
summary: You instill magical vigor in your allies when you inspire them to attack.

name: Courageous Onslaught
summary: You use your performance to orchestrate an onslaught against your enemies.

name: Effortless Concentration
trait: Bard, Druid, Sorcerer, Summoner, Witch, Wizard
summary: You can maintain a spell with hardly a thought.
source: Player Core pg. 106, Player Core 2 pg. 157

name: Resounding Finale
summary: You bring your performance to a sudden, dramatic finish, drowning out other sounds.

name: All in my Head

name: Deep Lore
summary: Your repertoire is vast, containing far more spells than usual.

name: Discordant Voice
summary: Your courageous anthem lets loose a discordant shriek that imbues your allies’ attacks with powerful sonic reverberations.

name: Eternal Composition
summary: The world is a stage upon which you are always playing.

name: Impossible Polymath
prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, or Trained in Religion; Esoteric Polymath
summary: Your esoteric formulas are so unusual that they allow you to dabble in magic from diverse traditions that other bards don’t understand.

name: Fatal Aria
summary: Your songs overwhelm the target with unbearable emotion, potentially striking them dead on the spot.

name: Perfect Encore
summary: You develop another incredible creation.

name: Pied Piping
summary: You learn the _pied piping_ composition spell, which enables you to control the actions of weak-minded individuals.

name: Symphony of the Muse
summary: You have learned how to weave countless performances together into a solo symphony with multitudinous effects.

name: Ultimate Polymath
summary: You can flexibly cast all of your spells, granting a dizzying array of possible options.

name: Deadly Simplicity
prerequisite: deity with a simple or unarmed attack favored weapon, trained with your deity's favored weapon
summary: When you are wielding your deity’s favored weapon, increase the damage die size of that weapon by one step.

name: Divine Castigation
summary: Your deity’s grace doesn’t extend to your sworn enemies.

name: Domain Initiate
summary: Your deity bestows a special spell related to their powers.

name: Harming Hands
summary: The mordant power of your void energy grows.

name: Healing Hands
summary: Your vitality is even more vibrant and restorative.

name: Premonition of Avoidance
summary: Your deity grants you a moment’s foresight.

name: Communal Healing
summary: You’re an exceptional conduit for vitality and, as you channel it through you, you can divert some to heal yourself or another creature.

name: Emblazon Armament
summary: Carefully etching a sacred image into a physical object, you steel yourself for battle.

name: Panic the Dead
summary: Vitality strikes terror in the undead.

name: Rapid Response
summary: You work quickly in emergencies.

name: Sap Life
summary: You draw the life force out of your enemies.

name: Versatile Font
prerequisite: harmful font or healing font; deity that allows clerics to have both fonts
summary: As you explore your deity’s aspects, you move beyond restrictions on healing or harming.

name: Warpriest’s Armor
summary: Your training has helped you adapt to ever-heavier armor.

name: Channel Smite
summary: You siphon the energies of life and death through a melee attack and into your foe.

name: Directed Channel
summary: You can shape the energy you channel in a single direction.

name: Divine Infusion
summary: You pour energy into the subject of your healing to empower its attacks.

name: Raise Symbol
summary: You present your religious symbol emphatically.

name: Restorative Strike
summary: You balance both sides of the scales, restoring yourself while striking a foe.

name: Sacred Ground
summary: You pray continuously for 1 minute to call a subtle shadow of your deity’s realm over a 30-foot burst centered on you.

name: Cast Down
summary: The sheer force of your faith can bring a foe crashing down.

name: Divine Rebuttal
summary: You strive against magical threats physically and spiritually.

name: Divine Weapon
summary: You siphon residual spell energy into a weapon you’re wielding.

name: Magic Hands
summary: The blessing of your deity heightens your healing ability, integrating magical healing with the mundane.

name: Selective Energy
summary: As you call down divine power, you can prevent some enemies from benefiting or some allies from being hurt.

name: Advanced Domain
summary: Your prayers have unlocked deeper secrets of your deity’s domain.

name: Cremate Undead
summary: Your overwhelming vitality sets undead alight.

name: Emblazon Energy
summary: With elemental forces, you make your emblazoned symbols more potent.

name: Martyr
summary: You go to extreme lengths to support your allies, even when it means bringing harm to yourself.

name: Restorative Channel
summary: You can remove conditions with divine grace.

name: Sanctify Armament
summary: You touch a weapon and bring it into concordance with your deity.

name: Surging Focus
summary: When an ally you can see falls in battle, your surge of righteous indignation allows you to draw upon untapped reserves of divine power.

name: Void Siphon
summary: The raw energy of the Void saps the essence of the living.

name: Zealous Rush
summary: You bless yourself on the move.

name: Castigating Weapon
summary: The force of your deity’s castigation strengthens your body so you can strike down the enemy and its allies.

name: Heroic Recovery
summary: The restorative power of your healing invigorates the recipient.

name: Replenishment of War

summary: Striking out against your enemies draws praise and protection from your deity.

name: Shared Avoidance
summary: You can project your premonitions of danger to your allies.

name: Shield of Faith
summary: Residual energy from your domain spells bolsters your defenses.

name: Defensive Recovery
summary: Your faith provides temporary protection in addition to healing.

name: Domain Focus
summary: Your devotion to your deity’s domains grows greater, and so does the power granted to you.

name: Emblazon Antimagic
summary: Your deity’s symbol protects against offensive magic.

name: Fortunate Relief
summary: Your god favors your attempts to remove afflictions and conditions.

name: Sapping Symbol
summary: Your religious symbol glows with sacred energy, turning the attacker’s strength to weakness.

name: Shared Replenishment
summary: When your deity blesses your warlike acts, you can extend that favor to your allies.

name: Channeling Block
summary: You pour divine energy into a desperate block.

name: Deity's Protection
summary: When you call upon your deity’s power to fulfill the promise of their domain, you gain divine protection.

name: Ebb and Flow
summary: You can pull forth both vitality and the void simultaneously to harm your enemies and heal your allies.

name: Fast Channel
summary: Divine power is always at your fingertips, swiftly responding to your call.

name: Lasting Armament
summary: When you sanctify a weapon, it remains sanctified for an extended period.

name: Premonition of Clarity
summary: Your deity sends you a vision of faith to steel you against mental attacks.

name: Swift Banishment
summary: The force of your blow sends your victim back to its home plane.

name: Eternal Bane
summary: Your life has made you a nexus for your deity’s vile power.

name: Eternal Blessing
summary: Your deeds have brought your deity’s grace to you for all of eternity.

name: Rebounding Smite
summary: The energy from your smite persists for a moment, allowing you to pass it to a new target.

name: Remediate
summary: If your next action is to use your divine font to cast a 3-action heal or harm spell, you can harness the residual energy to counterbalance opposing forces.

name: Resurrectionist
summary: You can cause a creature you bring back from the brink of death to thrive and continue healing.

name: Divine Apex
summary: You can pour divine power into an item, letting the wearer exceed their limits.

name: Echoing Channel
summary: When you pull forth vitality or void energy, you also create a smaller pocket of that energy.

name: Improved Swift Banishment
summary: You easily banish creatures with your weapon.

name: Inviolable
summary: Your deity punishes creatures that harm you.

name: Miraculous Possibility
summary: Your deity empowers you to perform minor miracles, allowing you to readily adapt to the fluctuating needs of your duties.

name: Shared Clarity
summary: You can project your premonitions of clarity to your allies.

name: Avatar's Audience
summary: Your extensive service affords you certain divine privileges.

name: Avatar's Protection
summary: In moments of danger, you can call upon your god’s form in an instant.

name: Maker of Miracles
summary: You are a conduit for truly deific power.

name: Spellshape Channel
summary: Deep understanding of divine revelations into the nature of vital essence allows you to freely manipulate the energy of life and death.

name: Animal Companion
summary: You gain the service of a young animal companion (page 206) that travels with you on your adventures and obeys any simple commands you give it to the best of its abilities.

name: Animal Empathy (Druid)
summary: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

name: Leshy Familiar
summary: You call a minor spirit of nature into a plant body, creating a leshy companion to aid you in your spellcasting.

name: Plant Empathy
summary: You have a connection to flora that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

name: Storm Born
summary: You are at home out in the elements, reveling in the power of nature unleashed.

name: Untamed Form
summary: You are one with the wild, always changing and adapting to meet any challenge.

name: Verdant Weapon
summary: You cultivate a seed that can sprout into a wooden staff, vine whip, or another weapon.

name: Widen Spell
trait: Druid, Manipulate, Oracle, Sorcerer, Spellshape, Witch, Wizard
summary: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to spread out and affect a wider area.
source: Player Core pg. 128, Player Core 2 pg. 138

name: Call of the Wild
summary: You call upon the creatures of nature to come to your aid.

name: Enhanced Familiar
trait: Animist, Druid, Magus, Sorcerer, Thaumaturge, Witch, Wizard
summary: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.
source: Player Core pg. 129, Player Core 2 pg. 153

name: Order Explorer
summary: You have learned the secrets of another druidic order, passing whatever rites of initiation that order requires and gaining access to its secrets.

name: Poison Resistance
summary: Your affinity for the natural world grants you protection against some of its dangers.

name: Anthropomorphic Shape
summary: Humanoids’ supposed place apart from animals is folly—taking on their forms just requires some extra practice.

name: Elemental Summons
summary: You can call the elements to you.

name: Forest Passage
summary: You can always find a path, almost as if foliage parted before you.

name: Form Control
summary: With additional care and effort, you can take on an alternate shape for a longer period of time.

name: Leshy Familiar Secrets
summary: The leaf order’s secrets allow your familiar to take advantage of its leshy form.

name: Mature Animal Companion (Druid)
summary: Your animal companion has grown up over the course of your adventures, becoming a mature animal companion and gaining additional capabilities (page 211).

name: Order Magic
summary: You have delved deeper into the teaching of a new order, gaining access to a coveted order spell.

name: Snowdrift Spell
summary: The howling wind and precipitation of your magic turn to thick snow.

name: Current Spell
summary: As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you spin off some of its currents to form a barrier around you.

name: Grown of Oak
summary: You can make your skin take on the woody endurance of an ancient tree and have your familiar follow suit.

name: Insect Shape
summary: Your understanding of life expands, allowing you to mimic a wider range of creatures.

name: Instinctive Support
summary: When you support your animal companion, your companion supports you in turn.

name: Storm Retribution
summary: You lash out, directing a burst of storming fury toward a creature that has harmed you.

name: Deimatic Display
summary: Imitating animal threat displays, you make yourself appear larger and more imposing.

name: Ferocious Shape
summary: You’ve mastered the shape of dinosaurs.

name: Fey Caller
summary: You have learned some of the tricks the fey use to bend primal magic toward illusions and trickery.

name: Floral Restoration
summary: You request that nearby plants share their vitality with you to replenish your body and magic.

name: Incredible Companion (Druid)
summary: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

name: Raise Menhir
summary: You raise a druidic monument, such as a standing stone or warding tree, from the ground, creating a powerful primal ward that blocks other types of magic.

name: Soaring Shape
summary: Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below.

name: Wind Caller
summary: You bid the winds to aid you, carrying you through the air and allowing you passage through the strongest headwinds.

name: Elemental Shape
summary: You understand the fundamental elements of nature such that you can imbue them into your body and manifest as a living embodiment of those elements.

name: Healing Transformation
summary: You can take advantage of shapechanging magic to close wounds and patch injuries.

name: Overwhelming Energy
summary: With a complex gesture, you call upon the primal power of your spell to overcome enemies’ resistances.
source: Player Core pg. 133, Player Core 2 pg. 155

name: Plant Shape
summary: You can take the shape of a plant creature.

name: Primal Howl
summary: Your companion can let out a howl laced with your primal magic.

name: Pristine Weapon
summary: Your verdant weapon can cut through the resistances of magical creatures.

name: Side by Side (Druid)
summary: You and your animal companion fight in tandem, distracting your foes and keeping them off balance.

name: Thunderclap Spell
summary: Your lightning splits the air, generating a booming shock wave.

name: Dragon Shape
summary: You can take on the shape of some of the world’s most fearsome creatures.

name: Garland Spell
summary: If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the fungus or plant trait, a garland of plants grows in a 10-foot burst in the spell’s range.

name: Primal Focus
summary: Your connection to nature is particularly strong, and the spirits of nature flock around you, helping you replenish your focus.

name: Primal Summons
summary: Whenever you summon an ally, you can empower it with the elemental power of air, earth, fire, or water.

name: Wandering Oasis
summary: You’re surrounded by soothing energy.

name: Reactive Transformation
prerequisite: Untamed Form; Dragon Shape, Elemental Shape, Plant Shape, or Soaring Shape
summary: You transform reflexively when in danger.

name: Sow Spell
summary: You fold your spell into a seed.

name: Specialized Companion (Druid)
summary: Your animal companion continues to grow in power and ability.

name: Timeless Nature
summary: With primal magic sustaining you, you cease aging.

name: Verdant Metamorphosis
summary: You have turned into a plant version of yourself, gaining the plant trait and losing traits inappropriate for your new form (typically humanoid).

name: Impaling Briars
summary: You can fill an area with devastating briars.

name: Monstrosity Shape
summary: You can transform into a powerful magical creature.

name: Uplifting Winds
summary: The winds are eager to keep you aloft.

name: Invoke Disaster
summary: You can invoke nature’s fury upon your foes.

name: Perfect Form Control
summary: Thanks to magic and muscle memory, you can stay in your alternate shapes indefinitely.

name: Primal Aegis
summary: You surround yourself with a thick field of protective primal energy.

name: Hierophant's Power
summary: You have entwined yourself with the natural world, and its full power flows through you.

name: Ley Line Conduit
summary: You can draw magic from the ley lines of the world.

name: True Shapeshifter
summary: You transcend the limitations of form.

name: Combat Assessment
summary: You make a telegraphed attack to learn about your foe.

name: Double Slice
summary: You lash out at your foe with both weapons.

name: Exacting Strike
summary: You make a controlled follow-up attack, fully accounting for your momentum.

name: Point Blank Stance
summary: You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly.

name: Reactive Shield
summary: You can snap your shield into place just as you would take a blow, avoiding the hit at the last second.

name: Snagging Strike
summary: You combine an attack with quick grappling moves to throw an enemy off balance as long as it stays in your reach.

name: Sudden Charge
summary: With a quick sprint, you dash up to your foe and swing.
source: Player Core pg. 141, Player Core 2 pg. 77

name: Vicious Swing
summary: You unleash a particularly powerful attack that clobbers your foe but leaves you a bit unsteady.

name: Aggressive Block
summary: You push back as you block, knocking your foe away or off balance.

name: Assisting Shot
summary: Using your last shot to gauge your accuracy, you can fire off a quick shot to interfere with a foe in combat.

name: Blade Brake
summary: You plow your weapon into a floor, wall, or another sturdy surface, anchoring yourself in place.

name: Brutish Shove
summary: Using the momentum of your last attack to throw your weight into another, you make your opponent stumble back.

name: Combat Grab
summary: Using your prior attack to shift your opponent’s guard, you take another swing and grab them.

name: Dueling Parry (Fighter)
summary: You can parry attacks against you with your one-handed weapon.

name: Intimidating Strike
summary: Your blow not only wounds creatures but also shatters their confidence.
source: Player Core pg. 141, Player Core 2 pg. 77

name: Lightning Swap
summary: You have practiced quickly switching between combat styles and the equipment needed for them.

name: Lunge
summary: You attack an enemy at the edge of your reach.

name: Rebounding Toss
summary: You bounce your weapon off one foe to strike another.

name: Sleek Reposition
summary: While your opponent is still recovering from your prior attack, you snag its armor, clothing, or flesh to move it as you please.

name: Barreling Charge
summary: You rush forward, moving enemies aside to reach your foe.
source: Player Core pg. 143, Player Core 2 pg. 78

name: Double Shot
summary: You shoot twice in blindingly fast succession.

name: Dual-Handed Assault
summary: You snap your free hand over to grip your weapon just long enough to add momentum and deliver a more powerful blow to your opponent.

name: Parting Shot
summary: You jump back and make a quick shot that catches your opponent by surprise.

name: Powerful Shove
summary: You can push larger foes around with your attack.

name: Quick Reversal
summary: You turn your foes’ flanking against them with a quick reverse.

name: Shielded Stride
summary: When your shield is up, your enemies’ blows can’t touch you.

name: Slam Down
summary: You make an attack to knock a foe off balance, then follow up immediately with a sweep to topple them.

name: Swipe
summary: You make a wide, arcing swing.
source: Player Core pg. 144, Player Core 2 pg. 78

name: Twin Parry
summary: You use your two weapons to parry attacks.

name: Advanced Weapon Training
summary: You’ve studied the art of wielding an advanced weapon.

name: Advantageous Assault
summary: After compromising your enemy’s movement, you deliver a more deadly blow.

name: Dazing Blow
summary: You pummel a held foe, hoping to stagger them.

name: Disarming Stance
summary: You adopt a fencing stance that improves your control over your weapon.

name: Furious Focus
summary: You’ve learned to maintain your balance even when swinging furiously.

name: Guardian's Deflection (Fighter)
summary: You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their Armor Class against the triggering attack.

name: Reflexive Shield
summary: You can use your shield to fend off explosions and the like.

name: Revealing Stab
summary: You drive your piercing weapon into an imperceptible foe, revealing its location to your allies.

name: Ricochet Stance (Fighter)
summary: You adopt a stance to rebound your thrown weapons toward you.

name: Shatter Defenses
summary: Your offense exploits your enemy’s fear.

name: Shield Warden
summary: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you.
source: Player Core pg. 145, Player Core 2 pg. 96

name: Triple Shot
summary: You can quickly fire multiple shots with greater control.

name: Blind-Fight
summary: Your battle instincts make you more aware of concealed and invisible opponents.
source: Player Core pg. 145, Player Core 2 pg. 109

name: Disorienting Opening
summary: You use your foes’ openings to expose even greater weaknesses.

name: Dueling Riposte
summary: You elegantly counterattack against your flailing enemy.

name: Felling Strike
summary: Your attack can ground an airborne foe.

name: Incredible Aim
summary: By spending a moment to focus, you can ensure your attack strikes true.

name: Mobile Shot Stance
summary: Your shots become nimble and deadly.

name: Positioning Assault
summary: With punishing blows, you force your opponent into position.

name: Quick Shield Block
summary: You can bring your shield into place with hardly a thought.
source: Player Core pg. 147, Player Core 2 pg. 97

name: Resounding Bravery
summary: Even your fears serve as fuel for your fighting spirit.

name: Sudden Leap
summary: You make an impressive leap and swing while you soar.
source: Player Core pg. 147, Player Core 2 pg. 81

name: Agile Grace
summary: Your graceful moves with agile weapons are beyond compare.

name: Certain Strike
summary: Even when you don’t hit squarely, you can still score a glancing blow.

name: Crashing Slam
summary: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

name: Cut from the Air
summary: You can knock aside ranged attacks.

name: Debilitating Shot
summary: Aiming for a weak point, you impede your foe with a precise shot.

name: Disarming Twist
summary: After your initial attack redirects your foe’s defenses, your follow-up wrests their weapon from their grasp.

name: Disruptive Stance
summary: The slightest distraction can provoke your wrath, and you’re prepared to foil enemies’ actions.

name: Fearsome Brute
summary: Fear makes your foes weak and more vulnerable to your attacks.

name: Flinging Charge
summary: You throw a weapon to distract your opponent as you close the gap to begin your assault.

name: Mirror Shield
summary: You reflect the spell back against its caster.

name: Overpowering Charge
summary: You trample foes as you charge past.
source: Player Core pg. 148, Player Core 2 pg. 82

name: Tactical Reflexes
summary: You are particularly swift at punishing foes who leave you openings.

name: Twin Riposte
summary: A clever parry with one weapon leaves your opponent open to an attack with the other weapon.

name: Brutal Finish
summary: Your final blow can make an impact even if it rebounds off a foe’s defenses.

name: Dashing Strike
summary: Springing away from one foe, you Strike at another.

name: Dueling Dance (Fighter)
summary: Using a free hand as pivot and balance, you both attack and defend with your weapon.

name: Flinging Shove
summary: Whether you’re shoving opponents with a shield or a large weapon, you’ve learned to push them even further.

name: Improved Dueling Riposte
summary: Your weapon whirls and darts, striking foes whenever the slightest opening or moment of weakness presents itself.

name: Incredible Ricochet
summary: After your first shot singles out your opponent’s position, you direct another that ricochets around obstacles and strikes unerringly.

name: Lunging Stance
summary: Your body coiled to strike, you can lash out at distant enemies.

name: Paragon's Guard
summary: Once you’ve had a moment to set your stance, you always have your shield ready without a thought.

name: Desperate Finisher
summary: You throw everything you have into one last, reckless press.

name: Determination
summary: Your training allows you to shrug off your foes’ spells and conditions when the need is dire.

name: Guiding Finish
summary: Using your weapon as a lever, you force your opponent to end up right where you want them.

name: Guiding Riposte
summary: By shifting your weight and angling your weapon, you guide your opponent to a more favorable position.

name: Improved Twin Riposte (Fighter)
summary: Your weapons are a blur, blocking and biting at your foes.

name: Opening Stance (Fighter)
summary: At the first sign of trouble, often before you consciously realize the danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought.

name: Two-Weapon Flurry
summary: Using the momentum of your prior attack, you lash out with both your weapons in a sudden frenzy.

name: Whirlwind Strike
summary: You lash out in a blur of motion, attacking all nearby adversaries.
source: Player Core pg. 150, Player Core 2 pg. 84

name: Graceful Poise
summary: With the right positioning, your off-hand weapon can strike like a scorpion’s stinger.

name: Improved Reflexive Shield
summary: Your shield can help save nearby allies.

name: Master of Many Styles
summary: You move fluidly between stances, using your mastery of combat to always adopt the best tactics.
source: Player Core pg. 150, Core Rulebook pg. 165, Player Core 2 pg. 126

name: Multishot Stance
summary: You lock yourself in a stable position so you can fire swiftly and accurately.

name: Overwhelming Blow
summary: You throw your weight into a powerful attack that leaves you vulnerable.

name: Twinned Defense (Fighter)
summary: You’re always ready to use your off-hand weapon to interfere with attacks against you.

name: Impossible Volley
summary: You fire a volley at all foes in an area.

name: Savage Critical
summary: The wounds you inflict are grievous.

name: Smash from the Air
summary: Your expertise enables you to knock away spells.

name: Boundless Reprisals
summary: With a sixth sense for the flow of combat, you can quickly react to any situation as required.

name: Ultimate Flexibility
summary: Your experience keeps you on your toes, helping you adopt complex strategies on the fly and face the most dangerous challenges.
source: Player Core pg. 151, Pathfinder #150: Broken Promises pg. 77

name: Weapon Supremacy
summary: Your skill with weapons bends the laws of reality, allowing you to continuously attack with speed that would normally require magical assistance.

name: Crossbow Ace
summary: Your deep understanding of the crossbow allows you to reload efficiently while moving yourself out of the line of return fire.

name: Hunted Shot
summary: You take two quick shots against the one you hunt.

name: Initiate Warden
summary: You’ve trained with one of the ranger sects known as wardens, who practice a specialized type of primal magic.

name: Monster Hunter
summary: You quickly assess your prey and apply what you know.

name: Twin Takedown
summary: You swiftly attack your hunted prey with each of your weapons, potentially combining their damage into a single devastating attack.

name: Animal Empathy (Ranger)
summary: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

name: Favored Terrain
summary: You have studied a specific terrain to overcome its challenges.

name: Hunter's Aim
summary: When you focus on aiming, your attack becomes particularly accurate.

name: Monster Warden
summary: You understand how to defend yourself and others against your prey.

name: Quick Draw
summary: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.
source: Player Core pg. 159, Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 112

name: Advanced Warden
summary: You unlock more powerful primal spells.

name: Companion's Cry
summary: You can urge your companion to do its utmost.

name: Disrupt Prey
summary: Make a melee Strike against your prey.

name: Far Shot
summary: Your experience in the field has taught you how to focus your aim at a distance, increasing your accuracy.

name: Favored Prey
summary: You have studied a specific type of wild creature and can hunt it more easily.

name: Running Reload
summary: You can reload your weapon on the move.
source: Player Core pg. 159, Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 112

name: Scout's Warning
summary: You visually or audibly warn your allies of danger, granting them each a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.

name: Additional Recollection
summary: You scan the battlefield quickly, remembering critical details about multiple opponents you face.

name: Masterful Warden
summary: Your mastery of warden magic increases.

name: Mature Animal Companion (Ranger)
summary: Your animal companion becomes a mature animal companion and gains additional capabilities (page 211).

name: Skirmish Strike
summary: Your feet and weapon move in tandem.

name: Snap Shot
summary: You can react with ranged weapons when a creature is in close quarters.

name: Swift Tracker
summary: Your keen eyes catch signs of passage even when you’re moving.

name: Deadly Aim
summary: You aim for your prey’s weak spots, making your shot more challenging but dealing more damage if you hit.

name: Hazard Finder
summary: You have an intuitive ability to sense hazards.

name: Terrain Master
summary: You are able to adapt to your surroundings in any natural terrain.

name: Warden's Boon
summary: You point out vulnerabilities present in your hunted prey, granting the benefits listed in Hunt Prey and your hunter’s edge to an ally until the end of their next turn.

name: Camouflage
summary: You alter your appearance to blend in to the wilderness.

name: Incredible Companion (Ranger)
summary: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

name: Master Monster Hunter
summary: You have a nearly encyclopedic knowledge of all creatures of the world.

name: Peerless Warden
summary: Your mastery of primal magic has given you access to the greatest secrets of warden magic.

name: Penetrating Shot
summary: You shoot clear through an intervening creature to hit your prey.

name: Warden's Step
summary: You can guide your allies to move quietly through the wilderness.

name: Distracting Shot
summary: The sheer power of your attacks, or the overwhelming number of them, leaves an enemy flustered.

name: Double Prey
summary: You can focus on two foes at once, hunting both of them down.

name: Second Sting
summary: You read your prey’s movements and transform them into openings, so failures with one weapon set up glancing blows with the other.

name: Side by Side (Ranger)
summary: You and your animal companion fight in tandem.

name: Warden's Focus
summary: Your connection with your surroundings deepens and expands, allowing you to draw in more of nature’s primal power as you focus.

name: Sense the Unseen
summary: When you look for foes, you can catch even the slightest cues, such as their minute movements or the shifting of air currents on your skin.
source: Player Core pg. 162, Player Core 2 pg. 112

name: Shared Prey
summary: Hunting as a duo, you and your ally both single out your prey.

name: Stealthy Companion
summary: You’ve trained your animal companion to blend in to its surroundings.

name: Warden's Guidance
summary: You convey your prey’s location to your allies with a series of careful words or gestures.

name: Greater Distracting Shot
summary: Even a single missile can throw off your enemy’s balance, and more powerful attacks leave it flustered for longer.

name: Improved Twin Riposte (Ranger)
summary: At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only to perform a Twin Riposte.

name: Legendary Monster Hunter
prerequisite: Legendary in Nature; Master Monster Hunter
summary: Your knowledge of monsters is so incredible that it reveals glaring flaws in your prey.

name: Specialized Companion (Ranger)
summary: Your animal companion continues to grow in power and ability, and it is now cunning enough to become specialized.

name: Warden’s Reload
summary: Your mastery of magic and weapons like the crossbow allow you to wield both with equal ease.

name: Impossible Flurry
summary: You forgo precision to attack at an impossible speed.

name: Manifold Edge
summary: You’ve learned to leverage every possible edge.

name: Masterful Companion
summary: Your animal companion shares your incredible hunting skills, allowing it to take down your shared prey with ease.

name: Perfect Shot
summary: After watching the motions of combat with incredible intensity and precision, you fire at your prey at the perfect moment to deliver maximum pain.

name: Shadow Hunter
summary: You blend in to your surroundings so well that others have trouble telling you apart from the terrain.

name: Legendary Shot
summary: You focus on your hunted prey, perceiving angles, air resistance, and every variable that would affect your ranged attack.

name: To the Ends of the Earth
summary: Your ability to track your prey has surpassed explanation, allowing you to trace your prey’s movements and predict its location with ease.

name: Triple Threat
summary: You can divide your attention three ways when hunting.

name: Ultimate Skirmisher
summary: You are so skilled at navigating the wild, your movement is completely unaffected by terrain.

name: Nimble Dodge
summary: You deftly dodge out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

name: Overextending Feint
summary: You goad a foe into overextending.

name: Plant Evidence
summary: You can put a single item you’re holding of light or negligible Bulk onto a person without them noticing by succeeding at a Thievery check against their Perception DC.

name: Trap Finder
summary: You have an intuitive sense that alerts you to the presence of traps.
source: Player Core pg. 169, Player Core 2 pg. 107

name: Tumble Behind (Rogue)
summary: You tumble under and behind your foe, your rapid movement letting you catch them off guard.

name: Twin Feint
summary: You use an attack with one weapon to distract your foe from a second attack coming at a different angle.

name: You're Next
trait: Emotion, Fear, Mental, Rogue, Swashbuckler, Visual
summary: After downing a foe, you menace another.
source: Player Core pg. 171, Player Core 2 pg. 165

name: Brutal Beating
summary: Your critical hits shakes your foes’ confidence.

name: Clever Gambit
summary: Your battle tactics are aided by assessing your foe’s capabilities and range.

name: Distracting Feint
summary: Your Feints are far more distracting than normal.

name: Mobility
summary: You move without leaving an opening.

name: Strong Arm
summary: When you Strike with a thrown weapon, the weapon’s range increment increases by 10 feet.

name: Unbalancing Blow
summary: Interweaving attacks, you unbalance your foes.

name: Underhanded Assault
summary: You capitalize on the distraction provided by an ally.

name: Dread Striker
summary: You capitalize on your enemies’ fear to slip past their defenses.

name: Head Stomp
summary: Make an unarmed melee Strike against a prone target.

name: Mug
summary: You make a quick attack and rob your foe in the process.

name: Poison Weapon
summary: You apply a contact poison or injury poison to the required weapon; if you have a free hand, you can Interact to draw a poison as part of this action.

name: Predictable!
summary: By observing an opponent, you can get a sense of their next move and prepare to counter or resist it.

name: Reactive Pursuit
summary: You keep pace with a retreating foe.

name: Sabotage
summary: You subtly damage others’ equipment.

name: Scoundrel's Surprise
summary: You drop your disguise at the right moment and surprise your target.

name: The Harder They Fall (Rogue)
summary: You make your foes fall painfully when you trip them.

name: Twin Distraction
summary: Your movements with two weapons are so swift and disorienting that they befuddle your opponent.

name: Analyze Weakness
summary: Your knowledge of a creature’s physiology helps you attack with pinpoint accuracy.

name: Anticipate Ambush
summary: You keep watch for any hidden creatures or dangerous sites, moving at half your travel Speed.

name: Far Throw
summary: When you Strike with a thrown weapon, you take only a –1 penalty for each additional range increment between you and the target, rather than a –2 penalty.

name: Gang Up
summary: You and your allies harry an opponent in concert.

name: Light Step
summary: You aren’t bothered by tricky footing.

name: Shove Down
summary: You leverage your weight to topple foes that you move.

name: Sly Disarm
summary: You can Disarm a creature through sleight of hand rather than brute force.

name: Twist The Knife
summary: After stabbing your opponent in a weak spot, you tear the wound open.

name: Watch Your Back
summary: You menace the target, stoking their fears and drawing their attention.

name: Bullseye
summary: You carefully take aim to avoid your foe’s concealment and cover.

name: Delay Trap
summary: You try to jam the workings of a trap to delay its effects.

name: Improved Poison Weapon
summary: You deliver poisons in ways that maximize their harmful effects.

name: Inspired Stratagem
summary: During your daily preparations, you can review stratagems for the day’s adventures with up to five allies.

name: Nimble Roll
summary: You throw yourself into a roll to escape imminent danger.

name: Opportune Backstab
summary: When your enemy is hit by your ally, you capitalize upon the distraction.

name: Predictive Purchase (Rogue)
summary: You somehow manage to have just the thing for the situation.

name: Ricochet Stance (Rogue)
summary: You adopt a stance to rebound your thrown weapons toward you.

name: Sidestep
summary: You deftly step out of the way of an attack, letting the blow continue.

name: Sly Striker
summary: Your attacks deal more damage, even against creatures that aren’t off-guard.

name: Swipe Souvenir
summary: When you wriggle free from an enemy’s grasp, you take something of theirs with you.

name: Tactical Entry
summary: You Stride.

name: Methodical Debilitations
summary: You strategically craft your debilitations to lessen or negate an enemy’s tactical advantages.

name: Nimble Strike
summary: You’re cunning enough to find an opening in an opponent’s attack.

name: Precise Debilitations
summary: You attack with great precision.

name: Sneak Adept
summary: It’s almost impossible to spot you.

name: Tactical Debilitations
summary: You learn new debilitations that grant you tactical advantages against your foes.

name: Vicious Debilitations
summary: The debilitations you dish out seriously impair your foes.

name: Bloody Debilitation
summary: Your attacks slice arteries and veins.

name: Critical Debilitation
summary: Your debilitations are especially effective on your most powerful attacks.

name: Fantastic Leap
summary: You launch yourself through the air at a foe.

name: Felling Shot
summary: Your ranged attacks can shoot an unprepared foe right out of the air.

name: Preparation
summary: You survey the battlefield, calculating the possibilities.

name: Reactive Interference
summary: Grabbing a sleeve, swiping with your weapon, or creating another obstruction, you reflexively foil an enemy’s response.

name: Ricochet Feint
summary: While in Ricochet Stance, you can bounce a thrown weapon off a foe to distract them.

name: Spring from the Shadows
summary: You leap from hiding and assail your target.

name: Defensive Roll
summary: Dropping into a roll to disperse the force of the blow, you can partially evade a lethal attack and stay conscious.

name: Instant Opening
summary: You distract your opponent with a few choice words or a rude gesture.

name: Leave An Opening
summary: When you hit hard enough, you leave an opening so your ally can jump in on the action.

name: Stay Down!
summary: You have ways of keeping your foes down.

name: Blank Slate
summary: Your deceptions confound even the most powerful magic that could spy on you.

name: Cloud Step
summary: Using fantastic acrobatic skill, you can walk for brief stretches across insubstantial surfaces.

name: Cognitive Loophole
summary: You can find a loophole in a mental effect to temporarily overcome it.

name: Dispelling Slice
summary: Your sneak attack slices through the threads binding magic to a target.

name: Perfect Distraction
summary: You use clever tactics to mislead your foes as you sneak away.

name: Reconstruct The Scene
summary: You spend 1 minute surveying a small location (such as a single room) to get an impression of events that occurred there in the last day.
source: Player Core pg. 177, Player Core 2 pg. 113

name: Swift Elusion
summary: Attempt an Acrobatics check against the foe’s Reflex DC.

name: Implausible Infiltration
summary: You find tiny imperfections and somehow fit yourself through them, possibly moving directly through the wall or floor.

name: Implausible Purchase (Rogue)
summary: You can use Prescient Planner even if you have already used it after purchasing goods, and you can Interact to draw the item as a single action instead of a 2-action activity.

name: Powerful Sneak
summary: You’ve learned to exploit your enemies’ openings.

name: Hidden Paragon
summary: When you slip out of sight, you disappear.

name: Impossible Striker
summary: Nothing can prevent you from making a sneak attack, even if your opponent can see every blow coming.

name: Reactive Distraction
summary: You reactively switch with your decoy to foil your foe.

name: Cackle
summary: Your patron’s power fills you with confidence, letting you sustain a magical working even as a quick burst of laughter leaves your lips.

name: Cauldron
summary: You can brew magic in your cauldron, creating useful magical concoctions.

name: Counterspell
summary: When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your magic to disrupt it.

name: Witch's Armaments
summary: Your patron’s power changes your body to ensure you are never defenseless.

name: Basic Lesson
summary: Your patron grants you a special lesson, revealing a hidden facet of its nature.

name: Conceal Spell
summary: Through sheer mental effort, you can simplify the incantations and gestures needed to spellcast, leaving them barely noticeable.

name: Familiar's Language
summary: You’ve learned to speak with your familiar and other creatures like it.

name: Rites of Convocation
summary: Your patron grants you the power to summon other creatures to aid you.

name: Sympathetic Strike
summary: You collect your patron’s magic into one of your witch armaments, causing them to shine with runes, light, or another signifier of your patron.

name: Ceremonial Knife
summary: You have prepared a special knife to direct energies when spellcasting.

name: Greater Lesson
summary: Your patron grants you greater knowledge.

name: Witch's Charge
summary: You forge a magical link with another creature, granting you awareness of that creature’s condition and creating a conduit for spellcasting.

name: Incredible Familiar
summary: Your familiar is imbued with even more magic than other familiars.

name: Murksight
summary: Your vision pierces through non-magical fog, mist, rain, and snow.

name: Spirit Familiar (Witch)
summary: Your familiar can subsume its body to become pure spirit.

name: Stitched Familiar
summary: Your familiar can shed its material form, becoming a mass of animated magic.

name: Witch’s Bottle
summary: You spend 10 minutes and 1 Focus Point brewing a special potion containing the power of one of your hexes that targets a creature.

name: Double, Double
summary: For each temporary oil or potion you brew during your daily preparations, you brew two copies of it.

name: Major Lesson
summary: Your patron grants you even greater secrets.

name: Witch's Communion
summary: You can keep watch over multiple charges.

name: Coven Spell
summary: You rhyme with your ally’s incantations or echo their movements, linking your magic to empower their spell in one of two ways.

name: Hex Focus
summary: Your patron’s teachings have allowed you to achieve a deeper focus.

name: Witch’s Broom
summary: A broom is the only steed you need to fly through the night sky.

name: Patron’s Presence
summary: Your patron can direct its attention through your familiar, and its mere presence becomes an ominous weight on the minds of other beings to distract them and blot out their magic.

name: Reflect Spell
summary: When you successfully use Counterspell to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you can turn that spell’s effect back on its caster.

name: Rites of Transfiguration
summary: You can adapt your patron’s power to transform other creatures into forms more befitting their behavior or your whims.

name: Siphon Power
summary: You draw upon the reservoir of your patron’s magic that resides within your familiar.

name: Patron’s Claim
summary: Your patron partially manifests itself through your familiar to claim a foe’s power for its own.

name: Split Hex
summary: You siphon some of the power from an offensive hex you cast to direct it at a second target as well.

name: Hex Master
summary: You embody the link to your patron so completely that you can cast your hexes in rapid succession.

name: Patron's Truth
summary: You have mastered the greatest secrets of your patron’s magic and learned a fundamental truth about your patron, even if their identity still remains a mystery.

name: Witch's Hut
summary: Your home is an animated structure that obeys your commands.

name: Familiar
summary: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting.
source: Player Core pg. 201, Player Core 2 pg. 152

name: Spellbook Prodigy
summary: You are particularly adept at learning spells to add to your spellbook.

name: Energy Ablation
summary: As you direct destructive energy at a foe, you can divert some of its power into a protective barrier that shields you from harm.

name: Nonlethal Spell
summary: You can alter offensive spells to be less deadly.

name: Bespell Strikes
summary: You siphon spell energy into one weapon you’re wielding, or into one of your unarmed attacks, such as a fist.
source: Player Core pg. 202, Player Core 2 pg. 139

name: Call Wizardly Tools
summary: You’re mystically connected to your wizardly tools, ensuring you can always find them when you’ve misplaced them.

name: Linked Focus
summary: You have linked your bonded item to the well of energy that powers your school spells.

name: Spell Protection Array
summary: You inscribe a circle of arcane runes that dampen enemies’ magic.

name: Convincing Illusion
summary: You use your deceptive skills to make your illusions seem even more real.

name: Explosive Arrival
summary: Your summoned creature appears in a detonation of arcane runes.

name: Irresistible Magic
summary: You’ve studied ways of overcoming the innate defenses against magic that dragons, otherworldly beings, and certain other powerful creatures have.

name: Split Slot
summary: You can prepare two spells in one slot, giving you the freedom to choose the spell when you cast it.

name: Advanced School Spell
summary: You gain access to the advanced teachings of your arcane institution, learning a powerful new school spell.

name: Bond Conservation
summary: By efficiently and carefully manipulating the arcane energies unleashed by your bonded item, you can conserve just enough power to cast another spell, though this second spell is slightly weaker.

name: Form Retention
summary: You have trained your mind and body to tolerate polymorph magic for longer periods of time, so long as you prepare for the change appropriately.

name: Knowledge is Power
summary: Your academic knowledge about a creature allows you to subtly alter your magic to defeat them.

name: Scroll Adept
summary: During your daily preparations, you can create two temporary scrolls containing arcane spells from your spellbook.

name: Clever Counterspell
summary: You creatively apply your prepared spells to Counterspell a much wider variety of your opponents’ magic.

name: Forcible Energy
summary: You perform complex manipulations to make the energy from your spells so powerful that your enemies remain vulnerable to it afterward.

name: Keen Magical Detection
summary: You sense magical dangers.

name: Magic Sense
trait: Arcane, Detection, Magus, Oracle, Sorcerer, Wizard
summary: You have a literal sixth sense for ambient magic in your vicinity.
source: Player Core pg. 204, Player Core 2 pg. 142

name: Bonded Focus
summary: Your connection to your bonded item increases your focus pool.

name: Secondary Detonation Array
summary: You divert some of your spell’s energy into an unstable runic array.

name: Superior Bond
summary: When you draw upon your bonded item, you can leave a bit of energy within it for later use.

name: Scintillating Spell
summary: Your spells become a radiant display of light and color.
source: Player Core pg. 204, Player Core 2 pg. 157

name: Spell Tinker
summary: You’ve learned to alter choices you make when casting spells on yourself.

name: Infinite Possibilities
summary: You can prepare a spell slot that exists in your mind as many different possibilities at once.

name: Reprepare Spell
summary: You’ve discovered how to reuse some of your spell slots over and over.

name: Second Thoughts
summary: When your target proves resilient to your magical deceptions, you can try them again on someone else.

name: Archwizard's Might
summary: You have mastered the greatest secrets of arcane magic.

name: Spell Combination
summary: You can merge spells, producing multiple effects with a single casting.

name: Spell Mastery
summary: You have mastered a handful of spells to such a degree that you can cast them even if you haven’t prepared them in advance.
source: Player Core pg. 205, Pathfinder #150: Broken Promises pg. 76

name: Spellshape Mastery
summary: Your mastery of magic ensures that you can alter your spells just as easily as you can cast them normally.
source: Player Core pg. 205, Player Core 2 pg. 163

name: Lie to Me
summary: Use Deception to detect lies

name: Magical Crafting
summary: Craft magic items

name: Magical Shorthand
prerequisite: Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
summary: Learn spells quickly and at a reduced cost

name: Monster Crafting
summary: Craft items using monster parts

name: Multilingual
summary: Learn two new languages

name: Natural Medicine
summary: Use Nature to Treat Wounds

name: Nimble Crawl
summary: Crawl at a faster rate

name: No Cause for Alarm
trait: Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, General, Linguistic, Mental, Skill
summary: Reduce creatures’ frightened condition values

name: Oddity Identification
summary: Recognize magic involving minds, fortune, or secrets

name: Pet
summary: You have a loyal pet

name: Pickpocket
summary: Steal or Palm an Object more effectively

name: Planar Survival
summary: Use Survival to Subsist on different planes

name: Powerful Leap
summary: Jump farther and higher

name: Prescient Consumable
summary: Procure consumable items with Prescient Planner

name: Prescient Planner
summary: Procure a piece of adventuring gear

name: Quick Climb
summary: Climb swiftly

name: Quick Coercion
summary: Coerce a creature quickly

name: Quick Disguise
summary: Set up a disguise in less time

name: Quick Identification
prerequisite: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion
summary: Identify Magic in 1 minute or less

name: Quick Jump
summary: High Jump or Long Jump as a single action

name: Quick Recognition
prerequisite: Master in Arcana, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion; Recognize Spell
summary: Identify spells as a free action

name: Quick Repair
summary: Repair items quickly

name: Quick Squeeze
summary: Move swiftly as you Squeeze

name: Quick Swim
summary: Swim quickly

name: Quick Unlock
summary: Pick a Lock with 1 action

name: Quiet Allies
summary: Roll a single Stealth check when sneaking with allies

name: Rapid Mantel
summary: Pull yourself onto ledges quickly

name: Read Lips
summary: Read the lips of people you can see

name: Recognize Spell
prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
summary: Identify a spell as a reaction as it’s being cast

name: Ride
summary: Automatically succeed at commanding your mount to move

name: Robust Recovery
summary: Greater benefits from Treat Disease and Treat Poison

name: Scare to Death
summary: Scare a target so much, they might die

name: Schooled in Secrets
summary: Gather Information about and Impersonate members  of secret societies

name: Seasoned
prerequisite: Trained in Alcohol Lore, Trained in Cooking Lore, or Trained in Crafting
summary: +1 to Craft food and drink, including elixirs and potions

name: Shameless Request
summary: Make Requests of others with lesser consequences

name: Shield Block
summary: Ward off a blow with your shield

name: Sign Language
summary: Learn sign languages

name: Skill Training
summary: Become trained in a skill

name: Slippery Secrets
summary: Evade attempts to uncover your true nature

name: Specialty Crafting
summary: Gain bonuses to Craft certain items

name: Steady Balance
summary: Maintain your balance in adverse conditions

name: Streetwise
summary: Use Society to Gather Information and Recall Knowledge

name: Student of the Canon
summary: More accurately recognize the tenets of your faith or philosophy

name: Subtle Theft
summary: Your thefts are harder to notice

name: Survey Wildlife
summary: Identify nearby creatures through signs and clues

name: Swift Sneak
summary: Move your full Speed while you Sneak

name: Terrain Expertise
summary: +1 to Survival checks in certain terrain

name: Terrain Stalker
summary: Sneak in certain terrain without attempting a check

name: Terrified Retreat
summary: Cause foes you Demoralize to flee

name: Titan Wrestler
summary: Disarm, Grapple, Shove, or Trip larger creatures

name: Toughness
summary: Increase your maximum HP and reduce the DCs of recovery checks

name: Train Animal
summary: Teach an animal a trick

name: Trick Magic Item
prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
summary: Activate a magic item you normally can’t activate

name: Underwater Marauder
summary: Fight more effectively underwater

name: Unified Theory
summary: Use Arcana for checks for all magical traditions

name: Unmistakable Lore
summary: Recall Knowledge about your Lore more effectively

name: Untrained Improvisation
summary: Become more adept at using untrained skills

name: Unusual Treatment
summary: Treat Wounds tends to additional conditions

name: Virtuosic Performer
summary: +1 with a certain type of performance

name: Wall Jump
summary: Jump off walls

name: Ward Medic
summary: Treat several patients at once

name: Wary Disarmament
summary: +2 to AC or saves against devices or traps while disarming

name: Weapon Proficiency
summary: Become trained in a weapon type

name: Undead Spotter
summary: Your studies of the undead have taught you tellale signs of a disguised undead creature.

name: Strategic Repose
summary: You've trained extensively in fighting the undead.

name: Read the Dust
summary: You watch the creature or hazard as it collapses, careful for any sign it may return.

name: This Time, Bring the Body
summary: Since your soul has experienced not only death but also rebirth, you can shift your physical body into the Ethereal Plane for brief intervals.
source: Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web pg. 81

name: Athamaru Lore
summary: You've immersed yourself in community learning, particularly around navigating the waters and tending to animals.

name: Athamaru Weapon Familiarity
summary: You wield weapons designed to work underwater with ease.

name: Community-Minded
summary: You are familiar with all the members of your community and their typical movements, and you have learned how to apply these patterns outside those circles.

name: Coral Symbiotes
summary: You've tended to your coral jewelry so well that you have formed a symbiotic relationship with it.

name: Elver Pet
summary: Athamarus have bonded with eels more closely than any other fish.

name: Emit Defensive Odor
summary: While athamarus' natural pheromones are typically used for communication, you have developed yours into a defense mechanism to ward off foes.

name: Ocean Wariness
summary: Stories about those who have mistreated your people in the past (particularly stories about alghollthu mind control) left you untrusting of those outside your community.

name: Pheromonal Message
summary: Your communicative pheromones are particularly well developed from years of living with other athamarus.

name: Coral Growth
summary: The difference between yourself and your coral symbiotes is nearly impossible to tell apart as your bodies are so intertwined.

name: Growing Eel Friend
summary: Your eel pet grows larger and stronger.

name: Noxious Odor
summary: You have developed your skill with your defensive pheromones and have concentrated them into a noxious form.

name: Riptide Mount
summary: After working with aquatic beasts of burden for years, you have learned how to easily mount and dismount them.

name: Skilled Swimmer
summary: You move through the water with ease, mastering your movements with years of practice.

name: Coral Detoxification
summary: The coral colony that you've tended has merged with your kidneys to add an additional layer of filtration.

name: Emissary Assistance
summary: As an emissary, you have assisted land-bound creatures in journeying underwater to visit your settlements.

name: Moray Eel Mount
summary: You have either trained a giant moray eel since its hatching or have tamed one in the wild.

name: Persistent Odor
summary: Your pheromones now linger on creatures.

name: Attuned Electroreceptors
summary: You grow specialized organs that allow you to detect even the faintest of heartbeats.

name: Coral Reserve
summary: Your coral symbiotes provide a store of energy that you can call upon when needed.

name: Rapid Pheromone Recovery
summary: Your supply of pheromones replenish very quickly.

name: Swift Eel Mount
summary: Your rapport with your eel lets you guide it to avoid dangers as it swims.

name: Coral Lifeline
summary: Your coral symbiotes have grown into your bloodstream and are now curled around your heart.

name: Moray Ambush
summary: Like the moray eels athamaru communities raise and train, you know how to quickly strike from hiding.

name: Offensive Odor
summary: You've mastered your defensive pheromones and have nearly complete control over them.

name: Awakened Animal Lore
summary: You have taken the time to learn about the process of awakening and the experiences of your fellow awakened animals.

name: Awakened Magic
summary: When you awakened, primal magic was released within you.

name: Fascinated by Society
summary: Just as some humanoids find themselves driven to study nature, you are obsessed with the artificial constructs of society and can't get enough.

name: Land Legs
summary: You are comfortable on land for a short time.

name: Learn by Watching
summary: Before your awakening, you watched humanoids performing some skill near you frequently.

name: Natural Senses
summary: You have retained your sharp animal senses even after awakening.

name: Sea Legs
prerequisite: You don't have a swim Speed.
summary: You are comfortable on the water for short bursts.

name: Take Flight
summary: Though it's not fully effective, much of your ability to fly has stayed with you.

name: Tooth and Claw
summary: You've become adept with your born weapons.

name: You're So Cute!
summary: You know how to put on the charm, doing playful tricks to win favor.

name: Fierce Grasp
summary: Once you get your hands on someone, it's hard for them to get away.

name: Late Awakener
summary: Whether due to a more gradual process or your animal and sapient sides being especially in conflict, your awakening was a little slower than most, but your eyes are now fully open and your abilities have returned.

name: Natural Ambassador
summary: You remember what it was like to speak easily with other animals, using old, familiar ways of communication to learn what they want and ask for favors in return.

name: Scurry!
summary: Your instincts to move to safety are strong.

name: Strong of Wing
summary: You can fly with a greater distance.

name: Urban Jungle
prerequisite: Fascinated by Society; Expert in Society or Expert in Survival
summary: Cities are just a new form of wilderness.

name: Wild Stride
summary: You can move quickly when using your preferred modes of travel.

name: Animal Summoner
summary: The connection between you and primal magic deepens.

name: Full Flight
summary: Your flight is unbound, as natural as it was before you were awakened.

name: Awaken Others
summary: You can awaken others just through contact and communication.

name: Digger
prerequisite: Climbing Animal heritage or Running Animal heritage
summary: You are used to building homes and defenses underground.

name: Sharpened Senses
summary: Your senses have become so sharp that you notice changes subconsciously.

name: Awakened Stride
summary: You blend your instinct and intellect to move so fast you seem to be a blur.

name: Fearsome Form
summary: A fearsome illusion covers you, evoking the terror of the most dangerous animals.

name: True Senses
summary: Your senses are so sharp they pierce through all illusions.

name: Centaur Lore
summary: You've learned how to nurture your environment and to care for your people.

name: Centaur Weapon Familiarity
summary: You've trained in the weapons favored by your people, becoming a skilled archer and jouster.

name: Practiced Brawn
summary: You're accustomed to long days filled with hard physical labor.

name: Skilled Herbalist
summary: You've been taught how to craft healing remedies with a variety of herbs and plants.

name: Steelhoof
summary: You've girded your hooves in steel or other reinforcements aimed to inflict maximum damage.

name: Accommodating Mount
summary: You've trained to serve as a mount, if only for your most trusted allies.

name: Distant Archer
summary: You've trained to harry your foes from great distances, using your swiftness to maintain distance and keen eyesight to stay on target.

name: Proud Mentor
summary: You enjoy mentoring others and take pride in your students' accomplishments.

name: Speaker in Training
prerequisite: Budding Speaker Centaur heritage or the ability to cast a divine or primal spell
summary: You've begun your training as a Speaker.

name: Herbal Forager
summary: Your skill with herbs has improved.

name: Fierce Competitor
summary: You challenge a single ally to a physical competition.

name: Mentor of Legends
summary: You're an extraordinary teacher, capable of inspiring your students to amazing feats of athletics and ingenuity.

name: Ride On
summary: Even when tired, you refuse to give up, pushing yourself to extreme feats of endurance.

name: Speaker's Defense
prerequisite: Budding Speaker Centaur heritage or Speaker in Training
summary: As a Speaker, you've forged a deep bond with powerful spirits who you can urge to rise up to defend you and your people.

name: Stubborn Defiance
summary: You're brave and stubborn and refuse to back down or bow to the wishes of another.

name: Camoflage Coat
summary: You've learned to use your natural camouflage to your advantage, enhancing your ability to blend with your surroundings through careful movements and additional markings or attire.

name: Incredible Sprint
summary: You push yourself, unleashing a burst of sudden speed.

name: Miraculous Medic
