summary: Your ability to heal others is miraculous enough to bring people back from near-death.

name: Trample (Centaur)
summary: You've trained to stampede right over smaller foes without causing yourself any harm.

name: Merge with the Source
prerequisite: Speaker in Training or Budding Speaker Centaur heritage
summary: You're among the most powerful of Speakers and can adopt the form of the spirits you entreat with.

name: Starshot Arrow
summary: The greatest centaurs need not wait until their stories are over to touch the stars in the sky.

name: Merfolk Lore
summary: You paid close attention to your lessons in school.

name: Merfolk Weapon Familiarity
summary: You were taught the most effective weapons of the sea.

name: Ocean's Bite
prerequisite: Abyssal Merfolk heritage or Carcharodon Merfolk heritage
summary: Your jaws open wider than a humanoid mouth should, showing off multiple rows of serrated shark teeth or a viperfish-like nest of needles.

name: Seasong
summary: Sound carries far beneath the waves, and your people have strong, enchanting voices.

name: Swimmer's Guidance
summary: You're always ready to help those floundering in the water.

name: Wave Speaker
summary: Being part fish yourself, you can speak the language of the sea.

name: Apprentice Sea Witch
summary: You're familiar with the basic spells that most educated merfolk know.

name: Fishblooded
summary: There's nothing beneath the waves that can slow you down.

name: Healing Flesh
summary: Some legends claim that the flesh of a merfolk, if consumed, can grant health, longevity, and even immortality.

name: Strong Tail
summary: From sheer necessity, you've gotten surprisingly good at moving around on land.

name: Ill Tide
summary: Some land dwellers say that merfolk are bad luck.

name: Shore Gift
summary: Using old magic, you slip off your tail like an item of clothing and walk on two feet, resembling a humanoid ancestry, usually human but possibly elf, half-elf, or something stranger.

name: Siren Song
summary: You can beguile and bewitch with your song.

name: Tears of Pearl
trait: Emotion, Manipulate, Mental, Merfolk, Primal, Visual
summary: You weep, and your tears become gleaming pearls as they fall to the ground, so beautiful others can't help but grab at them.

name: Pummeling Whirlpool
summary: You draw water from the environs, swirling it into a rough torrent around you to punish your foes.

name: Sea Witch
summary: You've studied the waves, and they obey your will as extensions of your own fin.

name: Doom of Sailors
trait: Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, Fear, Mental, Merfolk, Primal
summary: Sailors know that the sight of an angry merfolk might well mean that they never see the shore again.

name: Kraken's Call
summary: You call forth the sleeping krakens of the deep to crush your enemies.

name: Artisanal Crafter
summary: Like many minotaurs, you take pride in creating items made from stone or metal.

name: Cattle Speech
summary: You can understand the lowing of cattle and similar animals as its own language.

name: Eye for Masonry
summary: Your familiarity with architecture allows you to easily spot subtle stonework.

name: Friendly Nudge
summary: You don't always have time to wait for your allies to make room, so it's best to politely move them yourself.

name: Keen Nose
summary: Accustomed to the foul air of underground tunnels, your sense of smell is sharpened, and noxious scents are less offensive.

name: Minotaur Lore
summary: You were raised in a minotaur enclave or have spent a great deal of time studying your culture and ancestry.

name: Minotaur Weapon Familiarity
summary: Your elders taught you to wield weapons that can split skulls and smash through shields.

name: Pantheon Magic
summary: The touch of divine meddling still runs through you, whether you want it or not.

name: Alarming Disappearance
summary: Your ability to move unseen is startling for one your size, causing panic among your enemies.

name: Beast of Burden
summary: Your broad frame can allow you to carry weights that immobilize smaller creatures.

name: Labyrinthine Echoes
summary: You can make your voice reverberate off any surface.

name: Natural Orienteering
summary: There are few twisting paths that can disorient you.

name: Puzzle Solver
summary: You have a natural affinity for problem-solving and the unknown.

name: Stretching Reach
summary: You can leverage your size and muscle to extend your reach and attack more distant foes.

name: Friendly Fling
summary: You can scoop up your friends with your horns to hurl them across the battlefield.

name: Goring Charge
summary: Driven by the momentum of your thundering steps and powerful mass, your horns can pierce your foes.

name: Siphon Torment
summary: Your progenitors suffered greatly at the hands of a curse, a fate you willingly take upon yourself rather than let fall upon others.

name: Stone Passage
summary: Calling upon your knowledge of stonework and inherent magic, you momentarily make a section of stone insubstantial, allowing you to pass through.

name: Phantom Charm
summary: You can harness the spiritual connection in your blood, allowing you to shift the negative threads of fate.

name: Shift the Little Ones
summary: With your large size, you need to be careful around your smaller friends.

name: Threatening Pursuit
prerequisite: Expert in Intimidation; Expert in Stealth
summary: You emit a terrifying growl and snort, stamping your hooves for all to hear so that they know that you hunt them.

name: Begin Stampede
summary: The sight of you charging forward into battle emboldens your allies to follow.

name: Into the Labyrinth
summary: Calling on your connection to minotaurs of myth, you shunt an enemy into a complex maze full of puzzles of your own devising.

name: Sequestered Spell
summary: You consumed so much of a type of magic as a larva that you can now cast it purely on instinct.

name: Small Speak
summary: You understand the languages of most small insects and can speak to them.

name: Surki Lore
summary: Either through the tales of elders in your settlement or through the messages thumped by those who oversaw your generation dig, you hold the knowledge of many surkis before you.

name: Surki Weapon Familiarity
summary: Surki weapons favor utility and practicality over grace and brutality.

name: Vestigial Magicsense
summary: While most surkis' ability to taste magic fades once they metamorphose into their adult form—replaced by keener darkvision—you've retained some of this sense.

name: Chemical Trail
summary: You can leave a faint chemical trail as you move and can use the chemical trails of other surkis to navigate.

name: Secondary Adaptation
summary: You've continued to adapt to the rigors of your environment by continuing your metamorphosis, even as an adult.

name: Tunnel Roll
summary: You can more easily navigate underground tunnels by rolling up into a ball.

name: Consume Magic
summary: You consume the magic of an incoming spell or effect to protect your allies, though you might give yourself indigestion.

name: Grand Metamorphosis
summary: One of your nodes has adapted into a new magic-emitting organ.

name: Nodal Healing
summary: You can induce wound repair by circulating magic throughout your body.

name: Generation Digger
summary: You're so adept at burrowing through the earth that you don't even need tools; in fact, you just might be trusted to lead the latest generation dig.

name: Magitaxis
summary: You move reflexively toward the source of magic you most consumed as a larva.

name: Unlimited Pluripotency
summary: Within all surkis is the capacity to be whatever they need to be, and you can tap into that capacity even now.

name: Nodal Regeneration
summary: Your body processes magic so effectively that you can induce true regeneration, replacing limbs and restoring organs.

name: Brutal Crush
summary: You've learned how to cloud your foes' minds with the brutal impact of your repeated attacks.

name: Creature Comforts
summary: You've found comfort in the forms of other creatures, insulating yourself from feelings of fear.

name: Rip and Tear
summary: You've learned to debilitate your enemies in the same way a hunter tears at their prey.

name: Misty Transformation
summary: Wild mists cover your form.

name: Toppling Transformation
summary: You use your body's expansion as leverage to displace a nearby creature.

name: Defensive Dismissal
summary: You change your form as a means of evading a potentially fatal blow.

name: Explosive Metamorphosis
summary: You use additional primal energy to transform, creating a burst of elemental energy to complement your transformation.

name: Cleansing Transformation
summary: You learn to cleanse bodily toxins alongside the transformations of your shape-changing magic.

name: Towering Transformation
trait: Barbarian, Druid, Emotion, Fear, Mental, Rage, Visual
summary: The physical growth of your transformation is a spectacle that shakes foes to their core.

name: Too Much to Swallow
summary: While you might be small enough to grab normally, you can change that at a moment's notice.

name: Natural Conduit
summary: You can use an animal as a conduit for your magic.

name: Animal Strength
summary: You tap into the primal strength of your _animal feature_.

name: Nature Prowler
summary: When you begin your turn hidden or unnoticed by your hunted prey, that creature is off-guard to you until the end of your turn.

name: Scatter Swarm
summary: Your patron reaches through your familiar to magically disperse a group of smaller threats.

name: Portents of the Haruspex
summary: Although the divinations of a haruspex traditionally require organs and lengthy interpretation, you've learned how to glimpse the future in a more simple fashion by reading creatures' wounds.

name: Wild Witch's Armaments
summary: Your patron's power continues to enhance your natural offensive capabilities.

name: Zoophonic Communication
summary: Your studies have expanded your ability to parley and negotiate into the animal realm.

name: Bestial Snarling
summary: You can convey the subtle menace of a low growl or predatory rumble.

name: Zoophonic Composition
summary: When the inspiration strikes, you can weave messages for animals into your compositions.

name: Ears of the Forest
summary: Beyond relying on your own senses, you keep an ear open for nearby creatures for help in exploring your surroundings.

name: Songbird's Call
summary: You call to the wilds with the voice of a songbird, thereby summoning a cloud of its kin.

name: Chorus Companion
summary: Animals can be musical partners as much as the subjects or audience.

name: Musical Summons
summary: Your studies have given you a deeper understanding of animals and beasts, allowing you to call them to your side as you cast your spell.

name: Pack Performance
summary: When you and animals sing together, your words ring even brighter and bolder, cutting through disruptions.

name: Spirit of the Beast
summary: You imbue your companion with the aspect of another animal.

name: Bestial Protection
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion that’s Large or larger
summary: Your companion's mere presence is enough to rattle creatures that fall under its shadow.

name: Nature's Precision
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with an agile or finesse unarmed attack
summary: Your companions pick at an enemy's weak points.

name: Tenacious Endurance
summary: You encourage your companion to refuse to yield, against even the mightiest of foes.

name: Pack Movement
summary: You and your companion move to take down a common enemy.

name: Ferocious Charge
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with an antlers, head, or horn unarmed attack
summary: You've taught your companions to charge directly at an enemy.

name: Running Kick
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a foot, hoof, or talon unarmed attack
summary: Your companion weaves in and out of combat, swiftly attacking before getting to a better position.

name: Sinking Jaws
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a jaws or fangs unarmed attack
summary: Like how a constrictor wraps itself around its next meal, your companion tightens its teeth around its constrained prey to squeeze the life out of it.

name: Sweeping Tail
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a tail unarmed attack
summary: Your companion swings its tail powerfully.

name: Vicious Rend
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a claw, fist, pincer, or talon unarmed attack
summary: Your companion sinks its claws and rips.

name: Billowing Wings
prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with wings
summary: You've trained your winged companions to gather air in their wings, whipping up a concentrated gust of wind at opponents, potentially staggering them.

name: Heightened Instincts
summary: You've worked to sharpen your companions' instincts to supernatural levels.

name: Pack Takedown
summary: The pack is strongest when it acts as one, and like a group of hungry wolves, you work together to bring down a single target.

name: Clawdancer Dedication
prerequisite: permanent unarmed claw or talon attack (such as one granted by your ancestry or a graft)
summary: You've practiced the art of fighting with your natural claws, hooking them into prey and thrashing at targets surrounding you.

name: Claw Snag
summary: You hook into the target, pulling yourself forward and rending flesh.

name: Dashing Pounce
summary: With a burst of speed, you leap into the air, slashing with your hands.

name: Talon Sweep
summary: Your long clawed legs let you catch enemies to either side.

name: Abscission Shards
summary: You twist your claw, breaking off a piece in your target.

name: Wheeling Grab
summary: You cartwheel on your claws, dancing over your foes.

name: Hindquarter Kick
summary: You hold your prey's defensive limbs in place with your claws while delivering a swift kick to their unprotected sides.

name: Spinning Stand
summary: You flare your legs around, using the momentum to both lash out and return to a standing position.

name: Tear Tendons
summary: You rake into your opponent with two claws, cutting into their muscle and depriving them of needed strength.

name: Feline Dance
summary: You fluidly move between stances in the process of dodging.

name: Hunting Snag
summary: Learning from nature's predators has taught you how to keep your prey close.

name: Springboard
summary: You use the power of your leg lashing out to spring off your foe and leap toward another, your talon descending in a crescent.

name: Claw and Talon Flow
summary: You fluidly shift between your two stances.

name: Precise Hooks
summary: Your body is a varied and deadly weapon.

name: Storm of Claws
summary: You lash out with your clawed limbs like a beast that has fallen upon its first meal in days, then back off to see your handiwork.

name: Ostilli Host Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Arcana or Trained in Nature
summary: You've bonded with an attached symbiote known as an ostilli.

name: Soothing Pulse
summary:
Your ostilli can use its stored magic to help staunch your wounds, granting you the Administer Ambient Magic action.

 **Administer Ambient Magic** <actions string="Two Actions" /> (healing) **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** Your ostilli pulses a calm lavender color as it converts stored magic into a curative balm.

name: Tactile Magic Feedback
summary: Your ostilli can sense nearby spellcasters.

name: Versatile Mutation
summary: Your ostilli's darts can deal different types of damage.

name: Cloaking Pulse
summary:
Your ostilli can emit illusion magic to mask your position, granting you the Drape Ambient Magic action.

 **Drape Ambient Magic** <actions string="Single Action" /> (illusion) **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** Your ostilli turns clear as it converts its stored magic into a bubble of refracting light around you.

name: Deflecting Pulse
summary:
Your ostilli can use its stored magic to protect you from other magic, granting you the Turn Aside Ambient Magic action.

 **Turn Aside Ambient Magic** <actions string="Single Action" /> (concentrate) Your ostilli glows a faint yellow as it establishes a barrier.

name: Propulsive Mutation
summary: Your ostilli can fire its dart farther.

name: Chaining Mutation
summary: The dart fired by your ostilli can ricochet to strike another creature.

name: Deadly Mutation
summary: The dart fired by your ostilli is more dangerous.

name: Spell Swallow
summary:
Your ostilli has grown strong enough to completely consume a spell cast at you, granting you the Devour Ambient Magic action.

 **Devour Ambient Magic** <actions string="Reaction" /> (concentrate) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A creature Casts a Spell with you as the only target; **Effect** Your ostilli radiates cyan light as its tentacle-like filters attempt to consume the magical effect.

name: Spraying Mutation
summary: Your ostilli can launch a multitude of darts at once over a short distance.

name: Cellular Reconstruction
summary: Your ostilli takes control of your nervous system and kicks your cellular functions into overdrive when you're about to die.

name: Swarmkeeper Dedication
summary: Your body has become a symbiotic hive for a swarm of crawling insects.

name: Aphet Flash
summary: Your swarm can emit a bright flash, much like aphet beetles, a genus of flash beetles once used by Osirian miners as sources of light.

name: Pyre Ant Sting
summary: Your swarm's stings burn with agonizing pain, much like that caused by the bright red pyre ants that make their tunnels within the parched sands of deserts like Qadira.

name: Weaver's Web
summary: Your swarm can spin dense webs much like those left by stone-gray weaver spiders under eaves and in derelict city buildings, especially along the coasts of Varisia.

name: Distracting Bites
summary: You know how to take advantage of those your swarm has attacked.

name: Mobile Swarm
summary: The clicking of fast-moving legs accompanies your swarm in all kinds of environments.

name: Carried with the Swarm
summary: When your swarm is sharing your space and Strides, you can choose to have your swarm carry you with it.

name: Sportlebore Choke
summary: Like nefarious sportlebores, a species of insect that plague adventurers by hiding in their rations as counterfeit food, your swarm can crawl down throats.

name: Veil of Bugs
summary: Your swarm is dense, blotting out vision.

name: Buzzing Death Cicadas
summary: Your swarm takes on characteristics of the death cicadas of the Mana Wastes, whose distinctive buzz is said to be a herald of imminent demise.

name: Expanded Swarm
summary: Your hive has grown to the point where it is difficult to keep your swarm contained within your body.

name: Thlipit Contestant Dedication
prerequisite: You have a long prehensile tongue or a tail. At the GM’s discretion, similar flexible appendages, such as tentacles, can be used to qualify instead.
summary: Grueling practice has strengthened your tongue or tail to the point where it's become a formidable weapon.

name: Fly Swat
summary: You've learned the secret of swatting away annoying pests and occasionally getting an easy meal out of it.

name: Lassoing Lash
prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; Trained in Athletics
summary: You quickly wrap your lash around an opponent and pull them toward you.

name: Powerful Lash
summary: You've learned to swing your lash ever faster and in wider arcs.

name: Snap Falling Fruit
summary: Your lash whips around to intercept projectiles.

name: Levered Swing
prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; Master in Athletics
summary: You can wrap your lash around a tree branch or railing, then pull yourself where you need to go.

name: Slurp Up
prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; unarmed attack with your tongue
summary: Your tongue darts out in search of refreshment.

name: Tail Guard
prerequisite: Thlipit Contestant Dedication; unarmed attack with your tail
summary: Enemies who attempt to stab you in the back will be unhappy to find your lashing tail on guard.

name: Slingshot Maneuver
summary: You spin your lash out for your ally to grab on to, giving them a boost to their movement.

name: Reflexive Grapple
summary: You've honed your reflexes so well that your lash can begin closing around a target as soon as it makes contact.

name: Spinning Release
summary: You wind your lash around your opponent, then spin them rapidly to discombobulate them.

name: Whirling Clobber
summary: After you've grasped a creature with your lash, you swing them around like a whirling hammer, smashing them into all nearby enemies.

name: Werecreature Dedication
summary: You're a werecreature, able to shift between your humanoid shape, an animal shape, and a monstrous hybrid of the two.

name: Animal Fleetness
summary: You're adept at using your animal shape's natural means of locomotion.

name: Beastkin Resilience
summary: You've regained beastkin protections after becoming a full werecreature.

name: Feral Senses
summary: The eyes and noses of animals are naturally sharper than most humanoids.

name: Antler Rush
summary: Stride twice.

name: Bear Hug
summary: You hug your opponent.

name: Death Roll
summary: You corkscrew your body, twisting your victim.

name: Echolocation
summary: When you take the Seek action, you can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Fearful Symmetry
summary: You attack with a feline grace as captivatingly beautiful as it is deadly.

name: Feeding Frenzy
summary: Your serrated teeth rip and tear at your prey.

name: Pack Attack
summary: You have mastered techniques for hunting alongside your pack.

name: Plague Rat
summary: Your bites carry a cursed infection.

name: Rushing Boar
summary: You embrace the pain of the triggering attack, allowing it to drive you into a violent rush.

name: Cornered Animal
summary: You become more dangerous when surrounded by enemies.

name: Feral Mending
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; you were not afflicted with the curse of the werecreature
summary: You can heal your wounds while reshaping your flesh.

name: Terrifying Transformation
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; you were afflicted with the curse of the werecreature
summary: Your flesh tears and warps as you transform.

name: You Don't Smell Right
summary: You can sniff out fellow werecreatures and master impersonators alike.

name: Dire Growth
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape is not Small
summary: You transform into a primal reflection of your animal shape.

name: Feral Lunge
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants a fangs or jaws unarmed attack
summary: You spring on an unsuspecting opponent, tearing at them with your teeth.

name: Feral Scramble
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants a claw unarmed attack
summary: Sinking your claws in, you propel yourself at shocking speed.

name: Feral Toss
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants an antler, horn, or tusk unarmed attack
summary: You hurl foes away with a shake of your head.

name: Touch of Lunacy
summary: In moments of viciousness, your curse can partially infect your prey.

name: Pouncing Transformation
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a land Speed only
summary: By transforming as you move, you attack from odd angles.

name: Shared Tide
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a swim Speed
summary: You Swim up to twice the normal distance.

name: Undying Beast
summary: You can be injured by non-silver sources but recover with staggering speed.

name: Wings of the Moon
prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a fly Speed
summary: You can fly long distances without breaks.

name: Scarred Hide
summary: Your hide is an impenetrable mass of scars, accrued over countless bloody conflicts.

name: Rapid Hybridization
summary: When danger threatens, your instincts kick in, and you can assume a different shape at a moment's notice.

name: Force of Nature
summary: You're a nigh-unstoppable killing machine, with only silver able to quell your rampage.

name: Wild Mimic Dedication
summary: Fighting in the wilds has honed your understanding of the unique abilities many creatures have.

name: Ferocity Mimicry
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have encountered a creature who has kept fighting or dealt damage after being reduced to 0 Hit Points (such as via death throes or Ferocity) or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat
summary: You have trained yourself to continue fighting even when your body is screaming for you to stop.

name: Rend Mimicry
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use Rend or have identified a creature that has Rend in combat
summary: Taking advantage of the brutal efficiency of hacking away at a target with two slashing attacks, you've mastered the art of punishing a foe caught between your slices.

name: Electrogenesis
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature deal electricity damage with an unarmed Strike or have identified a creature capable of dealing electricity damage with an unarmed Strike in combat
summary: Some animals and beasts have electric organs in their body that they can use to jolt their prey.

name: Primal Proportions
summary: You can mimic the sheer mass of the largest beasts.

name: Wild Speech
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; Animal Empathy (Ranger) or the ability to speak with a type of animal
summary: Your connection to the denizens of the wilds grows ever stronger, and you find yourself able to speak with animals like you would in your native tongue.

name: Environmental Adaptability
summary: Having experienced the harshest environs that nature has to offer, your body is able to adapt to intense heat and cold.

name: Petrifying Gaze Mimicry
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have attempted a saving throw against a creature’s petrifying gaze or a similar ability or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat
summary: Either by witnessing or surviving the petrifying stare of a medusa or similar creature, you have learned to petrify those you lock eyes with.

name: Trample Mimicry
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use Trample or have identified a creature with Trample in combat
summary: You Stride up to double your speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, trampling each creature whose space you enter.

name: Roar Mimicry
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have been targeted by a creature’s auditory ability that effects an area or have identified a creature with an auditory ability that effects an area
summary: You unleash a roar so loud that it's felt as deeply as it's heard.

name: Pounce Mimicry
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use an ability that lets them Stride and Strike as a single action (such as Pounce) or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat
summary: You have mastered the art of stalking your prey and striking when they are most vulnerable.

name: Emergency Regeneration
prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have deactivated a creature’s regeneration for at least 1 round or have identified a creature with regeneration in combat
summary: You have battled against foes whose bodies naturally regenerate, and while yours doesn't do so all the time, it can happen in a pinch.

name: Winged Warrior Dedication
prerequisite: you have permanent wings (such as from an ancestry or graft)
summary: Through rigorous training, you have strengthened your wings, granting you enough thrust to gain additional altitude.

name: Battering Wings
summary: Though not powerful enough for flight, your wings can deliver a thrashing to anyone who gets close.

name: Gusting Spell
summary: You manipulate the currents of your spell's energy, allowing you to gracefully glide with your wings.

name: Wing Bounce
summary: You rush forward, flapping your wings for a bit of lift, and can use that momentum to knock down a foe.

name: Sunbird Glare
summary: By keeping your feathers clean and sleek, you can catch the light across your wings to create a startling glare in the eyes of a creature within 20 feet.

name: Feathered Flechettes
summary: Unfurling your wings in a quick snap, you send feathers scattering in all directions.

name: Pluck From the Sky
summary: The skies are your rightful place, and you will not suffer another to occupy them.

name: Wing Shove
summary: You spread your wings wide, pushing foes away from you.

name: Falcon Swoop
summary: Like the fastest of predatory birds, you soar toward your prey at great speeds.

name: Redirecting Draft
summary: You flap your wings to blow arrows off course.

name: Smooth Hover
summary: You remain airborne through sheer effort.

name: Thunderous Landing
summary: You hurl away enemies with the force of your landing.

name: Bombing Run
summary: Using your elevation and speed to your advantage, you deliver aerial payloads with greater force.

name: Cratering Drop
summary: You follow up your enemy's fall, driving you both to the earth in a meteoric descent.

name: Sonic Strafe
summary: You can now achieve such flight speeds that your passage splits the very air.

name: Graft Technician
summary: You can create and implant grafts.

name: Cat Nap
summary: You can regain your energy quickly with a brief nap.

name: Cat's Luck
summary: You instinctively twist away from danger.

name: Catfolk Dance
summary: You have a habit of always being in the way when other creatures attempt to move.

name: Catfolk Lore
summary: Growing up among catfolk has taught you the traditional values of freedom, stewardship, and quick reactions to trouble.

name: Catfolk Weapon Familiarity
summary: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the catfolk trait.

name: Saber Teeth
summary: You have long fangs, natural or augmented.

name: Well-Met Traveler
summary: You naturally adopt a pleasant and affable demeanor when meeting others.

name: Climbing Claws
summary: You can extend your claws to aid you in climbing.

name: Graceful Guidance
summary: You can demonstrate how to quickly twist out of the way of dangerous effects.

name: Light Paws
summary: You can balance on your toes to step carefully over obstructions.

name: Lucky Break
summary: You are luckier even than most catfolk.

name: Pride Hunter
summary: You avoid the attention of creatures focused on your allies.

name: Springing Leaper
summary: Your powerful legs allow you to make sudden and dramatic leaps.

name: Well-Groomed
summary: You are fastidious about keeping clean.

name: Aggravating Scratch
summary: Your claws carry an irritant that is harmless to you but can be damaging to others.

name: Evade Doom
summary: You can elude supernatural disaster.

name: Luck of the Clowder
summary: When you use Cat's Luck to reroll, any creatures you choose within 10 feet who also just failed against the same effect (such as a single spell) can also reroll their saving throws and use the better result.

name: Predator's Growl
summary: You give a throaty growl to attempt to Demoralize a creature you just found.

name: Silent Step
summary: You Step, then Hide or Sneak.

name: Wary Skulker
summary: You can perform the Scout exploration activity at the same time as the Avoid Notice exploration activity.

name: Black Cat Curse
summary: You hiss a spiteful curse.

name: Caterwaul
summary: You give a daring yowl, calling your companion back from the brink of unconsciousness.

name: Elude Trouble
summary: Stride up to your Speed.

name: Reliable Luck
summary: You survive danger with surprising regularity.

name: Ten Lives
summary: When your character would die, you can attempt a DC 17 flat check.

name: Alchemical Scholar
summary: You gain the Alchemical Crafting feat.

name: Cantorian Reinforcement
summary: The life energy that helped create the first hobgoblins is particularly potent in you, protecting you from ongoing maladies.

name: Hobgoblin Lore
summary: You've studied traditional hobgoblin exercises and fieldcraft, all of which have a militaristic bent.

name: Hobgoblin Weapon Familiarity
summary: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the hobgoblin trait.

name: Leech-Clip
summary: You are trained to capture deserters, or “leeches.” Make a melee Strike with weapon from the flail group.

name: Remorseless Lash
summary: You're skilled at beating an enemy when their morale is already breaking.

name: Sneaky
summary: Stealth is an important tool in your arsenal.

name: Stone Face
summary: You've mastered the art of composure, even in the face of fear.

name: Vigorous Health
summary: You can withstand blood loss startlingly well.

name: Agonizing Rebuke
summary: When you terrorize your enemies, you also cause them painful mental distress.

name: Expert Drill Sergeant
summary: While exploring, when you are leading and allies are Following the Expert, instead of granting a +2 circumstance bonus in the applicable skill, you grant a +3 circumstance bonus if you're an expert and a +4 circumstance bonus if you're a master.

name: Recognize Ambush
summary: Your combat training has honed you to be ready for an attack at all times.

name: Runtsage
summary: Unlike most of your kind, who dismiss goblins as embarrassments or expendable annoyances, you have studied the methodology behind their irresponsible and incomprehensible actions.

name: Cantorian Rejuvenation
summary: The life-giving energy that flows in your blood revitalizes you.

name: Fell Rider
summary: You have trained with your animal companion to become a terrifying juggernaut on the battlefield.

name: Pride in Arms
summary: With a shout of triumph, you grant inspiration to an ally fight on.

name: Squad Tactics
summary: You are adept at working with your allies to surround an enemy.

name: Can't Fall Here
summary: You physically help an ally remain standing and encourage them to push through their pain against dire odds.

name: War Conditioning
summary: You have extensive training in remote environments, allowing you to move through these areas easily.

name: Cantorian Restoration
summary: The energy that flows in your blood can save a life in the direst of times.

name: Rallying Cry
summary: You call out to your allies and push them to give their all in combat.

name: Ask the Bones
summary: You keep the bone of an ancestor or a friend to call upon for advice.

name: Crunch
summary: Your jaws can crush bone and bite through armor.

name: Hyena Familiar
summary: Hyenas serve kholo as pets and trackers.

name: Kholo Lore
summary: You paid close attention to the senior hunters in your clan to learn their tricks.

name: Kholo Weapon Familiarity
summary: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the kholo trait.

name: Pack Hunter
summary: You were taught how to hunt as part of a pack.

name: Sensitive Nose
summary: Your large black nose isn't just for show.

name: Absorb Strength
summary: You consume a piece of your enemy, absorbing their strength.

name: Distant Cackle
summary: It takes a very brave person to enter the laughter-haunted forest where you dwell.

name: Pack Stalker
summary: Ambushes are an honored kholo tradition.

name: Rabid Sprint
summary: You run on all fours as fast as you can.

name: Affliction Resistance
summary: Your diet has strengthened you against diseases and poisons.

name: Left-hand Blood
summary: It's said that the flesh of the right side of a hyena can heal diseases, but that the flesh of the left side is deadly and poisonous.

name: Right-hand Blood
summary: It's said that the flesh of the right side of a hyena can heal diseases, but that the flesh of the left side is deadly and poisonous.

name: Ambush Hunter
summary: You are always searching for the perfect opportunity to ambush your enemies.

name: Breath Like Honey
summary: You smell of honey and savory things.

name: Grandmother's Wisdom
summary: You carry the bones of your ancestors with you, and you can ask them for counsel.

name: Laughing Kholo
summary: Your sinister giggle is a sound of warning and threat.

name: Ancestor's Rage
summary: You transform into an enormous, otherworldly hyena.

name: Bonekeeper's Bane
summary: Whenever an enemy starts its turn adjacent to you, it must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is highest.

name: First to Strike, First to Fall
summary: Whenever you successfully Strike a creature that has not acted in the first round of combat, that creature is off-guard until the end of your next turn.

name: Impaling Bone
summary: Once per day, you can cast _impaling spike_ as a 7th-rank innate occult spell, except the spike is made of bone instead of cold iron.

name: Legendary Laugh
summary: Your laugher echoes in the minds of your enemies.

name: Cringe
summary: With pitiful posturing, you cause your foe to pull back a deadly attack.

name: Dragon's Presence
summary: As kin to dragonkind, you project unflappable confidence (that collapses catastrophically against the deadliest foes).

name: Kobold Lore
summary: You attentively learned key kobold survival strategies from your elders.

name: Kobold Weapon Familiarity
summary: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the kobold trait.

name: Scamper
summary: You Stride up to your Speed, with a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.

name: Snare Setter
summary: You are adept at the time-honored kobold art of making traps.

name: Ally's Shelter
summary: You follow your allies' example.

name: Grovel
summary: You convince your foe you're less of a threat.

name: Snare Genius
summary: If the snare normally takes 1 minute to Craft, you can Craft it with 3 Interact actions instead.

name: Winglets
summary: Through the lingering influence of your warren's patron, you've sprouted a small set of wings.

name: Between the Scales
summary: You've learned to take advantage of slips in your foes' defenses.

name: Briar Battler
summary: When you're in difficult terrain from an environmental feature, you can Take Cover, even if the feature wouldn't ordinarily be large enough for you to Take Cover.

name: Close Quarters
summary: If you're Small or smaller, you can end your movement in the same square as a Small or smaller ally.

name: Evolved Spellhorn
summary: Your inborn arcane power grows.

name: Fleeing Shriek
summary: You let out an ear-piercing screech.

name: Winglet Flight
summary: Intense use and exercise have made your winglets more powerful.

name: Resplendent Spellhorn
summary: Your magic continues to flourish.

name: Tumbling Diversion
prerequisite: Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Deception
summary: Attempt to Tumble Through an opponent's space.

name: Vicious Snares
summary: You deal an additional 1d6 precision damage with damage snares you craft.

name: Benefactor's Majesty
summary: You tap into the grandeur of your warren's benefactor.

name: Bone Magic
summary: Your connection to your iruxi ancestors manifests as a simple primal spell that you cast using a fragment of an ancestor's bones.

name: Iruxi Armaments
summary: Your weapons are those you were born with.

name: Lizardfolk Lore
summary: You listened carefully to the tales passed down among your community.

name: Marsh Runner
summary: When you use the Step action, you can ignore difficult terrain caused by flooding, swamps, or quicksand.

name: Parthenogenic Hatchling
summary: You were hatched from an unfertilized egg during hard times for your people, and are a biological copy of your mother.

name: Reptile Speaker
summary: You hear the sounds of reptiles as language.

name: Envenom Fangs
summary: You envenom your fangs.

name: Flexible Tail
summary: You can perform simple Interact actions with your tail, such as opening an unlocked door.

name: Gecko's Grip
summary: You cling to walls with a preternatural grip.

name: Shed Tail
summary: You can shed a portion of your tail to escape.

name: Swift Swimmer
summary: You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.

name: Dangle
summary: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing.

name: Hone Claws
summary: You grind or gnaw a particularly wicked edge onto your claws.

name: Terrain Advantage
summary: Non-lizardfolk creatures in difficult terrain are off-guard to you.

name: Bone Investiture
summary: You encase yourself in spiritual dinosaur bones to become a Huge dinosaur.

name: Iruxi Spirit Strike
summary: Your iruxi unarmed attacks channel the spiritual energy of your ancestors.

name: Primal Rampage
summary: You gain _unfettered movement_ and _mountain resilience_ as 4th-rank primal innate spells that you can cast once per day.

name: Fossil Rider
summary: Using your ancestors' bones, you manifest their spirits around you in a fossilized form.

name: Scion Transformation
summary: You go into hibernation for twenty-four hours and perform a ritual dedicated to your ancestors, undergoing a one-time metamorphosis.

name: Cheek Pouches
summary: Your cheeks are stretchy, and you can store up to four items of light Bulk or less in these cheek pouches.

name: Pack Rat
summary: You've learned how to cram vast quantities into small spaces.

name: Rat Familiar
summary: You have a pet rat that has become magically bonded to you.

name: Ratfolk Lore
summary: Years of experience among ratfolk communities have made you nimble, and you've learned to run and hide when enemies threaten.

name: Ratspeak
summary: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with rodents, including beavers, mice, porcupines, rats, and squirrels, but not with other mammals, such as dogs or bats.

name: Tinkering Fingers
summary: You're trained in Crafting.

name: Vicious Incisors
summary: Your jaws unarmed attack deals 1d6 piercing damage instead of 1d4, and gains the backstabber trait.

name: Warren Navigator
summary: You gain the trained proficiency rank in Survival.

name: Cornered Fury
summary: If a foe of a larger size than you critically hits and damages you, that foe is off-guard to you for 1 round.

name: Lab Rat
summary: You've spent more than your share of time in an alchemy lab.

name: Quick Stow
summary: You Interact to store one item you're holding in your cheek pouches (provided it fits).

name: Rat Magic
summary: There always seems to be a little rat around to carry messages for you.

name: Ratfolk Roll
summary: You roll up into a ball and move up to four times your Speed in a straight line down an incline.

name: Big Mouth
summary: Instead of storing up to four items of Light Bulk in your cheek pouches, you can store up to 1 Bulk worth of items.

name: Overcrowd
summary: As long as you are Small, you can end your movement in the same square as a Small ally.

name: Rat Form
summary: You can transform into an innocuous-looking rat.

name: Uncanny Cheeks
summary: You gain the Prescient Consumable and Prescient Planner feats, except that you always withdraw the objects from your cheek pouches.

name: Shinstabber
summary: As long as you're Small or smaller, you can end your movement in the same square as an ally of any size.

name: Skittering Sneak
summary: You squish, slink, and skitter from cover to cover with great speed and stealth.

name: Warren Digger
summary: You've learned to put your sturdy claws to work digging through the earth.

name: Call the Swarm
summary: You give a shrill whistle and point, and a massive swarm of rats pours forth from the surrounding terrain to fill a 30-foot burst within 120 feet.

name: Greater than the Sum
summary: You call upon the familial bonds you share with your allies and other ratfolk to become an overwhelming force in battle.

name: Mariner's Fire
summary: You conjure uncanny orbs of spiritual flame that float above or below the water's surface.

name: One-Toed Hop
summary: Assuming a peculiar stance, you make a short hop on each toe.

name: Scavenger's Search
summary: You're always on the lookout for supplies and valuables.

name: Squawk!
summary: You let out an awkward squawk, ruffle your feathers, or fake some other birdlike tic to cover up a social misstep or faux pas.

name: Storm's Lash
summary: Wind and lightning have always been friends to you.

name: Tengu Lore
summary: You learned skills for surviving in the place where your people were dispersed.

name: Tengu Weapon Familiarity
summary: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the tengu trait plus the katana, khakkara, temple sword, and wakizashi.

name: Uncanny Agility
summary: You have near-supernatural poise that lets you move swiftly across the most unsteady surfaces.

name: Eat Fortune
summary: As someone tries to twist fate, you consume the interference.

name: Long-Nosed Form
summary: You transform into a specific, curious-looking human form.

name: Magpie Snatch
summary: You move quickly, snatching a shiny item that catches your eye.

name: Soaring Flight
summary: You Fly.

name: Tengu Feather Fan
summary: You've learned to bind some of your feathers together into a fan to focus your ancestral magic.

name: Soaring Form
summary: You have a fly Speed of 20 feet at all times.

name: Wind God's Fan
summary: Your fan can stir up even more powerful winds.

name: Harbinger's Claw
summary: You caw ominously, cursing the creature with misfortune.

name: Jinx Glutton
summary: You can Eat Fortune once per hour, rather than once per day.

name: Thunder God's Fan
summary: Your fan unleashes the fury of the storm.

name: Great Tengu Form
summary: You take on the imposing form of a large, winged spirit.

name: Trickster Tengu
summary: You can transform yourself or the bodies of others to express your displeasure.

name: Croak Talker
summary: You can communicate with the simplest of frogs and other similar creatures using longwinded croaks.

name: Hunter's Defense
summary: Your canny understanding of natural and primal creatures helps you predict and dodge their attacks.

name: Jungle Strider
summary: You are adept at dodging roots, foliage, and other jungle obstacles.

name: Nocturnal Tripkee
summary: You tend to do most of your hunting and work at night and have adapted to the requirements of nocturnal life.

name: Terrifying Croak
summary: You release a haunting croak that reminds those around you of their fears.

name: Tripkee Lore
summary: You are well versed in tripkee culture and tactics.

name: Tripkee Weapon Familiarity
summary: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the tripkee trait.

name: Fantastic Leaps
summary: Your leaps seem to defy gravity as you soar through the air in a single bound.

name: Long Tongue
summary: You've learned to stretch your exceptionally long tongue beyond its original limits.

name: Prodigious Climber
summary: Your natural climbing ability and technique has made you a potent climber.

name: Tenacious Net
summary: Escaping your nets is no simple task.

name: Tripkee Glide
summary: You can use your webbed feet to guide your fall.

name: Vomit Stomach
summary: In dire circumstances you can vomit out your stomach to expel toxins.

name: Absorb Toxin
prerequisite: You are not immune to diseases or poisons
summary: Your skin readily absorbs poison and can consciously draw toxins into your body to spare others.

name: Moisture Bath
summary: Your moist skin is especially resistant to damage from temperature-altering effects.

name: Ricocheting Leap
summary: You quickly use your momentum to topple and spring off of foes.

name: Tongue Tether
summary: Your tongue can momentarily latch on as readily as your hands.

name: Envenomed Edge
summary: With a combination of your poison glands and herbal concoctions, you can consistently deliver venomous attacks when you hit an enemy's weak points.

name: Hop Up
summary: Your frog-like agility awakens as soon as you do.

name: Unbound Leaper
summary: Your jumping prowess is unmatched.

name: Straveika
summary: You descend from one of the truly ancient vampires, a nosferatu cursed to eternal life but not eternal youth.

name: Svetocher
summary: You were born to a moroi, the most common vampires, and you share their supernatural fortitude and power of persuasion.

name: Eyes of Night
summary: You can see in the darkness as easily as a true vampire.

name: Fangs
summary: Your incisors have grown into true fangs: long, sharp, and well-suited to drawing blood.

name: Vampire Lore
summary: You were raised by your vampiric parent, or you've invested substantial time and energy researching the secrets of your undead progenitors.

name: Voice of the Night
summary: You hear and understand the words of creatures you share the darkness with.

name: Enthralling Allure
summary: The powers of domination employed by your progenitors have manifested in you as well.

name: Necromantic Physiology
summary: Your unusual physiology has developed in a way that makes it difficult for parasites and other infestations to prey upon you.

name: Undead Slayer
summary: Your knowledge of your own not-quite-living anatomy, combined with your experience in combat, helps you take down undead foes with ease.

name: Bloodletting Fangs
summary: You emulate your vampiric parent's techniques for drawing blood from a victim.

name: Night Magic
summary: You can tap into the magic that runs through your blood.

name: Form of the Bat
summary: You can transform into a harmless bat.

name: Symphony of Blood
summary: You call forth the blood of your foes to grant you vigor.

name: Arcane Dragonblood
summary: You descend from a dragon that wields mastery of their magical abilities, such as a fortune dragon or mirage dragon.

name: Divine Dragonblood
summary: You can trace your lineage to a dragon with almost deific powers, such as a diabolic dragon or empyreal dragon.

name: Occult Dragonblood
summary: Your blood contains a tiny fragment of unusual or inexplicable power from a mysterious dragon, such as a conspirator dragon or omen dragon.

name: Primal Dragonblood
summary: A dragon with a deep connection to the natural world, such as an adamantine dragon or a horned dragon, resides somewhere on your family tree.

name: Breath of the Dragon
summary: Tapping into the physiology of your draconic ancestor, you can exhale a torrent of energy in a 15-foot cone or a 30-foot line, dealing 1d4 damage.

name: Draconic Aspect
summary: You have an obvious draconic feature, such as sharp claws, a snout full of sharp teeth, or strong reptilian tail, that you can use offensively.

name: Draconic Resistance
summary: Draconic magic safeguards you against harm.

name: Draconic Sight
summary: You have a fraction of the senses of your draconic forebear.

name: Dragon Lore
summary: You've set your mind on learning more about your ancestor and their kin, and perhaps you were even raised by a dragon parent.

name: Scaly Hide
summary: You were born with a layer of scales across your entire body that resemble those of your draconic progenitor.

name: Deadly Aspect
summary: You have honed the unarmed attack your draconic heritage has granted you to a lethal degree.

name: Draconic Scent
summary: Your sense of smell has heightened to be as keen as that of a dragon.

name: Dragon's Flight
summary: You have grown a small pair of draconic wings or have honed your use of the wings you've had since birth.

name: Traditional Resistances
prerequisite: Arcane Dragonblood, Divine Dragonblood, Occult Dragonblood, or Primal Dragonblood
summary: Due to your blood, you have some resistance to certain types of magic.

name: Formidable Breath
summary: Thanks to rigorous breathing exercises and a diet similar to that of your lineage, your magical breath is more powerful.

name: True Dragon's Flight
summary: Your wings have grown more powerful, capable of keeping you aloft longer.

name: Wing Buffet
summary: You have a pair of draconic wings strong enough to batter your foes away and shove them away.

name: Draconic Veil
summary: Like some dragons, your forebear had the supernatural ability to change their shape to walk among humanoids.

name: Majestic Presence
summary: By taking an impressive stance, the full force of your personality cows lesser beings.

name: Form of the Dragon
summary: You can briefly transform into a paragon of your draconic ancestry.

name: Lingering Breath
summary: Your draconic breath destroys the surrounding environment and leaves your enemies in pain.

name: Chance Death
summary: Your previous life ended due to sheer poor luck, struck by lightning or choking on a fish bone.

name: Deliberate Death
summary: Once, you died because someone—murderer, monster, or soldier— chose to strike you down.

name: Duskwalker Lore
summary: You either found another duskwalker who taught you the secrets of your kind, or you managed to research your unusual heritage.

name: Duskwalker Weapon Familiarity
summary: You have familiarity with the bo staff, longbow, composite longbow, scythe, and staff

name: Ghost Hunter
summary: Your connection to the Boneyard ensures that your blows strike true against spectral beings.

name: Gravesight
summary: You can see in the darkness as easily as a psychopomp.

name: Lifesense
summary: You have a limited ability to sense life force, like your psychopomp forebears.

name: Spirit Soother
summary: You are attuned to the minute sounds and sensations of restless spirits.

name: Ward Against Corruption
summary: Your soul is warded against the power of undeath and plague, as well as that of the evil former psychopomps known as sahkils.

name: Duskwalker Magic
summary: Your connection to psychopomps gives you the power to glimpse the near future and protect corpses from the ravages of undeath.

name: Quietus Strikes
summary: Your connection to the Boneyard empowers you to bring death to all forms of life and unlife, exploiting their weaknesses.

name: Resist Ruin
summary: Your duskwalker heritage allows you to extend protection against void energy.

name: Boneyard's Call
summary: You have a powerful connection to the Boneyard and its courts, granting you the ability to travel to and from the Boneyard.

name: Alchemical Familiar
summary: You have used alchemy to create life, a simple creature formed from alchemical materials, reagents, and a bit of your own blood.

name: Alchemical Assessment
summary: You can identify alchemical items quickly.

name: Blowgun Poisoner
summary: You can capably deliver toxins with a blowgun.

name: Far Lobber
summary: You've learned how to throw a longer distance.

name: Quick Bomber
summary: You keep your bombs and bomb-related reagents in easy-to-reach pouches from which you draw without thinking.

name: Soothing Vials
summary: The healing chemicals in your versatile vials also help calm a patient's mind.

name: Clotting Elixirs
summary: Your restorative concoctions have a clotting effect on the drinker's blood.

name: Improvise Admixture
summary: You scrounge together enough ingredients from what's left in your alchemist's toolkit to produce a few more versatile vials on the fly.

name: Pernicious Poison
summary: You can add a toxic additive to an alchemical poison to make it splash poison on its target.

name: Revivifying Mutagen
summary: You metabolize a mutagen to heal yourself.

name: Smoke Bomb
summary: You can add a tarry additive to an alchemical bomb to make it emit smoke.

name: Efficient Alchemy
summary: Thanks to the time you've spent studying and experimenting, you know how to scale your formulas into larger batches that don't require any additional attention.

name: Enduring Alchemy
summary: You've learned how to make your personal energy last just a little bit longer when quickly brewing ad hoc concoctions.

name: Healing Bomb
summary: You can add a foamy catalyst to an elixir of life to turn it into a topical projectile.

name: Invigorating Elixir
summary: You can mix an aromatic salve into an elixir with the healing trait to soothe physical maladies.

name: Regurgitate Mutagen
summary: You redirect a mutagen within your body to spit a stream of stomach acid at a foe.

name: Tenacious Toxins
summary: Your victims tend to expire long before your poisons, since the latter have been specifically formulated to last longer.

name: Combine Elixirs
summary: You can add the full ingredients of a second elixir to an elixir you make to create a hybrid concoction.

name: Debilitating Bomb
summary: You can add a crystalline additive to an alchemical bomb to have it undermine your enemy.

name: Directional Bombs
summary: You can lob bombs with great force and a precise trajectory to angle the splash in a cone that sprays in a single direction, potentially allowing you to avoid allies and splash deeper into enemy lines.

name: Fortified Elixirs
summary: Your treatments for diseases and poisons can be very efficacious, though they tend not to last as long.

name: Sticky Poison
summary: A combination of additional viscosity and careful application keeps your weapons poisoned even when suffering significant wear and tear.

name: Alter Admixture
summary: Sometimes, you need to adapt your alchemical mixtures to new situations.

name: Improved Invigorating Elixir
summary: Choose physical invigoration or mental invigoration, and add the listed conditions to those you can choose for an invigorating elixir.

name: Mutant Physique
summary: Basic mutagens that affect your physical form can bring out the beast within you, turn you nigh invincible, or make your body more elastic.

name: Pinpoint Poisoner
summary: Unsuspecting targets are especially vulnerable to your poisons.

name: Sticky Bomb
summary: You can mix in a sticky additive to an alchemical bomb to make its contents adhere and continue to deal damage.

name: Advanced Efficient Alchemy
summary: You make an even-larger batch of alchemical items each morning.

name: Expanded Splash
summary: You can throw bombs at just the right trajectory to create especially large and powerful explosions.

name: Greater Debilitating Bomb
summary: You have learned enhanced techniques and alchemical secrets that allow you to expand the range of effects you can impose with your bombs.

name: Unstable Concoction
summary: You can mix a wondrous yet volatile liquid into an alchemical consumable if it has an initial effect that uses dice.

name: Extend Elixir
summary: Integrating your own personal energy into the elixirs you create causes them to affect you for longer.

name: Supreme Invigorating Elixir
summary: For the purposes of counteracting effects with invigorating elixirs, treat your level as though it were 2 higher.

name: Uncanny Bombs
summary: You lob bombs unerringly, despite obstructions or distance.

name: Double Poison
summary: You can apply two different infused injury poisons to the same weapon, though not to a piece of ammunition.

name: Mutant Innervation
summary: Basic mutagens that affect your mind and thoughts can make you communicate telepathically, protect you from being detected, or let you communicate with anyone.

name: True Debilitating Bomb
summary: You have discovered increasingly devastating ways for your bombs to impede your foes.

name: Eternal Elixir
summary: Your body readily accepts and retains minor changes.

name: Exploitive Bomb
summary: You can mix a refractile substance into an alchemical bomb to foil resistances.

name: Persistent Mutagen
summary: You've trained your physical form to remain stable.

name: Improbable Elixirs
summary: Your mastery of alchemical secrets enables you to replicate effects most believe can be achieved only via magic.

name: Miracle Worker
summary: Your alchemical mastery can resuscitate the recently slain.

name: Perfect Debilitation
summary: You have perfected the formulas for bombs that impede your enemies.

name: Alchemical Revivification
summary: If you die while under the effect of at least one elixir, the alchemical compounds in your bloodstream bring you back to life at the start of your next turn.

name: Craft Philosopher's Stone
summary: Your research has paid off, culminating in the legendary philosopher's stone.

name: Mega Bomb
summary: You can add a highly explosive additive to an alchemical bomb to turn it into a mega bomb.

name: Acute Vision
summary: When you are raging, your visual senses improve, granting you darkvision.

name: Adrenaline Rush
summary: In the heat of battle, you are capable of amazing feats of strength.

name: Draconic Arrogance
summary: Few can sway you from your goals while the fury of combat fills you.

name: Moment of Clarity
summary: You push back your rage for a moment in order to think clearly.

name: Raging Intimidation
summary: Your fury fills your foes with fear.

name: Raging Thrower
summary: Thrown weapons become especially deadly in your fury.

name: Acute Scent
summary: When your anger is heightened, your sense of smell improves.

name: Bashing Charge
summary: You smash, bust, and charge through solid obstacles without hesitation.

name: Furious Finish
summary: Desperate to finish the fight, you pour all your rage into one final blow.

name: No Escape
summary: You keep pace with a retreating foe.

name: Second Wind
summary: You can enter a second rage, but afterward you need to catch your breath.

name: Shake It Off
summary: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness.

name: Oversized Throw
summary: With a great heave, you seize a piece of your surroundings, such as a boulder, log, table, wagon, or chunk of earth, and hurl it at your foes.

name: Raging Athlete
summary: Physical obstacles can't hold back your fury.

name: Scars of Steel
summary: When you are struck with the mightiest of blows, you can flex your muscles to turn aside some of the damage.

name: Spiritual Guides
summary: Though no one sees them and only you can hear them, the spirits around you constantly chatter, save when you are raging.

name: Supernatural Senses
summary: Your scent is preternaturally sharp, and you can always rely on your sense of smell to help guide you when your vision is compromised.

name: Wounded Rage
summary: You roar in pain, awakening the rage within you.

name: Animal Skin
summary: Your proficiency in unarmored defense increases to expert.

name: Brutal Bully
summary: You push your foes around and leave bruises.

name: Cleave
summary: You swing clear through one foe and into another.

name: Dragon's Rage Breath
summary: You breathe deeply and exhale powerful energy in a 30-foot cone, dealing 1d6 damage per level to each creature in the area with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

name: Giant's Stature
summary: You grow to incredible size.

name: Inner Strength
summary: Your strength is part of your rage.

name: Mage Hunter
summary: You use your hatred of magic to lash out at a known spellcaster.

name: Nocturnal Senses
summary: Your senses gain even greater clarity.

name: Reactive Strike
trait: Barbarian, Champion, Commander, Exemplar, Guardian, Magus, Swashbuckler
summary: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.

name: Scouring Rage
prerequisite: an instinct that allows you to change your additional damage from Rage to a different damage type
summary: You emit a powerful surge of instinctual energy when you unleash your anger.

name: Spirits' Interference
summary: You call forth protective spirits to ward off ranged attacks.

name: Animalistic Brutality
summary: You deepen the connection into your animal instincts.

name: Disarming Assault
summary: You attack with enough force to knock the weapon out of your foe's hands.

name: Follow-up Assault
summary: Even in the face of failure you press the attack, determined to succeed.

name: Friendly Toss
summary: You toss your friends around the battlefield.

name: Furious Bully
summary: You bully foes across the battlefield.

name: Instinctive Strike
summary: You trust your instincts and your sense of smell, using all your senses to pinpoint your opponent's location.

name: Invulnerable Rager
summary: Even the heaviest armors serve only to enhance your unbridled fury.

name: Renewed Vigor
summary: Through the haze of battle, you quickly recover your raging vigor.

name: Share Rage
summary: You stoke an ally's fury.

name: Thrash
summary: You thrash your foe around.

name: Come and Get Me
summary: You open yourself to attacks so you can respond in turn.

name: Furious Sprint
summary: You rush forward.

name: Great Cleave
summary: Your fury carries your weapon through multiple foes.

name: Impressive Landing
summary: You slam into the ground, shattering it around you.

name: Knockback
summary: The weight of your swing drives your enemy back.

name: Resounding Blow
summary: You strike your enemy in the head with such force that its ears ring.

name: Silencing Strike
summary: A quick strike to the face or mouth silences your opponent.

name: Tangle of Battle
summary: Your vicious strike pulls your foe closer, giving you the opportunity to grab them.

name: Terrifying Howl
summary: You unleash a terrifying howl.

name: Dragon's Rage Wings
summary: You sprout dragon wings from your back of the same color as your chosen dragon.

name: Embrace the Pain
summary: Ignoring your pain, you reach out and grab the creature or weapon that caused you harm.

name: Furious Grab
summary: You grab your foe while it's distracted by your attack.

name: Predator's Pounce
summary: You close the distance to your prey in a blur, pouncing on the creature before it can react.

name: Spirit's Wrath
summary: You call forth an ephemeral spirit, typically the apparition of an ancestor or a nature spirit, which takes the form of a wisp.

name: Sunder Spell
summary: You draw upon your superstitious fury to destroy a spell.

name: Titan's Stature
summary: You grow to even greater size.

name: Unbalancing Sweep
summary: You make a great sweep with your weapon or fists about yourself, knocking creatures off their feet and away from you.

name: Awesome Blow
summary: Your attacks are so powerful, they can flatten your opponents.

name: Giant's Lunge
summary: You extend your body and prepare to attack foes outside your normal reach.

name: Impaling Thrust
summary: You impale your enemy and hold it in place with your weapon, and leave it bleeding when it gets free.

name: Sunder Enchantment
summary: You can focus your superstition to break the magic of an item, in addition to destroying freestanding spells and those active on creatures.

name: Vengeful Strike
summary: When struck by an enemy, you respond in turn.

name: Collateral Thrash
summary: You smack the foe you're thrashing into someone else.

name: Desperate Wrath
summary: Your blood boils when you take a beating, and you throw caution to the wind to finish the fight.

name: Dragon Transformation
summary: You transform into a ferocious Large dragon, gaining the effects of 6th-rank _dragon form_ except that you use your own AC and attack modifier, you apply your extra damage from Rage, and the Dragon Breath action uses your class DC.

name: Furious Vengeance
summary: Your enemy's blow fuels your rage and provokes your immediate retaliation.

name: Penetrating Projectile
summary: Your projectiles are unhindered by flesh and bone.

name: Shattering Blows
summary: Your forceful blows shatter objects with ease.

name: Brutal Critical
summary: Your critical hits are particularly devastating.

name: Perfect Clarity
summary: You burn out all your rage to ensure that your attack lands and your mind remains free.

name: Vicious Evisceration
summary: You make a vicious attack that maims your enemy.

name: Whirlwind Toss
summary: You whirl a foe to smash into all nearby creatures before throwing them far away.

name: Annihilating Swing
summary: You have embraced brute destructive power.

name: Contagious Rage
summary: You can drive your allies into a frenzy, granting them incredible benefits.

name: Quaking Stomp
summary: You stomp the ground with such force that it creates a minor earthquake, with the effects of the _earthquake_ spell.

name: Unstoppable Juggernaut
summary: You have become a brutal, unstoppable force of nature, able to shrug off mortal wounds with ease.
source: Player Core 2 pg. 85, Pathfinder #150: Broken Promises pg. 76

name: Brilliant Flash
summary: Your light cleanses souls of fear.

name: Defensive Advance
summary: With the protection of your shield, you dive into battle! You Raise your Shield and Stride.

name: Deity's Domain
summary: You embody an aspect of your deity.

name: Desperate Prayer
summary: You call out to your deity in a plea for their aid.

name: Faithful Steed
summary: You gain the service of a young animal companion as a mount.

name: Iron Repercussions
summary: Disobeying your Iron Command has lasting consequences.

name: Nimble Reprisal
summary: You can use Retributive Strike at greater distance.

name: Ongoing Selfishness
summary: Your powerful personality and incredible ego demand that you protect yourself above all else.

name: Unimpeded Step
summary: With a burst of divine liberation, your ally's movement from your Liberating Step is unaffected by difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, narrow surfaces, and uneven ground.

name: Vicious Vengeance
summary: While your vengeance is painful for both you and your foe, none can doubt that your enemies suffer more.

name: Weight of Guilt
summary: Guilt clouds the minds of those who ignore your Glimpse of Redemption.

name: Divine Grace
summary: You call upon your deity's grace

name: Divine Health
summary: Your faith makes you resistant to disease, protecting you as you offer succor to the ill.

name: Aura of Courage
summary: You stand strong in the face of danger and inspire your allies to do the same.

name: Aura of Despair
summary: Your presence as an avatar of evil makes your foes more susceptible to terror and makes it almost impossible for them to shake off fear when you are near.

name: Cruelty
summary: The harm you deal with your corrupting touch saps the strength from your enemy's body.

name: Mercy
summary: Your touch soothes the body or mind.

name: Security
summary: Those you shield can benefit from your lasting protection.

name: Expand Aura
summary: You focus your divine power to extend your influence and protection.

name: Loyal Warhorse
summary: The loyalty you and your mount share is unbreakable.

name: Smite
summary: You single out one enemy to destroy in your deity's name.

name: Advanced Deity's Domain
summary: Through your conviction, you have glimpsed the deeper secrets of your deity's domain.

name: Greater Cruelty
summary: The extent of your corruption devastates your foes' minds and reflexes.

name: Greater Mercy
summary: Your faith enhances your ability to remove conditions.

name: Greater Security
summary: Shield in hand, you offer your ally its full protection you do yourself.

name: Heal Mount
summary: Your devotion to your mount manifests as a surge of vital energy.

name: Second Blessing
summary: Your continued service grants you another boon.

name: Imposing Destrier
summary: Under your care, your mount has realized its innate potential.

name: Radiant Armament
summary: Your blessed armament radiates power, further enhancing your chosen weapon.

name: Shield of Reckoning
prerequisite: Shield Warden; blessed shield, champion's reaction
summary: When you shield your ally against an attack, you call upon your power to protect your ally further.

name: Spectral Advance
summary: You gain the _spectral advance_ devotion spell

name: Affliction Mercy
summary: The divine grace that flows through you grants reprieve from an affliction.

name: Aura of Faith
summary: You radiate an aura of belief that imbues your attacks and those of nearby allies with divine power.

name: Blessed Counterstrike
prerequisite: champion’s reaction that grants an ally resistance to an enemy’s damage (including the grandeur, justice, liberation, and redemption causes)
summary: You call upon divine power and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against the enemy who triggered your champion's reaction.

name: Champion's Sacrifice
summary: You can suffer so that others might live.

name: Devoted Focus
summary: Your devotion is strong enough to increase your focus to incredible heights.

name: Divine Wall
summary: You use your shield to harry your enemies, preventing them from stepping away from or around you.

name: Gruesome Strike
prerequisite: champion’s reaction that grants extra damage with your Strikes (including the desecration, iniquity, and obedience causes)
summary: Make a Strike against the creature that triggered your champion's reaction.

name: Aura of Determination
summary: Your aura protects against powers that would twist the mind and body.

name: Aura of Life
summary: Your aura protects against the power of the Void.

name: Aura of Righteousness
summary: Your righteous aura dampens evil's might and prevents the unholy from escaping you.

name: Divine Reflexes
summary: You gain an additional reaction that you can use only for your champion's reaction.

name: Auspicious Mount
summary: Guided by your ongoing care, your steed has developed incredible intelligence and skill.

name: Instrument of Slaughter
prerequisite: champion’s reaction that grants extra damage with your Strikes (including the desecration, iniquity, and obedience causes)
summary: Your blessed armament thirsts for the blood of your foes.

name: Instrument of Zeal
prerequisite: Blessed Counterstrike or Retributive Strike; champion’s reaction that grants an ally resistance to an enemy’s damage (including the grandeur, justice, liberation, and redemption causes)
summary: Divine energy fills your weapon.

name: Shield of Grace
summary: You protect an ally with both your shield and your body.

name: Rejuvenating Touch
summary: Your healing energies linger after you cast, providing continual benefits.

name: Swift Retribution
summary: The transgressions of your enemies fuel you to retaliate with divine speed.

name: Ultimate Mercy
summary: Your mercy transcends the bounds of life and death.

name: Armament Paragon
summary: Add the following property runes to the list you can choose for your blessed armament: animated, _greater fearsome_, _grievous_, _keen_, and _greater vitalizing_.

name: Sacred Defender
summary: You are a great warrior that can stand strong against the fiercest opponents to your cause.

name: Shield Paragon
summary: Your shield is a vessel of divine protection.

name: Swift Paragon
summary: The movement of you and your allies is swift and decisive as the judgment of your deity.

name: Eliminate Red Herrings
summary: You have a keen sense for avoiding spurious lines of inquiry.

name: Flexible Studies
summary: You've collected a cross-section of information on various disciplines you can refer to when preparing for various tasks.

name: Known Weaknesses
summary: Whenever you Devise a Stratagem, you can also attempt a check to Recall Knowledge as part of that action before rolling the d20.

name: Takedown Expert
summary: You've mastered combat practices that let you get up close and bring down perpetrators alive.

name: That's Odd
summary: When you enter a new location, such as a room or corridor, you immediately notice one thing out of the ordinary.

name: Underworld Investigator
summary: Your work as an investigator makes you familiar with the criminal element.

name: Athletic Strategist
summary: You know how to calculatedly manipulate joints and body weight.

name: Certain Strategem
summary: You know exactly where to strike a foe to target their weak spots.

name: Exploit Blunder
summary: By watching your foes closely, you can make the most out of their mistakes.

name: Person of Interest
summary: Sometimes, you need to follow the leads as they come in the middle of an investigation.

name: Shared Stratagem
summary: The plans you make include your allies as well as yourself.

name: Solid Lead
summary: Sometimes your case splinters into smaller mysteries, but you never lose sight of the big picture.

name: Alchemical Discoveries
summary: You've devoted extra time in the lab to improve your knowledge of alchemy.

name: Detective's Readiness
summary: When you're on a case, you stay watchful and resolute to avoid tricks your suspect might pull.

name: Lie Detector
summary: You're adept at noticing the tells of a liar—sweat, flushing, a quavering voice, a quickening pulse.

name: Ongoing Investigation
summary: You're always investigating what's around you, even as you perform other activities.

name: Scalpel's Point
summary: Your stratagems benefit from your precise knowledge of anatomy.

name: Strategic Assessment
summary: You learn your foes' strengths and weaknesses by watching them move.

name: Connect the Dots
summary: Ephemeral connections between people, places, and concepts are invisible to most, but seeing them is your stock and trade.

name: Predictive Purchase
summary: You have just the thing for the situation.

name: Thorough Research
summary: You have comprehensive knowledge in your fields of interest.

name: Clue Them All In
summary: You can clue in all your allies at once.

name: Defensive Stratagem
summary: By scrutinizing a foe, you learn how to better avoid its attacks.

name: Whodunnit?
summary: You carefully consider your case and narrow down some of the details.

name: Just One More Thing
summary: After your attempt to influence someone goes poorly, you add another bit of information or ask a pointed question, possibly salvaging your previous attempt.

name: Ongoing Strategy
summary: You're constantly studying small aspects of everyone's movements, even if you don't have a stratagem in place ahead of time.

name: Suspect of Opportunity
summary: Sometimes something intrudes upon your case unexpectedly, such as an ambush sent to bring your investigation to a close.

name: Empiricist's Eye
summary: Sharp and piercing, your eyes see all and convey more.

name: Foresee Danger
summary: You perceive every possible way your foe's attack could land and attempt to avoid them all.

name: Just As Planned
summary: In the blink of an eye, you calculate your enemy's movements and know exactly where to aim your next blow.

name: Make 'em Sweat
summary: Your line of questioning lets a suspect know you can see right through them, shaking them to the core.

name: Reason Rapidly
summary: Your mind works through clues at an unbelievable speed.

name: Share Tincture
summary: You use Quick Tincture, and the item you create remains potent until the start of your next turn.

name: Surgical Shock
summary: With a few well-placed jabs with your fist or weapon, you render your opponent disoriented or ungainly.

name: Plot the Future
summary: You spend 10 minutes in contemplation to uncannily predict how events will play out.

name: Strategic Bypass
summary: Your plans account for your foes' resistances, enabling you to strike a telling blow.

name: Didactic Strike
summary: When you find a glaring weakness, you can set your allies up to annihilate your foe.

name: Implausible Purchase
summary: It seems impossible, but you've analyzed every angle and are able to just keep pulling out exactly the item you need, even in far-flung locations.

name: Lead Investigator
summary: You spend 1 minute briefing up to four allies about one of your open investigations.

name: Trickster's Ace
summary: Whether from jury-rigged magic items, deduction from the study of magical interactions, or other means, you have a contingency in your back pocket for desperate situations.

name: Everyone's a Suspect
