summary: You are so suspicious of everyone you meet that you keep mental notes on how to defeat them all—even your own allies.

name: Just the Facts
summary: You fundamentally understand everything to the point where your research can't possibly be wrong.

name: Crane Stance
summary: Your arms flutter like a crane's wings.

name: Dragon Stance
summary: You enter the stance of a dragon and make powerful leg strikes like a lashing dragon's tail.

name: Monastic Archer Stance
summary: You enter a specialized stance for a unique martial art centered around the use of a bow.

name: Monastic Weaponry
summary: You have trained with the weaponry of your monastery or school.

name: Mountain Stance
summary: You enter the stance of an implacable mountain—a technique created by dwarven monks—allowing you to strike with the weight of an avalanche and block blows with your garments.

name: Qi Spells
summary: You have cultivated your qi to produce magical effects.

name: Stumbling Stance
summary: You enter a seemingly unfocused stance that mimics the movements of the inebriated—bobbing, weaving, leaving false openings, and distracting your enemies from your true movements.

name: Tiger Stance

name: Crane Flutter

name: Greater Revelation

name: Forestall Curse

name: Lighter than Air

name: Revelation's Focus

name: Diverse Mystery

name: Portentous Spell

name: Blaze of Revelation

name: Divine Effusion

name: Mystery Conduit

name: Oracular Providence

name: Bleed Out
summary: You channel the residual energy from the last spell you cast into a ranged bloodletting.

name: Propelling Sorcery
summary: The force of your magic can be used to propel yourself or another.

name: Arcane Evolution

name: Divine Evolution
summary: The divine might provided by your bloodline flows through you.

name: Occult Evolution
summary: You draw power from the obscure secrets of the universe.

name: Primal Evolution
summary: You can call upon the creatures of the wild for aid.

name: Split Shot
summary: You fragment a ranged spell.

name: Advanced Bloodline
summary: You draw more power from your bloodline.

name: Diverting Vortex
summary: You use vestiges of magic to create a protective vortex.

name: Energy Ward
summary: You convert energy from the last spell you cast into a protective ward.

name: Safeguard Spell
summary: You are inured to the effects of your own spells.

name: Spell Relay
summary: You open the power in your blood to your ally's spellcasting, using your magic to boost their range.

name: Bloodline Resistance
summary: Your magical blood makes you more resistant to magic.

name: Crossblooded Evolution
summary: Odd interactions in your bloodline provide you with unexpected effects.

name: Explosion of Power

name: Energy Fusion

name: Greater Bloodline
summary: You uncover the greater secrets of your bloodline.

name: Signature Spell Expansion

name: Blood Sovereignty

name: Bloodline Focus

name: Greater Physical Evolution
summary: You change form readily.

name: Greater Spiritual Evolution

name: Terraforming Trickery

name: Spell Shroud

summary: Your bloodline's deep connection to mental essence greatly enhances your spell repertoire.

name: Greater Vital Evolution
summary: Vital power surges through you like a font of energy.

name: Greater Crossblooded Evolution
summary: Your bloodline is extraordinarily complex.

name: Bloodline Conduit

name: Bloodline Perfection

name: Extravagant Parry

name: Goading Feint

name: Agile Maneuvers
summary: Your easily maneuver against your foes.

name: Dual Finisher

name: Flashy Roll
summary: You can use Flashy Dodge before attempting a Reflex save, in addition to its original trigger.

name: Stunning Finisher
summary: You attempt a dizzying blow.

name: Vivacious Bravado
summary: Your ego swells, granting you a temporary reprieve from your pain.

name: Buckler Dance
summary: You spin your buckler defensively toward every attack.

name: Derring-do

name: Reflexive Riposte

name: Stumbling Finisher

name: Targeting Finisher

name: Cheat Death

name: Perfect Finisher
summary: You focus your panache into an impeccable assault.

name: Deadly Grace
summary: Your graceful attacks are especially powerful.

name: Felicitous Riposte

summary: Your strikes flow endlessly.

summary: At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain an extra reaction

summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level oracle feat of your choice.

summary: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

summary: You gain one oracle feat.

summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level swashbuckler feat of your choice.

summary: You gain one swashbuckler feat.

summary: You’ve learned to riposte against ill-conceived attacks.

name: Swashbuckler's Speed

summary: Your studies open up new horizons.

summary: You can save your shield from total destruction, even after a devastating attack.

name: Beastmaster Dedication
summary: You gain the service of a young animal companion that travels with you and obeys your commands.

name: Additional Companion
summary: Another animal joins you in your travels.

name: Mature Beastmaster Companion
summary:
All of your animal companions grow up, becoming mature animal companions and gaining additional capabilities.

Your animal companion has greater independence.

name: Beastmaster's Trance
summary: You can enter a trance that allows you to briefly inhabit the body of one of your animal companions and share its senses.

name: Swift Guardian
summary: When danger appears, you quickly send away your active companion and call in a different animal ally.

name: Incredible Beastmaster Companion
summary: Your mature animal companions continue to grow and develop.

name: Beastmaster Bond
summary: You can communicate telepathically with your animal companions within 100 feet.

name: Beastmaster's Call
summary: You quickly call in a primal projection of a non-active companion to provide the companion’s support benefit.

name: Specialized Beastmaster Companion
summary: Your nimble and savage animal companions become cunning enough to become specialized.

name: Lead the Pack
prerequisite: Mature Beastmaster Companion; you have multiple animal companions
summary: You can have up to two animal companions active at once.

name: Blessed One Dedication
summary: You are touched by a deity and gifted with the ability to alleviate the suffering of others.

name: Blessed Sacrifice
summary: You gain the protector’s sacrifice domain spell

name: Blessed Spell
prerequisite: Blessed One Dedication; Mercy; ability to cast spells from spell slots
summary: When you focus your magic on an ally, you can remove harmful conditions.

name: Blessed Denial
summary: You exude peace and protection, lessening a harmful condition as it falls upon an ally.

name: Bounty Hunter Dedication
summary: When focused on finding your quarry, you’re relentless.

name: Posse
summary: By spending 1 minute giving guidance to help hunt down your prey, you instruct up to five willing creatures to assist you.

name: Tools of the Trade
summary: You’re well-versed in weapons that allow you to bring bounties back in one piece, or at least alive.

name: Keep Pace
summary: Once you are upon your prey, they can’t escape.

name: Opportunistic Grapple
summary: You use an opening to capture your prey.

name: Cavalier Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Nature or Trained in Society
summary: You gain a young animal companion that serves as your mount.

name: Cavalier's Banner
trait: Archetype, Aura, Emotion, Mental, Uncommon, Visual
summary: You fly the banner of your pledge from your mount, raising your allies’ spirits.

name: Cavalier's Charge
summary: You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride twice.

name: Impressive Mount
summary: You’ve trained your mount to become a powerful force on the battlefield.

name: Quick Mount
summary: You and your mount can spring into action at a moment’s notice.

name: Defend Mount
summary: You interpose yourself between an attacker and your mount, defending your mount from harm.

name: Mounted Shield
summary: You’ve trained with your shield to defend both yourself and your mount.

name: Incredible Mount
summary: Under your care and training, your mount has realized its innate potential.

name: Trampling Charge
summary: You urge your mount to charge into the fray, trampling all enemies who stand in your path.

name: Unseat
summary: With a mighty blow from atop your companion, you attempt to knock an opponent off their mount.

name: Specialized Mount
summary: You’ve trained your mount to perform in unusual or even extreme circumstances, granting it abilities far beyond others of its kind.

name: Legendary Rider
summary: You and your mount move like one being, effortlessly reading each other’s signals and synchronizing even in the thick of battle.

name: Celebrity Dedication
summary: The more people you have looking at you, the more content you are, and you take every opportunity to show up others when their performances are less than perfect.

name: Never Tire
summary: As long as you have an audience, you can continue to perform even when you are on the brink of collapse.

name: Mesmerizing Gaze
summary: When you meet someone’s gaze, they’re unable to look away from you.

name: Command Attention
trait: Archetype, Auditory, Aura, Concentrate, Emotion, Mental, Visual
summary: You command the attention of all around you with style, ensuring their gaze falls only upon you until the end of your next turn.

name: Dandy Dedication
summary: You are a consummate student of dignity, etiquette, and fashion.

name: Distracting Flattery
summary: You know how to maintain a good impression and manage your image, even while keeping uncouth company.

name: Gossip Lore
summary: Your time gossiping in fashionable salons keeps you informed on every topic.

name: Fabricated Connections
summary: You can lie about having taken an action so convincingly that you acquire all the tangible benefits of having successfully completed it.

name: Party Crasher
summary: You attend all the fashionable society parties, no matter how exclusive they might be.

name: Dual-Weapon Warrior Dedication
summary: You're exceptional in your use of two weapons.

name: Dual Thrower
summary: You know how to throw two weapons as easily as strike with them.

name: Dual-Weapon Reload
summary: You carry your ammunition in a way that allows you to reload while holding two weapons.

name: Flensing Slice
summary: When you hit with both attacks with Double Slice, you flense the target, making it bleed and creating a weak spot.

name: Dual-Weapon Blitz
summary: You attack as you weave your way around the battlefield.

name: Dual Onslaught
summary: When you lash out with both weapons, you leave no room for the target to escape your attack.

name: Duelist Dedication
prerequisite: trained in light armor and simple weapons
summary: You are always ready to draw your weapon and begin a duel, no matter the circumstances.

name: Duelist's Challenge
summary: Select one enemy you can see and proclaim a challenge against it.

name: Selfless Parry
summary: You protect those near to you with a flash of steel and a stroke of good luck.

name: Student of the Dueling Arts
summary: Dueling is your art, and your weapon is your instrument.

name: Eldritch Archer Dedication
prerequisite: expert in at least one weapon from the or bow or crossbow weapon group
summary: You channel powerful magic with your archery, allowing you to deliver potent spells through the tip of an arrow rather than the more mundane flick of the wrist or whatever other gestures are usually used.

name: Basic Eldritch Archer Spellcasting
summary: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

name: Enchanting Shot
summary: With a single whisper carried on the wind, you enchant your ammunition to make a foe more vulnerable to your attacks.

name: Magic Ammunition
summary: You imbue your ammunition with raw and potent magic, transforming it to suit your needs in any situation.

name: Precious Ammunition
summary: You have learned to mimic the power that lies between magic and material.

name: Eldritch Reload
summary: You integrate your talent for magic into your use of reloading weapons.

name: Expert Eldritch Archer Spellcasting
summary: You learn additional eldritch archer magic.

name: Homing Shot
summary: Your shots zip around corners and fly at impossible angles to reach your target.

name: Incorporeal Shot
summary: You can concentrate an immense amount of magic to create a piece of ammunition that phases through everything but your target.

name: Fatal Shot
summary: You modify an arrow or bolt to bring death to your target in a single potent hit.

name: Master Eldritch Archer Spellcasting
summary: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

name: Familiar Master Dedication
summary: You have forged a mystical bond with a creature.

name: Familiar Mascot
summary: When selecting master abilities, you can choose an ally to benefit from any specific master ability.

name: Familiar Conduit
prerequisite: Familiar Master Dedication; able to cast spells
summary: Under your tutelage, your familiar has grown attuned to the hidden currents of the world and can serve as a conduit for your magic.

name: Improved Familiar
summary: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side.

name: Mutable Familiar
summary: Your familiar's supernatural spirit has outgrown its corporeal body.

name: Gladiator Dedication
summary: You know how to turn combat into a form of entertainment.

name: Fancy Moves
summary: You show off your fighting style to discourage your foes.

name: Play to the Crowd
summary: You show off for the crowd.

name: Stage Fighting
summary: You pull punches to give a better show.

name: Performative Weapons Training
summary: You're skilled with flashy weapons and can use them to great effect.

name: Call Your Shot
summary:
When you successfully Play to the Crowd, add the following to the list of benefits you can choose from:
  • A creature you can see within 30 feet becomes frightened 2.

name: Herbalist Dedication
summary: You can create natural remedies.

name: Fresh Ingredients
summary: It is amazing the difference fresh herbs can make.

name: Poultice Preparation
summary: When you create an elixir as an herbal item, you can prepare it as a poultice instead.

name: Advanced Herbalism
summary: Your herbalist talents continue to grow with use and you have become potent at making even more remedies from less.

name: Endemic Herbs
summary: The herbal items you create use medicinal plants endemic to your location.

name: Linguist Dedication
summary: You have studied languages and their development.

name: Multilingual Cipher
summary: You use multiple languages to create and break codes.

name: Phonetic Training
summary: You can pronounce and repeat words with near-perfect accuracy even if you don’t understand their meaning, and you can write them down in a phonetic script that allows you or another creature with Phonetic Training to read it later.

name: Spot Translate
summary: You bridge a language gap, repeating the message in a different language that you know.

name: Analyze Idiolect
prerequisite: Linguist Dedication; Expert in Deception; Expert in Society
summary: You break down a specific individual’s idiolect, memorizing their speech mannerisms and habits.

name: Read Shibboleths
summary: All communication is filled with slight tells and signals.

name: Crude Communication
summary: Even if you don’t speak a creature’s language, you can rely on inflection, root words, and body language to infer rudimentary meaning.

name: Marshal Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy or Trained in Intimidation; trained in martial weapons
summary: You’ve combined your social skills and combat training to become a talented combat leader.

name: Dread Marshal Stance
summary: Putting on a grim face for the battle ahead, you encourage your allies to strike fear into their foes with vicious attacks.

name: Inspiring Marshal Stance
summary: You become a brilliant example of dedication and poise in battle, encouraging your allies to follow suit.

name: Snap Out of It!
summary: You give a quick shout, hoping to shake the fog clouding your ally’s thoughts.

name: Steel Yourself!
summary: You encourage an ally to toughen up, giving them a fighting chance.

name: Cadence Call
summary: You call out a quick cadence, guiding your allies into a more efficient rhythm.

name: Rallying Charge
summary: Your fearless charge into battle reinvigorates your allies to carry on the fight.

name: Back to Back
summary: You excel at watching your allies’ backs and helping them watch yours.

name: To Battle!
summary: With a resounding cry, you rally your ally to take the offensive.

name: Topple Foe
summary: You take advantage of the opening created by your ally to tip your foe off their feet.

name: Coordinated Charge
summary: You heroically dash into the fray, inspiring your allies to follow.

name: Tactical Cadence
summary: Your remarkable breath control and concise instructions allow you to coordinate your allies more effectively, even in desperate situations.

name: Target of Opportunity
summary: You capitalize on your ally’s attack and use the opportunity to secure a blow of your own, adding to the oncoming barrage.

name: Martial Artist Dedication
summary: You have trained to use your fists as deadly weapons and can deliver devastatingly powerful blows with them.

name: Follow-up Strike
summary: You have trained rigorously to use all parts of your body as a weapon, and when you miss with an attack, you can usually continue the attack with a different body part and still deal damage.

name: Grievous Blow
summary: You know how to deliver focused, powerful blows that bypass your enemies’ resistances.

name: Path of Iron
summary: With a burst of effort and speed, you weave a nimble path through your many enemies, striking each in turn as you move past them.

name: Mauler Dedication
summary: You specialize in melee weapons that require two hands.

name: Clear the Way
summary: You put your body behind your massive weapon and swing, shoving enemies to clear a wide path.

name: Shoving Sweep
summary: You swing your weapon at your foe, rebuffing them back.

name: Hammer Quake
summary: You smash the ground with your weapon, knocking nearby creatures to the ground.

name: Avalanche Strike
summary: You attack all nearby adversaries.

name: Medic Dedication
summary: You become an expert in Medicine.

name: Doctor's Visitation
summary: You move to provide immediate care to those who need it.

name: Treat Condition
summary: You treat an adjacent creature in an attempt to reduce the clumsy, enfeebled, or sickened condition.

name: Holistic Care
summary: You provide emotional and spiritual care.

name: Resuscitate
summary: You resuscitate the dead.

name: Pirate Dedication
summary: As a pirate, you sail the seas in search of enemy ships to plunder and great adventures to embark on.

name: Pirate Combat Training
summary: You're particularly skilled at wielding the weapons used traditionally by pirates.

name: Rope Runner
prerequisite: Pirate Dedication; Trained in Acrobatics; Trained in Athletics
summary: You run and climb across ropes and rigging almost as easily as on the ground.

name: Walk the Plank
summary: You frighten  a foe into moving where you want them, traditionally demanding they walk the plank.

name: Poisoner Dedication
summary: You make a point of always having a few toxins near at hand—you never know when some arsenic or the like might prove useful.

name: Poisoner's Twist
summary: Poisons attack specific parts of the body—one venom might target the lungs, another the circulatory system, while another deteriorates the nerves.

name: Advanced Poisoncraft
summary: You can create up to 6 poisons per day with advanced alchemy.

name: Poison Coat
summary: In nature, certain animals are covered in venomous spines, and just brushing against them can prove deadly.

name: Acquired Tolerance
summary: A small amount of poison taken at nonlethal doses, can help the body build up resistance against a more deadly dosage.

name: Chemical Contagion
summary: Your injury poisons can spray onto creatures.

name: Ritualist Dedication
prerequisite: Expert in Occultism, Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, or Expert in Religion
summary: You have begun to master the difficult art of casting rituals.

name: Flexible Ritualist
summary: You can perform two aspects of a ritual yourself.

name: Resourceful Ritualist
summary: You can cast difficult rituals  that might otherwise be just beyond your skill.

name: Efficient Rituals
summary: You can perform particularly extensive rituals  in less time.

name: Assured Ritualist
summary: You can cover for a secondary caster's error.

name: Enterprising Ritualist
summary: Elegant and expensive components are no replacement for your skill and practice atritual casting.

name: Scout Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival
summary: You are a highly skilled scout, capable of guiding your allies, detecting imminent threats, and avoiding the attention of dangerous enemies.

name: Scout's Charge
summary: You meander around unpredictably, and then ambush your opponents without warning.

name: Terrain Scout
summary: You have mastered movement in many different environments.

name: Fleeting Shadow
summary: You're able to quickly disappear and then move about without drawing the attention of your enemies.

name: Scout's Speed
summary: You move faster, especially when traveling, allowing you to scout out ahead and report back without slowing your allies.

name: Scout's Pounce
summary: You leap from the shadows to strike at your foes.

name: Scroll Trickster Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Nature, Trained in Arcana, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
summary: You've studied scrolls in depth.

name: Basic Scroll Cache
summary: You have a vast and overflowing collection of scroll  scraps, riddled with errors and misspellings and leaking energy like a sieve.

name: Skim Scroll
summary: You can activate the magic of a scroll with a cursory read as you draw it from your belt.

name: Expert Scroll Cache
summary: Your scroll collection has vastly grown, both in size and potency.

name: Master Scroll Cache
summary: Your scroll collection is incredible, brimming with eldritch power, and you can prepare far more of them than an ordinary scroll trickster.

name: Scrounger Dedication
summary: While others need specialized tools and a dedicated space, you have found a way to build just about anything, anywhere.

name: Reverse Engineering
summary: Your nigh-constant tinkering and fiddling with objects means you are able to reverse engineer items into formulas more effectively than most.

name: Magical Scrounger
summary: You can craft a temporary wondrous item using the magic scrounged from all around.

name: Expert Disassembly
summary: You can apply the same techniques you use to reverse engineer objects to disable dangerous traps and break apart locks.

name: Sentinel Dedication
summary: You have trained carefully to maximize the protective qualities of your armor.

name: Steel Skin
summary: You wear your armor like a second skin, taking comfort in the protection it offers.

name: Armor Specialist
summary: You have trained hard to optimize your armor's unique protective qualities to maximize the materials used in its creation.

name: Armored Rebuff
summary: You rebuff puny attacks with your armor, knocking back your foe.

name: Mighty Bulwark
summary: Thanks to the incredible connection you have forged with your armor, you can use it to shrug off an extensive array of dangers.

name: Snarecrafter Dedication
summary: You have studied the art of crafting snares and laying traps, and few have shown more talent in these arts than you.

name: Surprise Snare
summary: You install one prepared snare for deployment in a space that's occupied by an enemy.

name: Remote Trigger
summary: You've learned how to trigger snares from afar, creating ranged hazards to assail your opponents and allowing you to disarm enemies' snares harmlessly.

name: Giant Snare
summary: You can create bigger snares for quick deployment, making it more likely for a creature to walk into your snares.

name: Lightning Snares
summary: You can rig a trap with incredible speed.

name: Plentiful Snares
summary: You can prepare incredible numbers of snares each day out of simple ingredients.

name: Talisman Dabbler Dedication
summary: You are trained in the use of  <%CONSUMABLES%19%> talismans <%END> and similar magical paraphernalia.

name: Quick Fix
summary: You can attach a  <%CONSUMABLES%19%> talisman <%END> using only a bit of glue and some string.

name: Deeper Dabbler
summary: With some streamlining to your process and a deeper collection of  <%CONSUMABLES%19%> talisman <%END> materials, you make a greater number of talismans every day.

name: Talismanic Sage
summary: Normally, affixing more than one  <%CONSUMABLES%19%> talisman <%END> to an item causes the talismans to be suppressed, but when you Affix a Talisman, you can specially treat one item you're working on, allowing it to have two active talismans at once.

name: Vigilante Dedication
summary: You have two identities, each with its own name and abilities.

name: Hidden Magic
prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
summary: You've learned to hide the magical auras of your gear.

name: Minion Guise
prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Expert in Deception; animal companion or familiar
summary: When you are in your social identity, you can also grant a social identity to an animal companion, familiar, pet, or other minion you gained from a class feature or feat.

name: Safe House
summary: You establish a safe house—a secure space in which to hide your secrets from the outside world.

name: Social Purview
summary: You have built a reputation for yourself in your social identity.

name: Startling Appearance
summary: You can startle foes who are unaware of your presence.

name: Quick Change
summary: You can shift between your identities with ease.

name: Subjective Truth
summary: Your disparate identities allow you to defeat magic that detects lies.

name: Many Guises
summary: You can take on any number of mundane guises.

name: Frightening Appearance
summary: Your dramatic appearances can frighten bystanders.

name: Stunning Appearance
summary: Your sudden appearance leaves your foe unable to respond.

name: Viking Dedication
summary: Vikings spend long periods of time at sea, only to leap from their boats at a moment's notice, charge through the surf, and take their enemies by storm.

name: Hurling Charge
summary: You make a ranged Strike with your thrown weapon, Stride, and then Interact to draw another weapon.

name: Viking Weapon Familiarity
summary: From childhood, you have been exposed to traditional viking combat techniques, and you soon learned to handle axe, sword, and shield in battle.

name: Second Shield
summary: You're used to your shield breaking in the middle of battle, and you're prepared to use a backup or any convenient nearby object to defend yourself.

name: Into the Fray
summary: You charge into battle with shield-splintering fury.

name: Weapon Improviser Dedication
summary: You don't take the normal –2 penalty to attack rolls with improvised weapons.

name: Improvised Pummel
summary: When you make a Strike with an improvised weapon you're wielding, you gain a +1 item bonus to the attack roll, and you can have the Strike deal two weapon damage dice instead of the improvised weapon's normal number.

name: Surprise Strike
summary: Whenever you make a Strike with an improvised weapon against a creature that hasn't observed you making a Strike using an improvised weapon or that is otherwise ignorant of your skill with improvised weapons, the creature is off-guard against you for that Strike.

name: Improvised Critical
summary: You can apply critical specialization effects to improvised weapons you wield.

name: Makeshift Strike
summary: You quickly snatch up whatever is nearby and then attack with it as an improvised weapon.

name: Shattering Strike (Weapon Improviser)
summary: The improvised weapon shatters, destroying it completely but dealing an additional 3d6 piercing damage to the creature you hit with the Improvised Pummel.

name: Wrestler Dedication
summary: Your training in the wrestling arts has made you particularly adept at moving, striking, and grappling while unencumbered.

name: Disengaging Twist
summary: Your ability to twist your opponents’ bodies into painful locks and holds makes you particularly adept at escaping such predicaments.

name: Elbow Breaker
summary: You bend your opponent’s body or limbs into agonizing positions that make it difficult for them to maintain their grip.

name: Suplex
summary: Flexing your entire body, you heave your opponent over your head and slam them into the ground.

name: Clinch Strike
summary: Your opponents can’t slip your grasp without punishment.

name: Running Tackle
summary: You charge, throwing your body at your foe in a vicious tackle.

name: Strangle
summary: You squeeze the breath out of your foe.

name: Submission Hold
summary: Your iron grip saps your opponent’s strength.

name: Aerial Piledriver
summary: Heaving both yourself and your opponent into the air, you bring them crashing to the ground.

name: Spinebreaker
summary: You squeeze your opponent in a vicious bear hug, putting intense pressure on their nerves, joints, or other pain points.

name: Inescapable Grasp
summary: Your grasp has a supernatural quality to it, preventing your foes from easily escaping—with or without magical assistance.

name: A Home in Every Port
summary: You have a reputation in towns and villages you've visited, and residents are always willing to open their doors to you.

name: Acrobatic Performer
summary: You're an incredible acrobat, evoking wonder and enrapturing audiences with your prowess.

name: Aerobatics Mastery
summary: You move with grace in flight and can perform amazing aerial stunts.

name: Armor Assist
prerequisite: Trained in Warfare Lore or Trained in Athletics
summary: You are practiced in helping yourself and others don heavy gear.

name: Armored Stealth
summary: You have learned techniques to adjust and modify your armor and movements to reduce the noise you make.

name: Assured Identification
prerequisite: Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion
summary: You rarely misidentify an item.

name: Backup Disguise
summary: You have a specific disguise that you keep at the ready, worn underneath your outer garment.

name: Battle Planner
summary: You are constantly drawing up plans and battle scenarios, assembling strategies and gathered intelligence for later use.

name: Biographical Eye
summary: In even a brief conversation or social interaction, you pick up on subtle social and visual cues to learn a great deal about a person's origin and history.

name: Bon Mot
trait: Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, General, Linguistic, Mental, Skill
summary: You launch an insightful quip at a foe, distracting them.

name: Caravan Leader
summary: You know how to get the most effort out of your allies on the road.

name: Concealing Legerdemain
summary: Rather than hide an object somewhere the inspectors won't search, you're skilled at keeping the object on the move so it's never where they look.

name: Consult the Spirits
prerequisite: Master in Occultism, Master in Nature, or Master in Religion
summary: You have learned rites or meditations that enable you to perceive minor, invisible spirits within a place.

name: Crafter's Appraisal
summary: Your knowledge of items' construction allows you to discern their magical effects as well.

name: Deceptive Worship
summary: Members of your cult frequently pass themselves off as worshippers of other religions.

name: Dirty Trick
summary: You hook a foe's bootlaces together, pull their hat over their eyes, loosen their belt, or otherwise confound their mobility through an underhanded tactic.

name: Discreet Inquiry
prerequisite: Expert in Deception or Expert in Diplomacy
summary: You are subtle in your efforts to learn the things you need to know.

name: Distracting Performance
summary: Your performances are especially distracting, allowing your allies to Sneak away with ease.

name: Disturbing Knowledge
summary: You utter a litany of dreadful names, prophecies, and descriptions of realms beyond mortal comprehension, drawn from your study of forbidden tomes and scrolls.

name: Doublespeak
summary: You're skilled at saying one thing and meaning something different.

name: Environmental Guide
summary: You can rapidly adapt to climates and help others do the same.

name: Evangelize
prerequisite: Master in Diplomacy; follower of a specific religion or philosophy
summary: You point out a detail that incontrovertibly supports your faith, causing a listener's mind to whirl.

name: Exhort the Faithful
prerequisite: Expert in Religion; follower of a specific religion
summary: Your knowledge of the tenets of your faith gives you insight into the best ways to get others of your faith to help you or to follow your directions.

name: Express Rider
summary: You can encourage your mount to cover ground quickly.

name: Eye for Numbers
summary: You've learned to quickly estimate the number of items in a group with relative accuracy at only a glance.

name: Eyes of the City
prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy or Trained in Society
summary: You can track down targets with the help of locals.

name: Forensic Acumen
summary: You understand principles of forensic medicine, making you better at examining a body to determine the cause of death or injury.

name: Glean Contents
summary: You are adept at quickly scanning loose papers and carefully discerning the contents of sealed letters without damaging the seal.

name: Improvise Tool
summary: You can jury-rig solutions when you don't have the proper tools on hand.

name: Improvised Repair
summary: You can hastily patch damaged equipment together, but the temporary fix lacks the full care required for lasting repairs.

name: Incredible Scout
summary: When you scout, you are particularly alert for danger, granting your allies precious moments to prepare to fight.

name: Influence Nature
summary: With patience and time, you can make bird calls, leave game trails, and ultimately influence the behavior of a certain type of animals in the region to favor and even aid you in the days to come.

name: Inoculation
summary: You have practice combating plague, and your patients are less likely to succumb to the same disease again for a time.

name: Keen Follower
summary: Your keen observation of your allies has made you better at following their lead.

name: Lead Climber
summary: When climbing, you can prepare routes for others to follow, and you can pull your allies up to avoid disaster.

name: Legendary Guide
summary: You know the wilderness so well that you can help your party travel through it with ease.

name: Leverage Connections
prerequisite: Courtly Graces or Streetwise; Expert in Society
summary: You know the right people who can get things done for you in certain circles.

name: Numb to Death
prerequisite: Diehard; you have died at least once
summary: Your past has left you numb to death's call.

name: Pick Up the Pace
summary: You lead by example and can help others push themselves beyond their normal limits.

name: Pilgrim's Token
prerequisite: Trained in Religion; follower of a specific religion
summary: You carry a small token of protection from a site holy to your faith.

name: Rapid Affixture
summary: You take only 1 minute to Affix a Talisman.

name: Risky Surgery
summary: Your surgery can bring a patient back from the brink of death, but might push them over the edge.

name: Robust Health
summary: Your physiology responds well to first aid.

name: Rolling Landing
summary: You land with quick rolls that help you keep your momentum.

name: Root Magic
summary: Your talismans ward against foul magic.

name: Sanctify Water
prerequisite: Expert in Religion; you follow a deity with “holy” or “unholy” sanctification
summary: You imbue water with your deity's blessing.

name: Shadow Mark
summary: You have learned special tricks that help you follow individuals without them noticing you.

name: Signature Crafting
summary: Magic items you create bear a stamp specific to your handiwork.

name: Slippery Prey
prerequisite: Trained in Athletics or Trained in Acrobatics
summary: You're able to escape bonds more easily than others.

name: Snare Crafting
summary: You can use the Craft activity to create snares.

name: Sow Rumor
summary: You spread rumors, which may or may not be true, about a specific subject.

name: Supertaster
summary: You have refined your palate and have a discerning sense of taste that can detect abnormalities in the flavor and texture of food and beverages.

name: Terrifying Resistance
summary: The spells of those you have Demoralized are less effective on you.

name: Thorough Search
summary: You take your time searching to ensure you find everything.

name: True Perception
summary: Your perceptive abilities and ability to process sensory information are so far beyond the pale that you notice minute discrepancies in all sorts of illusions and physical transformations.

name: Tumbling Teamwork
summary: Your tumbling distracts a foe enough to create an advantage for one of your allies.

name: Tumbling Theft
prerequisite: Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Thievery
summary: You reach for an opponent's item as you move past a foe.

name: Underground Network
summary: You're connected to groups that know what's going on in the streets, and you can get information out of them quickly.

name: Water Sprint
summary: Experience and training have taught you that water has just enough surface tension for a master sprinter to traverse the surface.

name: Red Mantis Assassin Dedication
prerequisite: trained in sawtooth sabers; worshipper of Achaekek; member of the Red Mantis assassins
summary: You have learned how to stalk your foes and slay them with a sawtooth saber.

name: Basic Red Mantis Magic
summary: You have learned limited divine magic from your Red Mantis training.

name: Crimson Shroud
summary: You swathe yourself in a veil of red mist for 1 minute.

name: Red Mantis School Spell
summary: You gain the Red Mantis magic school’s initial school spell.

name: Achaekek's Grip
summary: You sense if a creature you have slain in the last year has been restored to life

name: Mantis Form
summary: You gain the _mantis form_ focus spell

name: Fading
summary: You partially fade from reality.

name: Expert Red Mantis Magic
prerequisite: Master in Religion; Basic Red Mantis Magic
summary: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits

name: Vernai Training
prerequisite: Achaekek's Grip; Basic Red Mantis Magic
summary: To resurrect a creature you’ve slain, a spellcaster must counteract your influence on its death.

name: Prayer Attack
summary: You’ve mastered the signature assassination style of the Red Mantis.

name: Master Red Mantis Magic
prerequisite: Legendary in Religion; Basic Red Mantis Magic
summary: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

name: Dokkaebi Fire
summary: You can create illusory wisps of ghostly blue flame.

name: Spiritual Headhunter
summary: Your spirit coffin can temporarily detain the spirits of those you kill, allowing you to ask them one last question before they pass on.

name: Nourishing Symbiosis
summary: As you recuperate from your wounds, life energy flows from you to the land and back to you again.

name: Witness of Earth
summary: The primal magic in your soul offers the patient earth’s timeless counsel.

name: Majestic Proclamation
summary: You announce your name to your enemies, bringing your constellation to bear in a blinding display.

name: Phantom Visage
summary: You cloak yourself in illusions to mask your nature.

name: Tangle of Limbs
summary: Dokkaebi have a strong tradition of wrestling.

name: Phantom Resemblance
summary: Your can now draw from experience to wear any face you remember.

name: Glorious Gamtu
summary: You can access the mystical power that dokkaebi refer to as a hat.

name: Goblin Club
summary: You can summon a mass of magic energy in your hand that, naturally, you use to smack those who offend you.

name: Whispers in the Night
summary: You weave your illusions with greater ability, allowing you to play tricks and slip through the night.

name: Flames of Vision
summary: Dokkaebi were among the first goblins to pioneer gazing through flames, spectral or physical, to cast their senses far and wide.

name: Perfected Gamtu
summary: Your hat embodies the illusory grandeur of a master dokkaebi.

name: Hungry Eyes
summary: Your eyes can see through darkness with an oni’s visual acuity.

name: Oni Weapon Familiarity
summary: Oni prefer large, cruel weapons for smashing their foes to pieces, and so do you.

name: Oni Form
summary: Your horns flash briefly as you grow in size and ferocity.

name: Bloodsoaked Dash
summary: Injuries don’t bother you anymore—in fact, the pain invigorates you.

name: Oni's Mask
summary: You aren’t as malleable as your oni ancestors but still can disguise yourself.

name: Storming Gaze
summary: You can open or energize a notable third eye on your forehead to strike with storming power.

name: Blood Must Have Blood
summary: You tap into a bottomless hunger for carnage.

name: Tempest Gaze
summary: Your third eye grows stronger and more powerful.

name: Oni Rampage
summary: Nothing invigorates you more than your own freshly spilled blood.

name: Kishin Rage
summary: Your eyes glow a deep red and your body courses with adrenaline as you obtain a fraction of the power of the kishin oni.

name: Fisheye
summary: You can gain the magic of the seas by eating your favorite seafood.

name: Briny Beverage
summary: You can survive off the sea as well as gain insight from its waters.

name: Scarlet Strands
summary: The innate magic in your blood turns your signature crimson tresses into more than just a stylish coiffure.

name: Arboreal Conversationalist
prerequisite: Kijimuna Gnome heritage or at least one primal innate spell from a gnome heritage or feat
summary: With your close connection to primal energies and the First World, you can communicate with trees.

name: Kijimuna Whistle
prerequisite: Kijimuna Gnome heritage or at least one primal innate spell from a gnome heritage or feat
summary: Your connection to nature—and trees, in particular—has become so strong that you can summon the plants you befriended in the forests of your youth.

name: Koi Secrets
summary: Due to their beautiful colors, ornamental koi are often found in parks and gardens where townsfolk roam.

name: Duck!
summary: Your long experience with your erratic patrons and their peers has given you a lot of practice in hitting the deck when you hear the rumbling of a powerful entity.

name: Friend of the Family
summary: You come from a long line of imperial kobolds—if you meet a stranger who has some political standing in Tian Xia, they might know someone from your family line.

name: Imperial Dragon Potion
prerequisite: Expert in Crafting; Heavenscribe Kobold heritage
summary: During your daily preparations, you can spend 10 minutes to create a variant energy breath potion, which has the kobold trait in addition to its normal traits.

name: Kaiju's Footfalls
summary: You channel the might and mass of a kaiju.

name: Childlike Plant
prerequisite: Chrysanthemum Leshy heritage or Peachchild Leshy heritage
summary: You’re adept at hiding your plantlike features to pass as a human.

name: Unassuming Heroes
summary: You have a talent for making friends through simple kindness, often among stray animals or other creatures that people tend to overlook, and your inherent magic can make these acts take on additional power.

name: Noble Bloom
summary: Certain plants and flowers hold a reputation throughout Tian Xia for being strong and upstanding, able to weather adversity.

name: Kodama Call
summary: The small spirits known as kodama pride themselves in taking care of trees and other vegetation, and they’ll happily come to your aid as well.

name: Green Dash
summary: The spirits of vegetation send you on your way, letting you move in a burst of speed.

name: Sash of the Wind
summary: At your request, the nature spirits of the air and wind spin themselves into an iridescent sash loosely draped around your shoulders that buoys you through the sky.

name: Flower Chimera
summary: You call on a guardian of the wild to burst forth from the land to aid you.

name: Return to the Seed
summary: Once per month, when you die, you can instead choose to fade away.

name: Crocodile's Twin
prerequisite: Bakuwa Lizardfolk heritage or Makari Lizardfolk heritage
summary: Your egg contained your twin, a crocodile.

name: Spirit Coffin
summary: A hump forms on your back that allows you to attack and trap spirits.

name: Ancestral Form
prerequisite: Bakuwa Lizardfolk heritage or Makari Lizardfolk heritage
summary: Casting your memory back deep into the past, you take the form of an ancestral guardian.

name: River Adaptation
summary: Webbing sprouts on your legs and tail as you shift to a more aquatic form.

name: Ferry Through Waves
summary: The waters around you permit you passage, a privilege you can share with a willing ally.

name: Mooneater
summary: You call on the spirit of the dragon that devoured the moon to temporarily swallow a celestial body and blind onlookers with its visage.

name: Charmed Sleep
summary: When you sleep, you turn into an inanimate object a little smaller than a human’s thumb—easily overlooked and carried.

name: Speak with the Sleeping
summary: You can speak to all inanimate objects and the slumbering spirits within them.

name: Elemental Spark
summary: You’ve learned to alter the magic of your sprite’s spark, imparting them with elemental energies.

name: Along the Deep River
summary: Once per year, when you die, you turn into an immaterial ball of light.

name: Made for Combat
summary: You can use your body as a deadly weapon.

name: Sudden Terror
summary: You leverage your body’s amorphous nature to spook others.

name: Minuscule Mentee
summary: You’ve found a fellow poppet on the cusp of awakening and decided to help.

name: Insulated Poppet
prerequisite: Tsukumogami Poppet heritage; you have a metal or ceramic body
summary: You’ve used insulating wraps or special glazes to reduce your weakness to current and temperature.

name: No Hands, No Problems
summary: After a lifetime of using temporary, ghostly limbs to manipulate objects, you hardly need real hands.

name: Solidarity
summary: You bestow some of your own life energies to mend damage.

name: Awaken the Obake
summary: Not every tool is well cared for, and those that are treated badly might awaken as malevolent spirits.

name: Seven Changes Performance
summary: While kitsune are known for their magical illusion powers, you’re skilled at stage magic, especially costuming and quick changes.

name: Rekindled Light
summary: You temporarily drain your star orb familiar’s energy to save an ally.

name: Vulpine Scamper
summary: You’re especially nimble while in your full fox shape.

name: Fox Arson
summary: When you critically hit with a foxfire Strike, the target takes an additional 1d4 persistent damage of the same type as the foxfire.

name: Many Guises
summary: You can use Shifting Faces three times per day instead of once per day.

name: Larger than Life (Kitsune)
summary: When you Change Shape, you can assume the form of a creature that’s Large or Huge in size.

name: Fox Possession
summary: You can project a spiritual form to possess another.

name: It Takes a Village
summary: Your community bond creates better dynamics when working together.

name: Nalinivati's Light
summary: Your slit eyes expand to absorb light and can see in the darkest of places.

name: Throat Pocket
summary: You’ve trained to use unique nagaji eating habits to your advantage.

name: Metabolic Control
summary: You're able to better control your body's metabolism to preserve energy.

name: Venom Gulp
summary: You can store prepared venom in your throat and spit it at your foes in addition to your own toxic spray.

name: Hypnotic Gaze
summary: You can widen your field of vision, allowing you to affect more creatures with your Hypnotic Lure.

name: Synchronous Slither
summary: You’ve learned to travel at your ally’s rhythm and use their movement to adjust your own position.

name: Form of the Beloved Mother
summary: You channel the blessings of Nalinivati to transform into a manifestation of her will.

name: All This Will Happen Again
summary: Even in the face of overwhelming tribulation, you find solace in the notion that this feeling is fleeting; all things are merely part of a never-ending cycle.

name: Elucidating Vision
summary: Your eyes have seen many things in your past lives, and your sight seems to have grown more powerful over your lifetimes.

name: Innate Understanding
summary: Vague connections to the knowledge and prowess of your past help guide you in tasks that this life might not understand.

name: Remnants of the Past
summary: Memories of your first life are strong and continually return to you, even after several incarnations.

name: Samsaran Lore
summary: You have untold ages of knowledge beneath your belt, focused on the pursuit of enlightenment.

name: Samsaran Weapon Memory
summary: The training of your past lives and even of those of samsarans who came before is deep-seated and guides your movements in combat.

name: All This Has Happened Before
summary: You instantly recall a memory from one of your countless past lives that heightens your awareness of your surroundings and quickens your response.

name: And Will Do So Once More
summary: You’ve learned how to let go of most worries and move past them.

name: Blood Like Water
summary: The watery fluid in your veins doesn’t flow in the same way as traditional blood.

name: Thousand-Year Grudge
summary: You can call upon your former lives and project all of your accumulated frustration, failure, and despair through your eyes at a target, overwhelming their senses.

name: I Will Return
summary: Your special connection to death and rebirth allows you to sense when it’s your time to enter the Great Beyond, and now isn’t the time.

name: Life's Blood
summary: Your journey to enlightenment has made your blood possess nigh-immortal properties, allowing you to heal others.

name: Memory of Skill
summary: Your years of training in a previous life didn’t go to waste with your death, and you can call upon this training when you most need it.

name: Secrets of the Past
summary: You’ve established a stronger connection with your past selves and can play out the memories of your lifetimes in an instant, helping you draw on knowledge that lives deep within your mind.

name: Memory of Mastery
summary: Flashes of past selves surface in an instant, especially when you’re under duress.

name: Water to Water
summary: You allow your body to collapse into water, then reconstitute your corporeal form elsewhere.

name: The Cycle Continues
summary: Death is as natural as breathing to you, and you can move past it as easily as the other troubles in your life.

name: This Too Shall Pass
prerequisite: And Will Do So Once More
summary: Mortal worries are such simple matters to you that you leave them behind almost as quickly as you experience them.

name: Awakened Jewel
summary: You once held the head gem of a deceased ancestor or loved one, and it awakened a mysterious power in your own.

name: Crown of Bone
summary: When you came of age, you were blessed by the Mother Earth with a thickened skull, which was celebrated as an auspicious sign among your community.

name: Folk Healer
summary: Your community recognizes you as a shaman or other animist, a status you obtained through lineage, apprenticeship, or a supernatural event.

name: Sarangay Lore
summary: You listened carefully to the tales passed down among your community.

name: Traveler's Counsel
summary: On your travels, you’ve resolved countless disputes and counseled those in need.

name: Deflecting Jewel
summary: You walk the line between two sides of something, such as belonging to two clans, having a mixed allegiance or faith, or being caught between two possible fates.

name: The Moon Weaver's Art
summary: You’ve learned to create minor illusions by collecting strands of moonlight and weaving them together to create small images or cloaking veils.

name: Smoke Through Bamboo
summary: You’ve spent significant time slipping silently between bamboo thickets, and your light-footedness allows you to navigate even the thickest forests and brush with ease.

name: Tikling Bird Twirl
summary: You trained your footwork by dancing to music between snapping bamboo poles, and your increased mobility helps you succeed when hunting dangerous beasts or fighting multiple opponents.

name: Warding Jewel
summary: A life of hunting and battle has caused your head gem to attune to the waxing moon, which has manifested in the power to protect you from harm.

name: Ancestral Healer
summary: Following the traditions of those who came before you, you’ve learned how to banish effects that cloud the mind, body, and spirit.

name: Paralyzing Jewel
summary: Your dedication to the ideals of art and beauty allows your head gem to access the power of the waning moon.

name: Spiritual Echo
summary: You possess the head gem of a deceased ancestor or loved one, which has begun to resonate with your own.

name: Light-bending Jewel
summary: Your ability to walk unseen through the world has given you the new moon’s blessing.

name: Rejuvenating Embrace
summary: You rejuvenate your spirit by taking your rest where Mother Earth embraces Father Moon.

name: Sheltering Jewel
summary: Your head gem has accessed the power of the full moon through your determination to heal and protect your loved ones.

name: Convocation of Earth and Moon
summary: You call upon Mother Earth and Father Moon to fill you with light.

name: Trample
summary: You know how to leverage your size and momentum when using your horns attack, and can use your movement speed to overrun your foes.

name: Everyday Form
summary: There’s nothing better than being a tanuki, but sometimes you need a less conspicuous form when going into the big city or other crowded places.

name: Iron Belly
summary: A good laugh comes from the belly, and by laughing every day, yours has grown quite strong.

name: Scorched on the Crackling Mountain
summary: By ritualistically marking your fur with fire, like an infamous tanuki of legend, you protect yourself against future flames.

name: Tanuki Lore
summary: Tanuki love to play two things: tricks and music.

name: Teakettle Form
summary: Your shapeshifting is advanced enough to take the form of not just creatures, but objects as well.

name: False Priest Form
summary: Nobody respects tanuki, but most everyone respects an esteemed priest, so what better form to take if you want to get by a little easier? When you Change Shape, you can assume the shape of a priest or other religious official from a religion of your choosing.

name: Hasty Celebration
summary: After even the briefest success, you get caught up in the moment and begin to party, cheering your allies on.

name: Leaf Transformation
summary: You know how to run an enterprise that others would never be able to get off the ground—some say it’s your savvy acumen or jovial manner, but you know it’s because you can cut costs by transforming leaves into money.

name: Ponpoko
summary: No true tanuki would ever be caught without a musical instrument to play under the full moon.

name: Statue Form
summary: An inconspicuous statue in front of a shop is the perfect form to wait for things to blow over.

name: Many Faces
summary: Putting on a new face offers a great way to get a fresh perspective on life.

name: Mud Boat's Passage
summary: You instinctively create magical boats that keep your feet dry (mostly).

name: Phantom Orchestra
summary: An easy way to trick others is to throw your voice into a nearby forest or thicket to make strange noises.

name: Rolling White Bottle Form
summary: As you fall to the ground, you transform into a white bottle, gourd, or sake jar, then roll away before anyone can pick you up.

name: Combined Form
summary: Cooperation and coordination are the secrets to getting by in tanuki society.

name: Ponpoko-pon!
summary: Whether it’s because you play especially vigorously or are simply off-key, the music of your belly drum can physically wound your foes.

name: Splendid Illusion
summary: You cover your surroundings in outlandish fantasy.

name: Landscape Form
summary: While walking down the road on a moonlit night, one might be puzzled to find a shop or hill that wasn’t there before.

name: Start the Festival!
summary: No distance can stop tanuki from making their way to a good party.

name: Aegis of the Dissolution
summary: You are a friend of shadows and know how to avoid the troubles they bring.

name: Dance of the Mousedeer
summary: You move your body in a pattern that evokes the small and clever Sister Mousedeer, misdirecting enemies and filling their vision with shadows to hide behind.

name: Inherit the Dreaming Heirloom
summary: Whether you always carried it or perhaps only recently inherited, you have a pusaka— an heirloom containing a spirit who you communicate with in your dreams.

name: Refined Motion in Darkness
summary: The ability to move elegantly and undetected through darkness aided your people as they fled the Netherworld.

name: Wayang Lore
summary: You can use your knowledge to enhance your performances or aid you in hiding.

name: Wayang Weapon Familiarity
summary: You learned to fight with weapons that help you keep your distance or make the most of striking from shadows.

name: Dissolution's Clarity
summary: The Dissolution teaches that darkness can bring clarity and focus, serenity and strength—and so you draw on nearby shadows to replenish your magic.

name: Shadowplay
summary: As your blow lands, you detach from your shadow to get the drop on your enemy.

name: Dance of the Tiger
summary: Tales tell of the Tiger stalking the Mousedeer for days, hidden and instilling dread upon its prey.

name: Dissolution's Sight
summary: Accepting your inner darkness means that no outer darkness can obscure your sight.

name: Rouse the Dreaming Relic
summary: The spirit within your pusaka resonates with other magical items in your possession.

name: Shadow Tempo
summary: As your ally moves past you, you match your movements to their rhythm, following them across the battlefield.

name: Dalang's Ally
summary: You move your shadow as a master puppeteer, allowing it to dance around your enemies and serve you in combat.

name: Dance of the Jester
summary: Through your incredible dance skill, you can embody the character of the Jester, able to take control of the shadows of other players on stage (much to your amusement).

name: Palm-leaf Silhouette
summary: You can make yourself as flat as a paper doll or shadow.

name: Slay Giants Unseen
summary: In the darkness, your attacks can bring any red-faced giant to their knees.

name: Dissolution's Sovereignty
summary: With discipline born from a lifetime in darkness, you convince the shadow of an enemy to fight by your side.

name: Sever the Dreaming Shadow
summary: As you whisper to your pusaka, it attempts to cut away an enemy’s shadow, leaving them in an eternal sleep.

name: Ash-piercing Gaze
summary: Neither cinders nor winds shall prevent you from seeing those who need help.

name: Avowed Insight
prerequisite: Yaksha heritage with an edict that requires you to confront a certain type of creature.
summary: You become trained in the Lore skill corresponding to one creature type mentioned by your vow (for example, Fey Lore if your heritage is deny the firstborn pursuit).

name: Bamboo and Silt Repose
summary: At home among mire and copse, you flit from river to tree with a dragonfly’s shimmering grace.

name: Howling Aspect
summary: Pulling your hair loose into flames and gnashing your teeth into ragged fangs, you howl a vow of ire, and your form surges to meet the demands of your deadly promise.

name: Meticulous Restorer
summary: Waste not, want not; your steady eye allows you to restore craftwork quickly while conserving valuable material.

name: Sage of Scattered Leaves
summary: The epics of your people’s tragic yet proud history blaze like burning leaves in the forests of ancestral memory.

name: Tangle-tongue's Wit
summary: Your talent for language is a blessing from the yaksha makers of old.

name: Unwavering Guide
summary: Sharp-eyed and sure-footed, your presence is a boon to those you guide.

name: Colugo's Traversal
summary: Forbidding valleys and sheer cliffs can’t curb your vows to reunite the lost.

name: Stem the Tide
summary: You can cast _protector tree_ as a 1st-rank primal innate spell once per day.

name: Withstand the Storm
summary: Your skin hardens like bark and gains the sheen of glazed clay, lessening the wild’s ruinous sting against your body.

name: Abjure the False Kin
summary: Your vow reminds you that there can be brackish vinegar hiding within honeyed words, helping you detect attempts to influence your mind.

name: Fiend-trampling Stature
summary: Fiends unfortunate enough to be trampled beneath your feet or rent within your grasp are swiftly granulated into bone kindling and blood powder, and the pain of your strikes prevents them from action.

name: Four-armed Aspect
summary: You intone vows to shoulder others’ pains; in response, your torso sprouts an additional pair of arms to help you bear those burdens.

name: Horn and Bone Incantation
summary: You invoke mantras of tellurian rebirth.

name: World-protector's Hospitality
summary: Through your spiritual power, you impede starvation and restore pantries.

name: Adamantine Mantra
summary: You attain your true potential as a tutelary spirit.

name: Germination of Resolve
summary: Vitality floods your trammeled soul, offering you rejuvenation, if not quite rest.

name: Wild-haired Fury
summary: Your broken bones jut at odd angles, yet this pain only adds to your anger and prowess.

name: Strength of Eight Legions
summary: You meditate for 24 hours in a one-time ceremony within a forest or cave; after your seclusion, your frame and limbs swell with warlike might to enact your vows.

name: Transcend the Azimuth
summary: As the earth drinks the light of sun and moon, so does your steady vow imbibe superlunary forces, ready to be unleashed with a moment’s mantra.

name: Crawling Form
prerequisite: Born of Animal heritage or Born of Celestial heritage
summary: You can transform into a small animal or celestial creature to scurry and spy.

name: Morphic Strike
summary: You can lash out with a portion of your previous self.

name: Natural Mutagen
summary: You can distill your natural shapeshifting ability into an elixir that grants a lesser ability to morph.

name: Polymorphic Escape
summary: You polymorph into a tiny vermin, a cloud of leaves, or another shape that allows you to escape.

name: Twilight Dweller
summary: You’re accustomed to shaded forests and caves.

name: Yaoguai Historian
summary: You know extensively about your own kind.

name: Among Humanity
summary: Your talents in shapechanging allow you to pass unseen.

name: Awakened Yaoguai Heritage
summary: You’ve delved into the power of your legacy.

name: Bold Defiance
summary: You harden your form as you dance between shapes.

name: Immobile Form
prerequisite: Born of Item heritage, Born of Elements heritage, or Born of Vegetation heritage
summary: You take on the shape you had before you awoke to hide in plain sight.

name: Kin Hunter
summary: You’re adept at combating other supernatural creatures.

name: Signature Weapon
summary: Your energy saturates one of your weapons; it might be one inherited or one tied to your history.

name: Brilliant Vision
summary: You ignore concealment from clouds, dust, fog, mist, smoke, and similarly loose matter.

name: Forever Among Humanity
summary: Passing unseen within society is second nature to you now.

name: Quick Recovery (Yaoguai)
summary: You use your command over your form to repair lifethreatening wounds.

name: Unleash Yaoguai Might
summary: As you enter your yaoguai form, you draw upon your internal magic to assume an even greater form.

name: Elucidation
summary: You can cut through illusions with such precision that all those around you find their senses sharpened as well.

name: Improved Signature Weapon
summary: Your signature weapon takes on the properties of mystical materials renowned for defeating undead, spirits, and other such creatures.

name: Unnerving Terror
summary: You let out a mighty howl, chant of death, or speak with eerie repetition that plants fear in others.

name: Gentle Death and Rebirth
summary: You were once born from the energies of the land and nature, and by their power, you can return to life again.

name: Legendary Monster
summary: Your yaoguai form has reached its pinnacle, allowing you to assume (or perhaps, return to) the form of a monster of legend.

name: Five-breath Vanguard Dedication
prerequisite: Two of the five elemental stances (Ironblood Stance, Mountain Stance, Reflective Ripple Stance, Stoked Flame Stance, and Tangled Forest Stance)
summary: You flow like the elemental cycle, adapting your stance and techniques constantly in response to whatever circumstances you face.

name: Renewing Cycle
summary: The first time each round that you Cycle Elemental Stance, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that last until the start of your next turn.

name: Induce Imbalance
summary: Your blows can disrupt the delicate balance of elemental energies that keep a body in good health.

name: Protective Cycle
summary: You react to harm by flowing into an elemental stance with new advantages.

name: Five Breaths, One Death
summary: You cycle through the elements in a devastating combination attack.

name: Strategist Stance
prerequisite: Marshal Dedication; Trained in Society or Trained in Lore; Warfare Lore
summary: You find the most strategic options for you and your allies.

name: Know Your Enemy
summary: You aim to turn knowledge into power against your foes.

name: Form Up!
summary: You’ve trained in battle formations for a plethora of situations.

name: General's Gambit
summary: You move strategically forward to draw the enemy’s attention away from your allies.

name: Spirit Warrior Dedication
summary: You’re a warrior who trains your spirit and body to work in perfect harmony, enhancing your attacks with your spiritual energy while fighting with a ferocious martial technique that combines blade and fist.

name: Kaiju Defense Oath
summary: You’ve sworn an oath to defend the helpless from dangerous titanic beasts, including kaiju that roam the surface of Golarion.

name: Sacred Wilds Oath
summary: You’ve sworn an oath to protect the holy places within nature and the spirits that dwell within, from ancient trees to primordial wild guardians.

name: Tricksterbane Oath
summary: You’ve sworn an oath to ferret out and destroy malevolent shapechangers who pose as mortals with evil intent.

name: Cutting Heaven, Crushing Earth
summary: Your skill in combining fist and blade has grown into a seamless art where each attack makes an opponent more vulnerable to the next.

name: Flowing Palm Deflection
summary: The simple and precise movements of your hands allow you to deflect blows with the same efficacy as a raised shield.

name: Spirit of the Blade
summary: You charge your blade with spiritual energy, allowing it to cut through spirits and fiends with fearsome efficiency.

name: Sword-light Wave
summary: You channel spiritual energy through your weapon, unleashing it as a torrent of devastating power.

name: Gods' Palm
summary: You control your spirit energy when you attack, using it to reinforce yourself or to thrust past your enemy’s physical defenses.

name: Sheltering Pulse
summary: You thrust your hand or weapon into the ground and release a pulse that creates a sheltering nexus of energy for you and your allies.

name: Transcendent Deflection
summary: You charge your weapon with spiritual energy and intercept the attack.

name: Intercepting Hand
summary: Your particular martial art includes various defensive actions designed to remove your opponent’s ability to cause harm.

name: Sword of Sealing
summary: Your spiritual power pierces both body and soul, pinning your foe in place.

name: Starlit Sentinel Dedication
summary: You’ve been chosen by one of the constellations of the Tian Xia zodiac.

name: Special Sentinel Technique
summary: You can channel the power of your constellation into a unique technique.

name: Blade of the Heart
summary: The bonds of the heart are stronger than any steel, more powerful than any magic.

name: Desperate Wish
summary: You call out a desperate wish to the stars to save a friend.

name: Sentinel's Orbit
summary: Just as your constellation traverses the sky, so too can you.

name: Fan Dancer Dedication
summary: You sweep across the battlefield, manifesting both the gentle spring breeze and the crisp autumn gusts.

name: Petal Step
summary: You have a mastery over your own movement and can distribute your weight to dance lightly over the ground like petals drifting on the water.

name: Solo Dancer
prerequisite: Fan Dancer Dedication; Expert in Performance
summary: You often dance alone with a grace exceeding that of most other performers, carrying yourself with a poise and confidence that draws the attention of those around you.

name: Twirl Through
summary: You sweep across the battlefield in a fluttering of movement honed from years of coordinating perfectly spaced movements alongside fellow dancers.

name: Fluttering Misdirection
summary: You’ve trained in drawing the eyes of your audience to specific aspects of your performance through the careful manipulation of your fans and body.

name: Sweeping Fan Block
summary: You leap up on one leg, snapping your fans open alongside your head before sweeping them across your body.

name: Pushing Wind
summary: As you spin and glide your fans alongside your allies, you kick up a mild wind that gently carries you all forward.

name: Twirling Strike
summary: Your fans, one raised up alongside your head and the other alongside your hip, become a blur as you twirl across the battlefield.

name: Close Formation
prerequisite: Fan Dancer Dedication; Master in Performance
summary: You practiced fan dance as a member of a large group, coordinating your moves together to create living art and heightening your sense of spatial awareness.

name: Dizzying Spin Dance
summary: You’re practiced in using your fans to spin with dizzying speed.

name: Fluttering Distraction
summary: You’re trained in snapping and fluttering your fans to draw the eyes of observers around you.

name: Sweeping Fan Redirection
prerequisite: Fan Dancer Dedication; Sweeping Fan Block
summary: You can redirect ammunition back at the creature that fired it with sweeping gusts of wind.

name: Peony's Flourish
summary: As you spin around and create wide arching circles with your fans, you manifest a mosaic of peonies that confuses your enemies.

name: Dragon's Journey
summary: Your movements are like that of a dragon weaving a serpentine path between your enemies and allies.

name: Wandering Chef Dedication
summary: Whether trained in a noble kitchen or a humble home, you know how to cook delicious dishes and source ingredients from the wilderness or urban settings.

name: Morning Side Dishes
summary: You know a proper breakfast should have a variety of sides.

name: Additional Servings
prerequisite: Wandering Chef Dedication; Expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore
summary: Your number of versatile vials per day increases to 5.

name: Food Preservation
summary: Your techniques extend the storage life for certain ingredients and food through pickling, alcohol, or fermentation.

name: Feast Planner
summary: You learn the fortifying brew ritual, but you instead prepare dishes for a lavish meal that have the same effect as the drinks from the normal version of the ritual.

name: Packed with Flavor
prerequisite: Wandering Chef Dedication; Expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore
summary: Edible morsels you create are particularly potent and bursting with flavor.

name: Cosmic Cocktail
summary: Using the liquors, vinegars, and fruits or herbs at your disposal, you spend 1 minute to create a cocktail with colors reminiscent of space and its stars.

name: Regional Specialty
summary: You can create dishes that reflect the food sources endemic to your environment and medicinal food techniques utilizing the cycle of the five elements.

name: Numbing Spice Exhalation
summary: You can mix alchemically preserved peppers into an alchemical food consumable to spice it up with alchemical fire.

name: Fermenting Liquors
summary: You always have a special batch of preserved liquor ready for each day.

name: Glitter Crystals
summary: You can mix a blend of crushed flowers and alchemical salt into an alchemical elixir with the healing trait or alchemical food.

name: Sour Bomb
summary: You can mix ingredients with a powerful sour smell into an alchemical bomb to make its explosion an overpowering stench.

name: Prepare Elemental Medicine
trait: Exploration, General, Manipulate, Secret, Skill, Uncommon
prerequisite: Trained in Crafting, Herbalism Lore, or Cooking Lore
summary: You diagnose your patient, then prepare and administer a dose of elemental medicine to a creature.

name: Acupuncturist
summary: You’ve studied the routes by which qi flows through the body.

name: Energy Fortification
prerequisite: Prepare Elemental Medicine; Expert in Occultism
summary: You learn Minkaian traditions about the void and know how to manipulate the five elements to fortify vitality and void energies in the body.

name: Pei Zing Adept
prerequisite: Prepare Elemental Medicine; Expert in Crafting, Herbalism Lore, or Expert in Medicine
summary: You’re practiced at timing preparations to the point where you can treat multiple patients at once.

name: Temperature Adjustment
prerequisite: Master in Crafting, Master in Medicine, or Herbalism Lore
summary: You learn Hwan temperature classifications for the elements—wood and water are cold elements, while fire, earth, and metal are hot elements.

name: Intensified Element Stance
summary: You expend the elemental medicine in your body to empower your attacks, though you can’t consume any more elemental medicine until the next day.

name: Protective Pose
summary: Many physical poses can fortify one’s health, but some poses need more than one body to accomplish.

name: Meditate on This!
trait: Barbarian, Concentrate, Emotion, Incapacitation, Mental, Rage, Uncommon
prerequisite: Trained in Medicine or Tian Xia Lore
summary: You meditate to alter your qi, coloring it with your resentment and anger.

name: Oil Fire
summary: Your armor includes flame-resistant gauntlets with oil-filled finger joints.

name: Wukong Extension
summary: Invoking the name of Sun Wukong’s extending cudgel, Ruyi Bang, you activate hidden levers and cranks in your innovation, making it swiftly extend outward like a battering ram.

name: Duo Dragon Kick
summary: You’ve practiced an impressive spin technique with your construct, automatically attacking in tandem as you launch each other through the air.

name: Silk Bracelet
prerequisite: armor innovation, construct innovation, or weapon innovation
summary: Taking inspiration from Desna’s image as a giant silk moth in Tian Xia, you’ve attached a bracelet to your innovation that generates ultra-strong silk strands mixed with venom.

name: Xidao Sea Mine Drop
summary: You’ve rigged your armor innovation with a gizmo that can safely synthesize two sea mines a day, holding them in a protected compartment.

name: Guardian Lion Roar
prerequisite: armor innovation, construct innovation, or weapon innovation
summary: Your innovation is augmented with plates shaped to resemble the gaping maws of guardian lions, which you can energize to expel a stream of sonic energy reminiscent of a lion’s powerful roar.

name: Geobukseon Retaliation
summary: Your armor has a retractable spike-covered shell reminiscent of Hwanggot’s heavily armored geobukseon, or “turtle ships.” The shell unfolds across your body, giving you a +4 circumstance bonus to AC and resistance 2 to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Celestial Cacophony
trait: Fire, Inventor, Manipulate, Sonic, Uncommon, Visual
summary: Your weapon contains a detonation chamber that launches fireworks, sparklers, and black powder pellets that sizzle, twist, and scatter on the ground in a cacophonous manner liable to annoy the entire Celestial Court.

name: Distant Waterbird's Poise
summary: You flow around your foe, using the magic of your attack to carry you away.

name: Heaven-Earth Encompassing Sleeves
summary: Your magic extends to your garments.

name: Vermilion Threads
prerequisite: Arcane Cascade; unfurling brocade hybrid study
summary: Your Arcane Cascade sends threads to the four directions, creating a web of strings dyed by your skill and your enemies’ blood.

name: Unsheathing the Sword-Light
summary: Honed through 10,000 battles, your sword’s mere light can shatter ambitions and break armies.

name: Cultivator Dedication
summary: Through an esoteric, often exacting, regimen of meditation, diet, and exercise, you’ve learned to transform your body’s inner workings into a crucible of planar and spiritual energies.

name: Immortal Lightness
summary: You breathe, allowing your golden core to release qi into the meridians governing your lower body, and break into a burst of speed that could shame arrows in flight.

name: Lotus Above the Mud
summary: Your qi, dancing ever diligently toward cultivation, eludes the grasp of the world’s muck and mire.

name: Three Clear Breaths
summary: Through your disciplined condensations and circulations of qi, you’ve caught a fleeting glimpse of cultivation’s promise, and your health has handsomely profited along the way.

name: Wisteria-and-Peony Reunion
summary: Your roots of qi stand firm, shaking off pains and aches like the returning flowers and leaves shed during winter’s snow.

name: Cultivator's Keen Eye
summary: Attuned to all arrangements of qi, you gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

name: Ghost-path Epiphany
summary: Deviating from the orthodox path, you tread an inauspicious descent littered with flowers of death; this heretical choice will, in time, earn you the enmity and fear of more traditional cultivators.

name: Three Pecks of Dew
summary: At this stage of cultivation, your body is as much spirit as flesh.

name: The Bitter Scholar's Promotion
summary: Tian Xia’s shining cities belie its empires’ long shadow of death, darkened by thousands of years of suffering and injustice.

name: The Immortal Attains the Summit
summary: Your cultivation bearing glorious fruit, you behold Heaven’s will.

name: Familiar Sage Dedication
prerequisite: You have a familiar, and you're able to cast spells.
summary: You’ve forged an empowered mystical bond with your familiar.

name: Familiar's Resolve
summary: When you weave magic, your familiar traces symbols that throw off fear and doubt.

name: Fulu Familiar
