prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Expert in Occultism or Expert in Religion
summary: You can imprint your familiar’s spiritual essence into a fulu, a small paper charm that can be affixed to objects, creatures, or structures.

name: Tempest Cloud's Speed
summary: You and your familiar coordinate to channel elemental air.

name: Familiar Ritualist
prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; ability to cast a ritual
summary: Your familiar’s magical presence can serve as an aspect of a ritual.

name: Golden Dragon's Bounty
summary: Your familiar alters the material of a spell into that of a precious metal.

name: Lightning Rings' Intervention
summary: Your familiar learns to empower spells with an electrical discharge.

name: Seal of the Golden Dragon
prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Golden Dragon's Bounty
summary: Your familiar coils around you, protecting you with its magical resistance.

name: Lightning Rings' Overcharge
prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Lightning Rings' Intervention
summary: Your familiar can adopt an electrical form to empower weapon strikes.

name: Vexing Tempest
prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Tempest Cloud's Speed
summary: Your familiar channels elemental air around it to unleash a disruptive gust that sends creatures flying.

name: Phoenix's Flight
summary: You and your familiar learn the secrets of elemental fire, allowing you to merge together to become a legendary creature—a phoenix.

name: Rushing Goat Stance
summary: You enter the stance of an unruly goat, lowering your body and preparing to butt heads with your foes.

name: Twisting Petal Stance
summary: Your body moves like a petal twisting on the wind, confounding your opponents while using their energy against them.

name: Advanced Monastic Weaponry
summary: Your rigorous training regimen allows you to wield complex weaponry with ease.
source: Tian Xia Character Guide pg. 120, Player Core 2 pg. 121

name: Momentous Charge
summary: You rush into your enemies with great and reckless force.

name: Kaiju Stance
summary: Your encounter with one of the rare forces of nature known as kaiju has imbued you with knowledge of a martial art that allows you to emulate a fraction of their power.

name: Scattering in Spring
summary: You evade an incoming attack by twisting your enemy’s tactics in your favor.

name: Five-gods Ram
summary: You attack in an unceasing flurry of charging headbutts.

name: Whirling in the Summer Storm
summary: Your hands move in a hypnotic and distracting flurry that throws your foes off-balance before you cast them away with a violent pirouette.

name: World-breaking Footfall
summary: You slam the ground and unleash a fearsome roar, sending broken shards of earth flying in all directions.

name: Wake of Devastation
summary: Like a kaiju, you leave a trail of destruction in your wake.

name: Adamantine Body
summary: With your strong will and even stronger body, you shrug off an otherwise devastating blow.

name: Echoing Violence
summary: Your powerful attack causes damage that reverberates through your opponent’s body, shaking muscle from bone.

name: Greater Transformation
summary: You can assume your oni form more easily, and with greater benefits.

name: Apparition Sense
summary: You can see and interact with things others can’t.

name: Circle of Spirits
summary: With a thought, word, or gesture, you reach your mind out to another spirit.

name: Relinquish Control
summary: Your apparition takes over and shields you from outside influence.

name: Spirit Familiar (Animist)
summary: When you attune to your apparitions during your daily preparations, you can choose to dedicate a small amount of your life force to allow one of them to physically manifest as a familiar, which gains the spirit trait.

name: Embodiment Of The Balance
summary: Your place in the balance between the forces of life and entropy expands the spells you can pull from the spirit realms.

name: Grasping Spirits Spell
summary: Gaining substance from your magic, your apparitions increase the range of your spells, which then pull your enemy closer.

name: Spiritual Expansion Spell
summary: Your apparitions manifest to scatter the energy of your spell.

name: Apparition's Enhancement
summary: Spiritual power encases your weapon or unarmed attack.

name: Channeled Protection
summary: Your apparition uses excess energy to protect you.

name: Walk the Wilds
summary: You know the ways of birds and beasts and have gained the right to wear their forms.

name: Apparition Stabilization
summary: Your attuned apparition ensures that even if you would be distracted or disrupted, your magic does not go to waste.

name: Blazing Spirit
summary: Your apparition grants fiery defenses.

name: Grudge Strike
summary: You channel the spiritual power of spiteful grudges.

name: Medium's Awareness
summary: Your apparitions watch over you.

name: Roaring Heart
summary: You surge forward inexorably.

name: Apparition's Reflection
summary: Your apparition infuses your body with additional power.

name: Instinctive Maneuvers
summary: When you allow an apparition control over your body, it might vent its fury against your foes.

name: Spirit Walk
summary: Your allied apparitions ward you against the predations of their restless peers.

name: Wind Seeker
summary: Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below.

name: Apparition's Quickening
summary: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, you can draw power from one of your attuned apparitions to reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

name: Fly on Shadowed Wings
summary: Your apparition embraces you, feeding on your magic to become a pair of protective wings.

name: Apparition Cloud
summary: With a mere thought, you discorporate your familiar into a thousand shards of spiritual magic, protecting both it and yourself from physical harm while making it difficult for enemies to move near you.

name: Shadows Within Shadows
summary: Your apparition possesses a furtive and elusive nature that can influence and blend with your spiritual energy to form a protective and nearly impenetrable shroud of nondetection around you.

name: Whisper of Warning
summary: Your protective apparitions alert you to an incoming attack.

name: Banish Falsehoods of Flesh
summary: Your ability to manipulate supernatural energy allows you to deploy divine magic directly against a disguised enemy to reveal them as they truly are, or to cleanse an ally from an unwilling transformation.

name: Cardinal Guardians
summary: You focus your divine magic to allow your apparitions to work in concert using the magic from one to weaken an enemy against the power of the next.

name: Forest's Heart
summary: You adopt a stance that allows your apparitions to channel spiritual energy down through you to inhabit roots, control vines, and command plant-life from the ground you stand on to fight on your behalf.

name: Jester's Gambol
summary: You adopt a stance that makes your movements carefree and sublimely unpredictable, allowing you to move past impediments with ease and resist the attacks and importunateness of natural threats.

name: Monstrous Inclinations
summary: Your apparitions share with you the monstrous nature of those creatures who dwell in deep seas or ancient woods.

name: Spiritual Spellshape Stance
summary: You feed excess magical power into your apparition, allowing it to grow ethereal limbs it can use to help shape and focus your spells.

name: Cycle of Souls
prerequisite: liturgist practice; at least one animist stance
summary: Your spiritual allies guide your movements, allowing you to prepare for the trials before you at a speed faster than thought.

name: Spirit's Sacrifice
summary: Your attuned apparition gathers all of the energy it can through your shared bond and uses that power to disperse itself while channeling the energy back into you, saving your life.

name: Eternal Guide
summary: Your attuned apparitions recognize that you still have essential work to do and refuse to allow you to pass on, gathering up your essence to carry your soul back to the community you call home.

name: True Channel Spell
summary: You are a true conduit for spiritual power, able to unleash the greatest spells.

name: Energized Spark
summary: The energy of your spirit manifests as crackling lightning, the chill of winter, or the power of an element.

name: Sanctified Soul
summary: You’ve drawn a line in the sand in the cosmic struggle between good and evil and chosen a side.

name: Twin Stars
summary: Your divine spark embodies a primordial duality, and your ikon splits itself accordingly into two corresponding halves.

name: Vow of Mortal Defiance
prerequisite: You are not sanctified with the holy or unholy trait.
summary: Having seen the wreckage left by the gods and their servitors as they play in their great war of good and evil, you’ve come to the only reasonable conclusion: they all must be cut from their silken thrones.

name: Hurl at the Horizon
summary: Your weapon flies from your hand as if propelled under its own power.

name: Leap the Falls
summary: Reinforcing your legs with divine energy, you can leap the battlefield as powerfully as a salmon clearing a waterfall.

name: Red-Gold Mortality
summary: By channeling your divinity into a creature along with a strike, you can disrupt their ability to recover.

name: Only the Worthy
summary: You can designate your ikons as movable by only your own hand, leaving them fixed in place as surely as if they were lodged in stone.

name: Steel on Steel
summary: The ring of divinely empowered steel assails your enemies.

name: Through the Needle's Eye
summary: Your weapon strikes with the perfection your will demands.

name: Binding Serpents Celestial Arrow
summary: As you prepare to shoot your weapon, you invoke divine serpents that bind your enemies.

name: Flow of War
summary: Divine battle instincts take over your body, letting you move and lash out with instinctive speed.

name: Motionless Cutter
summary: Your weapon is so sharp even an insect alighting upon its still blade would be severed.

name: Additional Ikon
summary: Your story has grown rich enough that three ikons can’t contain its full complexity.

name: Battle Hymn to the Lost
prerequisite: of verse unbroken or peerless under heaven
summary: Your movements in combat are an artistic dirge to those spirits who could not fight to see another day.

name: Raise Island
prerequisite: born of the bones of the earth or restless as the tides
summary: You churn the sea and fish up stone so your enemies together can receive their punishment.

name: Rejoice in Solstice Storm
prerequisite: whose cry is thunder or dancer in the seasons
summary: You hold your arms out, and the fury of the seasons comes to your jubilant embrace.

name: Breath of Vital Ash
summary: Reddish ash stains your ikon, impossible to clean off.

name: Exult in Violence
summary: You let out a war cry as your blow lands true, and judgment descends on an enemy.

name: Fish from the Falls' Edge
summary: Seeing your ally fall, you let out a cry, sending your divine spark to them temporarily to keep them from tumbling down the River of Souls.

name: Journey Of the Sky Chariot
summary: Small wings, flaming wheels, or another signifier of flight sprout from your ikon as it gains the power to lift you from the ground.

name: Mated Birds in Paired Flight
summary: Your ikons bond like a pair of one-winged birds.

name: Compliant Gold
summary: You can command your weapon to shrink or grow, for convenience or power.

name: Extract Vow of Nonviolence
summary: You entice or threaten a weapon, making it swear not to harm you.

name: Rapid Spark
summary: Your spark shifts to where it needs to be.

name: Warped by Rage
summary: Rage courses through your body, transforming you into a beast of battle.

name: Complete the Hero's Journey
summary: As your divine spark travels through each of your ikons in turn, it gains power, culminating its journey when it enters your third ikon.

name: Destined Victory
summary: You demand a battle against your chosen enemy.

name: Infinite Blades Celestial Arrow
summary: Each shot you launch multiplies itself with spiritual blades, rings, and other missiles that shower upon your foes.

name: Crown of Rule
summary: This badge of office proclaims your sovereignty.

name: Gift of the Immortal Herb
summary: Your blood turns a divine gold, shining in moments its spilled and begetting new life.

name: Mark of The Sage
summary: Your ikon gains a pin, stripe, or similar marking showing you as a master of your craft.

name: Shroud of Ghosts
summary: Your ikon is connected to the world of the spirits, allowing you to partially fade into their realm.

name: Strike Rivers, Seize Winds
summary: Through sheer physical force, you can wrestle a river, lasso the winds, punch a hole to the molten center of the planet, or create other environmental disturbances via nothing but your own strength.

name: Branched Tree Of Pain
summary:
The blade of your ikon takes one or more notches, capable of dealing mortal pain to your foes.

**Immanence** When you Strike with the ikon, you critically succeed if you roll a 19 on the die as long as that result would be a success.

name: Eternity-Incinerating Blaze
summary: The blaze of your divine spark is hot enough that it burns in not just the present, but the past and future as well.

name: Seven-Colored Cosmic Bridge
summary: Your divine spark shines in a riot of shimmering colors, capable of carrying you through the world as fast as light itself.

name: Sunwrecker
summary: Your weapon has the might of legends, capable of shooting or striking any light out of the sky.

name: Cutting Without Blade
summary: While tales of your divine ikons have spread far and wide, you’ve realized that, as they are all manifestations of your soul, the object itself is unnecessary.

name: Reach for Immortality
summary: Your divine spark is now a bonfire in your soul, bringing you to the very cusp of undying immortality.

name: Remake the World
summary: For the briefest of moments, you can reach into the realm of true gods, gaining the power to shape reality to your will.

name: Aeonbound
summary: Your lineage is influenced or directly tied to the supernatural inhabitants of the Perfect City of Axis, a realm of pure and absolute order.

name: Battleblooded
summary: You descend from those whose lives were touched by legendary einherjars, who were crafted from the souls of mighty warriors slain in battle and chosen by valkyries to serve as foot soldiers to many gods.

name: Faultspawn
summary: You bear a grudge, inherited from a blasphemous asura forebear in your bloodline, against a particular deity and their works.

name: Proteankin
summary: Your blood bubbles with the roiling quintessence of the Maelstrom, the infinite sea of primal chaos that long ago spawned the other Outer Planes.

name: Creative Prodigy
summary: You have a powerful creative drive that is clear to any who interact with you.

name: Intuitive Crafting
summary: Your affinity with process and order makes you a natural artisan.

name: Irrepressible (Ganzi)
summary: Your slight otherworldly nature allows you to easily brush off emotional manipulation.

name: Sublime Mobility
summary: Your heritage has granted you either impressive athletic skill or a physical feature that aids in traversal.

name: Amorphous Aspect
summary: Your body is supremely flexible.

name: Bestial Brutality
summary: Your animalistic unarmed attack grows more dangerous.

name: Call to Battle
summary: You channel the undying spirit of the einherjar to join to fight.

name: Extraplanar Haze
summary: Your body emits tiny particles of extraplanar matter, such as crystalline motes or smoky vapor, that surround you in a haze.

name: Resilient Physiology
summary: Your ordered physiology rejects unwelcome elements, allowing you to reject the negative effects of poisons and diseases or shrug off other lasting negative effects.

name: Towering Presence
summary: You tap into your planar heritage and momentarily grow larger through force of will.

name: Anarchic Arcana
summary: The magic in your blood is unpredictable.

name: Extraplanar Cloud
summary: When you use Extraplanar Haze, you can spend 1 additional action to disperse the particles as a 10-foot-radius cloud centered on you instead of as a haze; the activity gains the concentrate trait.

name: Glory and Valor!
summary: You call upon your ascendant blood with a mighty cry that fills you with a revitalizing energy for 1 minute or until you critically fail a Strike, whichever comes first.

name: Larcenous Tail
summary: You can perform minor mischief with your tail.

name: Methodical Magic
summary: You can reorder the world with your magic.

name: Alter Resistance
summary: You focus on your protean forebears to change your energy resistance.

name: Arise, ye Worthy!
summary: A touch of valkyrie magic in your blood lets you hold back death’s grasp.

name: Impose Order
summary: You shift the underlying fabric of reality to impose a baseline of order.

name: Channel the Godmind
summary: You tap into the collective consciousness of the Godmind, the governing entity of axiomite society, to rapidly parse near-infinite variables to read your surroundings.

name: Pandemonium Eruption
summary: You unleash the pent-up chaos within you, becoming a nexus of unbridled destruction that wreaks unfettered havoc on everyone in your vicinity.

name: Animist Dedication
summary: You have formed a bond with an apparition and can cast divine spells.

name: Basic Animist Spellcasting
summary: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.

name: Spiritual Awakening
summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level animist feat.

name: Animist's Power
summary: You gain one animist feat.

name: Apparition Magic
summary: You can cast more divine spells each day.

name: Expert Animist Spellcasting
prerequisite: Basic Animist Spellcasting; Master in Religion
summary: You gain the  expert spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.

name: Master Animist Spellcasting
prerequisite: Expert Animist Spellcasting; Legendary in Religion
summary: You gain the  master spellcasting benefits as a prepared divine caster.

name: Exemplar Dedication
summary: A spark of inherent divine power has lit itself within you.

name: Basic Glory
summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level exemplar feat.

name: Exemplar Resilency
prerequisite: Exemplar Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier
summary: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each exemplar archetype class feat you have.

name: Advanced Glory
summary: You gain an exemplar feat.

name: Exemplar Expertise
summary: Your soul has been further tempered in divine power.

name: Second Ikon
summary: You gain an additional ikon, selected from those listed here.

name: Avenger Dedication
summary: Your training regimen has given you particular advantages when it comes to enforcing the interests of your faith.

name: Zealous Inevitability
summary: You channel your zeal through a sacred weapon, bringing a foe closer to their demise.

name: Silence the Profane (Avenger)
summary: Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy priests from using their magic against you, a technique you have now mastered and adapted.

name: Shadow of Death
summary: Strikes you make with your deity’s favored weapon against a creature with the doomed condition have the death trait, causing the target to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

name: Slay
summary: You finish your target with a vicious attack.

name: Haft Striker Stance
summary: You enter a stance that allows you to leverage the haft of your weapon to brutal effect as an effective and frighteningly efficient weapon in its own right.

name: Haft Beatdown
summary: The momentum of each of your attacks feeds into the next blow in the routine, creating a brutal rhythm that enables you to give your target one continuous beatdown.

name: Bloodrager Dedication
summary: Drinking powerful blood has awakened magical potential within you.

name: Blood Calls Blood
summary: The magical potency of your blood will not be denied.

name: Rising Blood Magic
summary: The power within your blood grows.

name: Siphon Magic
summary: You gorge upon the magical energies of your foe’s blood.

name: Spelldrinker
summary: You temporarily add a 3rd-rank spell to your spell repertoire, as determined by the type of creature whose blood you just drank.

name: Hematocritical
summary: You bathe in the arterial fluids of your enemy, drinking deep of their freed essence to empower your magic and increase your spellcasting efficacy.

name: Surging Blood Magic
prerequisite: Rising Blood Magic; master in Arcana or Religion, depending on your chosen tradition
summary: Your blood courses with magic.

name: Exultant Blood Magic
prerequisite: Surging Blood Magic; legendary in Arcana or Religion, depending on your chosen tradition
summary: The magic in your blood sings an exultant song of battle.

name: Seneschal Witch Dedication
summary: As you work to understand the connection with your missing patron, it’s increasingly easy to form bonds with those around you.

name: Patron's Glamour
summary: Gathering up threads of your old connection, you can temporarily disguise yourself as your missing patron.

name: Seneschal Spell
summary: You can channel even complex spells through your connection to your charge.

name: Multifaceted Will
summary: Without the firm hand of a patron, your power begins to reflect deeper complexities, sometimes latching onto entirely unexpected sources of magical potency.

name: Spiritual Secret
summary: You gain deeper insights into your patron’s abandoned power, allowing you to draw on that power more directly.

name: Watcher on the Wall
summary: You claim a patron’s symbol that you can etch onto any surface.

name: Patron's Whisper
summary: You gain the ability to speak to your charge over great distances.

name: Unstable Patronage
summary: You can act as a magical patron for your charges.

name: Patron Reborn
summary: You have fully realized the ability to serve as a patron.

name: Vindicator Dedication
summary: Your church ensures that you are cared for.

name: Interrogate
summary: You ask questions you know will be answered.

name: Silence the Profane (Vindicator)
summary: Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy spellcasters from using their prayers against you.

name: Vindicator's Judgement
summary: You can pronounce judgment on your foes, making them magically susceptible to your attacks.

name: Call The Hunt
summary: You instruct your allies on how best to defeat your prey.

name: Warrior Of Legend Dedication
summary: You have been given a powerful blessing of battle that is also your cursed doom.

name: Heroic Defiance
summary: Even as shadows of your doom haunt the corners of your vision, your implacable spirit surges and cries out that your time has not yet come.

name: Piercing Doom
summary: You have grown accustomed to the curse that comes with your blessing, able to channel its effects through your attacks and forestall your own demise.

name: Spear of Doom
summary: The conditions for your doom have been met, and you brace yourself for a battle that will see you either live to fight another day or die a legend.

name: Know thy Doom
summary: As your legend grows, details of your demise become clearer.

name: Only My Doom May Claim Me
summary: The power of your legend, fueled by your legendary deeds, resists any weapon that is not tied to your curse.

name: Razor's Edge
summary: Your curse and your power are one and the same, and you accept both equally.

name: Spear Dancer
summary: You favor weapons that allow you to lash out viciously while keeping enemies at bay, giving you an opportunity to strike without fear of reprisal.

name: Needle In The God's Eyes
summary: With sinews of bronze and thews of iron, you leap to the heavens, piercing the arrogant eyes of the gods.

name: Arms that Cut the Waves
summary: River, lake, sea, or ocean, the water calls to you, and you don’t fear its depths.

name: Binds that Tie
summary: You excel at assisting in capturing your foes.

name: Ears that Hear the Truth
summary: You have an acute understanding of the rhythms of living things, and you never miss the quaver that betrays a spoken lie.

name: Feet that Stride the Sky
summary: You feel the call of the sky, or perhaps a desperate urge to test the limits of the earth’s hold on you.

name: Hands that Unweave Disaster
summary: Your hands move with uncanny sureness, dismantling danger.

name: Storied Companion
prerequisite: handler's calling; you have an animal companion or pet
summary: Your companion is an integral part of your story, and you can expend your mythic power to protect it, defying events that would prevent it from being so.

name: We've Met Before
summary: Your ability to discern information about those you interact with is without peer.

name: Become Shadow
summary: You unleash your mythic power to shroud yourself in darkness and silence to stalk your prey.

name: Cutting Rebuke
summary: If words could kill, the poet might rule the world.

name: Godspeed
summary: Mythic power grants you speed to rival beasts and demigods.

name: Prescience
summary: Mythic power floods through your mind, filling you with visions of possible futures, events that might or might not happen, and warnings of things that might be.

name: Read The Wind
summary: You can derive meaning from the tiniest details when tracking an enemy.

name: Unbelievably Believable
summary: Your words echo with soothing and convincing power.

name: Unending Subsistence
summary: Your mythic power allows you to take a small amount of food and replicate it near endlessly.

name: Correct The Story
summary: You know the story of your journey well and can correct it when your enemy tells it incorrectly.

name: Divert Destiny
summary: You defy the fate before you, calling on wells of mythic vitality to sustain your life and allow you to persevere.

name: Fling Into action
summary: You release mythic power to turn disaster into opportunity and hurl yourself into an advantageous position.

name: Mythic Counterspell
prerequisite: Quick Recognition; ability to cast spells from spell slots,; Sage's Calling
summary: You quench and counter your enemy’s magic with potent spellcraft amplified and enhanced by carefully deployed mythic power.

name: Repel Assault
summary: Your Calling demands that you defy danger and injury to yourself or those who rely on you while allowing you to respond to the originators of such aggression with ferocious and unrivaled fury.

name: Unrivaled Retort
summary: You defy the death and destruction around you while using it to fuel your mythic power, spurring you on to acts of incredible speed and empowering a mighty ranged counterattack.

name: Arc of Destruction
summary: You redirect an incoming weapon or projectile and send your enemy’s own attack roaring back at them, increasing its accuracy with a surge of mythic power.

name: Mythic Allies
prerequisite: ability to cast spells from slots, at least one summon spell in your spellbook or repertoire
summary: You channel mythic power through your body and into a summoned ally, temporarily reinforcing them with a shared fraction of your mythic potential.

name: Mythic Magic
summary: You convert your mythic power into a magical effect.

name: Mythic Refocus
summary: As your ability to control your mythic power grows, you learn to channel it to restore and reinforce other forms of power at your command.

name: Steal Magic
summary: You don’t just counter your enemy’s magic, you instantly master it and make it your own.

name: Summon Mythic Power
summary: You call upon fate, divinity, or whatever other power has carried you this far, demanding that it carry you just a little bit farther.

name: Unbelievable Interception
summary: You move with unbelievable alacrity to intercept an enemy’s attack.

name: Become Destiny
summary: You defy any external force blocking your mythic purpose.

name: Call from Death's Door
summary: Even death halts in the face of your power.

name: Eyes that See Eternity
summary: Mythic power opens your eyes to the secrets of reality and eternity.

name: Mythic Casting
summary: You can infuse mythic power directly into your spells to make them exceptionally potent.

name: Mythic Containment
summary: You infuse a receptacle, such as a normal bag, sack, or box, with mythic power, transforming it into a prison into which you can command a creature.

name: Mythic Strike
summary: You infuse your weapon or unarmed attack with mythic power before lashing out at an enemy with devastating force.

name: Unbreaking Castle
summary: You’re the bulwark that doesn’t break.

name: Apocalypse Rider Dedication
summary: In the darkest hour of the night, a fearsome and terrible steed arrives as a gift from a powerful daemonic patron.

name: Behold, A Pale Horse
summary: Your apocalypse mount becomes worthier of an eventual Rider of the Apocalypse.

name: History of Violence
summary: Your attacks bring with them echoes of previous battles, calling the unquiet victims of your most brutal acts to savage your opponents.

name: Jousting Mount
summary: While riding your apocalypse mount, any two-handed weapon you wield gains the jousting trait with a die size equal to one die size lower than the weapon’s normal damage die.

name: One Among The Masses
summary: It will take more than a gathered mass of foes to take you down.

name: Putrefaction
summary: You spoil the food and water nearby, even within your foes’ bodies.

name: Night Terror
summary: Buoyed by your fearsome reputation, your steed can take flight.

name: Steal Death
summary: As a harbinger of daemonkind, you gain authority to delay the death of others if it serves your purposes, and in doing so, you bolster the well-being of both you and your mount to allow you sow further havoc.

name: To War!
summary: You inspire your allies to greater battle prowess while trampling enemies in your way.

name: Virulent Strike
summary: Those afflicted by certain maladies are closer to death in your presence.

name: Wither Away
prerequisite: Apocalypse Rider Dedication; Battle Harbinger Dedication
summary: You hasten the passage of time for a living creature, prematurely aging them into decrepitude.

name: Contagious Spell
summary: Your magic can bring devastation to more individuals.

name: Deathless Servant
summary: The servants of apocalypse know that it is impossible to cheat death, but your will is sufficient to help you outlive even your strongest enemies.

name: Memory of Nothing
summary: With a look and a gesture, you turn a thinking creature’s mind against itself, causing the creature to struggle to remember how to perform more complex actions.

name: Soul Vessel Mount
summary: Your mount has a supernatural hunger for mortal souls that you can feed.

name: Immortal Ruin
summary: Your commitment to ending all life earns you a measure of immortality, setting the stage for you to become a true Rider of the Apocalypse, possibly supplanting one of the Four.

name: Archfiend Dedication
summary: Driven by your Calling, you’ve begun to make plans for your own personal realm from whence you’re destined to rule over an army of fiends.

name: Don thy Fervor
summary: With a thought, the passion of your fiendish desires becomes evident in your eyes and posture.

name: Lord of the Fiends
summary: You consider every fiend a future subject and can assess them at a glance.

name: Manipulate Realm
summary: Thanks to your continued belief in your ultimate transformation, you have learned greater control over your manifested realm.

name: Marshall Fiendish Forces
summary: You have been in contact with a retinue of fiends, brokering all manner of deals so that they may eventually serve you.

name: Realm Strider
summary: You can teleport across the battlefield, disappearing and appearing in a burst of hellfire and brimstone, a flash of lightning, a cloud of caustic gas, or other environmental hazard common within your planned realm.

name: Seat of Power
summary: Your sheer determination has created a demiplane that houses a grand residence which will serve as the heart of your planned realm.

name: Brandish Authority
summary: With a terrifying pronouncement, you manifest a visible sign of your authority and fiendish power, such as a crown of flame upon your brow, a scepter forged of solidified souls, or a throne comprised of a dozen dragon skulls.

name: Imprison Foe
summary: Rather than grant your foes the mercy of a swift death, you can consign them to suffer in an extradimensional prison with an appearance of your choosing.

name: Profane Bargain
summary: You can strike a profane bargain with a willing, sapient creature.

name: Fiend Eternal
summary: Through all your machinations and accumulation of power, you have completed your apotheosis and become a true archfiend.

name: Ascended Celestial Dedication
summary: Your Calling has driven you to perform mortal deeds that will result in your ascension to the ranks of celestials.

name: Aegis for the Innocent
summary: You transfer a portion of your divine spark to an ally, temporarily dimming your nimbus to encase an ally in a barrier of light that repels attackers.

name: Ascend
summary: As you strive to ascend to the ranks of celestials, the pull of gravity loosens on your body.

name: Consult Celestial Advisor
summary: For many, the Calling of an ascended celestial is a wondrous but challenging path, which they must walk alone.

name: Channel Divine Spark
summary: You embrace your divine spark, unleashing your full potential.

name: Abjure Harm
summary: You’re nigh invincible, and it’s clear that your foe is so far beneath you that they have no hope of winning.

name: A Thousand Cries For Help
summary: You’ve learned to communicate with creatures from all over the world, overcoming language barriers to lend a hand and help where you’re needed.

name: Celestial Armaments
summary: You imbue a fragment of your divine spark into a weapon, blessing your blade and transforming it into a weapon worthy of the celestial realms.

name: Cleansing Spell
summary: Infused with celestial light, your magic can more effectively heal wounds and purge afflictions.

name: Army of One
summary: Even alone, you’re a force to be reckoned with— an army of one, so long as you have your celestial armaments.

name: Eyes Unclouded
summary: Your senses are enhanced by your divine spark, enabling you see things as they truly are, piercing through illusions, transformations, and lies.

name: Shining Glory
summary: With a righteous word, your divine aura inspires your allies to great heroics and causes foes to tremble.

name: Scouring Spark
summary: When you unleash your divine spark, you become a being of living light that scours away the darkness.

name: Celestial Rebirth
summary: Through your diligence and commitment to heroics, you finally complete your apotheosis into a true celestial.

name: Beast Lord Dedication
prerequisite: a mature animal companion or an advanced construct companion
summary: Your Calling has united your destiny with a companion, harnessing a connection between you that links your minds, hearts, and souls.

name: Chosen Ward
summary: You have designated an ally to be you and your companion’s ward, making it your primary directive to shield them from harm.

name: Guarded Domain
summary: You and your united companion have elected to become guardians of a particular location or domain.

name: We are One
summary: You and your companion move as one, never tripping each other up.

name: You Can't Hide From Us
summary: When you and your companion attack together, you can ensure that escape is but a whispered dream.

name: Bat Around
summary: Your attack moves a foe into a position that your united companion can take full advantage of.

name: Defend Our Union
summary: You can protect your companion from danger with a welltimed attack.

name: Telepathic Union
summary: Your union is so strong, you can communicate with each other without uttering a word, even across vast distances.

name: Unified Stance
summary: You and your companion enter a unified fighting style that allows you to fight in tandem more succinctly.

name: Creature of Myth
prerequisite: Beast Lord Dedication; you have a united companion with a specialization.
summary: Your specialized united companion grows with unparalleled power and strength, becoming a creature of myth.

name: Pack Of The Beast Lord
summary: You and your united companion call upon the service of others of its kind, creating figment duplicates of your companion to form a massive swarm of formidable power.

name: One Life, Two Vessels
summary: The minds of you and your companion are so intertwined that, so long as one of you lives, the other continues to exist in the living one’s mind.

name: Broken Chain Dedication
summary: Your Calling was sparked by your outrage at tyrants, after having witnessed a brutal act of oppression that you could no longer abide.

name: Bloc Tactics
summary: You have experience in undertaking direct action and know how to protect the identity and health of you and your allies when doing so.

name: Break the Cycle
summary: Sometimes people with no underlying quarrel have been fighting each other simply out of spite.

name: Release Me!
summary: Your retribution against one who would detain you is swift and dangerous.

name: Rites of Liberation
summary: You learn the _freedom_ ritual.

name: United Front
summary: Thanks to your powerful speeches, your movement finds allies in all sectors of society and even across enemy lines, all eager to help you accomplish your goals.

name: You Can't Keep Us Down
summary: Seeing your allies falter, you fill their hearts with your unbreakable hope, rousing them to stay in the fight.

name: Bring into the Fold
summary: Not all who oppress are irredeemable, and given encouragement and some time, they will abandon their cause and join your fight against the very system they used to uphold.

name: Cry of Rebellion
summary: You let loose a yell of unbridled passion, which fuels your allies, and pounds against your foes.

name: Lose Your Chains
summary: You rouse rebellion in the hearts of your allies, inspiring them to break free of their bonds.

name: Remember thy Names
summary: You peer into the eyes of a target of your Ultimatum of Liberation, as you say aloud the names of their victims, searing them into the oppressor’s mind, cursing them to feel their victims’ pain.

name: Stand Firm
summary: Your words help your ally shake off unease and terror.

name: Liberty or Death
summary: You have given a despot enough time to think, and now is the time for them to forfeit their control or die.

name: Rebellious Existence
summary: You have tied yourself so absolutely to the cause of liberty that your very existence is an act of rebellion.

name: Reprisal of the Fallen
summary: You can feel the sorrow, pain, and rage of those fallen to oppression, peering from just behind the veil of death, and you can bring them forth to exact their revenge.

name: Break the Causal Chain
summary: Something terrible has happened.

name: You Can't Kill an Idea
summary: Those who would destroy you instead transform you into a powerful yet formless entity.

name: Eternal Legend Dedication
summary: As your renown as a fighter grows, your Calling comes to fruition.

name: Demolishing Knockback
summary: You make a forceful attack that has the power to push your foe through walls.

name: Earth to Heavens Strike
summary: Your blows hamper both a foe’s mobility and cognitive functions by focusing first on their lower extremities and then their head.

name: Fautless Defense
summary: As you are struck, your steely determination reminds those who fight you that they are destined to be no more than footnotes in your tale.

name: Immovable Object
prerequisite: Eternal Legend Dedication; master in Fortitude or Reflex Saves
summary: You plant your feet in a wide stance, resisting all movement not of your own volition.

name: Scattering Shout
summary: With a flex of your mighty thews and a guttural bellow that can make ears bleed, you drive back any enemies surrounding you.

name: Death from Above
summary: Seemingly to defy gravity, you use a nearby vertical surface to propel yourself upward and then strike downward like the driving rain.

name: Leaping Hedgehog Strike
summary: You pounce toward an enemy and then barrel them over with one fluid movement, ending this maneuver with an attack that may catch them off-balance.

name: Pierce The Eye
summary: You aim a shot from your weapon directly at a foe’s eye, blinding them in the process.

name: Terrifying Mien
prerequisite: Eternal Legend Dedication; Master in Intimidation
summary: Whether they have heard of your legend or seen your prowess on the field of battle, those already quaking in their boots grow weak when forced to stand against you.

name: Weft and Warp
summary: With graceful poise, you perform a dance of dangerous attacks.

name: Exaltation Overwhelming
summary: Raising your weapon or fist aloft, you begin to gleam with dazzling radiance.

name: Legend of Combat
summary: You can deliver a lightning-fast series of blows and strikes, bringing all the strength of your legend to bear against those who have yet to experience your prowess.

name: Mythic Weapon Specialization
prerequisite: Eternal Legend Dedication; greater weapon specialization
summary: When you fully embrace your Calling, your blows hit with incredible force that can fell even the mightiest of creatures.

name: Unstoppable Force
summary: While you are in the stance provided by Immovable Object, you ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

name: Fight Through Oblivion
summary: Mortal wounds that would kill other warriors are no more than the flutter of butterfly wings to you.

name: Finish Their Story!
summary: Though your tale is immortal, your foes aren’t afforded such an advantage and mainly serve only to further your legend.

name: Living Epic
summary: You are a living legend, a being who cannot be claimed by death, as death has already passed you.

name: Godling Dedication
summary: Your Calling allows you to begin walking the path to true deific ascension, inspiring followers as your divine seed grows.

name: Claim Cardinal Domains
summary: Your dominion over the divine truths of the world increases.

name: Divine Invulnerability
summary: Though you are not yet a god, you can invoke a measure of omnipotence that makes you high invulnerable.

name: Receive Prayers
summary: You open your senses so the prayers of mortals can better reach your ears.

name: Absolve Sins
summary: Your forgiveness is without limit, though the path to penitence can be painful, especially against those who have trespassed against your current mortal form.

name: Font of Life or Death
summary: As you reach ever higher in your quest to achieve true divinity, the powers of life and death flow evermore easily from you.

name: Gird Champion
summary: Your will manifests into divine weapons to protect and arm your followers.

name: Pass Vengeful Judgement
summary: To prevent yourself from frivolously calling down the terrible power of divine wrath, you have vowed to do so only with the assent of your mortal hierophant.

name: Sanctified Relic
summary: You fill an item with your divine power, granting the wearer your blessings.

name: Stymie the Gods
summary: By exerting your will as a nascent god present in the mortal realms, you can hold off the influences of most distant entities, even ones much older and more powerful than yourself.

name: Assume Godhood
summary: You complete your apotheosis into living godhood, allowing you to empower more followers.

name: Prophesied Monarch Dedication
summary: Your Calling has culminated in a destiny of rulership, and you’re able to forge a mythic bond with noble knights whose destinies become intertwined with your own.

name: Bloom of Health
summary: You shout a rallying cry that inspires the well-being of your kingdom’s protectors.

name: Decree of Banisment
summary: You assume a demeanor of authority and decree banishment upon a foe who has defied your authority.

name: Decree of Prosperity
summary: You speak with a gentle encouragement that inspires confidence and competence in your followers.

name: Might of the Realm
summary: Bolstered by the presence of your knights, you strike a mighty blow in the name of your rule.

name: Kneel Before the Rightful Heir
summary: You command that your foes bow down before you or face your wrath.

name: My Kingdom, My Blood
summary: The health of the ruler is the health of the kingdom, and the health of the kingdom is that of its ruler, each bound to the other inextricably.

name: Noble Sacrifice
summary: As your knights devote their lives and swords to you, so too do you return their devotion with your own fierce protection.

name: Protect the Royal Line
summary: You must keep your royal person safe from harm, especially when surrounded by those who would dare approach you.

name: Decree of Execution
summary: You proclaim that a foe has violated the sanctity of your realm and must die.

name: Decree of War
summary: You declare your current foes as irredeemable enemies, calling your allies down upon them.

name: Fated Duel
summary: You and your knights are an unbeatable force together, but sometimes it’s a monarch’s duty to resolve the fate of their kingdom with nothing more than their own trusted weapon.

name: Sovereign's Blade
summary: As you raise your weapon into the air, it begins to shed a bright light that pierces darkness and calls your knights to your side.

name: Legacy of Monarchs
summary: No matter what might happen to you, your legacy shall never die.

name: Once and Future
summary: Though foul treachery might lay you low or dark magic still your heart, when the people cry out for you in desperate need, you shall rise to protect them.

name: Wildspell Dedication
prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots
summary: You gain the ability to tap into a powerful well of magic.

name: Extend Surge
summary: You tap deeper into the vortex of magical energy within you.

name: Invigorating Surge
summary: You alter the aura of magic surrounding you to protect a nearby ally.

name: Mythic Heightening
summary: You overload your minor spells to give them greater effect.

name: Spell Network
summary: Your aura links your friends together with mystic strands.

name: Burning Surge
summary: You cause a surge of magical energy to flare up, harming that creature and those near it.

name: Imbue Spell
summary: You pass the energy of your magic onto an ally, allowing another to release the spell.

name: Mystical Flare
summary: You release a torrent of magic to fill the air with tiny, distracting explosions of light.

name: Rapid Switch
summary: You’ve honed your control over your _spellsurge_ aura and can rapidly alter its effects.

name: Recharging Transference
summary: You can break your spells down into raw magical potential and transfer it to an ally.

name: Thundering Surge
summary: Your magic explodes in bursts of excess energy, creating thunderous waves.

name: Galvanize Spell
summary: You reabsorb the magic of your _spellsurge_ aura to power a piece of powerful magic.

name: Mana Detonation
summary: You can violently discorporate your form.

name: Mythic Counter
summary: You can overwhelm the magical designs of others with sheer magic power.

name: Mystic Life Force
summary: Magic energy sustains you, supporting your form far beyond the capabilities of mere flesh.

name: Surging Interference
summary: You absorb the scattered energy of others’ failed spells, using it to recharge your own magic.

name: Channeler's Stance
summary: You enter a stance that allows power to flow through you.

name: Spell-Woven Shot
summary: You combine your own magic with that of your magical crossbow or firearm.

name: Campfire Chronicler Dedication
summary: You’ve gained Isthralei’s attention and can now offer stories up to him

name: The Dead Tell Tales
summary: New campfire chroniclers are inundated with the stories of the ghosts below Pulura’s Fall and the lessons learned there.

name: Listener's Boon
summary: Isthralei has given you a gift to assist you on your journey.

name: Raging Stories
summary: When you Offer a Story about wild chances and fighting against all odds, you can wrap yourself in spectral flame in place of the normal benefits.

name: Cozy Campfire
summary: You spend 1 hour building a campfire in a single unoccupied square and whispering the stories of those you’ve met on your journeys.

name: Illuminating Stories
summary: Stories serve as beacons in the night, illuminating valuable knowledge even if the tale itself misses the mark.

name: Flickering Stories
summary: Stories, like fires, can create shadows as much as they illuminate.

name: Tales of the Road
summary: The blessings of Isthralei connect you to the thrum of the stories that underlie all settlements.

name: Stories of Home
trait: Archetype, Auditory, Divine, Exploration, Healing, Linguistic, Mental
summary: You share the joy of every story of long-awaited homecoming you’ve offered to Isthralei.

name: Pact of Huldra's Renewal
summary: You’ve sworn a pact with Zemnaïdé, a huldra professor at Cobyslarni, to help renew his former homeland of the Sarkoris Scar.

name: Ouroboric Pact
summary: You’ve studied pacts at Cobyslarni, or learned under someone who has, and understand them to not only create a bargain between individuals, but a separate entity altogether: the pact itself.

name: Pact of the Nightblossom
summary: You’ve sworn a pact with Jenway Nightblossom of the Synod of Truth in Dreams, a talented oneiromancer and pactbinder.

name: Pact of the Crossroads
summary: You’ve sworn a pact with Ng the Hooded, the Eldest known as the Lord of the Crossroads, though your only sign of Ng’s acknowledgment is the benefits you receive.

name: Pact of the Death Hunter
summary: You’ve sworn a pact with a psychopomp bent on the destruction of all undeath.

name: Pact of the Fey Paths
summary: You’ve sworn a pact with a powerful fey creature that longs to see the wonders of the Universe.

name: Pact of the Rune Dragon
summary: While the students of Cobyslarni are taught to make pacts with many kinds of dragons, a pact with a rune dragon is somewhat more frequent due to their interest in the accomplishments of various academies.

name: Pact of the Living Pact
summary: You’ve sworn a pact with a pact that has somehow survived long after the death of the original pactbinder.

name: Talent Envy
summary: You give off a bedazzling glow with every performance, sparking feelings of severe envy and inadequacy in those who compare their talent to yours.

name: Kitharodian Actor Dedication
summary: You’ve studied classic Taldan theater and learned to embody various roles to a sublime degree.

name: Animal Actor
summary: You participated in a performance of _The Leaping Lion_, a play focusing on Cyricas, the animal-loving adventurer who traveled with his ape friend Mardu and remains a favorite hero among Taldan youth.

name: Heaven's Step Offense
summary: Your lessons from the stage find life in the storied mercy and fearlessness of Grand Prince Gennaris III.

name: Clean Take
summary: Thanks to many long hours of rehearsals, your acting skill is infinitely adaptable.

name: Monumental Maestro
summary: You’ve studied the moving compositions of Andreas Romung, a legendary maestro whose Shining Crusade anthems live on in the music for the play _Echoes of Glory_.

name: Stunt Performer Stance
summary: You clear your mind, regulate your breathing, and prepare your muscles in a stance inspired by Kemen Kayton, a graduate of Zimar’s Monastery of the Seven Forms.

name: Sympathetic Portrayal
summary: You portrayed Grand Prince Stavian III in _Fall of the Troubled King_, a production dedicated to the life and times of the paranoid Taldan ruler whose violent resistance to new policies on succession kicked off the War for the Crown.

name: Bleak Humorist
summary: You’ve watched dozens of morbid comedies depicting Beldam I, Taldor’s prankster emperor whose wife accidentally killed him when she struck him with a marble bust after he jumped out from behind curtains to frighten her.

name: Of Lions and Wyrms
summary: You starred in a war drama depicting First Emperor Taldaris’s battles against the Grogrisant, a massive six- eyed lion, and Verksaris the Kingeater, a mighty dragon.

name: Ruthless Orator
summary: You were once cast in the role of Daronlyr XII, one of Taldor’s most ambitious rulers who slew his cousin to seize the crown, yet somehow still managed to convince the entire Ulfen Guard to swear loyalty to him simply through his powers of oration.

name: Victorious Vigor
summary: Your victories in battle fill you with pride and imbue you with the energy to fight a bit longer despite your wounds.

name: Calculated Splash
summary: You have calculated all the angles to maximize a bomb’s splash.

name: Merciful Elixir
summary: You mix a special additive into your elixir that calms the drinker’s body and mind.

name: Potent Poisoner
summary: By concentrating your poisons’ toxic components, you make them harder for victims to resist.

name: Greater Merciful Elixir
summary: Your additives contain panaceas that can remedy a plethora of maladies.

name: Perfect Mutagen
summary: You have enhanced the formulas for your mutagens, aligning them perfectly to your physiology.

name: Animal Rage
trait: Barbarian, Concentrate, Polymorph, Primal, Rage, Transmutation
summary: You transform into your animal.

name: Litany Against Wrath
summary: You excoriate a foe for its wrath against goodly creatures.

name: Litany Against Sloth
summary: You rail against the sin of sloth, turning a foe’s laziness against it.

name: Blade of Justice
summary: You call upon divine power and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against a foe you have witnessed harming an ally or innocent.

name: Lasting Doubt
summary: When you cast doubt upon your foes, the effect lasts longer than usual.

name: Liberating Stride
summary: Your allies can move farther when you release them from harm.

name: Aura of Vengeance
summary: When you call upon others to take retribution, you also guide their aim.

name: Litany of Righteousness
summary: You call upon righteousness to expose an evil foe’s weakness.

name: Wyrmbane Aura
summary: Your aura protects against destructive energies and dragons’ breath.

name: Celestial Mount
summary: Your steed gains incredible celestial powers granted by your deity.

name: Command Undead
summary: You grasp the animating force within an undead creature and bend it to your will.

name: Improved Command Undead
prerequisite: harmful font; Command Undead; evil alignment
summary: Undead creatures find it all but impossible to resist your commands.

name: Green Tongue
summary: You share a special kinship with all things green and living.

name: Diamond Soul
summary: You have fortified your body and mind against eldritch effects.

name: Tongue of Sun and Moon
summary: You have transcended the barriers between words and meaning.

name: Enlightened Presence
summary: You exude an aura of resolve.

name: Empty Body
summary: You transmute your body into an ethereal form.

name: Meditative Wellspring
summary: When you clear your mind, your focus comes flowing back in a powerful rush.

name: Snare Specialist
summary: You specialize in creating quick traps to obstruct your enemies on the battlefield.

name: Quick Snares
summary: You can rig a snare in only moments.

name: Powerful Snares
summary: Your snares are particularly dif cult for enemies to avoid.

name: Targeting Shot
summary: You carefully track your prey’s position and defenses.

name: Ubiquitous Snares
summary: You can prepare a seemingly impossible number of snares in advance, and you’re ready to spring them on unsuspecting foes.

name: Minor Magic
summary: You’ve dabbled in a variety of tricks, gaining minor magical abilities from a particular tradition.

name: Battle Assessment
summary: With careful observation during battle, you identify an enemy’s strengths and weaknesses.

name: Magical Trickster
summary: You can sneak spells past your foes’ defenses as easily as any blade.

name: Relentless Stalker
summary: Stay adjacent to your prey when they attempt to move away.

name: Wilderness Spotter
summary: Use Survival for your Initiative when in a specific terrain.

name: Godless Healing
prerequisite: Battle Medicine; can't have a patron deity
summary: With limited access to divine healing magic, Rahadoumi often become adept at using ordinary medicine for when dangerous situations arise.

name: Eye of the Arclords
summary: The Arclords of Nex have achieved a unique mastery of magic.
source: World Guide pg. 81, Wake the Dead #2 pg. 28

name: Pathfinder Agent Dedication
summary: You're a field agent of the globe-trotting Pathfinder Society.

name: Careful Explorer
summary: You gain a sixth sense for traps, noticing them even when you're not trying to.

name: Deft Cooperation
summary: You gain a bonus to your own checks when Aiding an ally.

name: Thorough Reports
summary: Recalling Knowledge adds creatures to your list, granting you bonuses to Recall in future encounters.

name: Wayfinder Resonance Tinkerer
summary: Access a new cantrip by using your Wayfinder.

name: Lastwall Sentry Dedication
prerequisite: member of the Knights of Lastwall; Shield Block
summary: Swear yourself as a sentry for the Knights of Lastwall.

name: Eye of Ozem
prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; expert in Perception
summary: Learn how to better spot danger at a distance.

name: Necromantic Resistance
summary: Gain resistance to necromancy effects and damage.

name: Grave Sense
summary: Learn how to sense undead in the area.

name: Necromantic Tenacity
summary: Reduce the power that necromantic effects hold over you.

name: Lastwall Warden
summary: Use your shield to protect your allies.

name: Living Monolith Dedication
prerequisite: Ancient Osiriani and Sphinx languages; Trained in Crafting
summary: Begin to process to become a living monolith.

name: Ka Stone Ritual
prerequisite: Living Monolith Dedication; a sphinx or living monolith with this feat performs a ritual with you
summary: You enchant your _ka stone_ and can use it to wield magic.

name: Stone Blood
summary: Your blood clots quickly.

name: Fortified Flesh
summary: Your flesh is resistent to physical damage.

name: Attunement to Stone
summary: You can feel vibrations through the ground.

name: Judgment of the Monolith
summary: You can use your _ka stone_ to compel the truth.

name: Stone Communion
summary: You can speak Terran and speak with stones.

name: Student of Perfection Dedication
prerequisite: powerful fist or expert in unarmed attacks; member of a House of Perfection
summary: You have joined one of the Houses of Perfection.

name: Perfect Strike
summary: You call upon insight from your training to recover accuracy.

name: Perfect Ki Adept
summary: You gain the appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection.

name: Magic Warrior Dedication
summary: You have taken up a nameless mask and sworn the oath of the magic warriors.

name: Magic Warrior Aspect
summary: You can alter your form to gain an aspect of the animal your mask represents.

name: Magic Warrior Transformation
summary: You can transform fully into the animal your mask represents.

name: Nameless Anonymity
summary: Your mask protects you further from divination.

name: Hellknight Armiger Dedication
prerequisite: member of a Hellknight Order; trained in heavy armor as well as your order's favored weapon
summary: You have taken the first step to being a full Hellknight.

name: Ardent Armiger
summary: You have been trained to resist the manipulations of fiends.

name: Diabolic Certitude
summary: Your Hellknight training drilled details of Hell’s denizens deep into your mind.

name: Mortification
summary: Your reckonings have prepared your body for physical punishment.

name: Armiger's Mobility
prerequisite: expert in heavy armor; Hellknight Armiger Dedication
summary: You’ve learned how best to move in heavy armor.

name: Runescarred Dedication
summary: Overwhelming magic has branded your body with powerful runes.

name: Spell Runes
summary: The magical runes on your body grant you several magical abilities.

name: Living Rune
summary: You’ve bridged a connection between the runes on your body and the magic of runestones, allowing you to place an armor rune on your living flesh.

name: Warding Rune
summary: Your runes provide a warding effect that protects you against a specific school of magic.

name: Greater Spell Runes
summary: You gain more powerful spell runes.

name: Different Worlds
prerequisite: ability to select ancestry feats from multiple ancestries
summary: Create a second identity for yourself with a different name, history, and background.

name: Reveal Machinations
summary: You convince a creature that you played a minor but recurring role in its life.

name: Secret Speech
summary: Learn the secret language of a society.

name: Silver's Refrain
summary: Learn the _silver's refrain_ composition cantrip.

name: Tweak Appearances
summary: You can alter a creature's clothing to improve their social impact.

name: Bellflower Dedication
prerequisite: Charisma 14; Expert in Stealth; Expert in Survival; member of the Bellflower Network
summary: You dedicate yourself to freeing slaves and escorting them to freedom.

name: Scarecrow
summary: You fight fiercely to protect your crop.

name: Garden Path
summary: You can guide your crop to move without notice.

name: Practiced Guidance
summary: You can better Aid your crop.

name: Tiller's Drive
summary: Increase your Speed and that of your crop.

name: Tiller's Aid
summary: You can quickly Aid your crop.

name: Cut the Bonds
prerequisite: Bellflower Dedication; expert in a melee weapon
summary: You can counteract a magical effect that impedes movement.

name: Arcane Tattoos
summary: You have tattoos on your body corresponding to one of the ancient Thassilonian schools of magic.

name: Courteous Comeback
summary: You grew up in the proud Padishah Empire, where even insults have a certain poetic wit.

name: Devil's Advocate
summary: You know more about the habits of devils than is entirely safe.

name: Dragon Spit
summary: Many Tian-Dan claim to have dragon blood in their veins, and in your case, this is true—you can spit energy, and you might have an especially visible sign of your draconic heritage.

name: Gloomseer
summary: Gloom holds few terrors for you, and the pall of darkness over Nidal has made you comfortable in dim light.

name: Keep Up Appearances
summary: Taldan pride means you never show weakness.

name: Know Oneself
summary: You center yourself and call to mind the Vudrani monastic ideals of mindfulness and self-knowledge.

name: Quah Bond
summary: You grew up among the Shoanti tribes, with the spirits watching over you, and they offer you guidance.

name: Saoc Astrology
summary: The ancient Saoc Brethren were the masters of astrology, and while your knowledge may be but a pale shadow of their wisdom, it still comes in handy.

name: Tupilaq Carver
prerequisite: You have a spellcasting class feature with the divine or primal tradition
summary: You know the truth behind old stories that tell of sending a fetish of bone and sinew to seek vengeance.

name: Viking Shieldbearer
summary: You trained with shields and weapons as soon as you were old enough to hold them, eager to win honor and glory for yourself.

name: Witch Warden
summary: You and your family have fought long and hard against witches, particularly the winter witches of Irrisen, and you’ve learned to be wary of their curses and the otherworldly powers their patrons grant.

name: Darkseer
summary: Zon-Kuthon smiles upon you—even if you curse his name—granting you pitch-black eyes that allow you to see in shadows and darkness.

name: Ornate Tattoo
summary: You expand your tattoos to encompass greater magic.

name: Wavetouched Paragon
summary: You have been blessed by the sea, granting you the ability to swim like a fish.

name: Dragon Prince
summary: The blood of the Dragon Kings runs strong in your veins.

name: Heir of the Saoc
summary: In the past, you would have been a proud initiate of the Saoc Brethren.

name: Shory Aeromancer
prerequisite: Garundi ethnicity, Mauxi ethnicity, or Tian-Yae ethnicity
summary: Your ancestors hailed from the flying cities of the Shory, and a few simple tricks have come down through the ages to you.

name: Virtue-Forged Tattoos
summary: Your tattoos are a work of eldritch genius, a masterpiece of art, magic, and skin.

name: Irriseni Ice-Witch
summary: You can trace your direct descent from one of the Queens of Irrisen and thus from Baba Yaga herself.

name: Shadow Pact
summary: Thousands of years ago, your ancestors made a pact with Zon-Kuthon.

name: Shory Aerialist
prerequisite: Garundi ethnicity, Mauxi ethnicity, or Tian-Yae ethnicity; Shory Aeromancer or ability to cast _fly_
summary: Unique in Golarion’s history, the Shory people developed fighting styles dedicated to combat in the air.

name: Round Ears
summary: Your elven lineage is subtle enough that you look barely different from other humans, and you’ve learned to use that to your advantage.

name: Sociable
summary: You’re extremely extroverted, and you often spend your time carousing or otherwise socializing.

name: Overlooked Mastermind
summary: Many consider half-orcs little more than dumb brutes.

name: Avenge in Glory
summary: You honor your ally’s life, gaining temporary Hit Points equal to your level for 1 minute.

name: Clan's Edge
summary: By moving your clan dagger with rapid precision, you can protect yourself more effectively.

name: Forge-Day's Rest
summary: Your unusual rest cycle allows you to recover faster.

name: Surface Culture
summary: Your interactions with other cultures on the surface have not only taught you about many other ancestries, but have also helped you realize the value of your own.

name: Clan Protector
summary: Your clan dagger can protect your allies as easily as yourself.

name: Protective Sheath
summary: When you lash out with your clan dagger, you keep its sheath close at hand.

name: Tomb-Watcher's Glare
summary: When you critically hit an undead creature, or an undead creature critically fails a saving throw against one of your abilities, you drive your divine wrath home in your enemy’s heart.

name: Battleforger
summary: You can sharpen weapons, polish armor, and apply special techniques to temporarily gain better effects from your armaments.

name: Energy Blessed
summary: Energy runs through your blood more powerfully.

name: Heroes' Call
summary: The songs of ancient heroes echo through your mind and quicken your pulse, especially in dire straits.

name: Kneel for No God
summary: Your ancestors’ defiance of magic and your people’s strictly egalitarian mindset mean that certain forms of magic have little effect on you.

name: Elemental Wrath
summary: You are so attuned to the land that you can call forth a bolt of energy from your surroundings.

name: Elven Verve
summary: While all elves are immune to the paralyzing touch of ghouls, you can shake off flesh-numbing magic of all kinds.

name: Share Thoughts
prerequisite: Mualijae ethnicity, Ilverani ethnicity, or Vourinoi ethnicity
summary: You have an uncanny knack of communicating with other elves without speaking, though this habit that is often uncomfortable to observers.

name: Wildborn Magic
summary: You have learned to access the old magic of wild places.

name: Woodcraft
summary: You have a innate familiarity with forested areas.

name: Defiance Unto Death
summary: You loathe the alghollthus and their mind magic, and you’ve been trained to be willing to die rather than give into mental manipulation.

name: Elven Instincts
summary: Your senses let you react rapidly.

name: Forest Stealth
summary: You are skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage.

name: Wildborn Adept
summary: The whispers of the jungle grant you more diverse access to simple primal magic.

name: Brightness Seeker
summary: Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes studying your surroundings in search of omens related to a particular course of action to cast _augury_ as an innate divine spell.

name: Sense Thoughts
summary: You have an even stranger knack for knowing what other people are thinking.

name: Wandering Heart
prerequisite: Arctic Elf, Cavern Elf, Desert Elf, Woodland Elf, or any other elf heritage based on adapting to an environment
summary: While all elves adapt to their environments over time, you have traveled so widely and become attuned to so many environs that your body now changes more rapidly than other elves.

name: Gnome Polyglot
summary: Your extensive travels, curiosity, and love of learning help you to learn languages quickly.

name: Grim Insight
summary: Others’ attempts to scare you often grant you insights about your would-be bullies that you can then exploit.

name: Inventive Offensive
summary: You can jury-rig your weapons to perform in unexpected ways.

name: Life-Giving Magic
summary: The upwelling of innate magic refreshes your body.

name: Natural Performer
summary: Entertainment comes naturally to you.

name: Theoretical Acumen
summary: You study a creature’s form and behavior to hypothesize likely means of overcoming its strengths.

name: Unexpected Shift
summary: Your supernatural connection sometimes causes you to phase from reality when under threat, disappearing for split seconds before reappearing—often surprising you as much as your enemies.

name: Vibrant Display
summary: Whereas most gnomes’ coloration is static or changes slowly, you can cause your hair, eye, and skin color to scintillate in brief and disorienting bursts.

name: Eclectic Obsession
summary: Your desire for stimulation has led you from one pursuit to another and granted you a smattering of expertise with myriad crafts and professions.

name: Intuitive Illusions
summary: Illusion magic comes to you so naturally that you can effortlessly sustain your magical ruses.

name: Natural Illusionist
summary: By drawing upon the First World’s magic, you can siphon a portion of that malleable world to create a convincing illusion.

name: Fortuitous Shift
summary: You have grown more comfortable with your penchant for supernatural disappearance.

name: Bouncy Goblin
summary: You have a particular elasticity that makes it easy for you to bounce and squish.

name: Fang Sharpener
prerequisite: Irongut Goblin heritage or Razortooth Goblin heritage
summary: You have filed your teeth into jagged points and have an unusually powerful jaw, making your mouth a dangerous weapon.

name: Hard Tail
summary: Your tail is much stronger than most, and you can lash out with it with the strength of a whip.

name: Ankle Bite
prerequisite: Fang Sharpener or Razortooth Goblin heritage
summary: Whenever someone grabs onto you, you instinctively bite down hard.

name: Chosen of Lamashtu
summary: You bear the favor and blessings of Lamashtu, the Mother of Monsters.

name: Tail Spin
summary: You excel at using your tail as a weapon to upend your foes.

name: Torch Goblin
summary: You’ve spent enough time on fire that you know how to use it to your advantage.

name: Tree Climber (Goblin)
prerequisite: Tailed Goblin heritage or Treedweller Goblin heritage
summary: Your time in forest or jungle canopies has taught you how to scramble across branches with sure feet.

name: Freeze It!
summary: You are no rime hag or Jadwiga, but the magic of the north has still left a mark on you.

name: Hungry Goblin
summary: You’ll eat anything and anyone.

name: Roll with It (Goblin)
summary: When you take a big hit, your foe bounces you around like a rubber ball, but you escape the worst of the blow.

name: Scalding Spit
summary: Your bodily fluids burn with surprising volatility, as if you ran on oil instead of blood.

name: Unbreakable-er Goblin
summary: As hard as most unbreakable goblins are to break, you are that much harder to break.

name: Adroit Manipulation
summary: You’ve fiddled with knots, locks, and blacksmith’s puzzles since you were a child to give your hands something to do.

name: Innocuous
summary: Halflings have been unobtrusive assistants of larger folk for untold ages, and your people count on this assumption of innocence.

name: Intuitive Cooperation
summary: You are accustomed to working alongside others, relying on each other to get by.

name: Unassuming Dedication
summary: Your family instilled the values of care and patience into you from a young age.

name: Easily Dismissed
summary: You are practiced at blending into the background of the streets and halls of larger folk to ensure that you are overlooked.

name: Halfling Ingenuity
summary: While your willingness to dig into a task you know little about might get you into trouble, your incredible luck often saves you from danger.

name: Shared Luck (Halfling)
summary: You are evidence that it’s lucky to travel with a halfling.

name: Cunning Climber
summary: Whether you are climbing a ship’s rigging, a jungle tree, or a clock tower, you have an uncanny knack for finding footholds and handholds where larger creatures can’t.

name: Fade Away
summary: Your ability to blend into the background allows you to fade away entirely or appear innocuous even to magical effects.

name: Helpful Halfling
summary: When you aid a friend with a task, you find many ways to help and avoid interfering.

name: Cobble Dancer
summary: You know how to take advantage of foes thrown off-balance by unstable flooring, loose cobblestones, or similar impediments.

name: Incredible Luck (Halfling)
summary: Even other halflings consider you to be particularly lucky.

name: Formation Training
summary: You know how to fight in formation with your brethren.

name: Formation Master
summary: You can assemble a formation even with members of ancestries that lack the hobgoblins’ military discipline, and you can extend these benefits to your hobgoblin allies.

name: Iruxi Unarmed Cunning
summary: You make the most of your iruxi unarmed attacks.

name: Entourage
summary: You have a small group of admirers who tend to follow you around while you’re in civilized settlements.

name: Firebrand Braggart Dedication
prerequisite: Charisma 14; second mark member of the Firebrands
summary: Your Firebrand training has taught you that achieving something is more satisfying if you boast about it first.

name: Boaster's Challenge
prerequisite: Expert in Deception, Expert in Diplomacy, or Expert in Intimidation; Firebrand Braggart Dedication
summary: You call out a foe, causing them to become flustered and easier to defeat.

name: Daring Act
prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics or Trained in Athletics; Firebrand Braggart Dedication
summary: You attempt a death-defying maneuver to distract your enemies.

name: Bravo's Determination
prerequisite: Expert in Deception; Firebrand Braggart Dedication
summary: Your confidence borders on self-delusion, but it keeps you going against overwhelming odds.

name: Great Boaster
summary: Your bragging is particularly effective.

name: Daring Flourish
summary: You make quick use of an opening from your daring stunts.

name: Demanding Challenge
summary: If your skill check to challenge a foe is a success, the target of your challenge takes a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls (or –2 if you critically succeed) until the end of your next turn.

name: Daredevil's Gambit
summary: If you critically succeed at your Daring Act, you can enter the target’s space and remain there until the beginning of your next turn or until the target moves, whichever comes first.

name: Order Training
summary: You gain the lesser order benefit for the Hellknight order to which you belong.

name: Advanced Order Training
prerequisite: Hellknight Armiger Dedication; Hellknight Dedication or Hellknight Signifer Dedication
summary: You gain the greater order benefit for the Hellknight order to which you belong.

name: Hellknight Order Cross-Training
prerequisite: Hellknight Armiger Dedication; Hellknight Dedication or Hellknight Signifer Dedication
summary: You gain the lesser order benefit of a Hellknight order other than the one to which you belong.

name: Hellknight Dedication
prerequisite: Hellknight Armiger Dedication; lawful alignment; member of a Hellknight Order; passed the Hellknight Test
summary: You have forged your body to comply with the commands of your mind—orders steeped in the Measure and the Chain.

name: Sense Chaos
summary: You sense chaos as an unsettling feeling of nervous energy.

name: Blade of Law
summary: You call upon the power of law and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against a foe you have witnessed breaking or disrespecting the law or otherwise acting disorderly.

name: Hell's Armaments
summary: You’ve trained with your order’s weapon and your Hellknight plate long enough to apply your expertise from other weapons and armor.

name: Hellknight Signifer Dedication
prerequisite: spellcasting class feature; Hellknight Armiger Dedication; lawful alignment; member of a Hellknight Order; passed the Hellknight Test
summary: You have bolstered your force of will with the power of the Measure and the Chain.

name: Masked Casting
summary: You harness the magical energy flowing through your eyeless mask to effortlessly protect you from visual effects.

name: Gaze of Veracity
prerequisite: Hellknight Signifer Dedication; ability to cast focus spells
summary: You can channel your mask’s power to pierce through lies and see the truth in any situation.

name: Signifer's Sight
summary: The magic flowing through your signifer’s mask allows you to see in the dark, and the mask dampens the distraction caused by sudden flashes of bright light.

name: Signifer Armor Expertise
summary: You’ve spent enough time helping your comrades equip medium and heavy armor that you spread your own expertise to those armors as well.

name: Everstand Stance
summary: You brace your shield with both hands, enhancing its potential for both offense and defense.

name: Everstand Strike
summary: Your follow-up blow leaves you an opening to set your shield.

name: Light of Revelation
summary: You’ve learned to call upon light to reveal what is hidden.

name: Sun Blade
summary: You can unleash burning sunlight from your sword or spear.

name: Impassable Wall Stance
summary: You refuse to let foes past your guard.

name: Knight Vigilant
prerequisite: Trained in Religion; any good alignment; member of the Knights of Lastwall of knight rank
summary: You are dedicated to the cause of the Shining Sentinels.

name: Unshakable Idealism
prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; expert in Will saves
summary: Your faith and hope can’t be shaken, and you won’t flee when lives are at stake.

name: Endure Death's Touch
prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; expert in medium or heavy armor
summary: Your conviction redirects the undead’s attack through your armor and then harmlessly away.

name: Aegis of Arnisant
prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; Shield Block; Master in Religion
summary: Inspired by the tale of Arnisant, you transform your shield into a magic ward.

name: Knight in Shining Armor
prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; expert in light armor, medium armor, or unarmored defense; trained in heavy armor
