summary: As a knight in shining armor, you train daily in the heaviest armor, expanding your expertise to heavy armor.

name: Knight Reclaimant Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival; any non-evil alignment; member of the Knights of Lastwall of knight rank
summary: You have sworn the Crimson Oath and become a full member of the Crimson Reclaimers.

name: Invoke the Crimson Oath
summary: You can invoke the Crimson Oath to unleash blasts of ruby energy from your weapon.

name: Survivor of Desolation
summary: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against unnatural weather events or environmental hazards occurring in blighted or otherwise unnaturally marred regions.

name: Reaper of Repose
prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; master proficiency in a weapon
summary: Your skill and fervor allow you to pierce undead defenses and exploit their weaknesses.

name: Blade of the Crimson Oath
summary: You call upon the Crimson Oath to smite undead and then make a weapon or unarmed Strike against an undead foe.

name: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Arcana or Trained in Nature; member of the Magaambya of attendant rank
summary: You devote much of your study to halcyon magic.

name: Mask Familiar
summary: Your mask takes on a personality of its own, allowing it to serve as your familiar.

name: Adaptive Mask Familiar
summary: Your mask familiar adapts quickly to material form, allowing it to gain more familiar and master abilities.

name: Cascade Bearer's Flexibility
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Cascade Bearers affiliation
summary: You call upon your Cascade Bearer training to help you adjust a spell for the current situation.

name: Emerald Boughs Accustomation
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Expert in Society; Emerald Boughs affiliation
summary: You are comfortable and socially capable in almost any cultural context.

name: Rain-Scribe Sustenance
summary: You use the power of your Rain-Scribe magic to draw on a stream of primal power for sustenance.

name: Tempest-Sun Redirection
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Tempest-Sun Mages affiliation
summary: If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots that damages other creatures, you can bend some of that spell’s offensive energy, protecting allies in the area and boosting your own defenses against certain foes.

name: Uzunjati Storytelling
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Uzunjati affiliation; master in a Recall Knowledge skill
summary: You tell a quick story or begin telling a longer tale.

name: Cascade Bearer's Spellcasting
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Cascade Bearers affiliation
summary: Your Cascade Bearer training allows you to broaden the horizons of your halcyon spells further than most Magaambyans, weaving in spiritual magic.

name: Emerald Boughs Hideaway
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Emerald Boughs affiliation
summary: You use Emerald Bough techniques to create a small extradimensional space called a hideaway that lasts as long as you are conscious.

name: Rain-Scribe Mobility
summary: You surround yourself in a mantle of Rain-Scribe magic and Stride twice; difficult terrain does not reduce your Speed, even if the difficult terrain has been manipulated by magic.

name: Tempest-Sun Shielding
summary: You transform unrealized spell energy into a protective shield.

name: Uzunjati Recollection
prerequisite: Uzunjati Storytelling; master in a Recall Knowledge skill
summary: You tell a story spontaneously from nearly forgotten facts, delving into your memory and entertaining your audience in the process.

name: Halcyon Speaker Dedication
prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; member of the Magaambya of conversant rank
summary: You devote much of your study to halcyon magic.

name: Dualistic Synergy
summary: If your next action is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots, you gain a benefit.

name: Persistent Creation
summary: You can cast _creation_ as an innate spell at will, choosing whether it is arcane or primal each time.

name: Halcyon Spellcasting Initiate
summary: Your knowledge of halcyon magic increases.

name: Shared Synergy
summary: You can grant the benefit from Dualistic Synergy to an ally within 30 feet instead of yourself, either allowing that ally to Recall Knowledge, granting that ally temporary Hit Points, or both, depending on the spell’s tradition.

name: Charged Creation
summary: Your magic is drawn to your persistent creations.

name: Flexible Halcyon Spellcasting
summary: You broaden your ability to channel your power into halcyon magic.

name: Halcyon Spellcasting Adept
prerequisite: Halcyon Spellcasting Initiate; master in either Arcana or Nature, expert in the other
summary: You refine your halcyon magic.

name: Fulminating Synergy
summary: When you draw upon your spells’ synergy, you create a physical manifestation of their magical resonance and invoke it to harm a foe.

name: Halcyon Spellcasting Sage
prerequisite: Halcyon Spellcasting Adept; legendary in either Arcana or Nature, master in the other
summary: Your command over halcyon magic is nearly unmatched.

name: Synergistic Spell
prerequisite: Halcyon Spellcasting Initiate; Fulminating Synergy; Legendary in Arcana; Legendary in Nature
summary: You combine your synergy and spells into a fantastic web of magic, allowing you to cast two spells at once.

name: Forced Entry
prerequisite: Expert in Athletics; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
summary: You are trained to preserve the archaeological value of your location when entering.

name: Recognize Threat
prerequisite: master in a Recall Knowledge skill; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
summary: You quickly assess the threat so you can relay the information to your team.

name: Everyone Duck!
summary: You intentionally set off the trap, but you take special precautions to protect yourself and your allies from the trap’s effects.

name: Educated Assessment
summary: You attempt to Recall Knowledge about a creature, and the GM uses the same secret roll result against the creature’s Deception or Stealth DC, giving you the information from a Battle Assessment.

name: Scrollmaster Dedication
prerequisite: expert in any Lore skill; member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Scrolls
summary: Your experience chronicling adventures and discoveries grants you heightened discernment and memory.

name: Lore Seeker
summary: You see what others don’t, and you’ve developed magical tricks to find hidden truth.

name: Unravel Mysteries
prerequisite: master in a Decipher Writing skill; Scrollmaster Dedication
summary: You can understand the true meaning of texts quickly, and even when you get lost or hit a dead end, you aren’t discouraged from making further attempts to get to the bottom of things.

name: Font of Knowledge
summary: Experience or focused study have granted you mastery of a number of topics.

name: Spellmaster Dedication
prerequisite: Intelligence 14, Wisdom 14, or Charisma 14; ability to cast focus spells; member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Spells
summary: As a Spellmaster, you are adept at identifying magic.

name: Surreptitious Spellcaster
summary: You’ve learned that it pays for a Pathfinder to be able to cast spells without being noticed.

name: Ward Casting
summary: You carefully ward your spell by drawing from a mantle of magical energy you prepared to protect your casting, increasing your chance of retaining the spell.

name: Spellmaster's Resilience
summary: Your experience with a specific type of harmful magic makes you more resistant to it.

name: Absorb Spell
prerequisite: Spellmaster Dedication; spell repertoire or ability to prepare spells
summary: You absorb a spell and store it in your body.

name: Swordmaster Dedication
prerequisite: Strength 14, Dexterity 14, or Constitution 14; member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Swords
summary: Your Swords training taught you to never lose hold of your weapon.

name: Harrying Strike
summary: Your attack prevents a foe from pursuing your allies.

name: Shoulder Catastrophe
summary: You’ve trained to protect your allies by diverting the worst attacks to yourself.

name: Death's Door
summary: You continue to fight when others would fall.

name: False Faith
summary: Droskar knows you may need to disguise yourself in societies that oppose your faith.
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City pg. 63

name: Crystal Keeper Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Elven Lore or Trained in Society
summary: You can use Arcana, Occultism, Religion, or Society to Decipher Writing by meditating before a crystal, regardless of the type of writing.
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City pg. 74

name: Crystal Ward Spells
summary: Your study of crystals and the energies held within a gem’s facets grants you special arcane crystal ward spells.
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City pg. 74

name: Simple Crystal Magic
summary: You are capable of seeing magic as flowing runes and can scribe a personal rune that represents you.
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City pg. 74

name: Armor Rune Shifter
summary: You learn the secrets of armor runes by viewing them through gems and can alter them at your discretion.
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City pg. 75

name: Weapon-Rune Shifter
summary: You learn how to alter the magic of weapon runes by using a crystal as a focusing component.
source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City pg. 75

name: Deadly Poison Weapon
summary: Your poisons are devastatingly potent.
source: Pathfinder #149: Against the Scarlet Triad pg. 78

name: Pesh Skin
summary: Your plant form sprouts hundreds of spines, and your blood causes mild hallucinations in creatures exposed to it.
source: Pathfinder #149: Against the Scarlet Triad pg. 78

name: Shaped Contaminant
summary: Through a combination of careful manipulation and precise breath control, you can deploy inhaled toxins precisely.
source: Pathfinder #149: Against the Scarlet Triad pg. 78

name: Zephyr Guard Dedication
summary: As a Zephyr Guard, you’re always vigilant against crime and threats to the city’s safety.
source: Pathfinder #149: Against the Scarlet Triad pg. 81

name: Decry Thief
prerequisite: Zephyr Guard Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
summary: When you attempt to Demoralize, you can make it harder for the target to flee, in place of the action’s normal effects.
source: Pathfinder #149: Against the Scarlet Triad pg. 81

name: Know the Beat
summary: You have been trained to investigate crimes.
source: Pathfinder #149: Against the Scarlet Triad pg. 81

name: Relentless Disarm
prerequisite: Zephyr Guard Dedication; Trained in Athletics
summary: You have been trained to disarm foes.
source: Pathfinder #149: Against the Scarlet Triad pg. 81

name: Unfazed Assessment
prerequisite: Zephyr Guard Dedication; expert in Perception
summary: You have witnessed hundreds of fighting styles and quickly adapt to defend against complicated maneuvers.
source: Pathfinder #149: Against the Scarlet Triad pg. 81

name: Apex Companion
summary: Gain the _apex companion_ focus spell.

name: Aura of Unbreakable Virtue
summary: Overwhelm evil creatures with your aura.

name: Bloodline Metamorphosis
summary: Swap out spells from your repertoire more easily.

name: Efficient Alchemy (Paragon)
summary: Prepare more alchemical items from your infused reagents.

name: Emblazon Divinity
summary: Emblazon more equipment at the same time.

name: Enduring Debilitation
summary: Your debilitations last for 1 minute.

name: Golden Body
summary: Strike harder and heal more rapidly.

name: Song of the Fallen
summary: Gain the _song of the fallen_ focus spell.

name: Superior Sight
summary: Increase your visual acuity.

name: Battle Prayer
prerequisite: Master in Religion; you follow a deity
summary: Calling out to your deity, you recite scripture to harm a foe

name: Bless Tonic
prerequisite: Master in Crafting; deity who grants _heal_ divine font
summary: You channel positive energy into restoratives that ward against harm

name: Bless Toxin
prerequisite: Master in Crafting; deity who grants _harm_ divine font
summary: You pour negative energy into toxins you create to further debilitate your targets

name: Blessed Blood (Sorcerer)
prerequisite: bloodline that grants divine spells; you follow a deity
summary: Your deity’s blessings manifest in your blood-borne power

name: Charlatan
summary: You’ve learned to mimic the abilities of spellcasters by studying their flourishes and words

name: Environmental Grace
prerequisite: Master in Survival; deity who grants the cold, fire, nature, or travel domain
summary: You rapidly adapt to environments through a combination of skill, meditation, and divine grace

name: Mortal Healing
prerequisite: Godless Healing, you follow the Laws of Mortality
summary: You grant greater healing when the gods don’t interfere

name: Sacred Defense
prerequisite: Master in Religion; you follow a deity
summary: You call upon your deity to grant you their protective blessing

name: Sacred Ki
prerequisite: Ki Strike; you follow a deity
summary: The power of your faith suffuses your ki

name: Syncretism
summary: You have come to see the overlap between two deities’ teachings

name: Juggler Dedication
summary: You become trained in Performance and gain the Juggle skill feat
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 74

name: Focused Juggler
summary: You continue Juggling until the end of your next turn.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 74

name: Quick Juggler
summary: When you start to Juggle or add another item to those you are Juggling, you add two items instead of one.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 74

name: Reflexive Catch
summary: Grab an item thrown at you.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 74

name: Lobbed Attack
summary: Make an unexpected ranged attack with a Juggled item.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 74

name: Opportune Throw
summary: Make a ranged attack with a Juggled item against a vulnerable creature.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 74

name: Staff Acrobat Dedication
prerequisite: Dexterity 16; Trained in Acrobatics; Trained in Athletics; trained with at least one of the following weapons: staff, bo staff, halfling sling staff, or any weapon in the spear or polearm group (referred to in this archetype as “your staff”)
summary: Gain bonuses when using your staff as an implement to aid Acrobatics and Athletics actions.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 75

name: Bullying Staff
summary: You can Shove and Trip larger creatures.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 75

name: Staff Sweep
summary: You sweep your foes away with your staff.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 75

name: Levering Strike
summary: Strike your foe and make them unbalanced
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 75

name: Whirlwind Stance
prerequisite: Staff Acrobat Dedication; expert proficiency in your staff
summary: You use your staff as a defensive implement as well as an offensive one.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 75

name: Pivot Strike
summary: You Leap and then Strike using your staff.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 75

name: Juggle
summary: You can Juggle items and still use your hands between tosses.
source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On pg. 76

name: Animal Trainer Dedication
summary: You gain a young animal companion.
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God pg. 76

name: Beast Speaker
summary: You can speak with animals.
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God pg. 76

name: Mature Trained Companion
summary: Your animal companion grows up, becoming a mature animal companion.
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God pg. 76

name: Insistent Command
prerequisite: Master in Nature; Animal Trainer Dedication
summary: When you roll a success to Command an Animal, you get a critical success.
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God pg. 76

name: Splendid Companion
summary: Your animal companion continues to develop.
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God pg. 76

name: Specialized Companion
summary: Your animal companion gains a specialization.
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God pg. 76

name: Encouraging Words
trait: Auditory, General, Linguistic, Mental, Skill, Stamina
summary: You give an ally a quick pep talk, helping them recover.

name: Steel Your Resolve
summary: Regain Stamina Points equal to half your maximum.

name: Ravening's Desperation
summary: Your study of the Beast of Gluttondark has taught you how to make do in the most trying of circumstances rather than succumb to weakness.

name: Dig Quickly
summary: Your hands work as effectively as shovels when you need to dig a quick hole.

name: Esteemed Visitor
summary: Your polite manners and natural ability to comfort others make it easy for you to break down cultural barriers and earn strangers’ trust.

name: Handy with Your Paws
summary: You can easily craft objects.

name: Improvisational Defender
summary: You are always prepared for fights that frequently disrupt seemingly peaceful times.

name: Scamper Underfoot
summary: You are used to ducking under foes and can scurry around the battlefield with ease.

name: Shoony Lore
summary: Growing up in shoony society, you learned the value of honesty, friendship, and hard work, even during trying times.

name: Loyal Empath
summary: You have incredible empathy for your friends and family, and you have an innate timing for helping others in distress.

name: Practiced Paddler
summary: You’re skilled at navigating bogs and marshes, even for a paddler shoony.

name: Tough Tumbler
summary: You’ve taken your share of licks while scurrying around the battlefield and know how to defend yourself against opportunistic attackers.

name: Improvisational Warrior
summary: You have increased skill with improvised weapons.

name: Sodbuster
summary: Years toiling in soil have made you an expert digger.

name: Steadfast Ally
summary: Your presence alone is enough to provide your allies with emotional support.

name: Unrivaled Builder
summary: Building things is like solving a puzzle, and you know how to use anything at your disposal to get the job done.

name: Golem Grafter Dedication
prerequisite: expert in Arcana and Crafting, or an ally with expert proficiency in those skills willing to augment you
summary: Your flesh has been specially treated with the same arcane and alchemical processes used to toughen the skin of flesh golems.

name: Accursed Clay Fist
prerequisite: Golem Grafter Dedication; expert in unarmed attacks
summary: You have replaced one of your forearms with one made of clay and infused with cursed arcane magic.

name: Quicken Heartbeat
summary: You’ve replaced your heart with one made of animated quicksilver and living adamantine.

name: Legs of Stone
summary: You gain a +2 status bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to Shove or Trip you.

name: Iron Lung
summary: Your lungs are infused with the resilience of iron.

name: Turpin Rowe Lumberjack Dedication
summary: Your logging training has made you intimately familiar with all aspects of forestry.

name: Axe Climber
summary: You can climb wooden surfaces using axes.

name: Log Roll
summary: You shuffle your feet to dislodge the surface beneath you or otherwise cause your opponent to become unsteady.

name: Axe Thrower
summary: You have mastered the weight and balance of a variety of axes and can lob them with ease.

name: Widen the Gap
summary: Once you have penetrated a foe’s defenses, you can home in on the same spot to exploit your opponent’s wound and deal some serious damage.

name: Fey Influence
summary: Your exposure to fey influence has given you some primal magic
source: Impossible Lands pg. 126, PFS Scenario #1-17: The Perennial Crown Part 2, The Thorned Monarch pg. 30

name: Astonishing Explosion
summary: Your bomb incorporates an explosive spark of wonder that leaves witnesses dumbfounded.

name: Banishing Blow
summary: The erratic teleportation magic you experienced in the Kortos Mounts has taught you a few tricks.

name: Denier of Destruction
summary: You can manipulate the same energies that the _aeon orbs_ use to sustain life.

name: Endurance of the Rooted Tree
summary: Just as the Vale of Aroden retains light and life despite inhospitable surroundings, you can sustain yourself regardless of your environment.

name: Mimic Protections
summary: By adopting resonant reflections, you have learned to copy the abilities of other creatures as well.

name: Reclaim Spell
summary: You have learned to manipulate reflections of magic, similar to the resonant reflections.

name: Reflecting Riposte
prerequisite: Dueling Riposte, Mirror Shield, or Twin Riposte
summary: You attempt to counteract the triggering spell using powerful magical techniques observed in the Kortos Mounts.

name: Ringmaster's Introduction
summary: You announce the triggering ally with a litany of their legendary achievements, spurring them to action.

name: Steal Essence
prerequisite: legendary in Thievery or master in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion
summary: Being in the presence of the _aeon orbs_ as they deteriorated has taught you how to siphon energy, and you do so with the required magic item.

name: Tenacious Blood Magic
summary: You have learned how to invest magic more deeply by witnessing Aroden's works.

name: Verdant Presence
summary: The life-giving properties of the _aeon orbs_ flourish within you.

name: Death's Drums
summary: Your life has been spent challenging death itself, and proximity to that implacable foe only makes your heart beat harder.

name: Azata Magic
summary: Your lineage traces back to the realm of Elysium, and you can harness its magic using this connection.

name: Convergent Tides
summary: Your footwork is like the convergence of tides, granting your body supernatural power and fluidity.

name: Shattering Spellstrike
summary: You intentionally channel a rampaging cascade of magic through your weapon, breaking it to deal more damage.

name: Surface Tension
summary: You encase the pieces of your broken weapon together with water you pull from the surrounding environment.

name: Crosscurrent Counter
summary: You counter the creature with the power of elemental water, a tendril of it encasing your limb or weapon.

name: Whirlpool's Pull
summary: You briefly conjure a tendril of water that allows you to grab an improvised weapon and then subsume that water to power your magic.

name: Maelstrom Flow
summary: You pour energy into an improvised weapon, speeding its destruction to grant it power.

name: Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Medicine; attended the University of Lepidstadt
summary: Before everything else, before the blood and the monsters and the Stasian technology and the horror, you are a doctor.

name: In Lightning, Life
summary: “In lightning, there is life.” This lesson is whispered throughout Lepidstadt, and you can put it to practical use.

name: Rise, My Creature!
summary: You have created life! You have usurped the power of the gods themselves!

name: Artery Map
summary: While you’ve learned all the places a scalpel can cause extensive bleeding to avoid disasters in surgery, such knowledge can serve other purposes.

name: Let my Creature Live!
summary: You continue to tinker with your creation’s muscles and rudimentary mind, granting it a limited form of autonomy.

name: Beautiful Knifework
prerequisite: Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication; Master in Medicine
summary: You perform surgical adjustments to disguise a willing ally or your construct companion.

name: Behold My Creation!
summary: You have rebuilt your creation once more.

name: Stasian Charge
summary: Charging a living body with electricity may seem like a bad idea, but you know better.

name: Stand Back, I'm a Doctor!
prerequisite: Master in Medicine; Lepidstadt Surgeon Dedication
summary: You have mastered techniques to aid those at the brink of death, even if they use dangerous Stasian technology.

name: A Miracle of Science!
summary: Once, you dreamed of creating life. Now you know that merely creating life lacks ambition.

name: Runelord Dedication
summary: Your connection to your sin suffuses all magic you use.

name: Embed Aeon Stone
summary: You discover the secrets to embedding _aeon stones_ into your flesh.

name: Aeon Resonance
summary: You gain the resonant power of one embedded aeon stone as if it were placed in a wayfinder.

name: Rod of Rule
summary: Your personal rune is connected more closely to your arcane bond.

name: Sinbladed Spell
summary: You punctuate your spellcasting with a flourish of your weapon, imparting physical force to your magic.

name: Sin Reservoir
summary: During your daily preparations, you can indulge in your associated sin or meditate on its values (and risks).

name: Sin Counterspell
summary: Your deep connection to a specific sin allows you to easily negate spells that sin opposes.

name: Orichalcum Bond
summary: The ancient Thassilonians associated sins with different skymetals, and you’ve adapted that theory to empower your bonded weapon beyond its normal limits.

name: Performer's Treatment
prerequisite: Expert in Medicine; Expert in Performance
summary: With your experience as a performer, you can keep a set of medical tools handy at all times.

name: Flood Stance
summary: The lessons of the flood teach a stance that distributes and circulates a single breath through the body and allows your punches to contain the focused power of a torrent of water.

name: Reflective Ripple Stance
summary: You enter a stance of fluid grace as small amounts of water flow with your movements and attacks.

name: Student of Water
summary: Following your studies of water, your qi stirs the water of the natural world.

name: Waterfowl Stance
summary: In your hands, swords dance like rainfall over the waves; who can tell where the storm ends and the sea begins?

name: Divert Streamflow
summary: With a brief gesture, you adapt swiftly to an attack like a flowing stream.

name: Tributary Circulation
summary: Never distant from water’s succoring presence, your refined breathing techniques focus your awareness and control of water inward.

name: Culvert's Collapse
summary: Under your foes’ onslaught, the water within your violent blood stirs.

name: Rippling Spin
summary: After the triggering attack is done, Step

name: Snakebird's Shadow
summary: Ganhil developed this technique through observing the sharp-beaked darters fishing Prada Hanam’s waters, seeking to match their speed and suppleness with the elemental flash of his blade.

name: Wake to Strife
summary: You summon the explosive power of a geyser beneath a foe.

name: Lessons of Flux
summary: You apply the persistence and permutation taught by faydhaans to your failures.

name: Wave Dashes Rocks
summary: You slam an unlucky foe with the tremendous power of a plunging wave.

name: Wave Spiral
summary: You dip and spin, unleashing a wide whirlpool of water.

name: Battle Harbinger Dedication
summary: You have trained extensively in combat, battlefield tactics, and stamina, focusing on being an exceptional warrior for your faith in exchange for less time studying the traditional spells and scriptures.

name: Aura Enhancement
summary: You’ve enhanced your training with your battle magic, allowing you access to a more potent divine font.

name: Tandem Onslaught
summary: You have trained your body and mind to work in tandem, and you can combine your combat and spellcasting prowess to better support yourself in battle.

name: Exigent Aura
summary: The power of your deity and your own convictions leave an impression on creatures even when they normally would be unable to comprehend your words or the feelings spurred on by your god.

name: Harbinger's Protection
summary: You often work on missions alone, making sure to cover up your weaknesses more effectively than other members of your faith.

name: Creed Magic
summary: You’ve expanded your divine capabilities, granting you magic that better supports your combat focus.

name: Harbinger's Armament
summary: Your deity grants you extra power that you have learned to channel into your weapons.

name: Empowered Onslaught
summary: When your body and mind are perfectly in sync and pushed to the limit, it can produce even greater results.

name: Tandem Auras
summary: You’ve learned how to maintain multiple auras at once, reinforcing them simultaneously.

name: Aura Expertise
summary: You’ve become so accustomed to maintaining your battle auras that it’s become second nature to you.

name: Greater Armament
summary: Your weapons have greater power available to them.

name: Live the Creed
summary: You’ve become an unparalleled figure among your faith, able to align your divine abilities with unparalleled swiftness.

name: Oath of The Avenger
summary: You’ve sworn an oath to punish wicked acts you witness.

name: Oath of The Defender
summary: During your daily preparations, you can swear an oath to defend against a certain kind of enemy during your deeds that day.

name: Oath of The Slayer
summary: During your daily preparations, you can swear an oath to defeat, topple, or destroy a certain kind of enemy during your deeds that day.

name: Sense Holiness
summary: The presence of goodness sickens you with its saccharine self-righteousness.

name: Sense Unholiness
summary: You sense the truly wicked as a queasy or foreboding feeling.

name: Enforce Oath
prerequisite: Any feat with the oath  trait
summary: You call on your oath to embolden you in combat.

name: Pale Horse
summary: Your mount becomes a grotesque creature of foreboding when you ride it.

name: Exalted Greatness
summary: You improve your exalted reaction with the benefit listed for your cause.

name: Celestial Form
summary: You take on a celestial countenance, gaining the features of a type of celestial who serves your deity; for example, as an angel, you gain a halo and feathery wings.

name: Fiendish Form
summary: Your features reshape into those of a type of fiend who serves your deity; for example, as a demon you might have putrid scales, twisted horns, and red eyes.

name: Retributive Focus
summary: Your enemy’s offenses fuel your righteous power.

name: Mortal Herald Dedication
prerequisite: Worshiper of a specific deity; Master in master in Religion or your deity’s divine skill
summary: You become a mortal herald of your deity, gaining power in return for your service.

name: Domain Embodiment
summary: Your deity contains multitudes, and you can express any aspect of them you desire.

name: Fear of God
prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; Expert in Intimidation
summary: You embed a divine fear into the triggering foe that lasts for 10 minutes.

name: Flash of Omnipresence
summary: Empowered with divine energy, you can be at an ally’s side in the blink of an eye.

name: Herald's Weapon
summary: Your weapon becomes a wrathful instrument of your deity’s power.

name: Mortal Ascension
summary: Your power uplifts you, breaking the bonds between you and the ground.

name: Shield the Faithful
summary: You and those closest to you are protected by your deity’s power.

name: Chastise
summary: With but a mere word from your deity, you exploit a foe’s fear to see their inner being brought low.

name: Declare Anathema
summary: You declare a creature you are aware of within 30 feet anathema, causing their friends and strangers to shy away from them.

name: Dive of the Divine
prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; fly Speed of at least 20 feet
summary: You dive from the sky, bringing down the might of the divine with you.

name: Following Smite
summary: You call upon your deity’s power and channel it through your weapon.

name: Free from Bonds
summary: As a mortal herald, you cannot easily be captured, nor can your allies.

name: Healing Sanctuary
summary: When you call upon your deity’s power, you also radiate a sense of safety that fortifies your allies.

name: Heraldic Proclamation
trait: Archetype, Divine, Healing, Sanctified, Spellshape, Spirit, Vitality
summary: You proclaim your spell with the might of your god behind you.

name: Invisible Hand
prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; Master in Stealth
summary: Sometimes your deity requires you to act in the shadows, accomplishing things without drawing attention to yourself— or them.

name: Deific Font
summary: Your life force can fuel the stuff of miracles.

name: Divine Presence
summary: Your spirit becomes one with your deity, granting you the bearing of a god.

name: Eyes of God
summary: You can see things as they truly are.

name: Flash of Omniscience
summary: You briefly see the world as your deity does, recognizing the truth of those around you for a moment.

name: Glory on High
prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; fly Speed of at least 20 feet
summary: You take to the skies to unveil the full magnificence of your deity’s power.

name: Guiding Words
trait: Archetype, Auditory, Concentrate, Divine, Fortune, Linguistic
prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; Master in Diplomacy
summary: Your words speak divine truth, guiding blades and arrows to their mark.

name: Marked For Rebuke
summary: You declare that an enemy is fit for further punishment in the sight of your deity.

name: Stand for the Fallen
summary: You protect your allies at the cost of your own blood, but your deity shields you from the worst of the harm.

name: Ease the Burden
summary: You wash away a creature’s pain with a touch.

name: Enter Divine Realm
summary: You are granted access to your deity’s realm and can travel there quickly.

name: Flash of Omipotence
summary: For but a moment you hold the power of a god.

name: Herald's Strike
summary: The power of your blows can send your victim hurling through your deity’s realm for a fragment of a second.

name: Moment of Apotheosis
summary: For a small moment, you can assume the form of your god.

name: Spark of Immortality
summary: You have become a divine entity, no longer entirely mortal.

name: Palatine Detective Dedication
summary: You have delved into the study of the occult and divine, becoming exceptionally skilled at identifying when such forces are at work.

name: Esoteric Spellcasting
summary: Your study of a variety of esoteric texts and supernatural matters has broadened your mind and improved your spellcasting.

name: Text Decoder
summary: Thanks to your constant involvement with cryptic texts, you have attained an almost-supernatural ability to decipher complex codes and understand ancient writings.

name: Palatine Enchantment
summary: You have found yourself facing supernatural beings often and have learned how to combat them.

name: Palatine Strike
summary: Your strikes are particularly deadly against supernatural creatures.

name: Challenge Insight
summary: Your deep grasp of the mystical lets you know exactly what to say to make others doubt how well they understand the source of their own power.

name: Cursebreaker
summary: Using various implements and esoteric methods, you can attempt to remove a curse from an unfortunate victim.

name: Greater Esoteric Spellcasting
summary: Your understanding of magic has evolved, and so has your spellcasting.

name: Open the Blazing Eye
summary: Thanks to your diligence in the study of divine and occult mysteries, you can focus to temporarily attain a perception beyond the ordinary.

name: Razmiran Priest Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Crafting; Trained in Deception
summary: You have earned entry to the priesthood of Razmir, either at the Exalted Lodge or another temple where Razmir’s holy masks are forged.

name: Perfect Truths
summary: Your knowledge of Razmir’s faith and doctrines has grown.

name: Mask of The 12th Step
prerequisite: Razmiran Priest Dedication; Expert in Crafting
summary: You have reached the 12th Step and been instructed in greater secrets of Razmir’s doctrine.

name: Mask of The 15th Step
prerequisite: Razmiran Priest Dedication; Master in Crafting
summary: You have ascended to the 15th Step and stand among the greatest of Razmir’s priests.

name: Living God
prerequisite: Razmiran Priest Dedication; Legendary in Crafting
summary: You have reached heights of power equaling Razmir’s himself.

name: Rivethun Emissary Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy; Trained in Religion
summary: You’re a practicing Rivethun emissary, skilled at interacting and bonding with the spirits of living creatures.

name: Emissary Familiar
summary: You forge a mystical bond with a spirit or create a spirit from a fragment of your own soul.

name: Domain Spirit
summary: You forge an intense spiritual bond of mutual trust and appreciation with a single spirit that you have already bonded with using Bond with Spirit.

name: Kaleidoscopic Entreaty
summary: If your next action is to cast entreat spirit, you can cause that spirit to unleash a brilliant display of color, light, and sound in a 10-foot emanation centered on you.

name: Rivethun Devotion
summary: Through study, dedication, and introspection, you’ve learned to wield magic that affects the spirit.

name: Advanced Domain Spirit
summary: Your connection with your domain spirit has deepened.

name: Consult the Spirits (Rivethun Emissary)
summary: You spend 1 hour communing with powerful spirits of the world to gain insight, information, or advice.

name: Manifold Conduit
summary: You can manifest multiple spirits at once in a cyclone around you.

name: Rivethun Adept
summary: Your ability to wield spirit magic has increased.

name: Embolded With Glorious Purpose
summary: Communing with powerful spirits of the world and other powers far greater than yourself fills your heart with purpose and inspires you to strive for greater accomplishments.

name: Rivethun Invoker Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Athletics; Trained in Religion
summary: You’re a practicing Rivethun invoker, able to enter a trance that connects you physically and mentally to surrounding spirits.

name: Invoke Offense
summary: You manifest a physical attack of the spirits all around you, such as the claw of an animal spirit or the whipping vine of a nature spirit.

name: Leverage Anguish
summary: You leverage your emotional turmoil to mend your physical form.

name: Invoke Defense
summary: You manifest a defensive quality of spirits all around, such as the thick hide of an animal spirit or the sturdy bark of a nature spirit.

name: Defy Sorrow
summary: You draw on this spiritual pain to push your body to greater heights.

name: Invoke Movement
summary: You manifest a form of locomotion of the spirits all around, such as the wings of an animal spirit or the watery flow of a nature spirit.

name: One with the Spirits
summary: The spirits you’ve invoked throughout your life have left behind echoes and spiritual fragments, which you can manifest across your own flesh, temporarily transforming you into something more akin to spirit than mortal.

name: Rivethun Involutionist Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Nature; Trained in Religion
summary:
You’re a practicing Rivethun involutionist, with a deep well
of inner power.

name: Basic Rivethun Spellcasting
summary: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

name: Spirit Companion
summary: You gain the service of a young animal companion, which has been blessed by the spirits of this world.

name: Expert Rivethun Spellcasting
prerequisite: Basic Rivethun Spellcasting; Master in Religion
summary: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

name: Specialized Spirit Companion
summary: Your animal companion gains a unique specialization, spirit-blessed.

name: Master Rivethun Spellcasting
prerequisite: Expert Rivethun Spellcasting; Legendary in Religion
summary: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

name: Expanded Domain Initiate
summary:
You have long venerated one of your deity’s lesser-known
aspects.

name: Splinter Faith
summary: Your faith in your deity is represented in an extremely unusual way that some might call heretical.

name: Speedrun Strats
summary: Whenever you take a move action to Stride, you can attempt an Acrobatics check to roll forward.

name: Venture-Gossip Dedication
prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; member of the Pathfinder Society
summary: Look, the motto of the Pathfinder Society is “explore, report, cooperate” and you’re just reporting what you hear!

name: Verbose Distraction
summary: You talk so much it can be distracting to your enemies and you’re often quick to remind your enemies that you’re just a little guy!

name: Hey! Over Here!
summary: Hey! Don’t listen to that! That’s bad sounds! Listen to me!

name: A Little Bird Told Me...
summary: You transform into a small bird, such as a finch or a sparrow, allowing you to eavesdrop on others and gain information you wouldn’t otherwise be able to acquire.

name: Define "Report"
summary: Look, getting caught in a lie is a normal part of venture-gossip life.

name: Catch and Kill
summary: When you’ve decided to quash a story, no one can escape from you with any incriminating information.

name: Muckraking
summary: It seems like your knowledge has come in handy after all and you have your enemy at your feet.

name: Verduran Shadow Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival
summary: Your awareness of primal energies allows you to explore forests with preternatural ease.

name: Canopy Predator
prerequisite: Verduran Shadow Dedication; Trained in Athletics
summary: You are as at home in the treetops as you are beneath their branches.

name: Underbrush Trailblazer
summary: You gain the Terrain Stalker feat, selecting the underbrush terrain; if you already have Terrain Stalker for underbrush, you can select a different type of difficult terrain.

name: Verduran Ambush
prerequisite: Verduran Shadow Dedication; Expert in Stealth
summary: You prepare to ambush a foe.

name: Death from Above
prerequisite: Canopy Predator; Verduran Shadow Dedication; Expert in Athletics
summary: You leap down on your target, using their body to cushion your fall and your momentum to empower your attack.

name: Sense the Strike
prerequisite: Verduran Shadow Dedication; Master in Survival
summary: You sense how an incoming attack moves through ambient primal energy, predicting how best to dodge.

name: Caustic Nectar
summary: You have specialized glands inside your throat, which produce acidic nectar that you can spit long distances.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 69

name: Unbowed, Unbroken
summary: Your connection to elemental wood manifests as resilience—towering trees, rough bark, deep roots, and patient determination.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 69

name: Wilderness Born
summary: You’re at home in the wilderness and easily disappear into it.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 69

name: Quick Root
summary: You react instinctively, sprouting roots from your legs and plunging them deep into the ground to keep your footing.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 69

name: Grow Tool
summary: You grow a simple tool from your own body, coaxing flowers, vines, roots, and wood to grow and sprout from your flesh into the desired shape.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 70

name: Pollinate
summary: As you’re hit, you emit a dense cloud of pollen, obscuring you from sight.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 70

name: One with the Wild
summary: You naturally blend in with the wilderness, becoming camouflaged.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 70

name: Unfettered Growth
summary: By tapping into the limitless power of the Plane of Wood, you can experience sudden, dramatic growth for a short time.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 70

name: Irresistible Bloom
trait: Emotion, Incapacitation, Mental, Olfactory, Uncommon, Visual
summary: You bloom, sprouting flowers and releasing a pleasant smell, becoming irresistible.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 70

name: Potent Nectar
summary: Your nectar becomes particularly dangerous.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 70

name: Fungal Exhalation
summary: You can conjure toxic spores to infect enemies.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 72

name: Hedge Prison
summary: You cultivate plants to entrap your foes.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 72

name: Born to the Trees
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Morph, Primal, Uncommon, Wood
summary: You adapt a creature to live among the trees, improving its ability to climb, balance, and leap.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 73

name: The Thousand Lashes of the Weeping Willow
trait: Impulse, Kineticist, Overflow, Plant, Primal, Uncommon, Wood
summary: You conjure a massive willow tree, which lashes your foes with a thousand branches.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 73

name: Release Spores
summary: You create a miasma of spores.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 74

name: Rotten Slurry
summary: You expel a glob of rotten, foul-smelling slurry from your torso, hand, or mouth at a foe.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 74

name: Irradiate
summary: You exude an aura of radiation, making everyone around you ill.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 74

name: Unleash the Blight
summary: You unleash the rot infecting you, spreading the blight to those nearby.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 74

name: Sprout Fruit
summary: The plants covering your body sprout a single, ripe fruit.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 75

name: Vine Lash
summary: A long vine sprouts from your arm, which you can temporarily wield like a whip.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 75

name: Defensive Growth
summary: You grow a shield of woven flowers and branches, then Raise that Shield to defend yourself from the triggering attack.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 75

name: Disperse into Petals
summary: You merge with the blossoms sprouting from you and disperse, becoming a visible cloud of blossoms and petals.
source: Pathfinder #202: Severed at the Root pg. 75

name: Gladiator's Roar
trait: Archetype, Emotion, Fear, Mental, Sonic, Uncommon
summary: You can project your voice into a high-pitched screech that damages your foes.

name: Operatic Adventurer
summary: Your training has focused you for the opera, and it certainly shows.

name: Perfect Pitch
summary: Your ear for harmony has enhanced your ability with musical magic.

name: Play to the Crowd
summary: You have a knack for knowing just how to manipulate groups by saying exactly what needs to be said.

name: Primadonna
summary: The spotlight should always be on you and you alone.

name: Virtuosic Dancer
summary: You’re so fond of using your Acrobatic feats on the stage that you’ve begun adding your own flair to these dances on the big stage.

name: Costume Change
prerequisite: Acrobat Dedication or Celebrity Dedication; Quick Disguise; Master in Performance
summary: Enough of your life has been spent performing that you’ve mastered the art of the quick change—especially when it comes to armor or invested items.

name: Fit for the Role
summary: Not only are you a flamboyant performer, but you’ve mastered an occult secret that allows you to outfit yourself and your companions with magical visages.

name: It's Not Over
summary: In the world of drama, the finale of any performance doesn’t have to be the end, and for you, this now extends to life itself.

name: Tempo Shift
prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Gladiator Dedication; Legendary in Acrobatics
summary: You are always ready to embrace to a change in tempo and adapt your actions to take advantage of unforeseen developments.

name: Fight Choreography
prerequisite: Acrobat Dedication or Gladiator Dedication; master in Theater Lore
summary: You’ve spent enough time training in stage fighting and teaching a wide range of stunts that you can prepare your companions with directions on how to avoid peril in battle.

name: Tragic Lament
trait: Archetype, Auditory, Emotion, Linguistic, Mental, Uncommon
prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Dandy Dedication; Legendary in Performance
summary: You dramatically cry out in poetic verse about the tragedies that led to your doom at this very moment, instilling guilt in your attacker.

name: More Real than Real
summary: Your performances aren’t just well-known, they’re famous across the land and beyond.

name: Tattooed Historian Dedication
prerequisite: Constitution +1; Trained in Belkzen Lore, Trained in Orc Lore, Trained in Orc Pantheon Lore, or (at the GM's discretion) a related Lore skill
summary: You become trained in Diplomacy or Performance; if you are already trained in both skills, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

name: Aurochs-Headed
prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy or Trained in Intimidation
summary: Your words and body language can subconsciously unsettle orcs, giving you an advantage when convincing them to see things your way.

name: Spell Survivor
summary: Once you’ve resisted an opponent’s magic, anything else they throw your way becomes less effective.

name: Agent of All Holds
summary: Orcs across Belkzen recognize you as an honored lorekeeper.

name: Inked Panoply
summary: Your tattoos can briefly animate and extend from your skin, granting you a spectral shieldbearer who protects you from harm.

name: Infused with Belkzen's Might
summary: Your tattoos immortalize the conquests of orc war leaders, such as Belkzen besieging the dwarven Sky Citadel of Koldukar.

name: Inscribed with Elders' Deeds
summary: Your tattoos commemorate unique exploits that (according to legends) only an orc could accomplish.

name: Wrath of the Hold
summary: Your tattoos carry the strength of an innumerable horde, and you can expend one use of your storied skin’s Living History ability to animate your tattoos as ghostly assailants that swarm your foes.

name: Political Acumen
summary: You have spent years following the political maneuvering and secret alliances of elves in Iadara.
source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 80

name: Traditional Ways
summary: You are a fervent follower of the long-standing elven traditions established when your people returned to Kyonin.
source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 80

name: Shame the Sin
summary: Your conviction against the sins that all demons grow from is so strong that you can force a demon to suffer from its sins when you strike a sound blow against them.
source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 80

name: Swamp Stealth
summary: In swamplands, you are particularly skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage, or moving quietly through murky water.
source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 80

name: Political Virtuoso
summary: Your mastery of the politics of your home nation is profound.
source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 80

name: Demon Hunter
prerequisite: Expert in Religion or Expert in Demon Lore
summary: The demons of Tanglebriar have long haunted your dreams, just as they have long threatened Kyonin.
source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 80

name: Anchoring Arrow
summary: You can prevent demonic foes from fleeing your wrath via teleportation.
source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 81

name: Cold Iron Stomach
summary: You have steeled yourself against potent odors.
source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 81

name: Treehealer
summary: You can undo the effect of demonic corruption in plants.
source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 81

name: Demon Slayer
summary: You can deliver a melee blow to a demon that creates an explosion of holy light to try to finish the demon off.
source: Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt pg. 81

name: Eagle Knight Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy; Trained in Society
summary: Eagle Knights are the marshals and envoys of Andoran and are committed to keeping the peace.

name: Commitment to Equality
prerequisite: Eagle Knight Dedication; Expert in Diplomacy
summary: You help an ally shake off any impediment that would give an enemy an unfair advantage.

name: Interpose
summary: You put yourself between an ally and danger.

name: Commitment to Justice
summary: When your allies are harmed, you deliver retribution.

name: Commitment to Liberty
summary: You can’t abide when a foe has one of your allies in its grip.

name: Bolster Ally
summary: You shout encouragement to your embattled ally.

name: Stir Allies
summary: You shout a command for your allies to scramble.

name: Aura of Confidence
summary: Your will and your faith in your nation is unassailable, and the feeling is contagious.

name: Talmandor's Shout
prerequisite: Eagle Knight Dedication; Master in Intimidation
summary: After seeing an enemy harm one of your allies, you deliver a righteous shout in the name of the celestial Talmandor.

name: Even the Odds
summary: Even when overpowered, Eagle Knights hold out hope.

name: Immediate Rebuke
summary: You can use Reactive Strike when a creature within your reach Strikes one of your allies.

name: Inflame Crowd
summary: Your performances are a call to action for the crowds who listen to you.

name: Stifle Flames
prerequisite: Trained in Nature or Trained in Survival
summary: Your forestry experience helped you develop techniques for fighting wildfires.

name: Vanish into The Land
prerequisite: Master in Stealth; Trained in Survival; Terrain Stalker
summary: You’re adept at using the land’s natural features to find places to hide.

name: Prophet of Kalistrade Dedication
prerequisite: trained in Mercantile Lore; Trained in Society; Charisma +2
summary: After induction into the ranks of the Kalistocrats, you learned the skills necessary to succeed in business and rise above others by following a set of detailed strictures.

name: Basic Prophet Spellcasting
summary: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

name: Smile at Failure
summary: You know staying cool is key to prevailing in social situations, as anger leads to mistakes.

name: Fortune's Favor
summary: You understand when an investment in you has the chance to pay off.

name: Prolific Prophet Spellcasting
summary: Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and the number of spell slots you gain from prophet of Kalistrade archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest prophet of Kalistrade spell slots.

name: Prophet's Lockbox
summary: You’ve learned secret methods that allow you to store your valuables where no one else can reach them.

name: Expert Prophet Spellcasting
prerequisite: Basic Prophet Spellcasting; Master in Society
summary: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

name: Master Merchant
summary: Kalistrade teaches that setbacks are only temporary and that perseverance is a treasured virtue.

name: Master Prophet Spellcasting
prerequisite: Expert Prophet Spellcasting; Legendary in Society
summary: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

name: Blackjacket Dedication
prerequisite: trained in medium armor and martial weapons
summary: You have entered the ranks of the Mercenary League and now wear the black uniform that’s the source of the organization’s popular epithet.

name: Belay That!
summary: You can recognize when a strategy isn’t working and advise your ally to change course.

name: Mercenary Motivation
summary: A large part of being in the Mercenary League entails doing mercenary work.

name: Battlefield Agility
summary: Your enemies might think they have you surrounded, but you know just how to extricate yourself.

name: Lead by Example
summary: You telegraph your next attack to let your allies in on your strategy.

name: Nothing Personal
summary: When you’re on a job, you can’t allow anyone to stop you.

name: Close Contract
summary: You’re bolstered when a plan comes together.

name: Opportune Opening
summary: Your combat training taught you to capitalize on any moment of weakness from your foe.

name: Stalwart Song
summary: As a stalwart defender, you rely on your martial training and your tried-and-true armor to face any danger without flinching.

name: Stalwart Chant
summary: You know story after story of unyielding, valiant dwarven heroes whose minds were bulwarks against fear and confusion.

name: Headless Haunt
summary: You were condemned to death and executed with one of Galt’s infamous _final blades_, where your soul was trapped for years or even decades.

name: Fling Head
summary: You Interact to remove your head, if it isn’t already detached, and fling it at an enemy within 30 feet, where it emits a bone-chilling wail before dematerializing and returning to your body.

name: Haunting Memories
summary: Your soul bears metaphysical impressions of the innumerable other spirits imprisoned with you in the _final blade_ from which you escaped, allowing you to draw upon their memories.

name: Klingegeist
summary: Your imprisonment inside a _final blade_ used to perform countless executions has instilled in you an aptitude for entering and possessing similar sharp implements of murder.

name: Ghostly Condemnation
summary: You shriek a death sentence upon a single target within 120 feet, forcing it to experience the final moments of your mortal life as you were dragged through a howling mob and forced to kneel before the _final blade_ that took your life and head.

name: Spectral Dagger
summary: By touching the _splinter of finality_ in your neck, you conjure a _spectral dagger_ into your hand that resembles the splinter wrapped in a crude hilt.

name: Dread Blade
summary: Your strikes with your conjured dagger impart the chill of the grave.

name: Soul Bleed
summary: Your blade can rupture an enemy’s very soul, draining away its essence to empower you.

name: Soul Well
summary: Your brush your fingers across your _splinter of finality_, momentarily creating a metaphysical vortex from which mortal spirits struggle to escape.

name: Lethal Edge
summary: When the terrified are struck by your spectral weapon, they feel the anguish of every life taken by _Silent Lenore_.

name: Hungry Blade
summary: Once your _spectral dagger_ has tasted an enemy’s soul, your _splinter of finality_ becomes increasingly relentless in its attempts to claim the soul.

name: Vengful Remnant
summary: You wreathe yourself in the tatters of all the souls claimed by your blade.

name: Instrument of Death
summary: Your _splinter of finality_  has reached the apex of its death-dealing potential.

name: Guillotine Blade
summary: The echoes of the _splinter of finality's_ original purpose resonate through the artifact.

name: Soul Oubliette
summary: Your mortal strike wrenches the soul from your victim’s body and imprisons it in your _splinter of finality_, with the effects of _seize soul_.

name: Wylderheart Dedication
summary: You’re primed to face off against threats from the Outer Rifts.

name: Demon-Hunting Companion
summary: You gain a young animal companion that has been specially trained to help you fight demons.

name: Wyldsinger
summary: Passion and song are your weapons of choice.

name: Blessed Sentinel
summary: You infuse a weapon with the blessing of Ketephys and attack.

name: Primal Guardian
summary: You grow in power as a guardian of nature.

name: Wild Dance
summary: The combination of your passion for both life and the battle against evil makes you graceful and unpredictable.

name: Fiend Slayer
summary: Your attack tears through a fiend, possibly sending it back to where it came from.

name: Sacred Weapon
summary: You’re a living weapon honed to destroy fiends.

name: Free Heart
summary: You follow all your passions, unlimited in creativity and zeal.

name: Elven Persistence
summary: Elves don’t give up easily on their pursuits.

name: Lion Blade Dedication
prerequisite: member of the Lion Blades; Trained in Performance
summary: Your Lion Blade spy training helps you conceal yourself and your identity.

name: Inspiring Recitation
summary: You quietly speak or recall coded phrases and metaphors whose meanings inspire you to complete your mission.

name: Lost in the Crowd
summary: You’ve learned how to move as one with crowds and hide among them, vanishing into a busy street in the flicker of an eye.

name: Crowd Mastery
summary: You use the crowd to your advantage, diverting your foes’ attention to potential hidden dangers in the crowd.

name: Expeditious Advance
summary: You advance and retreat quickly.

name: Interposing Crowd
summary: Your enemies can’t stop you when there’s a host of people between you.

name: Lion's Magic
summary: Many Lion Blades enhance their words with a bit of magic.

name: Spy's Countermeasures
summary: You’ve learned how to analyze and fake your responses to the most common magic used against spies.

name: Flickering Twirl
summary: You use your movements and disguises to make yourself a flickering blur.

name: Slowing Strike
summary: You wound your enemy so they can’t move nimbly.

name: Stunning Surprise
summary: You quickly move in to bring your foe down with a single blow.

name: Ulfen Guard Dedication
prerequisite: member of the Ulfen Guard; Trained in Athletics; Trained in Intimidation
summary: Central to your Ulfen Guard training is the ability to protect an ally.

name: Defender's Grit
summary: You can’t protect anyone if you’re dead.

name: Guard's Fury
prerequisite: Ulfen Guard Dedication; you can’t already use the Rage action
summary: Some Ulfen Guards tap into a well of fury to protect their charges.

name: Guarded Mind
summary: When your enemies try to turn your mind against you, thoughts of your anathema bolster you.

name: Wounded Party
summary: Harm to either you or your allies awakens your fury.

name: Tight Follower
summary: You keep up as a protector.

name: Protective Strike
summary: You keep harm at bay.

name: Shattered Sacrament
prerequisite: Halcyon Speaker Dedication; Cascade Bearer's Spellcasting
summary: When Vigil fell to Tar-Baphon’s Radiant Fire, that lost innocence brought you a deeper understanding of what faith means in the context of your own magic.

name: Speak for the Gravelands
prerequisite: Halcyon Speaker Dedication; Trained in Nature; can cast at least one spell with the vitality trait
summary: You have learned much of what the Gravelands need and are confident in your ability to speak for them.

name: Vellumis Excision
summary: You seek to excise the rot from the Gravelands and have made progress to do so.

name: Tripartite Omen
prerequisite: Dualistic Synergy; Shattered Sacrament; Master in Religion
summary: You invoke religious portents to ward yourself against danger without losing sight of the history that led to this point.

name: Vigil's Palisades
summary: When you use Persistent Creation, you can create up to three special wooden shields that provide a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and have Hardness 15, 120 HP, and BT 60.

name: Grave Threat
summary: You use your imposing demeanor to set up the undead for defeat.

name: Cut them Down, Burn them Out
prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; master proficiency in a weapon
summary: Inspired by the sixth line of the Crimson Oath, when you oppose the enemies of Lastwall, you aim to excise the rot from the land itself.

name: May Death Itself Reconsider
summary: Your will is so steadfast that even death can’t stop you.

name: Rallying Charge
summary: When you lead your allies to the front lines, you leave no one behind.

name: Preternatural Polish
summary: Armor you polish shines with righteous grace.

name: Body Barrier
summary: When your allies are in danger, you don’t hesitate to take the brunt of the blow for them.

name: Spirit of Vigil
summary: Though the city of Vigil itself has been destroyed, you will carry on its warrior spirit to the end of your days.

name: Uncanny Vitae
summary: Your warrior spirit is infused with a potent vital essence that imbues your gear.

name: Cenotaph Stance
summary: You take on a stance that marks your location as a place where none will fall.

name: Adept Storyteller
prerequisite: Uzunjati Storytelling; master in a Recall Knowledge skill
summary: Your ability to tell stories rivals those of the finest bards.

name: Cautious Word
summary: You let your words defend you, just as your allies in the Vellumis Scholars defend through knowledge.

name: Crusader's Masquerade
summary: Your mask can hide you from the undead.

name: Faith in the Fallen
summary: The Gravelands are full of fallen spirits seeking to move on, and you consider it your obligation to assist in that regard.

name: I knew the Heroes
prerequisite: Uzunjati Recollection; legendary in a Recall Knowledge Skill
summary: Your stories aren’t mere tales passed down from elder to youth or teacher to student.

name: Bloodsense
summary: You’re extraordinarily sensitive to the presence of blood.

name: Sanguine Tenacity
summary: Your blood carries permanent regenerative properties.

name: Vasodilation
summary: Using the power of your own blood, you encourage increased blood flow to nourish damaged tissue.

name: Sanguimancer Dedication
summary: You can draw and manipulate energy from blood. You store life energy in the form of special temporary Hit Points and spend it to manifest powerful effects.

name: Blood Shield
summary: You raise a barrier of your own blood to protect you.

name: Exsanguinate
summary: After one of your attacks, you direct your foe’s blood to spray upon you, infusing you with life energy.

name: Transfusion
summary: You bring forth the regenerative properties of blood on behalf of an ally or yourself.

name: Venipuncture
summary: A shell made up of hundreds of razor-thin needles of blood forms around you before exploding outward.

name: Caretaker's Intuition
summary: Your forebears had a deep understanding of the natural world around them, and you’ve learned some of their knowledge and techniques.

name: Caretaker's Restoration
summary: The stewarding abilities of your forebears allows you to repair objects important to you.

name: Jotun's Eyes
summary: Your vision has adapted to the darkness between planes.

name: Jotunborn Grappler
summary: Wrestling is a common pastime for jotunborn, and you’ve done your fair share.

name: Jotunborn Lore
summary: You were taught the history of your people’s planar travels as well as the skills necessary to thrive in sub-planar environments.

name: Jotunborn Weapon Familiarity
summary: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the jotunborn trait.

name: Plane-Stepping Dash
summary: You move with magical swiftness, treading between planar boundaries to shorten your journey.

name: Call the First Tools
summary: You can call upon the ancient powers bestowed on you by the gods to create any tools you might need at a moment’s notice.

name: Jotun's Battle Stance
summary: You emulate the battle stance of your forebears, allowing you to use mighty weapons to attack distant foes.

name: Jotun's Grasp
summary: You’ve mastered a technique that allows you to close the gap on foes and wrestle them into submission.

name: Planar Resilience
summary: Your body has adapted to the variety of harsh climes that you encounter in your travels.

name: Pounding Leap
summary: You use the momentum of your massive fists to launch yourself through the air.

name: Build the First Walls
summary: The powers of creation that run through you allow you to conjure a temporary wall.

name: Iivlar's Deflection
summary: You’re able to use the silk woven into your skin to deflect attacks, reducing the deadliness of grievous blows.

name: Jotun's Boost
summary: Your giant might allows you to pick up your allies and hurl them across the battlefield.

name: Plane Step
summary: You temporarily move just beyond the threshold of the current plane, granting you concealment until the end of your next turn.

name: Iivlar's Boundary Break
summary: You can bend the boundary between planes with the natural skill of an iivlar.

name: Jotun's Restoration
summary: You’ve mastered how to tap into your restorative powers at a higher frequency.

name: Plane Hop
summary: The spaces between planes are obvious to you, and you can use them to move in unexpected ways.

name: Smoothing Stomp
summary: You stomp and unleash a wave of the magic of creation in a 30-foot emanation that transforms non-magical difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain into normal terrain.

name: Jotun's Heart
summary: You have unlocked the power of a true giant within you.

name: Jotun's Transposition
summary: You’ve learned to fully move across planes, beginning with the Ethereal Plane.

name: Planar Traveler
summary: You concentrate on the spaces between planes, allowing you to enhance your movement for a short period.

name: Armor Regiment Training
summary: You've trained for grueling marches in full battle kit.

name: Commander's Companion
summary: You gain the service of a young animal companion. You can affix your banner to your companion.

name: Deceptive Tactics
summary: Your training has taught you that the art of war is the art of deception.

name: Officer's Medical Training
summary: You received formal training in battlefield triage and wound treatment.

name: Plant Banner
summary: You plant your banner to inspire your allies to hold the line.

name: Adaptive Stratagem
summary: Your constant training and strong bond with your allies allow you to change tactics on the fly.

name: Defensive Swap
summary: You and your allies work together selflessly to protect each other from harm.

name: Guiding Shot
summary: Your ranged attack helps guide your allies into striking your enemy's weak point.

name: Rapid Assessment
summary: You quickly evaluate your enemies.

name: Set-up Strike
summary: Your attack makes it difficult for your enemy to defend themselves against your allies' attacks.

name: Tactical Expansion
summary: Your folio is filled with tactics and techniques you’ve devised based on study and experience.

name: Banner Twirl
summary: You spin your banner in an elaborate pattern that your enemies find inscrutable.

name: Banner's Inspiration
trait: Brandish, Commander, Emotion, Flourish, Mental, Visual
summary: You wave your banner, inspiring allies to throw off the shackles of fear.

name: Observational Analysis
summary: You are able to rapidly discern relevant details about your opponents in the heat of combat.

name: Shielded Recovery
summary: You can bandage wounds with the same hand you use to hold  your shield.

name: Unsteadying Strike
summary: Your attack makes your opponent more susceptible to follow-up maneuvers from your allies.

name: Battle-Tested Companion
summary: Your companion is a tried and tested ally of unshakable reliability.

name: Claim the Field
summary: You hurl your banner forward with precision, claiming the battlefield for yourself and your allies.

name: Efficient Preparation
summary: You’ve developed techniques for drilling your allies on multiple tactics in a succinct and efficient manner.

name: Defiant Banner
summary: You vigorously wave your banner to remind yourself and your allies that you can and must endure.

name: Officer's Education
summary: You know that a broad knowledge base is critical for a competent commander.

name: Rallying Banner
trait: Brandish, Commander, Emotion, Healing, Mental, Visual
summary: Your banner waves high, reminding your allies that the fight can still be won.

name: Unrivaled Analysis
summary: Your experience allows you to derive even more information about your opponents from a mere glance.

name: Battle-Hardened Companion
summary: Accompanying you across countless battlefields has allowed your companion to unleash its full potential.

name: Drilled Reflexes
summary: You leave a lasting impression on your squadmates that makes them particularly adept at following your commands.

name: Standard-Bearer's Sacrifice
summary: Seeing an enemy take aim at your ally, you bravely flourish your banner to redirect their attention to you.

name: Targeting Strike
summary: Your attack creates an opening in your target's defenses for your allies to capitalize on.

name: Fortunate Blow
summary: You set an enemy up for a devastating follow-through from your allies.

name: Perfected Evaluations
summary: You instantly assess the strengths and weaknesses of the enemy forces.

name: Contact with the Enemy
summary: You know that even the best-laid plans rarely survive contact with the enemy, and you have prepared your allies to adapt with a wide array of contingencies.

name: Desperate Resuscitation
prerequisite: Officer's Medical Training; Master in Medicine
summary: You can use your training in combat medicine to revive the recently deceased.

name: Quickening Banner
summary: The sight of your banner urges your allies to strike now.

name: Confusing Commands
summary: You shout out bewildering but authoritative commands while imitating the voices, linguistic quirks, and speech patterns of your opponents.

name: Peerless Mascot Companion
summary: As veterans of countless battles, you and your companion share an indomitable strength.

name: Demand Surrender
summary: Confident in your victory, you command your opponent's  surrender.

name: Mercenary Reversal
summary: Even though the fight seems to be surging against you and your compatriots, you know that a key ally can always turn the tide.

name: Practiced Reflexes
summary: You snap out a quick series of signals or commands that urge your allies to act with alacrity.

name: Glorious Banner
summary: Your banner is an awesome sight to behold.

name: Pennant of Victory
summary: You wave your banner in victory, signaling to your allies that the fight is won.

name: Bodyguard
summary: You swear a vow to protect one of your allies at all costs, regardless of the risk this might pose to you.

name: Larger than Life (Guardian)
summary: When you're clad in the heaviest of armors, you have an outsized presence.

name: Long-distance Taunt
summary: You can draw the wrath of your foes even at a great distance.

name: Punishing Shove
summary: When you push a foe away, you put the entire force of your armored form into it.

name: Shield Warfare
summary: You know how to use shields offensively far better than most.

name: Shoulder Check
summary: You hit a foe with your armor to throw them off balance.

name: Covering Stance
summary: Your very presence on the field of battle protects nearby allies from harm.

name: Hampering Stance
summary: You make it difficult for enemies to move past you.

name: Phalanx Formation (Guardian)
summary: You know how to clear a line of fire for your allies.

name: Raise Haft
summary: You know how to use the haft of larger weapons to block your enemies' attacks.

name: Shield your Eyes
summary: You reflexively place your shield between your eyes and visual dangers.

name: Shielding Taunt
summary: By banging loudly on your shield, you get the attention of even the most stubborn of foes.

name: Taunting Strike
summary: The force of your blow causes your enemy to focus their attention on you.

name: Area Armor
summary: The armor you wear protects you and shelters your allies against explosions and other large-scale assaults.

name: Armored Courage
summary: You take comfort in the safety of your armor.

name: Energy Interceptor
summary: Though other guardians understand how to anticipate the flow of martial combat, you predict blasts of magical lightning, blazing trap runes, and more.

name: Flying Tackle
summary: You barrel forward, gathering enough momentum to take down a threatening foe.

name: Not so Fast!
summary: You lash out when foes try to get past you, possibly stopping them in their tracks.

name: Proud Nail
summary: When a foe ignores your taunts, you make them pay.

name: Shielded Attrition
summary: You provoke attacks from foes that might otherwise stop your allies from moving.

name: Disarming Intercept
summary: When you catch a weapon in your armor, you can move your body to wrench it from your foe's grasp.

name: Guarded Advance (Guardian)
summary: You slowly advance on the battlefield, taking utmost caution.

name: Lock Down
summary: You attack an enemy to ensure they can't move beyond your reach.

name: Retaliating Rescue
summary: When an ally is in danger, you can hustle to reach them and punish the foe threatening them.

name: Ring their Bell
summary: Using your armor, you pummel a foe that isn't focused on you in the head or face to stagger them.

name: Stomp Ground
summary: You bring your booted foot down on the ground with enough force to rattle your foes.

name: Group Taunt
summary: Your taunts draw the attention of multiple enemies at once.

name: Juggernaut Charge
summary: As you move forward in a rush, you put the weight of your armor behind an attack that can drag a foe with you.

name: Repositioning Block
summary: As you absorb a blow from an enemy, you can use their attack's momentum against them.

name: Shield from Arrows
summary: You place your shield in the path of an oncoming projectile.

name: Shield Wallop
summary: Attacks with your shield knock the sense out of your foes.

name: Belly Flop
summary: You crush an enemy under the enormous weight of your armor.

name: Get Behind Me!
summary: When saving your allies from harm, you push them behind you to better protect them.

name: Momentum Strike
summary: Putting your weight behind your weapon's swing, you can push one enemy into another.

name: Sure-Footed
summary: Even if you're knocked off balance, your armor continues to protect you.

name: Tough Cookie
summary: Though you've taken a lot of punishment, you aren't easily brought down.

name: Armor Break
summary: You flex your muscles to crack your damaged armor, blasting jagged shards into nearby enemies.

name: Armored Counterattack
summary: With the might of your armor behind you, you hit back at a foe who would dare try to hurt your allies.

name: Devastating Shield Wallop
summary: The impact of your shield sends foes tumbling to the ground.

name: Right Where you Want Them
summary: Whether with a weapon or your bare hands, you keep your opponents in their place.

name: Scattering Charge
summary: You charge into a group of enemies to send them flying.

name: Weakening Assault
summary: With a barrage of blows, you diminish an enemy's strength.

name: Blanket Defense
summary: You become a bulwark against foes' attacks that target you and your allies.

name: Bloody Denial
summary: You strike a foe with force to prevent them from reacting.

name: Keep up the Good Fight
summary: Your commitment to protecting others keeps you going, even  against insurmountable odds.

name: Opening Stance
summary: At the first sign of trouble, often before you consciously realize the danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought.

name: Clang!
summary: You make a foe pay for attacking you as its blow or spell glances off your armor.

name: Clobber
summary: With a mighty blow, you send an enemy flying backward and onto the ground.

name: Never!
summary: The idea that you would hurt your companions, even when you've lost your reason, is unthinkable.

name: Demolish Defenses
summary: With a powerful blow, you crack a foe's armor or tough hide, opening it up for further attacks.

name: Perfect Protection
summary: Your armor protects you from the deadliest hits.

name: Quick Vengeance
summary: Indignant at any who would strike you or your allies, you get your revenge.

name: Shield from Spells
summary: Your prowess with a shield allows you to block magic and more.
