name: Great Shield Mastery
summary: You've learned how to maximize the defensive abilities of the largest shields.

name: Unyielding Force
summary: Thanks to your armor, almost nothing can stop you.

name: Commander Dedication
summary: You gain the tactics class feature like a commander and gain your own folio; this folio contains two common mobility or offensive tactics of your choosing.

name: Basic Field Training
summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level commander feat.

name: Tactical Excellence
summary: You add two new tactics to your folio and increase your maximum number of tactics prepared by 1.

name: Advanced Field Training
summary: You gain a commander feat.

name: Officer's Expertise
summary: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to expert, and you become an expert in Warfare Lore.

name: Officer's Mastery
summary: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to master, and you become a master in Warfare Lore.

name: Guardian Dedication
summary: You become trained in Athletics; if you were already trained in Athletics, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

name: Basic Defender
summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level guardian feat.

name: Guardian Resiliency
prerequisite: Guardian Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points than 10 + your Constitution modifier
summary: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each guardian archetype class feat you have.

name: Advanced Defender
summary: You gain one guardian feat.

name: Guardian's Intercept
summary: You can use the Intercept Attack reaction once per 10 minutes.

name: Armored Resistance
summary: While you are wearing medium or heavy armor, you gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your character level when you use the Intercept Attack reaction to take damage instead of your ally.

name: Ironclad Fortitude
prerequisite: Guardian Dedication; expert in Fortitude saves
summary: Your proficiency rank in Fortitude saves increases to master.

name: Aldori Duelist Dedication
summary: Your Aldori duelist training teaches you martial techniques and increases your dedication to the Aldori dueling sword.

name: Dueling Acumen
summary: You're always ready for a new duel, and you've been trained to start and end fights quickly.

name: Aldori Parry
summary: You can parry attacks against you with your Aldori dueling  sword.

name: Duelist's Edge
summary: You hone your reaction time through duels and learn to draw your weapon seamlessly as you begin a fight.

name: Aldori Riposte
summary: You riposte with your Aldori dueling sword when your enemy leaves an opening.

name: Unnerving Prowess
summary: Your incredible skill with your blade unnerves your foes.

name: Saving Slash
summary: You quickly whirl your blade, trying to deflect enough momentum to avoid the worst of the attack.

name: One-on-One
prerequisite: Aldori Duelist Dedication; Trained in Deception
summary: Your true skill can be seen in a one-on-one fight where you have room to dance around your opponent.

name: Aldori's Retort
summary: You can flow through combat reactions with graceful ease.

name: Duelist's Form
summary: Many assume that a duelist's habit of fighting with one hand behind their back or on their hip is an insult or self-restriction.

name: Tempo Duelist
summary: You move with an unpredictable tempo, shifting between unnervingly slow and rapid movements.

name: Devastating Duelist
summary: You pointedly note your enemy's deficiencies, filling them with fear and dismay.

name: Aldori Swordlord
prerequisite: Aldori Duelist Dedication; you have taken the last name of Aldori, sworn to the Aldori swordpact, and demonstrated skill at swordplay by winning a duel using only a sword in the presence of an Aldori swordlord.
summary: You are an Aldori swordlord.

name: Swordlord Exile
prerequisite: Aldori Duelist Dedication; you have broken or forsaken the Aldori swordpact.
summary: You are a swordlord exile.

name: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication
summary: You have mastered stealthy weapons that allow you to strike carefully from a distance far enough to avoid reprisal, yet close enough to confirm your kills.

name: Crescent Cross Training
summary: You have familiarity with the crescent cross, an ingenious weapon that combines an arm-mounted, multi-chamber crossbow with a crescent-shaped blade.

name: Repeating Hand Crossbow Training
summary: The specific needs of your organization or mission warrant your use of the latest in ingenious crossbow technology.

name: Infiltrator's Reload
prerequisite: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication; Expert in Stealth
summary: You specialize in reloading while preparing for the next step in your infiltration.

name: Reloading Trick
summary: You can fire off a single shot even when it seems like you are unprepared.

name: Lethargy Poisoner
prerequisite: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication; Trained in Crafting
summary: You've learned more than the use of hand crossbows.

name: Infiltration Assassination
summary: With a high-priority target in reach, you quickly move to eliminate them.

name: Unseen Shot
summary: Your attacks are deadly, silent, and nearly untraceable.

name: Infiltrator's Blitz
summary: Though your training is meant to ensure you don't get caught by your enemies, your missions are often high risk, and sometimes the only option you have left when things go wrong is to unleash a blistering torrent of violence while running away as fast as possible.

name: Field Propagandist Dedication
prerequisite: Charisma +2; Trained in Deception; Trained in Diplomacy
summary: Having devoted your life to crafting propaganda, you know that winning the hearts and minds of soldiers can be a deciding  factor in securing the successful outcome of a war.

name: Fabricate Truth
trait: Archetype, Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, Linguistic, Mental
summary: You invent a false truth by fast talking, switching arguments, shifting the standard of evidence, and generally confounding others.

name: Predispose Settlement
prerequisite: Field Propagandist Dedication; Expert in Deception
summary: You spend 7 days of downtime seeding propaganda through a settlement with a population of 2,500 or fewer.

name: Invented Vulnerability
summary: You list off the potential fears and weaknesses of an enemy you can see or hear, speaking with such certainty that they  become real.

name: Invincible Army
summary: You enumerate the many virtues and victories of your chosen allies, creating a story of their invincibility so convincing that  it is as good as the truth.

name: Orator's Fillibuster
summary: When you seek to convince others of the worth of your cause, you are capable of unleashing such an entrancing torrent of rhetoric and metaphor that it is all but impossible to look away from you.

name: A Tale to Believe In
summary: You recite a tale of prowess that rewrites the combat unfolding around you.

name: The Truth as I See it
summary: Your knack for spinning a believable reality from threads of story is so practiced that sometimes even you begin to believe  what you're saying.

name: Mass Delusion
summary: You wave around fabricated evidence that contradicts what your enemies know to be true.

name: Guerrilla Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival
summary: You're skilled in subtle tactics and using the environment against your enemies.

name: Guerrilla Weaponry
summary: You are especially skilled in transforming simple weapons that can be easily assembled from readily available materials into deadly weapons.

name: Snare Expert
summary: Your knowledge of traps aids you in defending your hideout.

name: Hit and Run
summary: Leaping from a hiding place, you quickly attack your foe before retreating.

name: Poisoned Sticks and Stones
summary: You prepare your sling stones with small, edged grooves to enable them to deliver poison, and you have learned other  techniques for poisoning your weapons.

name: Rally Support
prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; trained in either Diplomacy or Intimidation
summary: You often rely on the local populace for supplies and shelter.

name: Venomous Weapons
summary: Your skill with poisons is such that your preferred weapons also contain trace amounts of it, even when you don't actively  apply a dose.

name: Battlefront Sabotage
summary: You know methods of sabotaging your enemy's war machines and weaponry.

name: Frightful Attrition
summary: Your diminishment of your foes' ranks damages their morale.

name: Lonely Army
summary: You move and attack with deadly silence, unbelievable speed, and unlimited ferocity.

name: Deathblow
prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; Poisoned Sticks and Stones
summary: Your carefully prepared and placed shot brings instant death to your target.

name: Terrain Ghost
prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; Master in Stealth; Master in Survival
summary: You move through your territory like a living shadow.

name: Iridian Choirmaster Dedication
summary: When you take this dedication, choose one willing, non-minion ally to be your student in the ways of the Iridian Choir.

name: Lesson of the Broken Wing
summary: You make yourself appear to be a tempting target to draw an enemy in, distracting them from your student's attacks.

name: Lesson of the Circling Gale
summary: You and your student have trained with footwork drills to mirror each other's movements.

name: Ensnaring Disarm
summary: You smack your foe's item out of their hand so that your student can grab it.

name: Lesson of Bonded Eyes
summary: You and your student share an understanding of your surroundings.

name: Repeat Lesson
summary: Upon seeing your student falter, you demonstrate the proper technique.

name: Lesson of Mutual Gambits
summary: You create an opening for your student, setting them up for their own attack.

name: Lesson of Sympathetic Vulnerability
summary: You temporarily borrow the essence of your student's attack to infuse yourself.

name: Lesson of the Splintered Aegis
summary: With your attack, you demonstrate to your student a hole in your enemy's defenses.

name: Seize Advantage
summary: You take the openings granted by your student's success to reposition yourself.

name: Lesson of Unified Elusion
summary: You and your student react as one to common threats.

name: Pupil's Guard
summary: You're intimately familiar with your student's motions and are ready to step in at a moment's notice should anything threaten to disrupt them.

name: Lesson of the Hurricane's Might
summary: You and your student enact a graceful dance of battle.

name: Simultaneous Strike
summary: Moving in unison, you and your student unleash an attack against a foe.

name: Shared Mind, Shared Heart
summary: Your thoughts and dreams are your student's thoughts and dreams, and vice versa.

name: Munitions Master Dedication
summary: You have drilled enough with your light mortar to operate it with unrivaled efficiency.

name: Focused Fire
summary: You limit the blast of your shot for accuracy.

name: Wrapped in Smoke
summary: You ignite a small portion of powder in a rapid, inefficient burn, creating a hazy cloud.

name: Siege Celerity
summary: You push yourself and your light mortar  beyond your limits.

name: Recoiling Relocation
summary: Your innovation contains a chamber to store a small amount of compressed exhaust gas from your Launches.

name: Burrowing Shot
summary: You tune light mortar to maximize penetration into hard surfaces.

name: Necrologist Dedication
prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots, ability to cast _summon undead_
summary: Your studies of the lists of the dead allow you to call forth a horde of undead with a brief incantation.

name: Dismal Harvest
summary: The expiring breaths of your enemies fuel your power.

name: Grasping Corpses
summary: Your foes are left reeling from the attacks made by the zombies or skeletons of your horde.

name: Shambling March
summary: Your horde is swifter, marching in time to your command.

name: Deathguard
summary: The twisting rotted limbs, clattering bones, or swirling ectoplasm of your horde can hide you from others' vision.

name: Ghostsong
summary: You have come to understand the pain and fury of spirits and can raise them to do your ghastly work.

name: Preserve the Horde
summary: The act of summoning additional undead minions doesn't make you lose the focus required to maintain the animation of your horde.

name: Danse Macabre
summary: Your horde can drag unwilling victims along with it as it shambles forward.

name: Shift Horde
summary: With a wave of your hand, your risen undead horde collapses and another one rises to take its place.

name: Wailing Dead
trait: Archetype, Auditory, Concentrate, Emotion, Fear, Flourish, Magical, Mental
summary: The voices of the spirits you command spark fear in the hearts of your enemies.

name: Death Rattle
summary: When the time comes for your horde to be returned to its temporary rest, its departure carries those nearby closer to death.

name: In the Horde's Grip
summary: When your skeletons and zombies attack, their skeletal claws and rotting hands clutch and tear flesh.

name: War Mage Dedication
prerequisite: You have a spellcasting class feature.
summary: Your studies into the battlefield applications of magic have made your spells particularly effective at disrupting enemy  formations or manipulating enemy troops into positions where they are more vulnerable to wide-scale magical attacks.

name: Mage's Field Dressing
summary: As your spell takes hold on your ally, you use some of its magic to quickly dress their wounds.

name: Shield Spell Reinforcement
prerequisite: War Mage Dedication; you can cast the _shield_ cantrip
summary: You can empower your defensive magic by channeling it through a physical shield.

name: Siege Ritualist
summary: Sometimes, magical warfare requires the application of more complex arcana.

name: Arcana of Iron
summary: You eschew wands and staves for more advanced weaponry.

name: Intimidating Spell
summary: The devastation wrought by your large-scale spells is particularly terrifying.

name: Shielding Formation
summary: You have mastered unique magical techniques designed to protect your allies from harm.

name: Spellshield
summary: Your shield becomes a bonded item capable of storing your spells.

name: Secrets of Steel
summary: As your prowess with weapons increases, so does the ferocity of magic you channel through those weapons.

name: Battlefield Arcana
summary: You have learned to safely cast spells even in the heat of battle.

name: Cushion Landing
summary: As you fall, your mount dashes to your rescue.

name: Mounting Leap
summary: You jump atop your mount from afar, landing comfortably astride it.

name: Dashing Pickup
prerequisite: Cavalier Dedication; expert in Acrobatics or Athletics
summary: You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride (or to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if it has the corresponding movement type).

name: Vaulting Gallop
summary: You've trained your mount to vault over obstacles at high speeds.

name: Rearing Display
summary: You've trained your mount to make an impressive attack and can leverage its presence to terrify your enemies.

name: Acclimated Mount
summary: By the grace of your god, your mount can overcome the natural challenges and hazards present in a specific terrain.

name: Faithful Stride
summary: Confident in your faith, you Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride up to twice its Speed (or up to three times its Speed if you used 3 actions for Faithful Stride).

name: Steed's Toppling Strike
summary: Those who defy your cause feel the powerful attacks of your mount.

name: Captain Dedication
prerequisite: Charisma +2; you don't have an animal companion, construct companion, or other companion that functions similarly
summary: You become trained in your choice of Diplomacy or Intimidation; if you are already trained in both of these skills, you become trained in a skill of your choice.

name: Additional Follower
summary: Another follower joins you in your travels.

name: Experienced Follower
summary: Your followers' skills have developed over the course of your  adventures.

name: Leader of All
summary: You accept anyone who would follow you on your adventures.

name: Cadre
prerequisite: Captain Dedication; expert in Diplomacy or Intimidation
summary: Between your daring adventures, people seek you out.

name: Tactical Guidance
summary: You can provide tactical guidance to help your follower act more efficiently.

name: Veteran Follower
summary: Your followers' training has made them veterans of battle.

name: Coordinated Tactics
summary: You and your follower fight in tandem.

name: Exceptional Follower
summary: Your followers' abilities have soared to new heights.

name: Legendary Leader
prerequisite: Captain Dedication; legendary in Diplomacy or Intimidation
summary: Your fame has spread throughout the lands.

name: Peerless Captain
summary: When you have an active follower in an encounter, you are quickened.

name: Incredible Familiar (Familiar Master)
summary: Your familiar is infused with even more magic than other familiars.

name: Myth Hunter
prerequisite: Trained in Hero-God Lore  or Trained in Legendary Beast Lore
summary: Your ancestors confronted and bested mythic beasts of Iblydan antiquity.

name: Fiery Rebirth
summary: When you escape death, you return to life with retributive fire that burns those who harmed you.

name: Follow the Threads of Fate
summary: A norn’s thread—spun from fate itself—runs through or wraps around your ikon.
source:
[Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
](/Sources.aspx?ID=273) pg. 79

name: Topple the Titans
summary: Even the greatest titans of the world are easier to kill when they’re lying on the ground.
source:
[Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
](/Sources.aspx?ID=273) pg. 79

name: Riddle the Sphinx
summary: You’ve learned the secrets of the sphinx’s riddles and empowered your ikon with them.
source:
[Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
](/Sources.aspx?ID=273) pg. 79

name: Shield of Stone
summary: You stole a gorgon’s gaze and trapped it in your ikon.
source:
[Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
](/Sources.aspx?ID=273) pg. 79

name: As a Thousand Soldiers
summary: Though you may have stolen from the hive, you’ve nothing but respect for the armies guarding it, and you borrow their strength to overwhelm your foes.
source:
[Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
](/Sources.aspx?ID=273) pg. 79

name: Forward Gaze into Life
trait: Concentrate, Divine, Exemplar, Uncommon, Vitality, Void
summary: Despite the constant cold of death at your back, you keep your gaze forward into the realm of life.
source:
[Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea
](/Sources.aspx?ID=273) pg. 79

name: Heroic Weakness
summary: As word of your faith spreads, so too does word of your foibles and weaknesses.

name: Myth of Quick-Thinking
summary: Your myth includes amusing parables of clever plans and sly maneuvers, often applied to small things in life such as disguising yourself as a sheep to ambush a wolf or tricking a snake into shedding its skin.

name: Myth of Realm-Walking
summary: Your myth speaks of distant travel to countless countries, planes, or dimensions.

name: Hero-God's Bond
summary: At times, the myth of a hero-god includes a favored partner or a bonded ally, such as the hero-gods of promises and shield-bearers, Upion and Warrick.

name: Martyr's Parry
summary: You intercede to absorb the triggering attack.

name: Grief's Fury
summary: A lost love. A broken spear. Rage burning through a hero-god.

name: Hydra's Bond
summary: When the hero-gods built Pol-Sylirica and its seven armies, they feared betrayal from within.

name: Fool's Fleeting Plan
summary: When Aercelys, hero-god of fools and fire, dove into the funeral pyre of his beloved daughter, he seemed a fool without thought for his safety.

name: Stages of Fate
summary: At one time, the hero-gods could not tell their own prophecies.

name: Windborne Shove
summary: The hero-god of phalanxes and winds, grand Konebrys, led a force of dozens against an army of thousands.

name: Awakened Power
summary: Your power spontaneously evolves or reconfigures itself.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 9, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 100

name: Greater Awakened Power
summary: Your power undergoes yet another awakening
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 9, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 100

name: Blasting Beams
summary: A directed beam of heat or an arc of lightning is one of the simplest ways to project energy.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 9, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 100

name: Consume Energy
summary: Your connection to energy is so much stronger than the offending display in front of you, allowing you to claim it for yourself.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 9, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 100

name: Storming Breath
summary: You spit out a freezing breath or sonic scream. You deal 4d6 damage, plus 1d6 damage for every level you have beyond 6th, to all creatures in a 30-foot cone, with a basic Reflex save.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 9, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 100

name: Propulsive Leap
summary: By expelling flames from your feet or levitating through electrical repulsion, you propel yourself through the air.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 10, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 101

name: Sonic Dash
summary: You bounce up and down once, then sprint forward.

name: Overclock Senses
summary: Your senses speed up to the point that time seems to stand still, allowing you to catch details and incoming attacks.

name: Unstable Gearshift
summary: You shift your body into a higher gear, your speed compounding further and further.

name: Lightspeed Assault
summary: You zoom from enemy to enemy, striking each in an instant.

name: Draining Touch
summary: You reach out your arm, grasping hungrily for a source of energy.

name: Borrowed Ability
summary: Your touch opens a conduit into the mind of your target, the emptiness within you pulling skills and memories through

name: Kinetic Dampening
summary: You feed off energy in your immediate surroundings, allowing you to dampen the force imparted by incoming blows.

name: Feed the Void
trait: Deviant, Extradimensional, Magical, Mental, Rare, Spirit
summary: The void within you manages to manifest itself temporarily, a black hole opening over your heart and threatening to draw everything in.

name: Bone Spikes
summary: Sharp shards of bone tear forth from your elbows, wrists, or other parts of your body.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 12, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 101

name: Titan Swing
summary: Your limbs tense as you deliver a mighty swing.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 13, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 101

name: High-Speed Regeneration
summary: Your wounds knit together with barely a thought.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 13, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 101

name: Tectonic Stomp
summary: You cause minor tremors that topple your enemies.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 13, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 101

name: Eerie Flicker
summary: Your body flickers momentarily into the Ethereal Plane.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 13, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 102

name: Ghostly Grasp (Deviant)
summary: An invisible arm extends from you to grab and manipulate objects.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 13, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 102

name: Enervating Wail
summary: You release a terrible wail that tears at the spirits of all nearby.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 13, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 102

name: Distant Wandering
summary: Your body falls unconscious and your spirit projects out of it.
source: Gatewalkers Player's Guide (Remastered) pg. 13, Dark Archives (Remastered) pg. 103

name: Covet Hoard
summary: You have a dragon’s desire for treasure.

name: Dragonet Breath
summary: You have developed your magical breath.

name: Dragonet Resistances
summary: You might be a little dragon, but you are still a dragon, which means it’s difficult to constrain you.

name: Mighty Dragonet
summary: You’ve grown especially large and now tower over your fellow dragonets.

name: My Claws are Daggers
summary: Your claws are as sharp as your teeth.

name: Scales of Steel
summary: Your scales are hard as armor, ensuring you always have some protection in the dangerous world.

name: Take Wing
summary: You have strengthened your wings and can now fly for short distances.

name: Ascended Dragonet Heritage
summary: You’ve awoken the power of your draconic heritage.

name: Inhale, Exhale!
summary: You take an especially deep breath as a prelude to unleashing your dragonet breath on your foes.

name: Jealous Grip
summary: You are protective of your hoard, and woe betide anyone who tries to take what’s yours.

name: Zip! Zoom!
summary: You can fly longer distances before you need to land.

name: Bond Companion
summary: You form a close bond with a companion, similar to that of a master and familiar, that lets you gift them with a touch of your inherent magic.

name: Ferocious Will
summary: You send a blast of magical feedback at the effect's source, dealing 5d6 mental damage with a basic Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

name: Into the Sky
summary: You fly as naturally as any dragonet.

name: Form a Flock
summary: You call nearby wild dragonets to swarm to your side.

name: Lurching Chomp
summary: Through your wiles, charm, or a little bit of magic, you lure in a foe for a closer look—and a quick bite!

name: Dazzling Dragonet Disappearance
summary: A brilliant sheen on your scales flashes when you’re hit, then you’re nowhere to be found.

name: Dragonet Immunities
summary: You will not fall asleep unless you choose to allow it, nor will you sit still.

name: Benefactor's Resistance
summary: Your scales have taken on the characteristics of your draconic benefactor and insulate you from certain damage types.

name: Draconic Sycophant
summary: You possess features that dragons find particularly cute or charming, making it easier to endear yourself to them, or at least cause them to momentarily forgive your insolence.

name: Dragonscaled Lore
summary: The study of dragons is not merely academic to you but part of your family tree.

name: Hoarder's Craw
summary: Your draconic features include a pouch inside your body that you use to store food prior to digestion.

name: Kobold Breath
summary: You channel the power of your draconic benefactor to expel a torrent of energy from your mouth that manifests as a 30-foot line or a 15-foot cone, dealing 1d4 damage.
source:
[Draconic Codex
](/Sources.aspx?ID=277) pg. 215, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 14

name: Benefactor's Strike
summary: Your benefactor’s blood flows through your veins, and you channel their power into your body.

name: Kobold Momentum
summary: You possess the confidence of a dragon, and your success emboldens you to draw on power reserves you didn’t know you had.

name: Tip the Scales
summary: You’re a cunning adversary in close quarters and are well-versed in hit-and-run tactics that exploit the advantages of your small stature.

name: Breath Unleashed
summary: You’re able to channel more of your draconic benefactor’s power and focus it into your Kobold Breath, increasing its effectiveness but requiring more time to recover.

name: Dracomancer
summary: The power infused into you by your draconic benefactor’s presence allows you to manifest their most iconic spells.
source:
[Draconic Codex
](/Sources.aspx?ID=277) pg. 215, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 15

name: Draconic Paragon
summary: Your connection to your draconic benefactor becomes especially pronounced.

name: Elite Dracomancer
summary: Your draconic power equals that of a lesser dragon.
source:
[Draconic Codex
](/Sources.aspx?ID=277) pg. 215, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 15

name: Aqueous Dragonblood
summary: Your blood surges with the might of dragons who master the waters, and you can move freely in their domain.

name: Summiting Dragonblood
summary: Thanks to your draconic blood, there are no mountains or hills you can’t surmount.

name: Terra Dragonblood
summary: Each step upon the earth makes your blood resonate.

name: Blood and Spirit
summary: Your connection to the divine has sanctified your blood, but the power only manifests when you are shedding it.

name: Earthbond
summary: Your bond to the terra firma under your feet increases as your connection to your draconic aspect grows.

name: Tenacious Jaws
summary: Your teeth are curved or hooked to hold on to your enemies.

name: Voice of the Elements
summary: You inherit a primal dragon’s bond to base elements.
source:
[Draconic Codex
](/Sources.aspx?ID=277) pg. 216, Rage of Elements pg. 21

name: Energize Bite
prerequisite: Breath of the Dragon; jaws unarmed attack
summary: The deadly energy of your breath remains in your jaws to empower your attacks.

name: Home in the Deep
summary: You cut through the water, and dwell beneath the surface with ease.

name: Mineral Deposits
summary: Precious metals from your bloodstream line your claws, jaws, or the tip of your tail, and you’re able call upon your blood to surge and empower your attacks.

name: Sheltering Wing
summary: You raise your fledgling wings to protect you from attack, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you until the start of your next turn.

name: Debilitating Breath
summary: Your breath causes lasting hindrance to those it harms.

name: Heart of Earth
summary: The earth parts to allow you passage.

name: Ascendant Blood
prerequisite: draconic exemplar associated with a specific plane (such as a diabolic dragon or empyreal dragon)
summary: Twice per week, you can cast _interplanar teleport_ as an innate spell of the tradition corresponding to your draconic exemplar.

name: Draconic Acolyte Dedication
summary: As an acolyte of dragonkind, you have an item known as a draconic gift that you can use to summon a portion of the magical essence of the dragon you received it from.

name: Draconic Fury
summary: You briefly summon spectral claws that lash out in a flurry.

name: Draconic Resilience
summary: Energy reminiscent of dragon scales shimmers over you, making it more difficult for attacks to penetrate your defenses.

name: Draconic Familiar
summary: Your devotion to dragons has attracted a loyal servant.

name: Essence Overflow
summary: Your Channel Draconic Essence ends, and all creatures (except you) in a 10-foot emanation from your spectral dragon take 6d6 damage with a

name: Benefactor's Wings
summary: Calling on your draconic gift, spectral wings carry you to your destination.

name: Reactive Resilience
summary: Your power blunts blades and weakens spells like the hardiest of dragon scales.

name: Deepening Devotion
summary: Your investment in your _draconic gift_ has unlocked greater power.

name: Reflexive Devotion
summary: The power of dragons flows through you at the merest thought.

name: Frightening Power
summary: Draconic essence coruscates around you, sapping the resilience of your foes.

name: Call Draconic Ally
summary: Either by beseeching a dragon or bending it to your will, you conjure a mighty creature to assist you.

name: Hidden Hoard
summary: Your _draconic gift_ is the key to a repository of treasure that only you can access.

name: Drake Rider Dedication
summary: You gain the service of a young riding drake, riding dragonet, or another animal companion with the dragon trait you have access to.

name: Mature Dragon Companion
summary: Your dragon companion matures and the bond you share is strengthened.

name: Winged Leap
prerequisite: dragon companion with the mount special ability; Drake Rider Dedication
summary: While drakes and dragons are able flyers, they’re uncomfortable carrying a rider in the air without special training.

name: Flair Rider Stance
prerequisite: Drake Rider Dedication; Trained in Acrobatics
summary: You spend little time in your saddle as you flip unpredictably around your dragon mount, dodging attacks.

name: War Rider Stance
prerequisite: Drake Rider Dedication; expert in martial weapons; dragon companion with a support benefit that includes damage
summary: Your dragon’s constant breath threatens your foes.

name: Incredible Dragon Companion
summary: Your mature dragon companion develops further, becoming more robust and formidable.

name: Wing Rider
summary: Your bond with your dragon has been honed so fine that it can carry you aloft with its full capability.

name: Death Dive
summary: You guide your mount into a plummet, diving headlong at a single foe.

name: Strafing Breath
summary: You urge your dragon mount forward, wreathed in magical power.

name: Guided Hover
summary: You guide your draconic companion, whose outstretched wings fill with unseen thermals.

name: Oatia Skysage Dedication
summary: Your study of the stars unlocks supernatural insights and magic.

name: Basic Skysage Divination
summary: The stars move, granting you a sliver of their magic.

name: Stargazer's Eyes
summary: Long hours in darkened observatories have sharpened your senses.

name: Night's Glow
summary: The stars and moon lend you their light.

name: Minor Omen
summary: The stars warn you of danger in the nick of time.

name: Scholar's Hunch
summary: Scholarly debates have taught you to think on your feet.

name: Starlit Spells
summary: The stars reveal and punish your enemies.

name: Expert Skysage Divination
summary: Your studies of the stars have taught you about the mysteries of the cosmos.

name: Night's Shine
summary: Your power from the moon and stars becomes strong enough to illuminate the night sky.

name: Night's Warning
summary: Portents written in the night sky show you how to avoid an attack.

name: Starlight Armor
summary: You armor yourself in the light of distant suns, shielding yourself from harm.

name: Master Skysage Divination
summary: You unlock the most powerful secrets hidden in the stars above.

name: Scion of Domora Dedication
prerequisite: Familiar Master Dedication; you have befriended a spirit guide and it bonded with you using its Bond to Mortal ability.
summary: You gain a spirit guide ally.

name: Spiritual Strike
summary: Your spirit guide enhances your attacks with occult power.

name: Guided Skill
summary: You ask your spirit guide for aid.

name: Guardian's Embrace
summary: Your spirit guide discorporates to surround you in an invisible protective shroud.

name: Invigorating Breath
summary: Your spirit guide exhales its sweet-smelling breath on you, granting you the strength to push through your pain.

name: Spiritual Flurry
prerequisite: Scion of Domora Dedication; Spiritual Strike
summary: When you use Spiritual Strike, hit targets become off-guard until the end of your current turn.

name: Spiritual Aid
summary: When you call your spirit guide for aid, its presence bolsters your will and agility.

name: Spirit Guide Form
summary: You fuse with your spirit guide, becoming a hybrid being with enhanced physical and spiritual power.

name: Twilight Speaker Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Society; you are an Ilverani elf
summary: You have carefully studied the histories, customs, and etiquette of many of the younger peoples of Golarion.

name: Empathetic Envoy
summary: You believe that treating others with respect is the fastest way into their hearts, and in turn others are more likely to believe in your good intentions and write off bad first impressions as flukes.

name: Disarming Smile
summary: With a wide and sincere smile, you give your attacker pause.

name: Betraying Shank
summary: While your usual diplomacy is well intentioned, you know that sometimes those same skills will need to be turned to deception.

name: Ilverani Purist
summary: All twilight speakers are trained to resist the alluring customs of younger peoples, but you have made it your mandate to keep the Ilverani way unchanged.

name: World-Wise Vigilance
summary: Your keen study of other cultures gives you insights into the ways those cultures fight.

name: Emphatic Emissary
summary: You can tell when diplomacy has failed and a meeting is close to unraveling or falling to blows.

name: Avenging Runelord Dedication
summary: The call of a long dead runelord has infected your soul and transformed your fate.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 72

name: Expanded Runelord Magic
summary: Your ability to use magic associated with your chosen sin grows.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 73

name: Reliable Magic
summary: Magic stored in written form or within wands is more reliable in your capable hands.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 73

name: Shining Runes
summary: Whenever you Cast a Spell that requires more than one action to cast, the signature Thassilonian runes you trace in the air flicker with light and command attention.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 73

name: Willing Runes
summary: Magical markings of every kind seem eager to aid your endeavors.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 73

name: Writhing Runelord Weapon
summary: Your prowess with long-hafted weapons catches your opponents by surprise, as it bends or elongates in an obviously supernatural manner.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 74

name: Autonomous Arms
prerequisite: Avenging Runelord Dedication; expert proficiency in a spear or polearm
summary: A portion of the ancient grasping spirit that infuses your being spills over into a spear or polearm you carry.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 74

name: Subjugation
summary: You have managed to gain a degree of control over the runelord’s ancient soul within your mind, enough that you can project this invasive influence into the minds of others.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 74

name: Vindictive Thoughts
summary: Those who seek to do you personal harm with magic must suffer the same misfortune.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 75

name: Advanced Runelord Magic
summary: Your ability to use magic associated with your chosen sin grows.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 75

name: Apocalyptic Visions
summary: Your runelord may not have lived long enough to need to retreat into hiding in the face of Earthfall, but the apocalyptic echoes of this event nevertheless reached their soul all the way in the Boneyard.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 75

name: Craft Runewell
summary: Even if the runelord whose soul influences you never did so themselves, you know how to create your own runewell—an artifact that grants you a measure of immortality.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 75

name: Heroic Scion Dedication
summary: Destiny calls, and the soul of a dead hero reincarnates to take up the fight! Either an old enemy resumes their efforts to affect chaos and violence, or a new threat arises and you feel compelled to stand against it.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 77

name: Avoid Fate's Gaze
summary: Your past and current enemies may know you by reputation, but spying on you with magic is much more difficult.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 77

name: I've Been Here Before
summary: You adapt quickly to new settings and terrains.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 77

name: Internal Dialogue
summary: Past experiences or even past selves whisper words of advice and encouragement when you need them.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78

name: My Reputation Precedes Me
summary: Long years of brave exploits haven’t gone unnoticed.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78

name: Reincarnated Companion
prerequisite: Heroic Scion Dedication; familiar or nimble or savage animal companion
summary: You’re not alone in having a legendary past life—so too does your companion.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78

name: To Thine Own Self
summary: Awareness of your past perils protects you from those who would manipulate your thoughts.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78

name: Daunting Spell
summary: Your enemies feel the inevitability of defeat once they feel the potency of your magic.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78

name: Let Death Be My Weapon
summary: You recall your death in vivid detail, and the fear, pain, and uncertainty you suffered are blunted by the truth of your reincarnation.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78

name: Momentary Respite
summary: Your sense of destiny manifests as rapid physical healing.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 78

name: Vigorous Victor
summary: Long years of success have not only shown you where your limits lie, they’ve expanded them.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 79

name: On My Best Day
summary: Be they in your current life or your previous one, you’ve had many heroic moments that continue to inspire you.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 79

name: Telling Blow
summary: Your determination empowers a telling blow to defeat your most powerful enemies.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 79

name: To Me!
summary: Two lives spent in adventuring groups has given you a special gift for bolstering party morale and pushing your allies to achieve greater ends when they work as a team.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 79

name: Eternal Hero
summary: Whatever the explanation, you’re almost impossible to kill.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 79

name: Timewracked Dedication
summary: The current of time shifts subtly in your field of view. You have learned to tread these temporal eddies, moving forward and pushing backward in small strokes.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 80

name: Be Right Back
summary: You can manipulate time to produce an item in a seemingly impossible fashion.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 81

name: Live Off Borrowed Time
summary: You tap into the future to steal a bit of time from yourself a few seconds from now that you can use immediately.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 81

name: Now You See Me
summary: You flash through several possible timelines as you move.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 81

name: Second Sight
summary: You peer into the next several seconds to watch the potential timelines around a nearby creature unfold.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 82

name: Temporal Fury
summary: You shift and skip through time, vanishing during your movement to appear in unexpected and advantageous locations for combat.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 82

name: Bolstered Recovery
summary: Whenever you rest, you recover with remarkable speed.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 82

name: Echoing Fury
summary: You cheat the rules of time to co-locate during your attack.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 82

name: Preserve the Moment
summary: Sometimes, your actions are so successful and impressive that it’s worth going back to them.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 82

name: Fracture Time Flow
summary: Your ability to interact with and even observe the flow of time allows you to fracture it slightly in a localized place whenever you land a particularly solid blow on a foe.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 83

name: Not This Time
summary: You reflexively attempt to cycle a creature’s timeline briefly to a reality where it’s less able to succeed.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 83

name: Timelessness
summary: Time travelers are rare, but even among them your isolation from time is unique.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 83

name: Warshard Warrior Dedication
summary: When you became infused with a shard of the god of war, you knew in your gut that your destiny would be one for the ages—yet you may not, at first, know the exact way such a destiny would play out.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 84

name: Athlete's Ally
summary: You channel the power of your warshard through your weapon to better perform athletic maneuvers.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 85

name: Lightless Sight
summary: You gain darkvision as long as you wield your warshard weapon.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 85

name: Steadfast Grip
summary: The connection you have with your warshard weapon strengthens it and assists you in maintaining your grip on it in battle.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 85

name: Transmute Weapon
summary: When you choose a warshard weapon during daily preparations, you can transform the material it’s composed of so that the weapon is made of a precious material.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 86

name: Warshard Rune
summary: When you choose a warshard weapon during your daily preparations, you can empower it with an additional magical effect.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 86

name: Divide and Conquer
summary: When you face multiple foes, you wield your warshard weapon with vigor.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 86

name: Indomitable Shot
summary: You can fire a single shot that penetrates multiple foes.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 86

name: Prescient Parry
summary: Your warshard weapon intervenes at the last second, rising to deflect the incoming blow.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 87

name: Final Shot Knows the Way
summary: You judge a foe’s defenses after attacking them and channel that knowledge into your warshard weapon and its ammunition.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 87

name: Throw and Catch
summary: You hurl your warshard weapon at an opponent, even though the weapon isn’t designed to be thrown.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 87

name: I Am the Weapon
summary: Your supernatural bond with your weapon infuses it with a powerful echo of your sentience, your memory, and even fragments of your very soul.
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #219: Lord of the Trinity Star pg. 87

name: Calm and Centered
summary: Your occult connection to the world helps you deal with being frightened or stupefied.

name: Comforting Presence
trait: Concentrate, Emotion, General, Mental, Skill, Uncommon
summary: Your occult connection to your allies lets you take on fear and confusion they feel.

name: Go With the Flow
summary: You have an occult connection to the world that helps you blend in with the cacophony of life around you.

name: Let's Try That Again
summary: You feel a sense of deja vu when you’ve made a mistake, almost as if you weren’t so careless in a past life and could certainly do better if given another chance.

name: Like a Roach
summary: Living with the bare necessities isn’t terribly hard for someone who has defied death, and like a cockroach, you always know how to survive.

name: Weight of Experience
summary: The experience you’ve accumulated over multiple lifetimes envelops you like a weighted blanket, providing comfort and bestowing confidence under pressure.

name: Wisdom From Another Life
summary: You absorbed a wide variety of facts before you died, and your soul still remembers slivers of this precious knowledge.

name: Animal Soul Siblings
summary: Your eyes have been opened to the spiritual essence suffusing the world.

name: Empathy Incarnate
summary: Reincarnation has given you a compassionate perspective and enabled you to relate to almost everyone you speak with, putting them at ease and quickly generating trust.

name: I've Had Many Jobs
summary: Finding and excelling at odd jobs is child’s play to one who has worked many occupations during many lives.

name: Reincarnated Ridiculer
summary: You’ve practiced the art of taunting an enemy, ensuring they know death will only make you stronger.

name: Sleep of the Reborn
summary: Philosophers compare the cycle of life, death, and rebirth to sleeping, dreaming, and waking.

name: Lingering Echoes
summary: Not everyone is reincarnated, and you feel a strong connection with the spiritual echoes of those who didn’t receive the same opportunity as you.

name: Plant Soul Siblings
summary: You’re now able to connect with the spirits present in the greenery of the natural world.

name: Rapid Retraining
summary: Some feel trapped by their choices and have a tough time reinventing themselves.

name: You Seem Somewhat Familiar
summary: You fought hundreds of foes in your various past lives, and now and then, something about a new opponent tugs at your memory, almost as if you defeated their grandparent long ago.

name: Clinging to Life
summary: This life still holds much for you, and you aren’t ready to fall back into the River of Souls just yet.

name: I Sense Malevolence
summary: Your time in the River of Souls has given you deep insight into the machinations of those who refuse to move on.

name: Linguistic Revival
summary: You achieved fluency in different languages with each reincarnation, and your brain remembers much of the grammar, idioms, and obscenities that you spouted in old lives.

name: Pain is Temporary
summary: Sangpotshi practitioners know that suffering is a fleeting sensation that ultimately strengthens the soul and prepares it for a new reincarnation.

name: Stone Soul Siblings
summary: Your connection with nature’s spirits has progressed to the point where you can even have casual conversation with pebbles and boulders.

name: Unbreakable Resolve
summary: The experience of coming back after death has granted you a strong sense of resolve; devilish words, slick spells, and conniving trickery can’t easily catch you unprepared.

name: Boneyard Acquaintance
summary: Before your soul returned from death, you interacted with a host of other souls on their way to the Boneyard.

name: Indomitable Spirit
summary: Your soul has accumulated countless particles of quintessence over myriad deaths and rebirths, and for one moment, this raw material from the Great Beyond envelops you and your comrades.

name: Release the Light
trait: Light, Rare, Reincarnated, Universal Ancestry, Visual
summary: Many people report seeing a bright light before their death.

name: See You in Hell
summary: You aren’t sure if you’ll be reincarnated again, so you might as well take this foe with you.

name: This is What It's Like to Die
summary: It’s one thing to remember your previous lives.

name: Ancestral Mind
summary: By unraveling memories and connections passed down from your progenitors and buried within your unconscious mind, you learn to convert your inherent magic into psychic power.

name: Counter Thought
summary: When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own mental magic to disrupt it.

name: Mental Buffer
summary: Your mind deflects some amount of harm from attacks that induce pain or manipulate your mind directly.

name: Psychic Rapport
summary: Your telepathic sensitivity intensifies when you're affected by mental magic, making it easier for you to link to other creatures.

name: Mental Balm
summary: Your spells release soothing mental waves.

name: Psi Burst
summary: With a passing thought, you direct violent psychic energies at a nearby creature.

name: Warp Space
summary: You use your magic to bend space, causing your spell to strike from a strange vector.

name: Astral Tether
summary: You spin out a thread of psychic energy that connects you to an ally, using it as a conduit for your abilities.

name: Homing Beacon
summary: As your spell strikes a target, you plant a beacon in the target's mind that announces its presence to those nearby.

name: Psi Strikes
summary: You siphon residual psychic energies from your spell into one weapon you're wielding or one of your unarmed attacks.

name: Thoughtform Summoning
summary: You can create a prototypical creature from the depths of your imagination instead of calling one from elsewhere.

name: Violent Unleash
summary: The force of your mind unleashing itself releases a violent shock wave that batters your enemies.

name: Inertial Barrier
summary: Your spell leaves behind barriers that reduce shock and motion.

name: Parallel Breakthrough
summary: You expand your mind beyond your area of psychic specialty.

name: Sixth Sense
summary: Your psychic abilities also allow you to detect the lingering thoughts of spirits and similar entities.

name: Strain Mind
summary: You strain your body beyond its limits to use an amp even when your mental power is depleted.

name: Brain Drain
summary: With a wresting of will, you siphon off a creature's mental energy to replenish your own.

name: Dark Persona's Presence
summary: When you Unleash your Psyche, all your rage and pain—the portion of your psyche dedicated to cruel retribution—come along with it.

name: Mental Static
summary: Your thoughts sting back when a lesser mind tries to invade your own.

name: Remove Presence
summary: Your spell reaches into the mind of a creature and removes you from it.

name: Thoughtsense
summary: You can detect the flickers of mental activity let off by all thinking creatures.

name: Whispering Steps
summary: Your spell leaves a lingering connection between you and a creature—one through which you can nudge the creature's mind this way or that.

name: Dream Guise
summary: You Stride into a willing ally's space, at which point both of your appearances shift into a shared third appearance, usually one that looks like a mix of the two of you.

name: Emotional Surge
summary: Your heart soars, increasing your power for a moment.

name: Impose Order (Psychic)
summary: You bring discipline to your mind and magic, ensuring that you don't under-perform.

name: Scour the Library
summary: Seeing an enemy's attack, you quickly consult multiple scraps of lore in your mind, synthesizing them into the perfect plan.

name: Amp Focus
summary: You've glimpsed the furthest recesses of your mind.

name: Foreseen Failure
summary: You see your spell fail to take hold to disastrous end, then snap back to reality—it was all a precognition, and you know to try a different spell.

name: No!!!
summary: The shock of seeing your ally near death breaks whatever limits exist in your mind, sending your power spilling forth.

name: Psi Catastrophe
summary: You stop holding your power back, unleashing it all in a catastrophic blast.

name: Conscious Spell Specialization
summary: You become more adept with the spells that are always in your mind.

name: Deep Roots
summary: Your mind-control spells send burrowing mental roots that tear at your target's mind when they're removed or run their course.

name: Shatter Space
summary: The sheer power of your magic fractures reality.

name: Constant Levitation
summary: Your power has unbound you from the earth below.

name: Target of Psychic Ire
summary: Your magic saturates your surroundings with hateful psychic energy.

name: Wandering Thoughts
summary: When your Psyche is Unleashed, each burst of magic you cast also folds space around you, and you travel through one of those folds.

name: All in your Head
summary: Flames scouring at your body, venom coursing through your veins—you refuse to believe they exist, and nothing can affect you if you don't believe in it.

name: Cranial Detonation
summary: As your overwhelming psyche fells a creature, you use its flickering consciousness to detonate psychic energy from the creature's head.

name: Become Thought
summary: You shed some of your material form, becoming a being of pure thought.

name: Mind over Matter
summary: Your mind’s limits are only what you imagine them to be.

name: Twin Psyche
summary: You’ve segmented your psyche so it can operate in tandem.

name: Unlimited Potential
summary: The laws of magic can limit your mind only if you think you need them, and you've grown past the need for such limits.

name: Automatic Psychic Action
summary: Your power wants to be free.

name: Ammunition Thaumaturgy
summary: You're so used to handling your implement, weapon, and esoterica in the heat of combat that adding a few bullets or arrows to the mix is no extra burden.

name: Diverse Lore
summary: Your wandering studies mean you've heard rumors or theories about almost every topic.

name: Divine Disharmony
summary: From your collection of religious trinkets, you pull out opposing divine objects.

name: Haunt Ingenuity
summary: Your cunning knowledge grants you the ability to notice the emotional echo of a soul that passed on, leaving a haunt in its wake.

name: Root to Life
summary: Marigold, spider lily, pennyroyal—many primal traditions connect flowers and plants with the boundary between life and death, and you can leverage this association to keep an ally on this side of the line.

name: Scroll Thaumaturgy
summary: Your multidisciplinary study of magic means you know how to activate the magic in scrolls with ease.

name: Call Implement
summary: You can tug on the bonds of ownership between yourself and your implement, causing it to find its way back to you.

name: Esoteric Warden
summary: When you apply antithetical material against a creature successfully, you also ward yourself against its next attacks.

name: Talisman Esoterica
summary: You know how to assemble the supernatural objects in your esoterica into a number of temporary talismans.

name: Turn Away Misfortune
summary: You perform a superstition, such as casting salt over your shoulder to ward off bad luck.

name: Breached Defenses
summary: You can find the one weak point in a creature's scales, wards, or armor to get past its resistances.

name: Instructive Strike
summary: You attack your foe and analyze how it reacts.

name: Paired Link
summary: You break a trinket, such as a lodestone or jade pendant, in two, creating a sympathetic link between the halves that bridges distance.

name: Thaumaturgic Ritualist
summary: Your studies into the supernatural have resulted in an especially strong knowledge of rituals

name: One More Activation
summary: You've forged a deeper bond to your invested items, allowing you to activate them more than usual.

name: Scroll Esoterica
summary: Your esoterica includes scraps of scriptures, magic tomes, druidic markings, and the like, which you can use to create temporary scrolls.

name: Sympathetic Vulnerabilities
prerequisite: Exploit Vulnerability mortal weakness or personal antithesis
summary: When you apply your will to invoke a vulnerability, the result is more powerful, and the vulnerability ripples out in a web from your main target to affect a broader range of creatures.

name: Cursed Effigy
summary: After your attack, you grab a bit of blood, cut hair, or other piece of the creature's body.

name: Elaborate Talisman Esoterica
summary: As you continue to collect talismanic esoterica, you improve your ability to create temporary talismans.

name: Share Weakness
summary: You select an object from your esoterica that has great personal value to you, such as a locket or treasured ring, and you grant it to an adjacent ally, establishing a personal link that allows your ally to affect an enemy as if they were you.

name: Thaumaturge's Investiture
summary: Magical equipment and gear are the tools of your trade, and you know you need as many as possible to help you against the supernatural.

name: Twin Weakness
summary: As you make an attack augmented by your esoterica, you also press your implement against the creature, applying its weakness as your implement's energies sear the creature's flesh.

name: Elaborate Scroll Esoterica
summary: You've picked up more scraps of magic texts, improving your makeshift scrolls.

name: Intensify Investiture
summary: Your bond to your invested items enables you to put more of yourself into them.

name: Shared Warding
summary: You ward your allies from the attacks of your foes whenever you apply those protections to yourself.

name: Thaumaturge's Demesne
summary: You have claimed an area or location as your demesne, granting you the ability to ward and protect it.

name: Esoteric Reflexes
prerequisite: an implement that grants a reaction
summary: Reacting with an implement becomes instinct.

name: Grand Talisman Esoterica
summary: You've gained the ability to place multiple talismans on an item.

name: Trespass Teleportation
summary: You can hunt your foe to the ends of creation.

name: Implement's Flight
summary: By weakening your relation to the ground and strengthening your relation to the sky, you've learned to soar through the air, your implement carrying you as surely as any broomstick or pestle.

name: Seven-Part Link
summary: By exchanging pieces of a seven-part set of esoterica, you create a magical web by which your allies can affect each other at a distance.

name: Sever Magic
summary: You apply a frayed thread, a pinch of fulu ash, or a similar undone charm to your weapon, and swing to break a spell.

name: Grand Scroll Esoterica
summary: You've completed the third and final step in your assimilation of scroll esoterica, granting you daily scrolls of incredible power.

name: Implement's Assault
summary: Your implement supercharges your weapon to shoot an impossible volley or carve through your foes.

name: Intense Implement
summary: You have an exceptional link to your third implement.

name: Ubiquitous Weakness
summary: You've nurtured your bonds with your comrades, allowing you to share the benefits of your esoterica.

name: Unlimited Demesne
summary: You can move your demesne here and there, bringing it wherever your journey takes you.

name: Wonder Worker
prerequisite: Legendary in Arcana, Legendary in Nature, Legendary in Occultism, or Legendary in Religion
summary: The thaumaturge's path culminates with the working of wonders.

name: Psychic Dedication
summary: You feel something awaken within your mind

name: Basic Thoughtform
summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level psychic feat.

name: Basic Psychic Spellcasting
summary: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits.

name: Advanced Thoughtform
summary: You gain one psychic feat.

name: Psi Development
summary: You’ve found a new mental form

name: Expert Psychic Spellcasting
prerequisite: Basic Psychic Spellcasting; Master in Occultism
summary: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

name: Master Psychic Spellcasting
prerequisite: Expert Psychic Spellcasting; Legendary in Occultism
summary: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

name: Thaumaturge Dedication
summary: You've uncovered basic thaumaturgy.

name: Basic Thaumaturgy
summary: You gain a 1st- or 2nd-level thaumaturge feat of your choice.

name: Advanced Thaumaturgy
summary: You gain one thaumaturge feat.

name: Implement Initiate
summary: Mastery of an implement is the sign of a studied thaumaturge.

name: Magical Knowledge
prerequisite: Thaumaturge Dedication; trained in at least one of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion and expert in at least one other
summary: Increase your proficiency rank in one of Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion.

name: Resolute
summary: You've tempered your mind and become resolute against effects that strain your willpower.

name: Devil's Eye
prerequisite: You made a bargain with a devil or won a legal case or other similar duel of wits against a devil.
summary: Your experience in the finer points of bargaining with a devil has awakened a sinister power that now inhabits your left eye.

name: Echo of the Fallen
prerequisite: You helped to lay a haunt, ghost, or spirit to rest.
summary: With the utmost gratitude for your help in releasing them from their unearthly coil, a tiny sliver of a ghostly entity has remained attached to you.

name: Lingering Chill
prerequisite: You've been brought to 0 Hit Points by an enemy that has the cold trait or an enemy's ability that has the cold trait.
summary: The chill of ice entered your veins and never left, adjusting the internal temperature of your body.

name: Elysium's Cadence
prerequisite: You've partied extensively with an azata or entered a romantic relationship with an azata.
summary: You've been ensnared by an azata's infectious enthusiasm for life, love, and freedom.

name: Jelly Body
prerequisite: You've been reduced to 0 Hit Points while engulfed by an ooze.
summary: Some of the ooze that surrounded you made its way permanently into parts of your body, turning you soft to the touch and semitransparent enough to show bones.

name: Gift of the Hoard
prerequisite: You have succeeded at an important task given by a dragon, such as procuring a special treasure for their hoard.
summary: In pleasing the cravings of a mighty dragon, they have deigned to impart some of their magical essence into your body.

name: Siphon Life
prerequisite: You've been reduced to 0 Hit Points by an enemy with the void trait.
summary: Experiences with necromantic energy have left a permanent mark on you.

name: Petrified Skin
prerequisite: You have been petrified by an enemy.
summary: You were the target of some petrifying effect, and an element of that stony gaze has remained with you.

name: Dormant Eruption
prerequisite: You've been brought to 0 Hit Points by an enemy that has the fire trait or an enemy's ability that has the fire trait.
summary: A sweltering heat and sparks of flame that take the form of tiny copies of you surround your body.

name: Sink and Swim
prerequisite: You've been brought to 0 Hit Points by an enemy that has the water trait or an enemy's ability that has the water trait.
summary: Your body looks like it's made of flowing water, clear and pristine, providing a natural grace to all your movements

name: Fey Life
prerequisite: You helped to save a fey from a terrible fate, and you're not a fey.
summary: There are some fates worse than death–and you worked to save a fey from one such fate.

name: Walk on the Wind
prerequisite: You've been brought to 0 Hit Points by an enemy that has the air trait or an enemy's ability that has the air trait.
summary: A flighty breeze follows you wherever you go, granting a dramatic flair to everything you do.

name: Cryptic Spell
summary: You hide your magic in the croak of a frog, in the sway of the trees, in the howl of the wind, and the flicker of the will-o'- wisp.

name: Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
summary: With a bit of hide, some antlers, and some cast-off fur, you can create a disguise that will fool even an experienced hunter.

name: Can't You See?
prerequisite: Trained in Occultism; Expert in Stealth
summary: The eye rebels, the mind recoils—no matter how much those who can see you try to explain what's there, their friends' gazes just skitter over you, like a bird afraid to land.

name: Eerie Environs
prerequisite: Trained in Intimidation; Trained in Stealth
summary: The natural world can be scary to those not used to it—and you make it scarier still.

name: Eerie Traces
prerequisite: Trained in Intimidation; Trained in Survival
summary: The tracks you leave behind are strange, somehow disconcerting and unnerving—they might travel backward, or through places no one would think to pass through.

name: Forgotten Presence
summary: The world conspires to keep you forgotten and unnoticed— memories cloud, ink stains out your name in ledgers, and portraits of you crack and warp over your face.

name: Eerie Proclamation
trait: Auditory, Concentrate, Curse, Druid, Linguistic, Manipulate, Primal, Ranger, Uncommon
prerequisite: Expert in Occultism; Expert in Survival
summary: You know there are places in the world that are just wrong— places where the birds don't sing and where you always feel like you're being watched.

name: Obscured Emergence
summary: You are, by nature, a thing of gloomy woods and barren wilds, and when you choose show yourself, a bit of this gloom clings to you, obscuring your form with strange distortions or mist.

name: Bizarre Transformation
summary: The forms you take on defy belief—chimerical sights of twisted antlers or acidic drool.

name: Aura Sight
trait: Concentrate, Exploration, General, Secret, Skill, Uncommon
summary: You've learned how to read the natural auras of other living creatures.

name: Automatic Writing
summary: When confronted with the unknown, you can receive knowledge beyond your own experience via written messages delivered by your hand.

name: Chromotherapy
summary: You firmly believe in the technique of strengthening one's life force, spiritual energies, and bodily fluids through the application of colored light.

name: Crystal Healing
summary: You know how to stimulate a body's natural healing abilities through the application of resonant crystals.

name: Folk Dowsing
summary: You can find what you're looking for using a dowsing rod or pendulum.

name: Morphic Manipulation
trait: Exploration, General, Primal, Skill, Uncommon, Vitality
summary: You've attuned your natural aura to that of plant life, coaxing it to grow faster than normal.

name: Read Psychometric Resonance
trait: Concentrate, Emotion, Exploration, General, Mental, Occult, Skill, Uncommon
summary: With a touch, you can read the psychic impressions left on objects by their previous owners.

name: Skeptic's Defense
summary: You don't believe in any mental twaddle, and you're certainly not afraid of it.

name: Clone-Risen
summary: You were formed from a clone ritual or alchemical experiment.

name: Mirror-Risen
summary: You were created from magic involving mirrors and still retain some ability to seek refuge in reflected illusions.

name: Morph-Risen
summary: You were once a shapeshifter or spellcaster using polymorph magic, but something went wrong, and you became trapped in the form of the creature you were imitating.

name: Progenitor Lore
summary: You didn't just inherit your physical form from your progenitor; you also retained some of their knowledge.

name: Warped Reflection
summary: Due to your origins, your form is more flexible than most.

name: Mistaken Identity
summary: You feel a strong connection with your progenitor and can convince yourself an effect targeting your mind was meant for theirs instead.

name: Reflective Pocket
summary: You've formed a connection with a small hand mirror, allowing you to use it as an extradimensional storage space.

name: Replicate
summary: You've learned to reshape your malleable form.

name: Warp Likeness
summary: You channel some of your own nature through your blow, temporarily warping your target's form to resemble your own.

name: Mirror Refuge
summary: Your origin in the space behind mirrors enables you to use a mirror as a hideaway, like the spell one with stone.

name: Two-Truths
summary: Your ability to imitate your progenitor is so strong, you can even convince yourself.

name: Unyielding Disguise
prerequisite: ability to cast _humanoid form_ or _illusory disguise_
summary: When you cast _humanoid form_ or _illusory disguise_ to alter your appearance, the spell's duration is 2 hours

name: Malleable Form
prerequisite: ability to cast at least one polymorph spell
summary: You adroitly shift your form, taking on another appearance.

name: Redirect Attention
summary: Through your strong connection with your progenitor, you're able to redirect those attempting to spy on you.

name: Reflect Foe
summary: You create a copy of a foe by calling them forth from a nearby reflection.

name: Alter Ego Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Deception; Trained in Stealth
summary: You make yourself into a living mirror, becoming a double of someone unremarkable, and you slip into exactly the role that can get you past security or into a sensitive facility.

name: Change of Face
summary: You know that for the best disguise to work, one requires not only the right skills but also the right look—luckily you can copy both using special magical techniques.

name: Fake It Till You Make it
summary: When you take on a role, you become more capable with all sorts of tasks involving that role.

name: In Plain Sight
summary: People often only see what they want to see, a weakness you know how to take full advantage of.

name: Sound Mirror
summary: You twist not just the visual, but the auditory as well, allowing you to pass without a sound and create minor noises as distractions—perfect for misdirection and infiltration.

name: Muscle Mimicry
prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication; Trained in Athletics; Master in Deception
summary: Your study of another allows you to mirror their movements subtly, even in the heat of combat.

name: Swap Reflections
summary: You've learned how to use even your reflection to your advantage.

name: Borrow Memories
summary: Knowing how someone thinks makes it much easier to know where they'll be, or even replace them altogether.

name: Living Vessel Dedication
summary: Whether willingly or not, you've become a vessel for a being of unimaginable power.

name: Entity's Strike
summary: The more you try to force your body to stay yours, the more it warps to channel the energy flowing through you.

name: Tap Vitality
summary: You tap into the entity's life force to heal your wounds, though at the cost of the entity's personality bleeding into your own.

name: Exude Demonic Corruption
prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is a demon
summary: Most of the changes from the demon within you have harmed you so far, but you've found a way to expel some of the corruption within you to poison others.

name: Fey's Trickery
prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is a fey
summary: You connect with the fey trickster within yourself to momentarily vanish from sight.

name: Warped Constriction
prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is an aberration or outer entity
summary: The entity inhabiting your body is an aberrant being with unfathomable motivations, and when you hold a foe close, tendrils and tentacles unfurl from your body to crush your foe and pollute it with alien wrongness.

name: Vessel's Form
summary: You symbiotically combine your form with that of the entity within you, taking a powerful hybrid form to temporarily boost your abilities in combat while maintaining control.

name: Pactbinder Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy; Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
summary: The first step toward forming a successful pact is an understanding of the magic behind it, along with skill at negotiation.

name: Sociable Vow
summary: You can leverage your vow in more social interactions.

name: Pact of Fey Glamour
summary: You've sworn a pact with fey powers, granting you the otherworldly appearance of your dreams in exchange for oaths of hospitality.

name: Pact of Draconic Fury
summary: You've sworn a pact with a dragon, giving you the ability to tap into the dragon's immeasurable power in exchange for adding to their hoard.

name: Pact of Infernal Prowess
summary: You've sworn a pact with devils, granting you success in life in exchange for your soul in the afterlife.

name: Pact of the Final Breath
summary: You've sworn a pact with a powerful psychopomp—typically an olethros advocate or yamaraj judge—granting you a reprieve before your soul will be collected in exchange for respect for the dead and assistance against the undead.

name: Pact of Eldritch Eyes
summary: You've sworn a pact with an entity beyond mortal comprehension, granting you distant visions.

name: Curse Maelstrom Dedication
prerequisite: You are cursed or have previously been cursed.
summary: A horrible curse has left a lingering stain on your soul, and its effects continue to plague you even if the curse's other effects have ended.

name: Familiar Oddities
prerequisite: Curse Maelstrom Dedication; Trained in Occultism or Trained in Curse Lore
summary: Perhaps due to the curse within you, curses occasionally perceive you as an extension of themselves and readily reveal themselves to you

name: Unnerving Expansion
summary: You gather your curse around you and impel it to pour outward, expanding your maelstrom.

name: Share Burden
summary: You draw the misfortune or curse into yourself, potentially enabling you to enter your curse maelstrom state.

name: Accursed Magic
summary: When the curse within you spills out, you can lay curses on others and claim them for yourself with ease.

name: Counter Curse
summary: You gather the energy of your maelstrom and fling its unleashed power into the enemy's curse, attempting to neutralize it.

name: Torrential Backlash
summary: Calling upon forbidden practices, you release the curse from within yourself, allowing it free rein to destroy everything around you.

name: Reverse Curse
summary: When you counter a curse or misfortune effect, you send it back to destroy its originator.

name: Sacral Lord
prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion
summary: By right of ritual or sheer stubbornness, you have claimed rulership of the land.

name: Sacral Monarch
prerequisite: Sacral Lord; Master in Occultism or Master in Religion
summary: You have come into your full powers and are truly a monarch of your realm, by your own definition at least.

name: Time Mage Dedication
prerequisite: You have a spellcasting class feature.
summary: You might be a novice in the temporal arts now, but in the future, you'll hold time in the palm of your hand.

name: Chronocognizance
prerequisite: Time Mage Dedication; master in Perception
summary: The flows and ebbs of time are obvious to you, as are the tangles that form when it's distorted.

name: Chronomancer's Secrets
summary: The secrets of time peel back, revealing deeper truths.

name: Future Spell Learning
summary: More future memories of time magic percolate back to the present, teaching you spells you've yet to learn.

name: What Could Have Been
summary: Rather than conjuring creatures from elsewhere in the world or the planes, you can temporarily pull a much different version of yourself from an alternate timeline.

name: Into the Future
summary: You know your spell will be needed not now but in a few moments, so you cast your magic into the future.

name: Spell Acceleration
summary: Special time-weaving techniques let you compress your spellcasting gestures and incantations into a short burst so you can cast with incredible speed—though it causes temporal strain.

name: Purge of Moments
summary: All things eventually end, a truth that you can put into practice by accelerating your passage through time to shake off harmful effects.

name: Timeline-Splitting Spell
