summary: You invest in two futures, then choose the one to make a reality.

name: Chronoskimmer Dedication
summary: You became partially unstuck from time and have learned how to manipulate your place in the flow of time.

name: Turn Back the Clock
summary: After failing a test of skill, you hop back in your personal timeline so you can try again.

name: Guide the Timeline
summary: You know the result you want and subtly nudge the timeline to your intended destination.

name: Reversing Charge
summary: You dive into the fray before rewinding yourself to safety. Stride up to your Speed.

name: Superimpose Time Duplicates
summary: You call alternate versions of yourself, either from a different timeline or perhaps yourself from a different point in your current timeline, to aid you in combat.

name: Borrow Time
summary: You reach ahead and make use of time that's yet to be.

name: Steal Time
summary: You reach into another creature's timeline and attempt to alter their flow of time.

name: Combat Premonition
summary: By narrowing your sense of the future, you can improve that of your allies.

name: Escape Timeline
summary: You step outside of the flow of time momentarily, allowing you to avoid dangers.

name: Space-Time Shift
summary: You travel just a few moments into the future to immediately arrive at your destination.

name: Reset the Past
summary: You manipulate time to recharge one of your temporal techniques—by revising your past so you never used it in the first place.

name: Psychic Duelist Dedication
prerequisite: Trained in Occultism; you have been in a psychic duel
summary: Through experience and in-depth visualizations of mental battles, you've grown adept at psychic duels.

name: Duel Spell Advantage
summary: When you start a psychic duel, you gain a third natural psychic spell.

name: Supreme Psychic Center
summary: With the merest thought, you realign your mental defenses to your duel's circumstances.

name: Instigate Psychic Duel
summary: You attempt to enter a psychic duel with a creature.

name: Mind Smith Dedication
summary: You've learned to imagine a shape in your mind, to envision it so strongly it takes form in the material world.

name: Malleable Movement
prerequisite: Mind Smith Dedication; Expert in Athletics
summary: You shift the shape of your weapon to help you Leap farther and faster.

name: Ghost Blade
summary: You alter your weapon's phase so it can more easily strike incorporeal creatures.

name: Just the Tool
summary: You temporarily change your weapon's shape to assist you in the field.

name: Mental Forge
summary: Your experiences in combat shape your mind's capability to strengthen and shape your weapon to match the way you move in combat.

name: Mind Shards
summary: With a swing and a thought, you detonate your mind weapon into a burst of psychic shards that shred the mind.

name: Malleable Mental Forge
summary: You open your mind to further weapon customization.

name: Mind Projectiles
summary: You've learned to stretch your mind's influence further, releasing projectiles with a swing of your mind weapon.

name: Runic Mind Smithing
summary: You focus your mind on thoughtforms of fundamental magical forces, shaping them into a property rune that you mentally etch onto your mind weapon.

name: Metallic Envisionment
summary: You always account for every weakness, allowing your mind to imagine just the right physical form to take advantage of your opponents.

name: Advanced Runic Mind-Smithing
summary: Your mind can hold onto more complicated patterns than ever before.

name: Sleepwalker Dedication
summary: You've learned to manipulate states of consciousness, beginning with your own.

name: Infiltrate Dream
summary: Entering a dream is as natural to you as stepping through a doorway.

name: Vision of Foresight
summary: You use your daydreams to predict the success of actions, rapidly envisioning the possibilities.

name: Dream Magic
summary: You learn dream-related magic to aid your studies.

name: Waking Dream
summary: While in your trance, you can blur the line between dreams and reality for others.

name: Oneiric Influence
summary: While Infiltrating a Dream, you can also implant a suggestion in the target's mind.

name: Ward Slumber
summary: Just before going to sleep, you can perform a 10-minute ward to protect the slumber of up to eight creatures within 30 feet of you.

name: Dream Logic
summary: You can transmit a sense of dreamy nonchalance.

name: Shared Dream
summary: You've learned to create a shared dreamscape to communicate with others.

name: Ever Dreaming
summary: You draw no distinction between the sleeping and waking worlds.

name: Trance of Celerity
summary: Your feet move faster, almost out of your conscious control.

name: On Borrowed Time
summary: You accelerate a foe's personal timestream, which causes them to experience time at a faster rate, putting a terrible strain on their mind and body.

name: Firework Technician Dedication
summary: You’ve learned the secrets of making fire and sound bloom using black powder, metals, and paper.
source: Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 134, Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 134

name: Coughing Dragon Display
summary: This display emits a cascade of loud bangs or glittering trails.
source: Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 134, Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 134

name: Expert Fireworks Crafter
prerequisite: Firework Technician Dedication; Expert in Crafting
summary: You’re particularly adept at crafting fireworks, allowing you to create more fireworks than you otherwise could.
source: Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 135, Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 134

name: Jumping Jenny Display
summary: This multi-sequence rocket blasts confetti at a series of altitudes.
source: Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 135, Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 134

name: Goblin Jubilee Display
summary: Flames and explosions sear the air in a riot of color and devastation that rivals that wrought by even the wildest goblin party.
source: Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 135, Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 134

name: Banshee Cry Display
summary: You’ve learned how to unleash a sudden and disruptive noisemaker at just the right moment in your display, a technique that can cause a spellcaster to fumble the phrasing of their magic
source: Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 135, Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 134

name: Hellbreaker Dedication
summary: By joining the League, you’ve taken on the responsibilities of a Hellbreaker.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 216, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 8

name: Devil you Know
prerequisite: Hellbreaker Dedication; Expert in Devil Lore or Expert in Hellknight Lore
summary: Your knowledge of your enemies gives you an advantage against them, granting you a swift reaction to their devilry.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 216, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 8

name: Hellbreaker's Resolve
summary: You gird yourself in both mind and body for danger, steeling your resolve.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 216, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 8

name: High Alert
summary: You're constantly on guard, keeping watch over your allies against fiendish forces—no one can get the jump on your group while you're around.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 216, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 8

name: Oppurtune Trickster
summary: You aren’t above using underhanded tactics to gain an advantage, easily routing your opponents when they attack.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 217, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 9

name: Hell's Bane
summary: Your in-depth knowledge of your foes grants you insight into their weaknesses, granting you an advantage when fighting against them.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 217, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 9

name: Rend Armor
summary: Your enemies' defenses are no match for you as you wrench your weapon to compromise their armor.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 217, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 9

name: Battle Scars
summary: You've faced enough opponents that your experience is written across your skin, toughening you against your fiendish foes.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 217, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 9

name: Defy Hell
summary: Your devotion to your cause gives you endless strength and courage to withstand the enemy's attacks.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 217, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 9

name: Return to the Pit!
summary: You can send the fiends who have vexed you back to their home plane where they belong.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 217, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 9

name: Thorn in Hell's Side
summary: Your devotion to the ideals of justice, freedom, and revolution allow you to truly punish those who stand in your way.
source: Pathfinder #222: Hellbreakers pg. 217, Hellbreakers Players Guide pg. 9
